wlc: וְאַל־תַּסְתֵּר פָּנֶיךָ מֵעַבְדֶּךָ כִּי־צַר־לִי מַהֵר עֲנֵנִי ׃
kjv: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.

wlc: קָרְבָה אֶל־נַפְשִׁי גְאָלָהּ לְמַעַן אֹיְבַי פְּדֵנִי ׃
kjv: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries are all before thee.

wlc: אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ חֶרְפָּתִי וּבָשְׁתִּי וּכְלִמָּתִי נֶגְדְּךָ כָּל־צוֹרְרָי ׃
kjv: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.

wlc: חֶרְפָּה שָׁבְרָה לִבִּי וָאָנוּשָׁה וָאֲקַוֶּה לָנוּד וָאַיִן וְלַמְנַחֲמִים וְלֹא מָצָאתִי ׃
kjv: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

wlc: וַיִּתְּנוּ בְּבָרוּתִי רֹאשׁ וְלִצְמָאִי יַשְׁקוּנִי חֹמֶץ ׃
kjv: Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.

wlc: יְהִי־שֻׁלְחָנָם לִפְנֵיהֶם לְפָח וְלִשְׁלוֹמִים לְמוֹקֵשׁ ׃
kjv: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.

wlc: תֶּחְשַׁכְנָה עֵינֵיהֶם מֵרְאוֹת וּמָתְנֵיהֶם תָּמִיד הַמְעַד ׃
kjv: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.

wlc: שְׁפָךְ־עֲלֵיהֶם זַעְמֶךָ וַחֲרוֹן אַפְּךָ יַשִּׂיגֵם ׃
kjv: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.

wlc: תְּהִי־טִירָתָם נְשַׁמָּה בְּאָהֳלֵיהֶם אַל־יְהִי יֹשֵׁב ׃
kjv: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.

wlc: כִּי־אַתָּה אֲשֶׁר־הִכִּיתָ רָדָפוּ וְאֶל־מַכְאוֹב חֲלָלֶיךָ יְסַפֵּרוּ ׃
kjv: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.

wlc: תְּנָה־עָוֹן עַל־עֲוֹנָם וְאַל־יָבֹאוּ בְּצִדְקָתֶךָ ׃
kjv: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.

wlc: יִמָּחוּ מִסֵּפֶר חַיִּים וְעִם צַדִּיקִים אַל־יִכָּתֵבוּ ׃
kjv: But I am poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.

wlc: וַאֲנִי עָנִי וְכוֹאֵב יְשׁוּעָתְךָ אֱלֹהִים תְּשַׂגְּבֵנִי ׃
kjv: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

wlc: אֲהַלְלָה שֵׁם־אֱלֹהִים בְּשִׁיר וַאֲגַדְּלֶנּוּ בְתוֹדָה ׃
kjv: This also shall please the Lord better than an ox or bullock that hath horns and hoofs.

wlc: וְתִיטַב לַיהוָה מִשּׁוֹר פָּר מַקְרִן מַפְרִיס ׃
kjv: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.

wlc: רָאוּ עֲנָוִים יִשְׂמָחוּ דֹּרְשֵׁי אֱלֹהִים וִיחִי לְבַבְכֶם ׃
kjv: For the Lord heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.

wlc: כִּי־שֹׁמֵעַ אֶל־אֶבְיוֹנִים יְהוָה וְאֶת־אֲסִירָיו לֹא בָזָה ׃
kjv: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein.

wlc: יְהַלְלוּהוּ שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ יַמִּים וְכָל־רֹמֵשׂ בָּם ׃
kjv: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.

wlc: כִּי אֱלֹהִים יוֹשִׁיעַ צִיּוֹן וְיִבְנֶה עָרֵי יְהוּדָה וְיָשְׁבוּ שָׁם וִירֵשׁוּהָ ׃
kjv: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.

wlc: וְזֶרַע עֲבָדָיו יִנְחָלוּהָ וְאֹהֲבֵי שְׁמוֹ יִשְׁכְּנוּ־בָהּ ׃
לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִד לְהַזְכִּיר ׃
lxx: Τῷ Δαυείδ, υἱῶν Ἰωναδὰβ καὶ τῶν πρώτων αἰχμαλωτισθέντων. θεός, ἐπὶ σοὶ ἥλπισα, μὴ καταισχυνθείην εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.
vulg: David psalmus filiorum Ionadab et priorum captivorum in te Domine speravi non confundar in aeternum
clem: Psalmus David, filiorum Jonadab, et priorum captivorum. [In te, Domine, speravi; non confundar in ternum.
kjv: Make haste, o God, to deliver me; make haste to help me, O Lord.

wlc: אֱלֹהִים לְהַצִּילֵנִי יְהוָה לְעֶזְרָתִי חוּשָׁה ׃
lxx: ἐν τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ σου ῥῦσαί με καὶ ἐξελοῦ με, κλῖνον πρὸς μὲ τὸ οὖς σου καὶ σῶσόν με.
vulg: in iustitia tua libera me et eripe me inclina ad me aurem tuam et salva me
clem: In justitia tua libera me, et eripe me: inclina ad me aurem tuam, et salva me.
kjv: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.

wlc: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ מְבַקְשֵׁי נַפְשִׁי יִסֹּגוּ אָחוֹר וְיִכָּלְמוּ חֲפֵצֵי רָעָתִי ׃
lxx: γενοῦ μοι εἰς θεὸν ὑπερασπιστήν, εἰς τόπον ὀχυρὸν τοῦ σῶσαί με· ὅτι στερέωμά μου καὶ καταφυγή μου εἶ σύ.
vulg: esto mihi in Deum protectorem et in locum munitum ut salvum me facias quoniam firmamentum meum et refugium meum es tu
clem: Esto mihi in Deum protectorem, et in locum munitum, ut salvum me facias: quoniam firmamentum meum et refugium meum es tu.
kjv: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.

wlc: יָשׁוּבוּ עַל־עֵקֶב בָּשְׁתָּם הָאֹמְרִים הֶאָח הֶאָח ׃
lxx: ὁ θεός, ῥῦσαί με ἐκ χειρὸς ἁμαρτωλοῦ, ἐκ χειρὸς παρανομοῦντος καὶ ἀδικοῦντος·
vulg: Deus meus eripe me de manu peccatoris de manu contra legem agentis et iniqui
clem: Deus meus, eripe me de manu peccatoris, et de manu contra legem agentis, et iniqui:
kjv: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.

wlc: יָשִׂישׂוּ וְיִשְׂמְחוּ בְּךָ כָּל־מְבַקְשֶׁיךָ וְיֹאמְרוּ תָמִיד יִגְדַּל אֱלֹהִים אֹהֲבֵי יְשׁוּעָתֶךָ ׃
lxx: ὅτι σὺ εἶ ἡ ὑπομονή μου, κύριε· Κύριος ἡ ἐλπίς μου ἐκ νεότητός μου.
vulg: quoniam tu es patientia mea Domine Domine spes mea a iuventute mea
clem: quoniam tu es patientia mea, Domine; Domine, spes mea a juventute mea.
kjv: But I am poor and needy: make haste unto me, O God: thou art my help and my deliverer; O Lord, make no tarrying.

wlc: וַאֲנִי עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן אֱלֹהִים חוּשָׁה־לִּי עֶזְרִי וּמְפַלְטִי אַתָּה יְהוָה אַל־תְּאַחַר ׃
lxx: ἐπὶ σὲ ἐπεστηρίχθην ἀπὸ γαστρός, ἐκ κοιλίας μητρός μου σύ μου εἶ σκεπαστής· ἐν σοὶ ἡ ὕμνησίς μου διὰ παντός.
vulg: in te confirmatus sum ex utero de ventre matris meae tu es protector meus in te cantatio mea semper
clem: In te confirmatus sum ex utero; de ventre matris me tu es protector meus; in te cantatio mea semper.

lxx: ὡσεὶ τέρας ἐγενήθην τοῖς πολλοῖς, καὶ σὺ βοηθὸς κραταιός.
vulg: tamquam prodigium factus sum multis et tu adiutor fortis
clem: Tamquam prodigium factus sum multis; et tu adjutor fortis.

lxx: πληρωθήτω τὸ στόμα μου αἰνέσεως. ὅπως ὑμνήσω τὴν δόξαν σου, ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν τὴν μεγαλοπρεπίαν σου.
vulg: repleatur os meum laude ut cantem gloriam tuam tota die magnitudinem tuam
clem: Repleatur os meum laude, ut cantem gloriam tuam, tota die magnitudinem tuam.

lxx: μὴ ἀπορίψῃς με εἰς καιρὸν γήρους. ἐν τῷ ἐκλιπεῖν τὴν ἰσχύν μου μὴ ἐνκαταλίπῃς με.
vulg: non proicias me in tempore senectutis cum deficiet virtus mea ne derelinquas me
clem: Ne projicias me in tempore senectutis; cum defecerit virtus mea, ne derelinquas me.

lxx: ὅτι εἶπαν οἱ ἐχθροί μου ἐμοί. καὶ οἱ φυλάσσοντες τὴν ψυχήν μου ἐβουλεύσαντο ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό,
vulg: quia dixerunt inimici mei mihi et qui custodiebant animam meam consilium fecerunt in unum
clem: Quia dixerunt inimici mei mihi, et qui custodiebant animam meam consilium fecerunt in unum,

lxx: λέγοντες Ὁ θεὸς ἐνκατέλιπεν αὐτόν· καταδιώξατε καὶ καταλάβετε αὐτόν, ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ ῥυόμενος.
vulg: dicentes Deus dereliquit eum persequimini et conprehendite eum quia non est qui eripiat
clem: dicentes: Deus dereliquit eum: persequimini et comprehendite eum, quia non est qui eripiat.

lxx: ὁ θεός. μὴ μακρύνῃς ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ,
vulg: Deus ne elongeris a me Deus meus in adiutorium meum respice
clem: Deus, ne elongeris a me; Deus meus, in auxilium meum respice.

lxx: αἰσχυνθήτωσαν καὶ ἐκλιπέτωσαν οἱ ἐνδιαβάλλοντες τὴν ψυχήν μου, περιβαλέσθωσαν αἰσχύνην καὶ ἐντροπὴν οἱ ζητοῦντες τὰ κακά μοι.
vulg: confundantur et deficiant detrahentes animae meae operiantur confusione et pudore qui quaerunt mala mihi
clem: Confundantur et deficiant detrahentes anim me; operiantur confusione et pudore qui qurunt mala mihi.

lxx: ἐγὼ δὲ διὰ παντὸς ἐλπιῶ. καὶ προσθήσω ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν αἴνεσίν σου.
vulg: ego autem semper sperabo et adiciam super omnem laudem tuam
clem: Ego autem semper sperabo, et adjiciam super omnem laudem tuam.

lxx: τὸ στόμα μου ἐξαγγελεῖ τὴν δικαιοσύνην σου, ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν τὴν σαοτηρίαν σου. ὅτι οὐκ ἔγνων πραγματίας.
vulg: os meum adnuntiabit iustitiam tuam tota die salutem tuam quoniam non cognovi litteraturam
clem: Os meum annuntiabit justitiam tuam, tota die salutare tuum. Quoniam non cognovi litteraturam,

lxx: ηἰσελεύσομαι ἐν δυναστίᾳ Κυρίου· Κύριε, μνησθήσομαι τῆς δικαιοσύνης σου μόνου.
vulg: introibo in potentiam Domini Domine memorabor iustitiae tuae solius
clem: introibo in potentias Domini; Domine, memorabor justiti tu solius.

lxx: ἐδίδαξάς με, ὁ θεός, ἐκ νεότητός μου, καὶ μέχρι νῦν ἀναγγελῶ τὰ θαυμαάσιά σου,
vulg: Deus docuisti me ex iuventute mea et usque nunc pronuntiabo mirabilia tua
clem: Deus, docuisti me a juventute mea; et usque nunc pronuntiabo mirabilia tua.

lxx: καὶ ἕως γήρους καὶ πρεσβείου· ὁ θεός, μὴ ἐνκαταλίπῃς με ἕως ἂν ἀπαγγείλω τὸν βραχίονά σου πάσῃ τῇ γενεᾷ τῇ ἐρχομένῃ. τὴν δυναστίαν σου
vulg: et usque in senectam et senium Deus ne derelinquas me donec adnuntiem brachium tuum generationi omni quae ventura est potentiam tuam
clem: Et usque in senectam et senium, Deus, ne derelinquas me, donec annuntiem brachium tuum generationi omni qu ventura est, potentiam tuam,

lxx: καὶ τὴν δικαιοσύνην σου, ὁ θεός, ἕως ὑψίστων, ἃ ἐποίησας μεγαλεῖα. ὁ θεός, τίς ὅμοιός σοι ;
vulg: et iustitiam tuam Deus usque in altissima quae fecisti magnalia Deus quis similis tibi
clem: et justitiam tuam, Deus, usque in altissima; qu fecisti magnalia, Deus: quis similis tibi?

lxx: ὅτι ἔδειξάς μοι θλίψεις πολλὰς καὶ κακά, καὶ ἐπιστρέψας ἐζωοποίησας με, καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἀβύσσων τῆς γῆς πάλιν ἀνήγαγές με,
vulg: quantas ostendisti mihi tribulationes multas et malas et conversus vivificasti me et de abyssis terrae iterum reduxisti me
clem: Quantas ostendisti mihi tribulationes multas et malas! et conversus vivificasti me, et de abyssis terr iterum reduxisti me.

lxx: πλεονάσας τὴν δικαιοσύνην σου. καὶ ἐπιστρέψας παρεκάλεσάς με, καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἀβύσσων πάλιν ἀνήγαγές με.
vulg: multiplicasti magnificentiam tuam et conversus consolatus es me
clem: Multiplicasti magnificentiam tuam; et conversus consolatus es me.

lxx: καὶ γὰρ ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι ἐν σκεύει ψαλμοῦ τὴν ἀλήθειάν ψαλῶ σοι, ὁ θεός, ἐν κιθάρᾳ, ὁ ἅγιος τοῦ Ἰσραήλ.
vulg: nam et ego confitebor tibi in vasis psalmi veritatem tuam Deus psallam tibi in cithara Sanctus Israhel
clem: Nam et ego confitebor tibi in vasis psalmi veritatem tuam, Deus; psallam tibi in cithara, sanctus Isral.

lxx: ἀγαλλιάσονται τὰ χείλη μου ὅταν ψάλω σοι, καὶ ἡ ψυχή μου ἣν ἐλυτρώσω.
vulg: exultabunt labia mea cum cantavero tibi et anima mea quam redemisti
clem: Exsultabunt labia mea cum cantavero tibi; et anima mea quam redemisti.

lxx: ἔτι δὲ καὶ ἡ γλῶσσά μου ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν μελετήσει τὴν δικαιοσύυην σου, ὅταν αἰσχυνθῶσιν καὶ ἐντραπῶσιν οἱ ζητοῦντες τὰ κακά μοι.
vulg: sed et lingua mea tota die meditabitur iustitiam tuam cum confusi et reveriti fuerint qui quaerunt mala mihi
clem: Sed et lingua mea tota die meditabitur justitiam tuam, cum confusi et reveriti fuerint qui qurunt mala mihi.]

wlc: בְּךָ־יְהוָה חָסִיתִי אַל־אֵבוֹשָׁה לְעוֹלָם ׃
lxx: Ὁ θεός, τὸ κρίμα σου τῷ βασιλεῖ δός, καὶ τὴν δικαιοσύνην σου τῷ υἱῷ τοῦ βασιλέως,
vulg: in Salomonem
clem: Psalmus, in Salomonem.
kjv: In thee, O Lord, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.

wlc: בְּצִדְקָתְךָ תַּצִּילֵנִי וּתְפַלְּטֵנִי הַטֵּה־אֵלַי אָזְנְךָ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנִי ׃
lxx: κρίνειν τὸν λαόν σου ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ τοὺς πταοχούς σου ἐν κρίσει.
vulg: Deus iudicium tuum regi da et iustitiam tuam filio regis iudicare populum tuum in iustitia et pauperes tuos in iudicio
clem: [Deus, judicium tuum regi da, et justitiam tuam filio regis; judicare populum tuum in justitia, et pauperes tuos in judicio.
kjv: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline thine ear unto me, and save me.

wlc: הֱיֵה לִי לְצוּר מָעוֹן לָבוֹא תָּמִיד צִוִּיתָ לְהוֹשִׁיעֵנִי כִּי־סַלְעִי וּמְצוּדָתִי אָתָּה ׃
lxx: ἀναλαβέτω τὰ ὄρη εἰρήνην τῷ λαῷ σου καὶ οἱ βουνοί
vulg: suscipiant montes pacem populo et colles iustitiam
clem: Suscipiant montes pacem populo, et colles justitiam.
kjv: Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou art my rock and my fortress.

wlc: אֱלֹהַי פַּלְּטֵנִי מִיַּד רָשָׁע מִכַּף מְעַוֵּל וְחוֹמֵץ ׃
lxx: ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ κρινεῖ τοὺς πτωχοὺς τοῦ λαοῦ· καὶ σώσεις τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν πενήταων, καὶ ταπεινώσει συκοβάντην·
vulg: iudicabit pauperes populi et salvos faciet filios pauperum et humiliabit calumniatorem
clem: Judicabit pauperes populi, et salvos faciet filios pauperum, et humiliabit calumniatorem.
kjv: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

wlc: כִּי־אַתָּה תִקְוָתִי אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה מִבְטַחִי מִנְּעוּרָי ׃
lxx: καὶ συνπαραμενεί τῷ ἡλίῳ, καὶ πρὸ τῆς σελήνης γενεὰς γενεῶν.
vulg: et permanebit cum sole et ante lunam generationes generationum
clem: Et permanebit cum sole, et ante lunam, in generatione et generationem.
kjv: For thou art my hope, O Lord God: thou art my trust from my youth.

wlc: עָלֶיךָ נִסְמַכְתִּי מִבֶּטֶן מִמְּעֵי אִמִּי אַתָּה גוֹזִי בְּךָ תְהִלָּתִי תָמִיד ׃
lxx: καὶ καταβήσεται ὡς ὑετὸς ἐπὶ πόκον, καὶ ὡσεὶ σταγόνες στάζουσαι ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν.
vulg: descendet sicut pluvia in vellus et sicut stillicidia stillantia super terram
clem: Descendet sicut pluvia in vellus, et sicut stillicidia stillantia super terram.
kjv: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother's bowels: my praise shall be continually of thee.

wlc: כְּמוֹפֵת הָיִיתִי לְרַבִּים וְאַתָּה מַחֲסִי־עֹז ׃
lxx: ἀνατελεῖ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις αὐτοῦ δικαιοσύνη, καὶ πλῆθος εἰρήνης ἕως οὗ ἀνταναιρεθῇ ἡ σελήνη.
vulg: orietur in diebus eius iustitia et abundantia pacis donec auferatur luna
clem: Orietur in diebus ejus justitia, et abundantia pacis, donec auferatur luna.
kjv: I am as a wonder unto many; but thou art my strong refuge.

wlc: יִמָּלֵא פִי תְּהִלָּתֶךָ כָּל־הַיּוֹם תִּפְאַרְתֶּךָ ׃
lxx: καὶ κατακυριεύσει ἀπὸ θαλάσσης ἕως θαλάσσης, καὶ ἀπὸ ποταμοῦ ἕως περάτων τῆς οἰκουμένης.
vulg: et dominabitur a mari usque ad mare et a flumine usque ad terminos orbis terrarum
clem: Et dominabitur a mari usque ad mare, et a flumine usque ad terminos orbis terrarum.
kjv: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day.

wlc: אַל־תַּשְׁלִיכֵנִי לְעֵת זִקְנָה כִּכְלוֹת כֹּחִי אַל־תַּעַזְבֵנִי ׃
lxx: ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ προπεσοῦνται Αἰθίοπες, καὶ οἱ ἐχθροὶ αὐτοῦ χοῦν λίξουσιν·
vulg: coram illo procident Aethiopes et inimici eius terram lingent
clem: Coram illo procident thiopes, et inimici ejus terram lingent.
kjv: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.

wlc: כִּי־אָמְרוּ אוֹיְבַי לִי וְשֹׁמְרֵי נַפְשִׁי נוֹעֲצוּ יַחְדָּו ׃
lxx: βασιλεῖς Θαρσεὶς καὶ αἱ νῆσοι δῶρα προσοίσουσιν. βασιλεῖς Ἀράβων καὶ Σαβὰ δῶρα προσάξουσιν·
vulg: reges Tharsis et insulae munera offerent reges Arabum et Saba dona adducent
clem: Reges Tharsis et insul munera offerent; reges Arabum et Saba dona adducent:
kjv: For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,

wlc: לֵאמֹר אֱלֹהִים עֲזָבוֹ רִדְפוּ וְתִפְשׂוּהוּ כִּי־אֵין מַצִּיל ׃
lxx: καὶ προσκυνήσουσιν αὐτῷ πάντες οἱ βασιλεῖς, πάντα τὰ ἔθνη δουλεύσουσιν αὐτῷ.
vulg: et adorabunt eum omnes reges omnes gentes servient ei
clem: et adorabunt eum omnes reges terr; omnes gentes servient ei.
kjv: Saying, God hath forsaken him: persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him.

wlc: אֱלֹהִים אַל־תִּרְחַק מִמֶּנִּי אֱלֹהַי לְעֶזְרָתִי חִישָׁה ׃
lxx: ὅτι ἐρύσατο πτωχὸν ἐκ χειρὸς δυνάστου, καὶ πένητα ᾦ οὐχ ὑπῆρχεν βοηθόςφείσεται
vulg: quia liberavit pauperem a potente et pauperem cui non erat adiutor
clem: Quia liberabit pauperem a potente, et pauperem cui non erat adjutor.
kjv: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.

wlc: יֵבֹשׁוּ יִכְלוּ שֹׂטְנֵי נַפְשִׁי יַעֲטוּ חֶרְפָּה וּכְלִמָּה מְבַקְשֵׁי רָעָתִי ׃
lxx: πτωχοῦ καὶ πένητος, καὶ ψυχὰς πενήτων σώσει·
vulg: parcet pauperi et inopi et animas pauperum salvas faciet
clem: Parcet pauperi et inopi, et animas pauperum salvas faciet.
kjv: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.

wlc: וַאֲנִי תָּמִיד אֲיַחֵל וְהוֹסַפְתִּי עַל־כָּל־תְּהִלָּתֶךָ ׃
lxx: ἐκ τόκου καὶ ἐξ ἀδικίας λυτρώσεται τὰς ψυχὰς αὐτῶν. καὶ ἔντιμον τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῶν ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ.
vulg: ex usuris et iniquitate redimet animas eorum et honorabile nomen eorum coram illo
clem: Ex usuris et iniquitate redimet animas eorum, et honorabile nomen eorum coram illo.
kjv: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.

wlc: פִּי יְסַפֵּר צִדְקָתֶךָ כָּל־הַיּוֹם תְּשׁוּעָתֶךָ כִּי לֹא יָדַעְתִּי סְפֹרוֹת ׃
lxx: καὶ ζήσεται καὶ δοθήσεται αὐτῷ ἐκ τοῦ χρυσίου τῆς Ἀραβίας, καὶ προσεύξονται περὶ αὐτοῦ διὰ παντός, ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν εὐλογήσουσιν αὐτόν.
vulg: et vivet et dabitur ei de auro Arabiae et orabunt de ipso semper tota die benedicent ei
clem: Et vivet, et dabitur ei de auro Arabi; et adorabunt de ipso semper, tota die benedicent ei.
kjv: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness and thy salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers thereof.

wlc: אָבוֹא בִּגְבֻרוֹת אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה אַזְכִּיר צִדְקָתְךָ לְבַדֶּךָ ׃
lxx: ἔσται στήριγμα ἐν τῇ γῇ ἐπʼ ἄκρων τῶν ὀρέων· ὑπεραρθήσεται ὑπέρ τὸν Λίβανον ὁ καρπὸς αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐξανθήσουσιν ἐκ πόλεως ὡσεὶ χόρτος τῆς γῆς.
vulg: erit firmamentum in terra in summis montium superextolletur super Libanum fructus eius et florebunt de civitate sicut faenum terrae
clem: Et erit firmamentum in terra in summis montium; superextolletur super Libanum fructus ejus, et florebunt de civitate sicut fnum terr.
kjv: I will go in the strength of the Lord God: I will make mention of thy righteousness, even of thine only.

wlc: אֱלֹהִים לִמַּדְתַּנִי מִנְּעוּרָי וְעַד־הֵנָּה אַגִּיד נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ ׃
lxx: ἔστω τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ εὐλογημένον εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας, πρὸ τοῦ ἡλίου διαμενεῖ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ· καὶ εὐλογηθήσονται ἐν αὐτῷ πᾶσαι αἱ φυλαὶ τῆς γῆς. πάντα τὰ ἔθνη μακαριοῦσιν αὐτόν.
vulg: sit nomen eius benedictum in saecula ante solem permanet nomen eius et benedicentur in ipso omnes tribus terrae omnes gentes beatificabunt eum
clem: Sit nomen ejus benedictum in scula; ante solem permanet nomen ejus. Et benedicentur in ipso omnes tribus terr; omnes gentes magnificabunt eum.
kjv: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.

wlc: וְגַם עַד־זִקְנָה וְשֵׂיבָה אֱלֹהִים אַל־תַּעַזְבֵנִי עַד־אַגִּיד זְרוֹעֲךָ לְדוֹר לְכָל־יָבוֹא גְּבוּרָתֶךָ ׃
lxx: εὐλογητὸς Κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ἰσραήλ, ὁ ποιῶν θαυμάσια μόνος,
vulg: benedictus Dominus Deus Deus Israhel qui facit mirabilia solus
clem: Benedictus Dominus Deus Isral, qui facit mirabilia solus.
kjv: Now also when I am old and greyheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have shewed thy strength unto this generation, and thy power to every one that is to come.

wlc: וְצִדְקָתְךָ אֱלֹהִים עַד־מָרוֹם אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂיתָ גְדֹלוֹת אֱלֹהִים מִי כָמוֹךָ ׃
lxx: καὶ εὐλογητὸν τὸ ὄνομα τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος· καὶ πληρωθήσεται τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ πᾶσα ἡ γῆ. γένοιτο, γένοιτο.
vulg: et benedictum nomen maiestatis eius in aeternum et replebitur maiestate eius omnis terra fiat fiat
clem: Et benedictum nomen majestatis ejus in ternum, et replebitur majestate ejus omnis terra. Fiat, fiat.]
kjv: Thy righteousness also, O God, is very high, who hast done great things: O God, who is like unto thee!

wlc: אֲשֶׁר הִרְאִיתַנִוּ צָרוֹת רַבּוֹת וְרָעוֹת תָּשׁוּב תְּחַיֵּינִו וּמִתְּהֹמוֹת הָאָרֶץ תָּשׁוּב תַּעֲלֵנִי ׃
lxx: Ἐξέλιπον οἱ δμνοι Δαυεὶδ τοῦ υἱοῦ Ἰεσσαί.
vulg: defecerunt laudes David filii Iesse
clem: Defecerunt laudes David, filii Jesse.
kjv: Thou, which hast shewed me great and sore troubles, shalt quicken me again, and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth.

wlc: תֶּרֶב גְּדֻלָּתִי וְתִסֹּב תְּנַחֲמֵנִי ׃
kjv: Thou shalt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.

wlc: גַּם־אֲנִי אוֹדְךָ בִכְלִי־נֶבֶל אֲמִתְּךָ אֱלֹהָי אֲזַמְּרָה לְךָ בְכִנּוֹר קְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל ׃
kjv: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, even thy truth, O my God: unto thee will I sing with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.

wlc: תְּרַנֵּנָּה שְׂפָתַי כִּי אֲזַמְּרָה־לָּךְ וְנַפְשִׁי אֲשֶׁר פָּדִיתָ ׃
kjv: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.

wlc: גַּם־לְשׁוֹנִי כָּל־הַיּוֹם תֶּהְגֶּה צִדְקָתֶךָ כִּי־בֹשׁוּ כִי־חָפְרוּ מְבַקְשֵׁי רָעָתִי ׃
lxx: Εἰς Σολομών.
kjv: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.

wlc: לִשְׁלֹמֹה אֱלֹהִים מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ לְמֶלֶךְ תֵּן וְצִדְקָתְךָ לְבֶן־מֶלֶךְ ׃
lxx: Ὡς ἀγαθὸς τῷ Ἰσραὴλ ὁ θεός, τοῖς εὐθέσι τῇ καρδίᾳ.
vulg: psalmus Asaph quam bonus Israhel Deus his qui recto sunt corde
clem: Psalmus Asaph. [Quam bonus Isral Deus, his qui recto sunt corde!
kjv: Give the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness unto the king's son.

wlc: יָדִין עַמְּךָ בְצֶדֶק וַעֲנִיֶּיךָ בְמִשְׁפָּט ׃
lxx: ἐμοῦ δὲ παρὰ μικρὸν ἐσαλεύθησαν οἱ πόδες, παρʼ ὀλίγον ἐξεχύθη τὰ διαβήματά μου.
vulg: mei autem paene moti sunt pedes paene effusi sunt gressus mei
clem: Mei autem pene moti sunt pedes, pene effusi sunt gressus mei:
kjv: He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.

wlc: יִשְׂאוּ הָרִים שָׁלוֹם לָעָם וּגְבָעוֹת בִּצְדָקָה ׃
lxx: ὅτι ἐζήλωσα ἐπὶ τοῖς ἀνόμοις, εἰρήνην ἁμαρτωλῶν θεωρῶν·
vulg: quia zelavi super iniquis pacem peccatorum videns
clem: quia zelavi super iniquos, pacem peccatorum videns.
kjv: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.

wlc: יִשְׁפֹּט עֲנִיֵּי־עָם יוֹשִׁיעַ לִבְנֵי אֶבְיוֹן וִידַכֵּא עוֹשֵׁק ׃
lxx: ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ἀνάνευσις ἐν τῷ θανάτῳ αὐτῶν, καὶ στερέωμα ἐν τῇ μάστιγι αὐτῶν·
vulg: quia non est respectus morti eorum et firmamentum in plaga eorum
clem: Quia non est respectus morti eorum, et firmamentum in plaga eorum.
kjv: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.

wlc: יִירָאוּךָ עִם־שָׁמֶשׁ וְלִפְנֵי יָרֵחַ דּוֹר דּוֹרִים ׃
lxx: ἐν κόποις ἀνθρώπων οὐκ εἰσίν, καὶ μετὰ ἀνθρώπων οὐ μαστιγωθήσονται.
vulg: in labore hominum non sunt et cum hominibus non flagellabuntur
clem: In labore hominum non sunt, et cum hominibus non flagellabuntur.
kjv: They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.

wlc: יֵרֵד כְּמָטָר עַל־גֵּז כִּרְבִיבִים זַרְזִיף אָרֶץ ׃
lxx: διὰ τοῦτο ἐκράτησεν αὐτοὺς ἡ ὑπερηφανία, περιεβάλοντο ἀδικίαν καὶ ἀσέβειαν αὐτῶν.
vulg: ideo tenuit eos superbia operti sunt iniquitate et impietate sua
clem: Ideo tenuit eos superbia; operti sunt iniquitate et impietate sua.
kjv: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth.

wlc: יִפְרַח־בְּיָמָיו צַדִּיק וְרֹב שָׁלוֹם עַד־בְּלִי יָרֵחַ ׃
lxx: ἐξελεύσεται ὡς ἐκ στέατος ἡ ἀδικία αὐτῶν, διῆλθον εἰς διάθεσιν καρδίας·
vulg: prodiet quasi ex adipe iniquitas eorum transierunt in affectum cordis
clem: Prodiit quasi ex adipe iniquitas eorum; transierunt in affectum cordis.
kjv: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.

wlc: וְיֵרְדְּ מִיָּם עַד־יָם וּמִנָּהָר עַד־אַפְסֵי־אָרֶץ ׃
lxx: δενοήθησαν καὶ ἐλάλησαν ἐν πονηρίᾳ. ἀδικίαν εἰς τὸ ὕψος ἐλάλησαν·
vulg: cogitaverunt et locuti sunt in nequitia iniquitatem in excelso locuti sunt
clem: Cogitaverunt et locuti sunt nequitiam; iniquitatem in excelso locuti sunt.
kjv: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.

wlc: לְפָנָיו יִכְרְעוּ צִיִּים וְאֹיְבָיו עָפָר יְלַחֵכוּ ׃
lxx: ἔθεντο εἰς οὐρανὸν τὸ στόμα αὐτῶν, καὶ ἡ γλῶσσα αὐτῶν διῆλθεν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.
vulg: posuerunt in caelum os suum et lingua eorum transivit in terra
clem: Posuerunt in clum os suum, et lingua eorum transivit in terra.
kjv: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.

wlc: מַלְכֵי תַרְשִׁישׁ וְאִיִּים מִנְחָה יָשִׁיבוּ מַלְכֵי שְׁבָא וּסְבָא אֶשְׁכָּר יַקְרִיבוּ ׃
lxx: διὰ τοῦτο ἐπιστρέψει ὁ λαός μου ἐνταῦθα, καὶ ἡμέραι πλήρεις εὑρεθήσονται αὐτοῖς,
vulg: ideo convertetur populus meus hic et dies pleni invenientur in eis
clem: Ideo convertetur populus meus hic, et dies pleni invenientur in eis.
kjv: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

wlc: וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ־לוֹ כָל־מְלָכִים כָּל־גּוֹיִם יַעַבְדוּהוּ ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπαν Πῶς ἔγνω ὁ θεός;
vulg: et dixerunt quomodo scit Deus et si est scientia in Excelso
clem: Et dixerunt: Quomodo scit Deus, et si est scientia in excelso?
kjv: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.

wlc: כִּי־יַצִּיל אֶבְיוֹן מְשַׁוֵּעַ וְעָנִי וְאֵין־עֹזֵר לוֹ ׃
lxx: ἰδοὺ ἁμαρτωλοὶ καὶ εὐθηνοῦνται καὶ εἰ ἔστιν γνῶσις ἐν τῷ ὑψίστῳ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα κατέσχον πλούτου.
vulg: ecce ipsi peccatores et abundantes in saeculo obtinuerunt divitias
clem: Ecce ipsi peccatores, et abundantes in sculo obtinuerunt divitias.
kjv: For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and him that hath no helper.

wlc: יָחֹס עַל־דַּל וְאֶבְיוֹן וְנַפְשׁוֹת אֶבְיוֹנִים יוֹשִׁיעַ ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπα Ἀρα ματαίως ἐδικαίωσα τὴν καρδίαν μου. καὶ ἐνιψάμην ἐν ἀθῴοις τὰς χεῖράς μου,
vulg: %et dixi; ergo sine causa iustificavi cor meum et lavi inter innocentes manus meas
clem: Et dixi: Ergo sine causa justificavi cor meum, et lavi inter innocentes manus meas,
kjv: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.

wlc: מִתּוֹךְ וּמֵחָמָס יִגְאַל נַפְשָׁם וְיֵיקַר דָּמָם בְּעֵינָיו ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐγενόμην μεμαστιγωμένος ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν, καὶ ὁ ἔλεγχός μου εἰς τὰς πρωίας.
vulg: et fui flagellatus tota die et castigatio mea in matutino
clem: et fui flagellatus tota die, et castigatio mea in matutinis.
kjv: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.

wlc: וִיחִי וְיִתֶּן־לוֹ מִזְּהַב שְׁבָא וְיִתְפַּלֵּל בַּעֲדוֹ תָמִיד כָּל־הַיּוֹם יְבָרֲכֶנְהוּ ׃
lxx: εἰ ἔλεγον Διηγήσομαι οὕτως, ἰδοὺ τῇ γεωεᾷ τῶν υἱῶν σου ἠσυνθέτηκα.
vulg: si dicebam narrabo sic ecce nationem filiorum tuorum reprobavi
clem: Si dicebam: Narrabo sic; ecce nationem filiorum tuorum reprobavi.
kjv: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.

wlc: יְהִי פִסַּת־בַּר בָּאָרֶץ בְּרֹאשׁ הָרִים יִרְעַשׁ כַּלְּבָנוֹן פִּרְיוֹ וְיָצִיצוּ מֵעִיר כְּעֵשֶׂב הָאָרֶץ ׃
lxx: καὶ ὑπέλαβον τοῦ γνῶναι· τοῦτο κόπος ἐναντίον μου,
vulg: et existimabam cognoscere hoc labor est ante me
clem: Existimabam ut cognoscerem hoc; labor est ante me:
kjv: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.

wlc: יְהִי שְׁמוֹ לְעוֹלָם לִפְנֵי־שֶׁמֶשׁ יָנִין שְׁמוֹ וְיִתְבָּרְכוּ בוֹ כָּל־גּוֹיִם יְאַשְּׁרוּהוּ ׃
lxx: ἕως εἰσέλθω εἰς τὸ ἁγιαστήριον τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ συνῶ εἰς τὰ ἔσχατα.
vulg: donec intrem in sanctuarium Dei intellegam in novissimis eorum
clem: donec intrem in sanctuarium Dei, et intelligam in novissimis eorum.
kjv: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.

wlc: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עֹשֵׂה נִפְלָאוֹת לְבַדּוֹ ׃
lxx: πλὴν διὰ τὰς δολιότητας ἔθου αὐτοῖς.
vulg: verumtamen propter dolos posuisti eis deiecisti eos dum adlevarentur
clem: Verumtamen propter dolos posuisti eis; dejecisti eos dum allevarentur.
kjv: Blessed be the Lord God, the God of Israel, who only doeth wondrous things.

wlc: וּבָרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹדוֹ לְעוֹלָם וְיִמָּלֵא כְבוֹדוֹ אֶת־כֹּל הָאָרֶץ אָמֵן וְאָמֵן ׃
lxx: πῶς ἐγένοντο εἰς ἐρήμωσιν ἐξάπινα ἐξέλιπον, ἀπώλοντο διὰ τὴν ἀνομίαν αὐτῶν.
vulg: quomodo facti sunt in desolationem subito defecerunt perierunt propter iniquitatem suam
clem: Quomodo facti sunt in desolationem? subito defecerunt: perierunt propter iniquitatem suam.
kjv: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.

wlc: כָּלּוּ תְפִלּוֹת דָּוִד בֶּן־יִשָׁי ׃
lxx: Ψαλμὸς τῷ Ἀσάφ. ὡσεὶ ἐνύπνιον ἐξεγειρομένου, κύριε, ἐν τῇ πόλει σου τὴν εἰκόνα αὐτῶν ἐξουδενώσεις.
vulg: velut somnium surgentium Domine in civitate tua imaginem ipsorum ad nihilum rediges
clem: Velut somnium surgentium, Domine, in civitate tua imaginem ipsorum ad nihilum rediges.
kjv: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.

lxx: ὅτι ηὐφράνθη ἡ καρδία μου, καὶ οἱ νεφροί μου ἠλλοιὼθησαν·
vulg: quia inflammatum est cor meum et renes mei commutati sunt
clem: Quia inflammatum est cor meum, et renes mei commutati sunt;

lxx: καὶ ἐγὼ ἐξουδενωμένος καὶ οὐκ ἔγνων, κτηνώδης ἐγενόμην παρὰ σοί.
vulg: et ego ad nihilum redactus sum et nescivi
clem: et ego ad nihilum redactus sum, et nescivi:

lxx: καὶ ἐγὼ διὰ παντὸς μετὰ σοῦ· ἐκράτησας τῆς χειρὸς τῆς δεξιᾶς μου,
vulg: ut iumentum factus sum apud te et ego semper tecum
clem: ut jumentum factus sum apud te, et ego semper tecum.

lxx: ἐν τῇ βουλῇ σου ὡδήγησάς με. καὶ μετὰ δόξης προσελάβου με.
vulg: tenuisti manum dexteram meam et in voluntate tua deduxisti me et cum gloria suscepisti me
clem: Tenuisti manum dexteram meam, et in voluntate tua deduxisti me, et cum gloria suscepisti me.

lxx: τί γάρ μοι ὑπάρχει ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ ; καὶ παρὰ σοῦ τί ἠθέλησα ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς
vulg: quid enim mihi est in caelo et a te quid volui super terram
clem: Quid enim mihi est in clo? et a te quid volui super terram?

lxx: ἐξέλιπεν ἡ καρδία μου καὶ ἡ σάρξ μου, ὁ θεὸς τῆς καρδίας μου, καὶ ἡ μερίς μου ὁ θεὸς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.
vulg: defecit caro mea et cor meum Deus cordis mei et pars mea Deus in aeternum
clem: Defecit caro mea et cor meum; Deus cordis mei, et pars mea, Deus in ternum.

lxx: ὅτι ἰδοὺ οἱ μακρύνοντες ἑαυτοὺς ἀπὸ σοῦ ἀπολοῦνται· ἐξωλέθρευσας πάντα τὸν πορνεύοντα ἀπὸ σοῦ.
vulg: quia ecce qui elongant se a te peribunt perdidisti omnem qui fornicatur abs te
clem: Quia ecce qui elongant se a te peribunt; perdidisti omnes qui fornicantur abs te.

lxx: ἐμοὶ δὲ τὸ προσκολλᾶσθαι τῷ κυρίῳ ἀγαθόν ἐστιν, τίθεσθαι ἐν τῷ κυρίῳ τὴν ἐλπίδα μου, τοῦ ἐξαγγεῖλαι πάσας τὰς αἰνέσεις σου ἐν ταῖς πύλαις τῆς θυγατρὸς Σιών.
vulg: mihi autem adherere Deo bonum est ponere in Domino Deo spem meam ut adnuntiem omnes praedicationes tuas % in portis filiae Sion;
clem: Mihi autem adhrere Deo bonum est; ponere in Domino Deo spem meam: ut annuntiem omnes prdicationes tuas in portis fili Sion.]

wlc: מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף אַךְ טוֹב לְיִשְׂרָאֵל אֱלֹהִים לְבָרֵי לֵבָב ׃
lxx: Ἵνα τί ἀπώσω, ὁ θεός, εἰς τέλος; ὠργίσθη ὁ θυμός σου ἐπὶ πρόβατα νομῆς σου;
vulg: intellectus Asaph ut quid Deus reppulisti in finem iratus est furor tuus super oves pascuae tuae
clem: Intellectus Asaph. [Ut quid, Deus, repulisti in finem, iratus est furor tuus super oves pascu tu?
kjv: Truly God is good to Israel, even to such as are of a clean heart.

wlc: וַאֲנִי כִּמְעַט נָטָוֻי רַגְלָי כְּאַיִן שֻׁפְּכֻה אֲשֻׁרָי ׃
lxx: μνήσθητι τῆς συναγωγῆς σου ἧς ἐκτήσω ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς· ἐλυτρώσω ῥάβδον κληρονομίας σου, ὄρος Σιὼν τοῦτο ὃ κατεσκήνωσας ἐν αὐτῷ.
vulg: memor esto congregationis tuae quam possedisti ab initio redemisti virgam hereditatis tuae mons Sion in quo habitasti in eo
clem: Memor esto congregationis tu, quam possedisti ab initio. Redemisti virgam hreditatis tu, mons Sion, in quo habitasti in eo.
kjv: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.

wlc: כִּי־קִנֵּאתִי בַּהוֹלְלִים שְׁלוֹם רְשָׁעִים אֶרְאֶה ׃
lxx: ἔπαρον τὰς χεῖράς σου ἐπὶ τὰς ὑπερηφανίας αὐτῶν εἰς τέλος, ὅσα ἐπονηρεύσατο ὁ ἐχθρὸς ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις σου.
vulg: leva manus tuas in superbias eorum in finem quanta malignatus est inimicus in sancto
clem: Leva manus tuas in superbias eorum in finem: quanta malignatus est inimicus in sancto!
kjv: For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

wlc: כִּי אֵין חַרְצֻבּוֹת לְמוֹתָם וּבָרִיא אוּלָם ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐνεκαυχήσαντο οἱ μισοῦντές σε ἐν μέσῳ τῆς ἑορτῆς σου,
vulg: et gloriati sunt qui oderunt te in medio sollemnitatis tuae posuerunt signa sua signa
clem: Et gloriati sunt qui oderunt te in medio solemnitatis tu; posuerunt signa sua, signa:
kjv: For there are no bands in their death: but their strength is firm.

wlc: בַּעֲמַל אֱנוֹשׁ אֵינֵמוֹ וְעִם־אָדָם לֹא יְנֻגָּעוּ ׃
lxx: ὡς εἰς τὴν εἴσοδον ὑπεράνω· ὡς ἐν δρυμῷ ξύλων ἀξίναις ἐξέκοψαν
vulg: et non cognoverunt sicut in exitu super summum quasi in silva lignorum securibus
clem: et non cognoverunt sicut in exitu super summum. Quasi in silva lignorum securibus
kjv: They are not in trouble as other men; neither are they plagued like other men.

wlc: לָכֵן עֲנָקַתְמוֹ גַאֲוָה יַעֲטָף־שִׁית חָמָס לָמוֹ ׃
lxx: τὰς θύρας αὐτῆς· ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ ἐν πελέκει καὶ λαξευτηρίῳ κατέρραξαν αὐτήν.
vulg: exciderunt ianuas eius in id ipsum in securi et ascia deiecerunt %eam;
clem: exciderunt januas ejus in idipsum; in securi et ascia dejecerunt eam.
kjv: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them as a garment.

wlc: יָצָא מֵחֵלֶב עֵינֵמוֹ עָבְרוּ מַשְׂכִּיּוֹת לֵבָב ׃
lxx: ἐνεπύρισαν ἐν πυρὶ τὸ ἁγιαστήριόν σου· εἰς τὴν γῆν ἐβεβήλωσαν τὸ σκήνωμα τοῦ ὀνόματός σου.
vulg: incenderunt igni sanctuarium tuum in terra polluerunt tabernaculum nominis tui
clem: Incenderunt igni sanctuarium tuum; in terra polluerunt tabernaculum nominis tui.
kjv: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.

wlc: יָמִיקוּ וִידַבְּרוּ בְרָע עֹשֶׁק מִמָּרוֹם יְדַבֵּרוּ ׃
lxx: εἶπαν ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῶν ἡ συγγενία αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό Δεῦτε καὶ καταπαύσωμεν τὰς ἑορτὰς Κυρίου ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς.
vulg: dixerunt in corde suo cognatio eorum simul quiescere faciamus omnes dies festos Dei a terra
clem: Dixerunt in corde suo cognatio eorum simul: Quiescere faciamus omnes dies festos Dei a terra.
kjv: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they speak loftily.

wlc: שַׁתּוּ בַשָּׁמַיִם פִּיהֶם וּלְשׁוֹנָם תִּהֲלַךְ בָּאָרֶץ ׃
lxx: τὰ σημεῖα ἡμῶν οὐκ εἴδομεν, οὐκ ἔστιυ ἔτι προφήτης, καὶ ἡμᾶς οὐ γνώσεται ἔτι.
vulg: signa nostra non vidimus iam non est propheta et nos non cognoscet amplius
clem: Signa nostra non vidimus; jam non est propheta; et nos non cognoscet amplius.
kjv: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.

wlc: לָכֵן יָשִׁיב עַמּוֹ הֲלֹם וּמֵי מָלֵא יִמָּצוּ לָמוֹ ׃
lxx: ἔως πότε, ὁ θεός, ὀνειδιεῖ ὁ ἐχθρός παροξυνεῖ ὁ ὑπεναντίος τὸ ὄνομά σου εἰς τέλος;
vulg: usquequo Deus inproperabit inimicus inritat adversarius nomen tuum in finem
clem: Usquequo, Deus, improperabit inimicus? irritat adversarius nomen tuum in finem?
kjv: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.

wlc: וְאָמְרוּ אֵיכָה יָדַע־אֵל וְיֵשׁ דֵּעָה בְעֶלְיוֹן ׃
lxx: ἵνα τί ἀποστρέφεις τὴν χεῖρά σου καὶ τὴν δεξιάν σου ἐκ μέσου τοῦ κόλπου σου εἰς τέλος;
vulg: ut quid avertis manum tuam et dexteram tuam de medio sinu tuo in finem
clem: Ut quid avertis manum tuam, et dexteram tuam de medio sinu tuo in finem?
kjv: And they say, How doth God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?

wlc: הִנֵּה־אֵלֶּה רְשָׁעִים וְשַׁלְוֵי עוֹלָם הִשְׂגּוּ־חָיִל ׃
lxx: ὁ δὲ βασιλεὺς ἡμῶν πρὸ αἰῶνος, εἰργάσατο σωτηρίαν ἐν μέσχῳ τῆς γῆς.
vulg: Deus autem rex noster ante saeculum operatus est salutes in medio terrae
clem: Deus autem rex noster ante scula: operatus est salutem in medio terr.
kjv: Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.

wlc: אַךְ־רִיק זִכִּיתִי לְבָבִי וָאֶרְחַץ בְּנִקָּיוֹן כַּפָּי ׃
lxx: σὺ ἐκραταίωσας ἐν τῇ δυνάμει σου τὴν θάλασσαν, σὺ συνέτριψας τὰς κεφαλὰς τῶν δρακόντων ἐπὶ τοῦ ὕδατος·
vulg: tu confirmasti in virtute tua mare contribulasti capita draconum in aquis
clem: Tu confirmasti in virtute tua mare; contribulasti capita draconum in aquis.
kjv: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.

wlc: וָאֱהִי נָגוּעַ כָּל־הַיּוֹם וְתוֹכַחְתִּי לַבְּקָרִים ׃
lxx: ἔδωκας αὐτὸν βρῶμα λαοῖς τοῖς Αἰθίοψιν.
vulg: tu confregisti capita draconis dedisti eum escam populis Aethiopum
clem: Tu confregisti capita draconis; dedisti eum escam populis thiopum.
kjv: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.

wlc: אִם־אָמַרְתִּי אֲסַפְּרָה כְמוֹ הִנֵּה דוֹר בָּנֶיךָ בָגָדְתִּי ׃
lxx: σὺ διέρρηξας πηγὰς καὶ χειμάρρους,
vulg: tu disrupisti fontem et torrentes tu siccasti fluvios Aetham;
clem: Tu dirupisti fontes et torrentes; tu siccasti fluvios Ethan.
kjv: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend against the generation of thy children.

wlc: וָאֲחַשְּׁבָה לָדַעַת זֹאת עָמָל הִיא בְעֵינָי ׃
lxx: σὴ ἐστιν ἡ ἡμέρα, καὶ σή ἐστιν ἧ νύξσὺ κατηρτίσω ἥλιον καὶ σελήνην.
vulg: tuus est dies et tua est nox tu fabricatus es auroram et solem
clem: Tuus est dies, et tua est nox; tu fabricatus es auroram et solem.
kjv: When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;

wlc: עַד־אָבוֹא אֶל־מִקְדְּשֵׁי־אֵל אָבִינָה לְאַחֲרִיתָם ׃
lxx: σὺ ἐποίησας πάντα τὰ ὅρια τῆς γῆς· θέρος καὶ ἔαρ σὺ ἐποίησας·
vulg: tu fecisti omnes terminos terrae aestatem et ver tu plasmasti ea
clem: Tu fecisti omnes terminos terr; statem et ver tu plasmasti ea.
kjv: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; then understood I their end.

wlc: אַךְ בַּחֲלָקוֹת תָּשִׁית לָמוֹ הִפַּלְתָּם לְמַשּׁוּאוֹת ׃
lxx: μνήσθητι ταύτης τῆς κτίσεως ἐχθρὸς ὠνείδισεν τὸν κύριον, καὶ λαὸς ἄφρων παρώξυνεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ.
vulg: memor esto huius inimicus inproperavit Dominum et populus insipiens incitavit nomen tuum
clem: Memor esto hujus: inimicus improperavit Domino, et populus insipiens incitavit nomen tuum.
kjv: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: thou castedst them down into destruction.

wlc: אֵיךְ הָיוּ לְשַׁמָּה כְרָגַע סָפוּ תַמּוּ מִן־בַּלָּהוֹת ׃
lxx: μὴ παραδῷς τοῖς θηρίοις ψυχὴν ἐξομολογουμένην σοι, τῶν ψυχῶν τῶν πενήτων σου μὴ ἐπιλάθῃ εἰς τέλος.
vulg: ne tradas bestiis animam confitentem tibi animas pauperum tuorum ne obliviscaris in finem
clem: Ne tradas bestiis animas confitentes tibi, et animas pauperum tuorum ne obliviscaris in finem.
kjv: How are they brought into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.

wlc: כַּחֲלוֹם מֵהָקִיץ אֲדֹנָי בָּעִיר צַלְמָם תִּבְזֶה ׃
lxx: ἐπίβλεψον εἰς τὴν διαθήκην σου, ὅτι ἐπληρώθησαν οἱ ἐσκοτωμένοι τῆς γῆς οἴκων ἀνομιῶν.
vulg: respice in testamentum tuum quia repleti sunt qui obscurati sunt terrae domibus iniquitatum
clem: Respice in testamentum tuum, quia repleti sunt qui obscurati sunt terr domibus iniquitatum.
kjv: As a dream when one awaketh; so, O Lord, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.

wlc: כִּי יִתְחַמֵּץ לְבָבִי וְכִלְיוֹתַי אֶשְׁתּוֹנָן ׃
lxx: μὴ ἀποστραφήτω τεταπεινωμένος καὶ κατηησ χυμμένος· πταωχὸς καὶ πένης αἰνέσουσιν τὸ ὄνομά σου.
vulg: ne avertatur humilis factus confusus pauper et inops laudabunt nomen tuum
clem: Ne avertatur humilis factus confusus; pauper et inops laudabunt nomen tuum.
kjv: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.

wlc: וַאֲנִי־בַעַר וְלֹא אֵדָע בְּהֵמוֹת הָיִיתִי עִמָּךְ ׃
lxx: ἀνάστα, ὁ θεός, δίκασον τὴν δίκην σου· μνήσθητι τῶν ὀνειδισμῶν σου τῶν ὑπὸ ἄφρονος ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν.
vulg: exsurge Deus iudica causam tuam memor esto inproperiorum tuorum eorum qui ab insipiente sunt tota die
clem: Exsurge, Deus, judica causam tuam; memor esto improperiorum tuorum, eorum qu ab insipiente sunt tota die.
kjv: So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before thee.

wlc: וַאֲנִי תָמִיד עִמָּךְ אָחַזְתָּ בְּיַד־יְמִינִי ׃
lxx: μὴ ἐπιλάθῃ τῆς φωνῆς τῶν ἱκετῶν σου, ἡ ὑπερηφανία τῶν μισούντων σε ἀναβαίη διὰ παντὸς πρὸς σέ.
vulg: ne obliviscaris voces inimicorum tuorum superbia eorum qui te oderunt ascendit semper
clem: Ne obliviscaris voces inimicorum tuorum: superbia eorum qui te oderunt ascendit semper.]
kjv: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden me by my right hand.

wlc: בַּעֲצָתְךָ תַנְחֵנִי וְאַחַר כָּבוֹד תִּקָּחֵנִי ׃
kjv: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.

wlc: מִי־לִי בַשָּׁמָיִם וְעִמְּךָ לֹא־חָפַצְתִּי בָאָרֶץ ׃
kjv: Whom have I in heaven but thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside thee.

wlc: כָּלָה שְׁאֵרִי וּלְבָבִי צוּר־לְבָבִי וְחֶלְקִי אֱלֹהִים לְעוֹלָם ׃
kjv: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.

wlc: כִּי־הִנֵּה רְחֵקֶיךָ יֹאבֵדוּ הִצְמַתָּה כָּל־זוֹנֶה מִמֶּךָּ ׃
kjv: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee.

wlc: וַאֲנִי קִרֲבַת אֱלֹהִים לִי־טוֹב שַׁתִּי בַּאדֹנָי יְהֹוִה מַחְסִי לְסַפֵּר כָּל־מַלְאֲכוֹתֶיךָ ׃
lxx: Συνέσεως τῷ Ἀσάφ.
kjv: But it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord God, that I may declare all thy works.

wlc: מַשְׂכִּיל לְאָסָף לָמָה אֱלֹהִים זָנַחְתָּ לָנֶצַח יֶעְשַׁן אַפְּךָ בְּצֹאן מַרְעִיתֶךָ ׃
lxx: Εἰς τὸ τέλος· μὴ διαφθείρης· ψαλμὸς τῷ Ἀσὰφ ᾠδῆς.
vulg: in finem ne corrumpas psalmus Asaph cantici
clem: In finem, ne corrumpas. Psalmus cantici Asaph.
kjv: O God, why hast thou cast us off for ever? why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?

wlc: זְכֹר עֲדָתְךָ קָנִיתָ קֶּדֶם גָּאַלְתָּ שֵׁבֶט נַחֲלָתֶךָ הַר־צִיּוֹן זֶה שָׁכַנְתָּ בּוֹ ׃
lxx: Ἐξομολογησόμεθά σοι, ὁ θεός, ἐξομολογησόμεθα καὶ ἐπικαλεσόμεθα τὸ ὄνομά σου· διηγήσομαι πάντα τὰ θαυμάσιά σου,
vulg: confitebimur tibi Deus confitebimur et invocabimus nomen tuum narrabimus mirabilia tua
clem: [Confitebimur tibi, Deus, confitebimur, et invocabimus nomen tuum; narrabimus mirabilia tua.
kjv: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast purchased of old; the rod of thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.

wlc: הָרִימָה פְעָמֶיךָ לְמַשֻּׁאוֹת נֶצַח כָּל־הֵרַע אוֹיֵב בַּקֹּדֶשׁ ׃
lxx: ὅταν λάβω καιρόν· ἐγὼ εὐθύτητας κρινῶ.
vulg: cum accepero tempus ego iustitias iudicabo
clem: Cum accepero tempus, ego justitias judicabo.
kjv: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.

wlc: שָׁאֲגוּ צֹרְרֶיךָ בְּקֶרֶב מוֹעֲדֶךָ שָׂמוּ אוֹתֹתָם אֹתוֹת ׃
lxx: ἐτάκη ή γῆ καὶ πάντες οἱ κατοικοῦντες αὐτήν, ἐγὼ ἐστερέωσα τοὺς στύλους αὐτῆς. διάψαλμα.
vulg: liquefacta est terra et omnes qui habitant in ea ego confirmavi columnas eius diapsalma
clem: Liquefacta est terra et omnes qui habitant in ea: ego confirmavi columnas ejus.
kjv: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; they set up their ensigns for signs.

wlc: יִוָּדַע כְּמֵבִיא לְמָעְלָה בִּסֲבָךְ־עֵץ קַרְדֻּמּוֹת ׃
lxx: εἶπα τοῖς παρανομοῦσιν μὴ παρανομεῖν, καὶ τοῖς ἁμαρτάνουσιν Μὴ ὑψοῦτε κέρας·
vulg: dixi iniquis nolite inique facere et delinquentibus nolite exaltare cornu
clem: Dixi iniquis: Nolite inique agere: et delinquentibus: Nolite exaltare cornu:
kjv: A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.

wlc: וְעֵת פִּתּוּחֶיהָ יָּחַד בְּכַשִּׁיל וְכֵילַפֹּת יַהֲלֹמוּן ׃
lxx: μὴ ἐπαίρετε εἰς ὕψος τὸ κέρας ὑμῶν. μὴ λαλεῖτε κατὰ τοῦ θεοῦ ἀδικίαν·
vulg: nolite extollere in altum cornu vestrum nolite loqui adversus Deum iniquitatem
clem: nolite extollere in altum cornu vestrum; nolite loqui adversus Deum iniquitatem.
kjv: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.

wlc: שִׁלְחוּ בָאֵשׁ מִקְדָּשֶׁךָ לָאָרֶץ חִלְּלוּ מִשְׁכַּן־שְׁמֶךָ ׃
lxx: ὅτι οὔτε ἀπὸ ἐξόδων οὔτε ἀπὸ δυσμῶν οὔτε ἀπὸ ἐρήμων,
vulg: quia neque ab oriente neque ab occidente neque a desertis montibus
clem: Quia neque ab oriente, neque ab occidente, neque a desertis montibus:
kjv: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary, they have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of thy name to the ground.

wlc: אָמְרוּ בְלִבָּם נִינָם יָחַד שָׂרְפוּ כָל־מוֹעֲדֵי־אֵל בָּאָרֶץ ׃
lxx: ὅτι ὁ θεὸς κριτής ἐστιν· τοῦτον ταπεινοῖ καὶ τοῦτον ὑψοῖ.
vulg: quoniam Deus iudex est hunc humiliat et hunc exaltat
clem: quoniam Deus judex est. Hunc humiliat, et hunc exaltat:
kjv: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.

wlc: אוֹתֹתֵינוּ לֹא רָאִינוּ אֵין־עוֹד נָבִיא וְלֹא־אִתָּנוּ יֹדֵעַ עַד־מָה ׃
lxx: ὅτι ποτήριρν ἐν χειρὶ Κυρίου, οἴνου ἀκράτου πλῆρες κεράσματος. καὶ ἔκλινεν ἐκ τούτου εἰς τοῦτο· πλὴν ὁ τρυγίας αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐξεκενώθη, καὶ πίονται πάντες οἱ ἁμαρτωλοὶ τῆς γῆς.
vulg: quia calix in manu Domini vini meri plenus mixto et inclinavit ex hoc in hoc verum fex eius non est exinanita bibent omnes peccatores terrae
clem: quia calix in manu Domini vini meri, plenus misto. Et inclinavit ex hoc in hoc; verumtamen fx ejus non est exinanita: bibent omnes peccatores terr.
kjv: We see not our signs: there is no more any prophet: neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.

wlc: עַד־מָתַי אֱלֹהִים יְחָרֶף צָר יְנָאֵץ אוֹיֵב שִׁמְךָ לָנֶצַח ׃
lxx: ἐγὼ δὲ ἀγαλλιάσομαι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, ψαλῶ τῷ θεῷ Ἰακώβ·
vulg: ego autem adnuntiabo in saeculum cantabo Deo Iacob
clem: Ego autem annuntiabo in sculum; cantabo Deo Jacob:
kjv: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?

wlc: לָמָּה תָשִׁיב יָדְךָ וִימִינֶךָ מִקֶּרֶב חוֹקְךָ כַלֵּה ׃
lxx: καὶ πάντα τὰ κέρατα τῶν ἁμαρτωλῶν συνκλάσω, καὶ ὑψωθήσεται τὰ κέρατα τοῦ δικαίου.
vulg: et omnia cornua peccatorum confringam et exaltabuntur cornua iusti
clem: et omnia cornua peccatorum confringam, et exaltabuntur cornua justi.]
kjv: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? pluck it out of thy bosom.

wlc: וֵאלֹהִים מַלְכִּי מִקֶּדֶם פֹּעֵל יְשׁוּעוֹת בְּקֶרֶב הָאָרֶץ ׃
kjv: For God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.

wlc: אַתָּה פוֹרַרְתָּ בְעָזְּךָ יָם שִׁבַּרְתָּ רָאשֵׁי תַנִּינִים עַל־הַמָּיִם ׃
kjv: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.

wlc: אַתָּה רִצַּצְתָּ רָאשֵׁי לִוְיָתָן תִּתְּנֶנּוּ מַאֲכָל לְעָם לְצִיִּים ׃
kjv: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.

wlc: אַתָּה בָקַעְתָּ מַעְיָן וָנָחַל אַתָּה הוֹבַשְׁתָּ נַהֲרוֹת אֵיתָן ׃
kjv: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers.

wlc: לְךָ יוֹם אַף־לְךָ לָיְלָה אַתָּה הֲכִינוֹתָ מָאוֹר וָשָׁמֶשׁ ׃
kjv: The day is thine, the night also is thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.

wlc: אַתָּה הִצַּבְתָּ כָּל־גְּבוּלוֹת אָרֶץ קַיִץ וָחֹרֶף אַתָּה יְצַרְתָּם ׃
kjv: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: thou hast made summer and winter.

wlc: זְכָר־זֹאת אוֹיֵב חֵרֵף יְהוָה וְעַם נָבָל נִאֲצוּ שְׁמֶךָ ׃
kjv: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O Lord, and that the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.

wlc: אַל־תִּתֵּן לְחַיַּת נֶפֶשׁ תּוֹרֶךָ חַיַּת עֲנִיֶּיךָ אַל־תִּשְׁכַּח לָנֶצַח ׃
kjv: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude of the wicked: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.

wlc: הַבֵּט לַבְּרִית כִּי מָלְאוּ מַחֲשַׁכֵּי־אֶרֶץ נְאוֹת חָמָס ׃
kjv: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.

wlc: אַל־יָשֹׁב דַּךְ נִכְלָם עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן יְהַלְלוּ שְׁמֶךָ ׃
kjv: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.

wlc: קוּמָה אֱלֹהִים רִיבָה רִיבֶךָ זְכֹר חֶרְפָּתְךָ מִנִּי־נָבָל כָּל־הַיּוֹם ׃
kjv: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.

wlc: אַל־תִּשְׁכַּח קוֹל צֹרְרֶיךָ שְׁאוֹן קָמֶיךָ עֹלֶה תָמִיד ׃
kjv: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.

wlc: לַמְנַצֵּחַ אַל־תַּשְׁחֵת מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף שִׁיר ׃
lxx: Εἰς τὸ τέλος, ἐν ὕμνοις· ψαλμὸς τῷ Ἀσάφ. ᾠδή, πρὸς τὸν Ἀσσύριον.
vulg: in finem in laudibus psalmus Asaph canticum ad Assyrium
clem: In finem, in laudibus. Psalmus Asaph, canticum ad Assyrios.
kjv: Unto thee, O God, do we give thanks, unto thee do we give thanks: for that thy name is near thy wondrous works declare.

wlc: הוֹדִינוּ לְּךָ אֱלֹהִים הוֹדִינוּ וְקָרוֹב שְׁמֶךָ סִפְּרוּ נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ ׃
lxx: Γνωστὸς ἐν τῆ Ἰουδαἰᾳ ὁ θεός, ἐν τῷ Ἰσραὴλ μέγα τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ.
vulg: notus in Iudaea Deus in Israhel magnum nomen eius
clem: [Notus in Juda Deus; in Isral magnum nomen ejus.
kjv: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.

wlc: כִּי אֶקַּח מוֹעֵד אֲנִי מֵישָׁרִים אֶשְׁפֹּט ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐγενήθη ἐν εἰρήνῃ ὁ τόπος αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὸ κατοικητήριον αὐτοῦ ἐν Σιών·
vulg: et factus est in pace locus eius et habitatio eius in Sion
clem: Et factus est in pace locus ejus, et habitatio ejus in Sion.
kjv: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.

wlc: נְמֹגִים אֶרֶץ וְכָל־יֹשְׁבֶיהָ אָנֹכִי תִכַּנְתִּי עַמּוּדֶיהָ סֶּלָה ׃
lxx: ἐκεῖ συνέτριψεν τὰ κράτη τῶν τόξων, ὅπλον καὶ ῥομφαίαν καὶ πόλεμον· ἐκεῖ συνκλάσει τὰ κέρατα. διάφαλμα.
vulg: ibi confregit potentias arcuum scutum et gladium et bellum diapsalma
clem: Ibi confregit potentias arcuum, scutum, gladium, et bellum.
kjv: I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:

wlc: אָמַרְתִּי לַהוֹלְלִים אַל־תָּהֹלּוּ וְלָרְשָׁעִים אַל־תָּרִימוּ קָרֶן ׃
lxx: φωτίζεις σὺ θαυμαστῶς ἀπὸ ὀρέων αἰωνίων.
vulg: inluminas tu mirabiliter de montibus aeternis
clem: Illuminans tu mirabiliter a montibus ternis;
kjv: Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.

wlc: אַל־תָּרִימוּ לַמָּרוֹם קַרְנְכֶם תְּדַבְּרוּ בְצַוָּאר עָתָק ׃
lxx: ἐταράχθησαν πάντες οἱ ἀσύνετοι τῇ καρδίᾳ· ὕπνωσαν ὕπνον αὐτῶν, καὶ οὐχ εὗρον οὐδὲν πάντες οἱ ἄνδρες τοῦ πλούτου ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτῶν.
vulg: turbati sunt omnes insipientes corde dormierunt somnum suum et nihil invenerunt omnes viri divitiarum manibus suis
clem: turbati sunt omnes insipientes corde. Dormierunt somnum suum, et nihil invenerunt omnes viri divitiarum in manibus suis.
kjv: For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.

wlc: כִּי לֹא מִמּוֹצָא וּמִמַּעֲרָב וְלֹא מִמִּדְבַּר הָרִים ׃
lxx: ἀπὸ ἐπιτιμήσεως σου, ὁ θεὸς Ἰακώβ, ἐνύσταξαν οἱ ἐπιβεβηκότες τοὺς ἵππους.
vulg: ab increpatione tua Deus Iacob dormitaverunt qui ascenderunt equos
clem: Ab increpatione tua, Deus Jacob, dormitaverunt qui ascenderunt equos.
kjv: But God is the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.

wlc: כִּי־אֱלֹהִים שֹׁפֵט זֶה יַשְׁפִּיל וְזֶה יָרִים ׃
lxx: σὺ φοβερὸς εἶ, καὶ τίς ἀντιστήσεταί σοι ἀπὸ τῆς ὀργῆς σους
vulg: tu terribilis es et quis resistet tibi ex tunc ira tua
clem: Tu terribilis es; et quis resistet tibi? ex tunc ira tua.
kjv: For in the hand of the Lord there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.

wlc: כִּי כוֹס בְּיַד־יְהוָה וְיַיִן חָמַר מָלֵא מֶסֶךְ וַיַּגֵּר מִזֶּה אַךְ־שְׁמָרֶיהָ יִמְצוּ יִשְׁתּוּ כֹּל רִשְׁעֵי־אָרֶץ ׃
lxx: ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἠκόντισας κρίσιν, γῆ ἐφοβήθη καὶ ἡσύχασεν,
vulg: de caelo auditum fecisti iudicium terra timuit et quievit
clem: De clo auditum fecisti judicium: terra tremuit et quievit
kjv: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

wlc: וַאֲנִי אַגִּיד לְעֹלָם אֲזַמְּרָה לֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב ׃
lxx: ἐν τῷ ἀναστῆναι εἰς κρίσιν τὸν θεόν, τοῦ σῶσαι πάντας τοὺς πρᾳεῖς τῇ καρδίᾳ. διάψαλμα.
vulg: cum exsurgeret in iudicium Deus ut salvos faceret omnes mansuetos terrae diapsalma
clem: cum exsurgeret in judicium Deus, ut salvos faceret omnes mansuetos terr.
kjv: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.

wlc: וְכָל־קַרְנֵי רְשָׁעִים אֲגַדֵּעַ תְּרוֹמַמְנָה קַרְנוֹת צַדִּיק ׃
lxx: ὅτι ἐνθύμιον ἀνθρώπου ἐξομολογήσεταί σοι, καὶ ἐνκατάλιμμα ἐνθυμίου ἑορτάσει σοι.
vulg: quoniam cogitatio hominis confitebitur tibi et reliquiae cogitationis diem festum agent tibi
clem: Quoniam cogitatio hominis confitebitur tibi, et reliqui cogitationis diem festum agent tibi.

lxx: εδξασθε καὶ ἀπόδοτε Κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν· πάντες οἱ κύκλῳ αὐτοῦ οἴσουσιν δῶρα
vulg: vovete et reddite Domino Deo vestro omnes qui in circuitu eius adferent munera terribili
clem: Vovete et reddite Domino Deo vestro, omnes qui in circuitu ejus affertis munera: terribili,

lxx: τῷ φοβερῷ καὶ ἀφαιρουμένῳ πνεύματα ἀρχόντων, φοβερῷ παρὰ τοῖς βασιλεῦσι τῆς γῆς.
vulg: et ei qui aufert spiritus principum terribili apud reges terrae
clem: et ei qui aufert spiritum principum: terribili apud reges terr.]

wlc: לַמְנַצֵּחַ בִּנְגִינֹת מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף שִׁיר ׃
lxx: Εἰς τὸ τέλος, ὐπὲρ Ἰδιθούμ· τῷ Ἀσὰφ ψαλμός.
vulg: in finem pro Idithun psalmus Asaph
clem: In finem, pro Idithun. Psalmus Asaph.
kjv: In Judah is God known: his name is great in Israel.

wlc: נוֹדָע בִּיהוּדָה אֱלֹהִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל גָּדוֹל שְׁמוֹ ׃
lxx: Φωνῇ μου πρὸς Κύριον ἐκέκραξα, καὶ ἡ φωνή μου πρὸς τὸν θεόν, καὶ προσέσχεν μοι.
vulg: voce mea ad Dominum clamavi voce mea ad Deum et intendit me
clem: [Voce mea ad Dominum clamavi; voce mea ad Deum, et intendit mihi.
kjv: In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place in Zion.

wlc: וַיְהִי בְשָׁלֵם סֻכּוֹ וּמְעוֹנָתוֹ בְצִיּוֹן ׃
lxx: ἐν ἡμέρᾳ θλίψεως μου τὸν θεὸν ἐξεζήτησα, ταῖς χερσίν μου νυκτὸς ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ, καὶ οὐκ ἠπατήθην· ἀπηνήνατο παρακληθῆναι ἡ ψυχή μου.
vulg: in die tribulationis meae Deum exquisivi manibus meis nocte contra eum et non sum deceptus rennuit consolari anima mea
clem: In die tribulationis me Deum exquisivi; manibus meis nocte contra eum, et non sum deceptus. Renuit consolari anima mea;
kjv: There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.

wlc: שָׁמָּה שִׁבַּר רִשְׁפֵי־קָשֶׁת מָגֵן וְחֶרֶב וּמִלְחָמָה סֶלָה ׃
lxx: ἐμνήσθην τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ εὐφράνθην· ἠδολέσχησα καὶ ὠλιγοψύχησεν τὸ πνεῦμα μου. διάψαλμα.
vulg: memor fui Dei et delectatus sum exercitatus sum et defecit spiritus meus diapsalma
clem: memor fui Dei, et delectatus sum, et exercitatus sum, et defecit spiritus meus.
kjv: Thou art more glorious and excellent than the mountains of prey.

wlc: נָאוֹר אַתָּה אַדִּיר מֵהַרְרֵי־טָרֶף ׃
lxx: προκατελάβοντο φυλακὰς οἱ ἐχθροί μου· ἐταράχθην καὶ οὐκ ἐλάλησα.
vulg: anticipaverunt vigilias oculi mei turbatus sum et non sum locutus
clem: Anticipaverunt vigilias oculi mei; turbatus sum, et non sum locutus.
kjv: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.

wlc: אֶשְׁתּוֹלְלוּ אַבִּירֵי לֵב נָמוּ שְׁנָתָם וְלֹא־מָצְאוּ כָל־אַנְשֵׁי־חַיִל יְדֵיהֶם ׃
lxx: διελογισάμην ἡμέρας ἀρχαίας. καὶ ἔτη αἰώνια
vulg: cogitavi dies antiquos et annos aeternos in mente habui
clem: Cogitavi dies antiquos, et annos ternos in mente habui.
kjv: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

wlc: מִגַּעֲרָתְךָ אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב נִרְדָּם וְרֶכֶב וָסוּס ׃
lxx: ἐμνήσθην καὶ ἐμελέτησα· νυκτὸς μετὰ τῆς καρδίας μου ἠδολέσχουν, καὶ ἔσκαλεν τὸ πνεῦμά μου.
vulg: et meditatus sum nocte cum corde meo exercitabar et scobebam spiritum meum
clem: Et meditatus sum nocte cum corde meo, et exercitabar, et scopebam spiritum meum.
kjv: Thou, even thou, art to be feared: and who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?

wlc: אַתָּה נוֹרָא אַתָּה וּמִי־יַעֲמֹד לְפָנֶיךָ מֵאָז אַפֶּךָ ׃
lxx: μὴ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας ἀπώσεται Κύριος. καὶ οὐ προσθήσει τοῦ εὐδοκῆσαι ἔτι;
vulg: numquid in aeternum proiciet Deus et non adponet ut conplacitior sit adhuc
clem: Numquid in ternum projiciet Deus? aut non apponet ut complacitior sit adhuc?
kjv: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,

wlc: מִשָּׁמַיִם הִשְׁמַעְתָּ דִּין אֶרֶץ יָרְאָה וְשָׁקָטָה ׃
lxx: ἡ εἰς τέλος ἀποκόψει τὸ ἔλεος ἀπὸ γενεᾶς καὶ γενεᾶς;
vulg: aut in finem misericordiam suam abscidet a generatione in generationem
clem: aut in finem misericordiam suam abscindet, a generatione in generationem?
kjv: When God arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.

wlc: בְּקוּם־לַמִּשְׁפָּט אֱלֹהִים לְהוֹשִׁיעַ כָּל־עַנְוֵי־אֶרֶץ סֶלָה ׃
lxx: ἡ ἐπιλήσεται τοῦ οἰκτειρῆσαι ὁ θεός, ἡ συνέξει τοὺς οἰκτειρμοὺς αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ ὀργῇ αὐτοῦ διάψαλμα.
vulg: aut obliviscetur misereri Deus aut continebit in ira sua misericordias suas diapsalma
clem: aut obliviscetur misereri Deus? aut continebit in ira sua misericordias suas?
kjv: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: the remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.

wlc: כִּי־חֲמַת אָדָם תּוֹדֶךָּ שְׁאֵרִית חֵמֹת תַּחְגֹּר ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπα Νῦν ἠρξάμην. αὕτη ἡ ἀλλοίωσις τῆς δεξιᾶς τοῦ ὑψίστου
vulg: et dixi nunc coepi haec mutatio dexterae Excelsi
clem: Et dixi: Nunc cpi; hc mutatio dexter Excelsi.
kjv: Vow, and pay unto the Lord your God: let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.

wlc: נִדֲרוּ וְשַׁלְּמוּ לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם כָּל־סְבִיבָיו יוֹבִילוּ שַׁי לַמּוֹרָא ׃
lxx: ἐμνήσθην τῶν ἔργων Κυρίου, ὅτι μνησθήσομαι ἀπὸ τῆς ἀρχῆς τῶν θαυμασίων σου,
vulg: memor fui operum Domini quia memor ero ab initio mirabilium tuorum
clem: Memor fui operum Domini, quia memor ero ab initio mirabilium tuorum:
kjv: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: he is terrible to the kings of the earth.

wlc: יִבְצֹר רוּחַ נְגִידִים נוֹרָא לְמַלְכֵי־אָרֶץ ׃
lxx: καὶ μελετήσω ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἔργοις σου, καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἐπιτηδεύμασίν σου ἀδολεσχήσω.
vulg: et meditabor in omnibus operibus tuis et in adinventionibus tuis exercebor
clem: et meditabor in omnibus operibus tuis, et in adinventionibus tuis exercebor.

lxx: ὁ θεός, ἐν τῆ ἁγἰῳ ἡ ὁδός σουοὐ
vulg: Deus in sancto via tua quis deus magnus sicut Deus noster
clem: Deus, in sancto via tua: quis deus magnus sicut Deus noster?

lxx: εἶ ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν ὁ ποιῶν θαυμάσια, τίς θεὸς μέγας ὡς ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐγνώρισας ἐν τοῖς λαοῖς σου τὴν δύναμίν σου·
vulg: tu es Deus qui facis mirabilia notam fecisti in populis virtutem tuam
clem: Tu es Deus qui facis mirabilia: notam fecisti in populis virtutem tuam.

lxx: ἐλυτρώσω ἐν τῷ βραχίονί σου τὸν λαόν σου, τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἰακὼβ καὶ Ἰωσήφ. διάψαλμα.
vulg: redemisti in brachio tuo populum tuum filios Iacob et Ioseph diapsalma
clem: Redemisti in brachio tuo populum tuum, filios Jacob et Joseph.

lxx: εἴδοσάν σε ὕδατα, ὁ θεός, εἴδοσάν σε ὕδατα καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν, καὶ ἐταράχθησαν ἄβυσσοι
vulg: viderunt te aquae Deus viderunt te aquae et timuerunt et turbatae sunt abyssi
clem: Viderunt te aqu, Deus; viderunt te aqu, et timuerunt: et turbat sunt abyssi.

lxx: π λῆθος ἠχοῦς ὕδατος· φωνὴν ἔδωκαν αἱ νεφέλαι, καὶ γὰρ τὰ βέλη σου διαπορεύονται·
vulg: multitudo sonitus aquarum vocem dederunt nubes etenim sagittae tuae transeunt
clem: Multitudo sonitus aquarum; vocem dederunt nubes. Etenim sagitt tu transeunt;

lxx: φωνὴ τῆς βροντῆς σου ἐν τῷ τροχῷ, ἐσαλεύθη καὶ ἔντρομος ἐγενήθη ἡ γῆ.
vulg: vox tonitrui tui in rota inluxerunt coruscationes tuae orbi terrae commota est et contremuit terra
clem: vox tonitrui tui in rota. Illuxerunt coruscationes tu orbi terr; commota est, et contremuit terra.

lxx: ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ ἡ ὁδός σου, καὶ αἱ τρίβοι σου ἐν ὕδασι πολλοῖς, καὶ τὰ ἴχνη σου οὐ γνωσθήσονται.
vulg: in mari via tua et semitae tuae in aquis multis et vestigia tua non cognoscentur
clem: In mari via tua, et semit tu in aquis multis, et vestigia tua non cognoscentur.

lxx: ὡδήγησας ὡς πρόβατα τὸν λαόν σου ἐν χειρὶ Μωυσῆ καὶ Ἀαρών.
vulg: deduxisti sicut oves populum tuum in manu Mosi et Aaron
clem: Deduxisti sicut oves populum tuum, in manu Moysi et Aaron.]

wlc: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־יְדִיתוּן לְאָסָף מִזְמוֹר ׃
lxx: Προσέχετε λαός μου τὸν νόμον μου, κλίνατε τὸ οὖς ὑμῶν εἰς τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ στόματός μου.
vulg: intellectus Asaph adtendite populus meus legem meam inclinate aurem vestram in verba oris mei
clem: Intellectus Asaph. [Attendite, popule meus, legem meam; inclinate aurem vestram in verba oris mei.
kjv: I cried unto God with my voice, even unto God with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.

wlc: קוֹלִי אֶל־אֱלֹהִים וְאֶצְעָקָה קוֹלִי אֶל־אֱלֹהִים וְהַאֲזִין אֵלָי ׃
lxx: ἀνοίξω ἐν παραβολαῖς τὸ στόμα μου, φθέγξομαι προβλήματα ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς.
vulg: aperiam in parabola os meum eloquar propositiones ab initio
clem: Aperiam in parabolis os meum; loquar propositiones ab initio.
kjv: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: my sore ran in the night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted.

wlc: בְּיוֹם צָרָתִי אֲדֹנָי דָּרָשְׁתִּי יָדִי לַיְלָה נִגְּרָה וְלֹא תָפוּג מֵאֲנָה הִנָּחֵם נַפְשִׁי ׃
lxx: ὅσα ἠκούσαμεν καὶ ἔγνωμεν αὐτά, καὶ οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν διηγήσαντο ἡμῖν·
vulg: quanta audivimus et cognovimus ea et patres nostri narraverunt nobis
clem: Quanta audivimus, et cognovimus ea, et patres nostri narraverunt nobis.
kjv: I remembered God, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.

wlc: אֶזְכְּרָה אֱלֹהִים וְאֶהֱמָיָה אָשִׂיחָה וְתִתְעַטֵּף רוּחִי סֶלָה ׃
lxx: οὐκ ἐκρύβη ἀπὸ τῶν τέκνων αὐτῶν εἰς γενεὰν ἑτέραν, ἀπαγγέλλοντες τὰς αἰνέσεις Κυρίου καὶ τὰς δυναστίας αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὰ θαυμάσια αὐτοῦ ἃ ἐποίησεν.
vulg: non sunt occultata a filiis eorum in generationem alteram narrantes laudes Domini et virtutes eius et mirabilia eius quae fecit
clem: Non sunt occultata a filiis eorum in generatione altera, narrantes laudes Domini et virtutes ejus, et mirabilia ejus qu fecit.
kjv: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.

wlc: אָחַזְתָּ שְׁמֻרוֹת עֵינָי נִפְעַמְתִּי וְלֹא אֲדַבֵּר ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀνέστησεν μαρτύριον ἐν Ἰακώβ, καὶ νόμον ἔθετο ἐν Ἰσραήλ, ὃν ἐνετείλατο τοῖς πατράσιν ἡμῶν γνωρίσαι αὐτὸν τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτῶν,
vulg: et suscitavit testimonium in Iacob et legem posuit in Israhel quanta mandavit patribus nostris nota facere ea filiis suis
clem: Et suscitavit testimonium in Jacob, et legem posuit in Isral, quanta mandavit patribus nostris nota facere ea filiis suis:
kjv: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

wlc: חִשַּׁבְתִּי יָמִים מִקֶּדֶם שְׁנוֹת עוֹלָמִים ׃
lxx: ὅπως ἂν γνῷ γενεὰ ἑτέρα, υἱοὶ οἱ τεχθησόμενοι, καὶ ἀναστήσονται καὶ ἀπαγγελοῦσιν αὐτὰ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτῶν·
vulg: ut cognoscat generatio altera filii qui nascentur et exsurgent et narrabunt filiis suis
clem: ut cognoscat generatio altera: filii qui nascentur et exsurgent, et narrabunt filiis suis,
kjv: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.

wlc: אֶזְכְּרָה נְגִינָתִי בַּלָּיְלָה עִם־לְבָבִי אָשִׂיחָה וַיְחַפֵּשׂ רוּחִי ׃
lxx: ἵνα θῶνται ἐπὶ τὸν θεὸν τὴν ἐλπίδα αὐτῶν, καὶ μὴ ἐπιλάθωνται τῶν ἔργων τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ ἐκζητήσουσιν·
vulg: ut ponant in Deo spem suam et non obliviscantur opera Dei et mandata eius exquirant
clem: ut ponant in Deo spem suam, et non obliviscantur operum Dei, et mandata ejus exquirant:
kjv: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?

wlc: הַלְעוֹלָמִים יִזְנַח אֲדֹנָי וְלֹא־יֹסִיף לִרְצוֹת עוֹד ׃
lxx: ἵνα μὴ γένωνται ὡς οἱ πατέρες αὐτῶν γενεὰ σκολιὰ καὶ παραπικραίνουσα, γενεὰ ἥτις οὐ κατηύθυνεν ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῆς, καὶ οὐκ ἐπιστώθη μετὰ τοῦ θεοῦ τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτῆς.
vulg: ne fiant sicut patres eorum generatio prava et exasperans generatio quae non direxit cor suum et non est creditus cum Deo spiritus eius
clem: ne fiant, sicut patres eorum, generatio prava et exasperans; generatio qu non direxit cor suum, et non est creditus cum Deo spiritus ejus.
kjv: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth his promise fail for evermore?

wlc: הֶאָפֵס לָנֶצַח חַסְדּוֹ גָּמַר אֹמֶר לְדֹר וָדֹר ׃
lxx: υἱοὶ Ἐφράιμ ἐντείνοντες καὶ βάλλοντες τόξον ἐστράφησαν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ πολέμου·
vulg: filii Effrem intendentes et mittentes arcus conversi sunt in die belli
clem: Filii Ephrem, intendentes et mittentes arcum, conversi sunt in die belli.
kjv: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.

wlc: הֲשָׁכַח חַנּוֹת אֵל אִם־קָפַץ בְּאַף רַחֲמָיו סֶלָה ׃
lxx: οὐκ ἐφυλάξαντο τὴν διαθήκην τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ ἐν τῷ νόμῳ αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἤθελον πορεύεσθαι.
vulg: non custodierunt testamentum Dei et in lege eius noluerunt ambulare
clem: Non custodierunt testamentum Dei, et in lege ejus noluerunt ambulare.
kjv: And I said, This is my infirmity: but I will remember the years of the right hand of the most High.

wlc: וָאֹמַר חַלּוֹתִי הִיא שְׁנוֹת יְמִין עֶלְיוֹן ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐπελάθοντο τῶν εὐεργεσιῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ τῶν θαυμασίων αὐτοῦ ὧν ἔδειξεν αὐτοῖς,
vulg: et obliti sunt benefactorum eius et mirabilium eius quae ostendit eis
clem: Et obliti sunt benefactorum ejus, et mirabilium ejus qu ostendit eis.
kjv: I will remember the works of the Lord: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.

wlc: אַזְכִּיר מַעַלְלֵי־יָהּ כִּי־אֶזְכְּרָה מִקֶּדֶם פִּלְאֶךָ ׃
lxx: ἐναντίον τῶν πατέρων αὐτῶν ἃ ἐποίησεν θαυμάσια, ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ ἐν πεδίῳ Τάνεως.
vulg: coram patribus eorum quae fecit mirabilia in terra Aegypti in campo Taneos
clem: Coram patribus eorum fecit mirabilia in terra gypti, in campo Taneos.
kjv: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.

wlc: וְהָגִיתִי בְכָל־פָּעֳלֶךָ וּבַעֲלִילוֹתֶיךָ אָשִׂיחָה ׃
lxx: διέρρηξεν θάλασσαν καὶ διήγαγεν αὐτούς, ἔστησεν ὕδατα ὡσεὶ ἀσκόν·
vulg: interrupit mare et perduxit eos statuit aquas quasi utrem
clem: Interrupit mare, et perduxit eos, et statuit aquas quasi in utre:
kjv: Thy way, O God, is in the sanctuary: who is so great a God as our God?

wlc: אֱלֹהִים בַּקֹּדֶשׁ דַּרְכֶּךָ מִי־אֵל גָּדוֹל כֵּאלֹהִים ׃
lxx: καὶ ὡδήγησεν αὐτοὺς ἐν νεφέλῃ ἡμέρας. καὶ ὅλην τὴν νύκτα ἐν φωτισμῷ πυρός·
vulg: et deduxit eos in nube diei et tota nocte in inluminatione ignis
clem: et deduxit eos in nube diei, et tota nocte in illuminatione ignis.
kjv: Thou art the God that doest wonders: thou hast declared thy strength among the people.

wlc: אַתָּה הָאֵל עֹשֵׂה פֶלֶא הוֹדַעְתָּ בָעַמִּים עֻזֶּךָ ׃
lxx: διέρρηξεν πέτραν ἐν ἐρήμῳ. καὶ ἐπότισεν αὐτοὺς ὡς ἐν ἀβύσσῳ πολλῇ·
vulg: interrupit petram in heremo et adaquavit eos velut in abysso multa
clem: Interrupit petram in eremo, et adaquavit eos velut in abysso multa.
kjv: Thou hast with thine arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

wlc: גָּאַלְתָּ בִּזְרוֹעַ עַמֶּךָ בְּנֵי־יַעֲקֹב וְיוֹסֵף סֶלָה ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐξήγαγεν ὔδωρ ἐκ πέτρας. καὶ κατήγαγεν ὡς ποταμοὺς ὕδατα.
vulg: et eduxit aquam de petra et deduxit tamquam flumina aquas
clem: Et eduxit aquam de petra, et deduxit tamquam flumina aquas.
kjv: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.

wlc: רָאוּךָ מַּיִם אֱלֹהִים רָאוּךָ מַּיִם יָחִילוּ אַף יִרְגְּזוּ תְהֹמוֹת ׃
lxx: καὶ προσέθεντο ἔτι τοῦ ἁμαρτάνειν αὐτῷ· παρεπίκραναν τὸν ὕψιστον ἐν ἀνύδρῳ,
vulg: et adposuerunt adhuc peccare ei in ira excitaverunt Excelsum in inaquoso
clem: Et apposuerunt adhuc peccare ei; in iram excitaverunt Excelsum in inaquoso.
kjv: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad.

wlc: זֹרְמוּ מַיִם עָבוֹת קוֹל נָתְנוּ שְׁחָקִים אַף־חֲצָצֶיךָ יִתְהַלָּכוּ ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐξεπείρασαν τὸν θεὸν ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις αὐτῶν, τοῦ αἰτῆσαι βρώματα ταῖς ψυχαῖς αὐτῶν.
vulg: et temptaverunt Deum in cordibus suis ut peterent escas animabus suis
clem: Et tentaverunt Deum in cordibus suis, ut peterent escas animabus suis.
kjv: The voice of thy thunder was in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.

wlc: קוֹל רַעַמְךָ בַּגַּלְגַּל הֵאִירוּ בְרָקִים תֵּבֵל רָגְזָה וַתִּרְעַשׁ הָאָרֶץ ׃
lxx: καὶ κατελάλησαν τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ εἶπαν Μὴ δυνήσεται ὁ θεὸς ἑτοιμάσαι τράπεζαν ἐυ ἐρήμῳ
vulg: et male locuti sunt de Deo dixerunt numquid poterit Deus parare mensam in deserto
clem: Et male locuti sunt de Deo; dixerunt: Numquid poterit Deus parare mensam in deserto?
kjv: Thy way is in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.

wlc: בַּיָּם דַּרְכֶּךָ וּשְׁבִילֶיךָ בְּמַיִם רַבִּים וְעִקְּבוֹתֶיךָ לֹא נֹדָעוּ ׃
lxx: ἐπεὶ ἐπάταξεν πέτραν, καὶ ἐρρύησαν ὕδατα, καὶ χείμαρροι κατεκλύσθησαν· μὴ καὶ ἄρτον δυνήσεται δοῦναι; ἢ ἑτοιμάσαι τράπεζαν τῷ λαῷ αὐτοῦ;
vulg: quoniam percussit petram et fluxerunt aquae et torrentes inundaverunt numquid et panem potest dare aut parare mensam populo suo
clem: quoniam percussit petram, et fluxerunt aqu, et torrentes inundaverunt. Numquid et panem poterit dare, aut parare mensam populo suo?
kjv: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

wlc: נָחִיתָ כַצֹּאן עַמֶּךָ בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן ׃
lxx: Συνέσεως τῷ Ἀσάφ. διὰ τοῦτο ἤκουσεν Κύριος καὶ ἀνεβάλετο, καὶ πῦρ ἀνήφθη ἐν Ἰακώβ, καὶ ὀργὴ ἀνέβη ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰσραήλ·
vulg: ideo audivit Dominus et distulit et ignis accensus est in Iacob et ira ascendit in Israhel
clem: Ideo audivit Dominus et distulit; et ignis accensus est in Jacob, et ira ascendit in Isral:

lxx: ὅτι οὐκ ἐπίστευσαν ἐν τῷ θεῷ, οὐδὲ ἤλπισαν ἐπὶ τὸ σωτήριον αὐτοῦ.
vulg: quia non crediderunt in Deo nec speraverunt in salutare eius
clem: quia non crediderunt in Deo, nec speraverunt in salutari ejus.

lxx: καὶ ἐνετείλατο νεφέλαις ὑπεράνωθεν, καὶ θύρας οὐρανοῦ ἠνέῳξεν·
vulg: et mandavit nubibus desuper et ianuas caeli aperuit
clem: Et mandavit nubibus desuper, et januas cli aperuit.

lxx: καὶ ἔβρεξεν αὐτοῖς μάννα φαγεῖν, καὶ ἄρτον οὐρανοῦ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς·
vulg: et pluit illis manna ad manducandum et panem caeli dedit eis
clem: Et pluit illis manna ad manducandum, et panem cli dedit eis.

lxx: ἄρτον ἀγγέλων ἔφαγεν ἄνθρωπος, ἐπισιτισμὸν ἀπέστειλεν αὐτοῖς εἰς πλησμονήν.
vulg: panem angelorum manducavit homo cibaria misit eis in abundantiam
clem: Panem angelorum manducavit homo; cibaria misit eis in abundantia.

lxx: καὶ ἐπῆρεν νότον ἐξ οὐρανοῦ, καὶ ἐπήγαγεν ἐν τῇ δυναστίᾳ αὐτοῦ λίβα,
vulg: transtulit austrum de caelo et induxit in virtute sua africum
clem: Transtulit austrum de clo, et induxit in virtute sua africum.

lxx: καὶ ἔβρεξεν ἐπʼ αὐτοὺς ὡσεὶ χοῦν σάρκας, καὶ ὁὡσεὶ ἄμμον θαλασσῶν πετεινὰ πτερωτά·
vulg: et pluit super eos sicut pulverem carnes et sicut harenam maris volatilia pinnata
clem: Et pluit super eos sicut pulverem carnes, et sicut arenam maris volatilia pennata.

lxx: καὶ ἐπέπεσον εἰς μέσον τῆς παρεμβολῆς αὐτῶν, κύκλῳ τῶν σκηνωμάτων αὐτῶν.
vulg: et ceciderunt in medio castrorum eorum circa tabernacula eorum
clem: Et ceciderunt in medio castrorum eorum, circa tabernacula eorum.

lxx: καὶ ἐφάγοσαν καὶ ἐνεπλήσθησαν σφόδρα, καὶ τὴν ἐπιθυμίαν αὐτῶν ἤνεγκεν αὐτοῖς.
vulg: et manducaverunt et saturati sunt nimis et desiderium eorum adtulit eis
clem: Et manducaverunt, et saturati sunt nimis, et desiderium eorum attulit eis:

lxx: οὐκ ἐστερήθησαν ἀπὸ τῆς ἐπιθυμίας αὐτῶν· ἔτι τῆς βρώσεως αὐτῶν οὔσης ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτῶν,
vulg: non sunt fraudati a desiderio suo adhuc escae eorum erant in ore ipsorum
clem: non sunt fraudati a desiderio suo. Adhuc esc eorum erant in ore ipsorum,

lxx: καὶ ὀργὴ τοῦ θεοῦ ἀνέβη ἐπʼ αὐτοὺς καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν ἐν τοῖς πλείοσιν αὐτῶν, καὶ τοὺς ἐκλεκτοὺς τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ συνεπόδισεν.
vulg: et ira Dei ascendit in eos et occidit pingues eorum et electos Israhel inpedivit
clem: et ira Dei ascendit super eos: et occidit pingues eorum, et electos Isral impedivit.

lxx: ἐν πᾶσιν τούτοις ἥμαρτον ἔτι, καὶ οὐκ ἐπίστευσαν τοῖς θαυμασίοις αὐτοῦ·
vulg: in omnibus his peccaverunt adhuc et non crediderunt mirabilibus eius
clem: In omnibus his peccaverunt adhuc, et non crediderunt in mirabilibus ejus.

lxx: καὶ ἐξέλιπον ἐν ματαιότητι αἱ ἡμέραι αὐτῶν, καὶ τὰ ἔτη αὐτῶν μετὰ σπουδῆς.
vulg: et defecerunt in vanitate dies eorum et anni eorum cum festinatione
clem: Et defecerunt in vanitate dies eorum, et anni eorum cum festinatione.

lxx: ἄταν ἀπέκτεννεν αὐτοὺς ἐζήτουν αὐτόν, καὶ ἐπέστρεφον καὶ ὥρθριζον πρὸς τὸν θεόν·
vulg: cum occideret eos quaerebant eum et revertebantur et diluculo veniebant ad Deum
clem: Cum occideret eos, qurebant eum et revertebantur, et diluculo veniebant ad eum.

lxx: καὶ ἐμνήσθησαν ὅτι ὁ θεὸς βοηθὸς αὐτῶν ἐστιν, καὶ ὁ θεὸς ὁ ὕψιστος λυτρωτὴς αὐτῶν ἐστιν.
vulg: et rememorati sunt quia Deus adiutor est eorum et Deus excelsus redemptor eorum est
clem: Et rememorati sunt quia Deus adjutor est eorum, et Deus excelsus redemptor eorum est.

lxx: καὶ ἠγάπησαν αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτῶν, καὶσσῃ αὐτῶν ἐψεύσαντο αὐτῷ·
vulg: et dilexerunt eum in ore suo et lingua sua mentiti sunt ei
clem: Et dilexerunt eum in ore suo, et lingua sua mentiti sunt ei;

lxx: ἡ δὲ καρδία αὐτῶν οὐκ εὐθεῖα μετʼ αὐτοῦ, οὐδὲ ἐπιστώθησαν ἐν τῇ διαθήκῃ εὐτοῦ.
vulg: cor autem ipsorum non erat rectum cum eo nec fideles habiti sunt in testamento eius
clem: cor autem eorum non erat rectum cum eo, nec fideles habiti sunt in testamento ejus.

lxx: αὐτὸς δέ ἐστιν οἰκτίρμων καὶ ἱλάσεται ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις αὐτῶν, καὶ οὐ διαφθερεῖ καὶ πληθυνεῖ τοῦ ἀποστρέψαι τὸν θυμὸν αὐτοῦ, καὶ οὐχὶ ἐκκαύσει πᾶσαν τὴν ὀργὴν αὐτοῦ.
vulg: ipse autem est misericors et propitius fiet peccatis eorum et non perdet eos et abundabit ut avertat iram suam et non accendet omnem iram suam
clem: Ipse autem est misericors, et propitius fiet peccatis eorum, et non disperdet eos. Et abundavit ut averteret iram suam, et non accendit omnem iram suam.

lxx: καὶ ἐμνήσθη ὅτι σάρξ εἰσιν. πνεῦμα πορευόμενον καὶ οὐκ ἐπιστρέφον.
vulg: et recordatus est quia caro sunt spiritus vadens et non rediens
clem: Et recordatus est quia caro sunt, spiritus vadens et non rediens.

lxx: ποσάκις παρεπίκραναν αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ, παρώργισαν αὐτὸν ἐν γῇ ἀνύδρῳ;
vulg: quotiens exacerbaverunt eum in deserto in ira concitaverunt eum in inaquoso
clem: Quoties exacerbaverunt eum in deserto; in iram concitaverunt eum in inaquoso?

lxx: καὶ ἐπέστρεψαν καὶ ἐπείρασαν τὸν θεόν, καὶ τὸν ἅγιον τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ παρώξυναν.
vulg: et conversi sunt et temptaverunt Deum et Sanctum Israhel exacerbaverunt
clem: Et conversi sunt, et tentaverunt Deum, et sanctum Isral exacerbaverunt.

lxx: οὐκ ἐμνήσθησαν τῆς χειρὸς αὐτοῦ, ἡμέρας ἧς ἐλυτρώσατο αὐτοὺς ἐκ χειρὸς θλίδοντος·
vulg: non sunt recordati manus eius die qua redemit eos de manu tribulantis
clem: Non sunt recordati manus ejus, die qua redemit eos de manu tribulantis:

lxx: ὡς ἔθετο ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ τὰ σημεῖα αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὰ τέρατα αὐτοῦ ἐν πεδίῳ Τάνεως·
vulg: sicut posuit in Aegypto signa sua et prodigia sua in campo Taneos
clem: sicut posuit in gypto signa sua, et prodigia sua in campo Taneos;

lxx: καὶ μετέστρεψεν εἰς αἷμα τοὺς ποταμοὺς αὐτῶν, καὶ τὰ ὀμβρήματα αὐτῶν ὅπως μὴ πίωσιν·
vulg: et convertit in sanguine flumina eorum et imbres eorum ne biberent
clem: et convertit in sanguinem flumina eorum, et imbres eorum, ne biberent.

lxx: ἐξαπέστειλεν εἰς αὐτοὺς κυνόμυιαν καὶ κατέφαγεν αὐτούς, καὶ βάτραχον καὶ διέφθειρεν αὐτούς·
vulg: misit in eos cynomiam et comedit eos et ranam et disperdit eos
clem: Misit in eos cnomyiam, et comedit eos, et ranam, et disperdidit eos;

lxx: καὶ ἔδωκεν τῇ ἐρυσίβῃ τὸν καρπὸν αὐτῶν, καὶ τοὺς πόνους αὐτῶν τῇ ἀκρίδι·
vulg: et dedit erugini fructus eorum et labores eorum lucustae
clem: et dedit rugini fructus eorum, et labores eorum locust;

lxx: ἀπέκτεινεν ἐν χαλάζῃ τὴν ἄμπελον αὐτῶν, καὶ τὰς συκαμίνους αὐτῶν ἐν τῇ πάχνῃ·
vulg: et occidit in grandine vineam eorum et moros eorum in pruina
clem: et occidit in grandine vineas eorum, et moros eorum in pruina;

lxx: καὶ παρέδωκεν ἐν χαλάζῃ τὰ κτήνη αὐτῶν. καὶ τὴν ὕπαρξιν αὐτῶν τῷ πυρί
vulg: et tradidit grandini iumenta eorum et possessionem eorum igni
clem: et tradidit grandini jumenta eorum, et possessionem eorum igni;

lxx: ἐξαπέστειλεν εἰς αὐτοὺς ὀργὴν θυμοῦ αὐτοῦ, θυμὸν καὶ ὀργὴν καὶ θλίψιν, ἀποστολὴν δι᾿ ἀγγέλων πονηρῶν·
vulg: misit in eos iram indignationis suae indignationem et iram et tribulationem inmissionem per angelos malos
clem: misit in eos iram indignationis su, indignationem, et iram, et tribulationem, immissiones per angelos malos.

lxx: ὡδοποίησεν τρίβον τῇ ὀργῇ αὐτοῦ, οὐκ ἐφείσατο ἀπὸ θανάτου τῶν ψυχῶν αὐτῶν, καὶ τὰ κτήνη αὐτῶν εἰς θάνατον συνέκλεισεν·
vulg: viam fecit semitae irae suae non pepercit a morte animarum eorum et iumenta eorum in morte conclusit
clem: Viam fecit semit ir su: non pepercit a morte animabus eorum, et jumenta eorum in morte conclusit:

lxx: καὶ ἐπάταξεν πᾶν πρωτότοκον ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ, ἀπαρχὴν τῶν πόνων αὐτῶν ἐν τοῖς σκηνώμασι Χάμ.
vulg: et percussit omne primitivum in terra Aegypti primitias laborum eorum in tabernaculis Cham
clem: et percussit omne primogenitum in terra gypti; primitias omnis laboris eorum in tabernaculis Cham:

lxx: καὶ ἀπῆρεν ὡς πρόβατα τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἤγαγεν αὐτοὺς ὡς ποίμνιον ἐν ἐρήμῳ
vulg: et abstulit sicut oves populum suum et perduxit eos tamquam gregem in deserto
clem: et abstulit sicut oves populum suum, et perduxit eos tamquam gregem in deserto:

lxx: καὶ ὡδήγησεν αὐτοὺς ἐν ἐλπίδι καὶ οὐκ ἐδειλίασαν, καὶ τοὺς ἐχθροὺς αὐτῶν ἐκάλυψεν θάλασσα.
vulg: et deduxit eos in spe et non timuerunt et inimicos eorum operuit mare
clem: et deduxit eos in spe, et non timuerunt, et inimicos eorum operuit mare.

lxx: καὶ εἰσήγαγεν αὐτοὺς εἰς ὄρος ἁγιάσματος αὐτοῦ, ὄρος τοῦτο ὁ ἐκτήσατο ἡ δεξιὰ αὐτοῦ·
vulg: et induxit eos in montem sanctificationis suae montem quem adquisivit dextera eius et eiecit a facie eorum gentes et sorte divisit eis terram in funiculo distributionis
clem: Et induxit eos in montem sanctificationis su, montem quem acquisivit dextera ejus; et ejecit a facie eorum gentes, et sorte divisit eis terram in funiculo distributionis;

lxx: καὶ ἐξέβαλεν ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν ἔθνη, καὶ ἐκληροδότησεν αὐτοὺς ἐν σχοινίῳ κληροδοσίας, καὶ κατεσκήνωσεν ἐν τοῖς σκηνώμασιν αὐτῶν ταῖς φυλαῖς τοῦ Ἰσραήλ.
vulg: et habitare fecit in tabernaculis eorum tribus Israhel
clem: et habitare fecit in tabernaculis eorum tribus Isral.

lxx: καὶ ἐπείρασαν καὶ παρεπίκραναν τὸν θεὸν τὸν ὕψιστον, καὶ τὰ μαρτύρια αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐφυλάξαντο·
vulg: et temptaverunt et exacerbaverunt Deum excelsum et testimonia eius non custodierunt
clem: Et tentaverunt, et exacerbaverunt Deum excelsum, et testimonia ejus non custodierunt.

lxx: καὶ ἐπέστρεψαν καὶ ἠσυνθέτησαν καθὼς καὶ οἱ πατέρες αὐτῶν καὶ μετεστράφησαν εἰς τόξον στρεβλόν·
vulg: et averterunt se et non servaverunt pactum quemadmodum patres eorum conversi sunt in arcum pravum
clem: Et averterunt se, et non servaverunt pactum: quemadmodum patres eorum, conversi sunt in arcum pravum.

lxx: καὶ παρώργισαν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τοῖς βουνοῖς αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐν τοῖς γλυπτοῖς αὐτῶν παρεζήλωσαν αὐτόν.
vulg: et in ira concitaverunt eum in collibus suis et in sculptilibus suis ad aemulationem eum provocaverunt
clem: In iram concitaverunt eum in collibus suis, et in sculptilibus suis ad mulationem eum provocaverunt.

lxx: ἤκουσεν ὁ θεός, καὶ ὑπερεῖδεν καὶ ἐξουδένωσεν τὸν Ἰσραὴλ σφόδρα·
vulg: audivit Deus et sprevit et ad nihilum redegit valde Israhel
clem: Audivit Deus, et sprevit, et ad nihilum redegit valde Isral.

lxx: καὶ ἀπώσατο τὴν σκηνὴν Σηλώμ, σκήναωμα αὐτοῦ οὗ κατεσκήνωσεν ἐν ἀνθρώποις·
vulg: et reppulit tabernaculum Selo tabernaculum suum ubi habitavit in hominibus
clem: Et repulit tabernaculum Silo, tabernaculum suum, ubi habitavit in hominibus.

lxx: καὶ παρέδωκεν εἰς αἰχμαλωσίαν τὴν ἰσχὺν αὐτῶν, καὶ τὴν καλλονὴν αὐτοῦ εἰς χεῖρας ἐχθροῦ·
vulg: et tradidit in captivitatem virtutem eorum et pulchritudinem eorum in manus inimici
clem: Et tradidit in captivitatem virtutem eorum, et pulchritudinem eorum in manus inimici.

lxx: καὶ συνέκλεισεν εἰς ῥομφαίαν τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὴν κληρονομίαν αὐτοῦ ὑπερεῖδεν.
vulg: et conclusit in gladio populum suum et hereditatem suam sprevit
clem: Et conclusit in gladio populum suum, et hreditatem suam sprevit.

lxx: τοὺς νεανίσκους αὐτῶν κατέφαγεν πῦρ, καὶ αἱ παρθένοι αὐτῶν οὐκ ἐπένθησαν·
vulg: iuvenes eorum comedit ignis et virgines eorum non sunt lamentatae
clem: Juvenes eorum comedit ignis, et virgines eorum non sunt lamentat.

lxx: οἱ ἱερεῖς αὐτῶν ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ ἔπεσαν. καὶ αἱ χῆραι αὐτῶν οὐ κλαυσθήσονται.
vulg: sacerdotes eorum in gladio ceciderunt et viduae eorum non plorabuntur
clem: Sacerdotes eorum in gladio ceciderunt, et vidu eorum non plorabantur.

lxx: καὶ ἐξηγέρθη ὡς ὁ ὑπνῶν Κύριος. ὡς δυνατὸς κεκραιπαληκὼς ἐξ οἴνου·
vulg: et excitatus est tamquam dormiens Dominus tamquam potens crapulatus a vino
clem: Et excitatus est tamquam dormiens Dominus, tamquam potens crapulatus a vino.
