lxx: καὶ ἐπάταξεν τοὺς ἐχθροὺς αὐτῶν εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω, ὄνειδος αἰώνιον ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς.
vulg: et percussit inimicos suos in posteriora obprobrium sempiternum dedit illis
clem: Et percussit inimicos suos in posteriora; opprobrium sempiternum dedit illis.

lxx: καὶ ἀπώσατο τὸ σκήνωμα Ἰωσήφ, καὶ τὴν φυλὴν Ἐφράιμ οὐκ ἐξελέξατο·
vulg: et reppulit tabernaculum Ioseph et tribum Effrem non elegit
clem: Et repulit tabernaculum Joseph, et tribum Ephraim non elegit:

lxx: καὶ ἐξελέξατο τὴν φυλὴν Ἰούδα, τὸ ὄρος τὸ Σειὼν ἠγάπησεν.
vulg: et elegit tribum Iuda montem Sion quem dilexit
clem: sed elegit tribum Juda, montem Sion, quem dilexit.

lxx: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν ὡς μονοκερώτων τὸ ἁγίασμα αὐτοῦ, ἐν τῇ γῇ ἐθεμελίωσεν αὐτὴν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.
vulg: et aedificavit sicut unicornium sanctificium suum in terra quam fundavit in saecula
clem: Et dificavit sicut unicornium sanctificium suum, in terra quam fundavit in scula.

lxx: καὶ ἐξελέξατο Δαυεὶδ τὸν δοῦλον αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἀνέλαβεν αὐτὸν ἐκ τῶν ποιμνίων τῶν προβάτων·
vulg: et elegit David servum suum et sustulit eum de gregibus ovium de post fetantes accepit eum
clem: Et elegit David, servum suum, et sustulit eum de gregibus ovium; de post ftantes accepit eum:

lxx: ἐξόπισθεν τῶν λοχευομένων ἔλαβεν αὐτόν, ποιμαίνειν Ἰακὼβ τὸν δοῦλον αὐτοῦ καὶ Ἰσραὴλ τὴν κληρονομίαν αὐτοῦ.
vulg: pascere Iacob servum suum et Israhel hereditatem suam
clem: pascere Jacob servum suum, et Isral hreditatem suam.

lxx: καὶ ἐποίμανεν αὐτοὺς ἐν νῇ ἀκακίᾳ τῆς καρδίας αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐν τῇ συνέσει τῶν χειρῶν αὐτοῦ ὡδήγησεν αὐτούς.
vulg: et pavit eos in innocentia cordis sui et in intellectibus manuum suarum deduxit eos
clem: Et pavit eos in innocentia cordis sui, et in intellectibus manuum suarum deduxit eos.]

wlc: מַשְׂכִּיל לְאָסָף הַאֲזִינָה עַמִּי תּוֹרָתִי הַטּוּ אָזְנְכֶם לְאִמְרֵי־פִי ׃
lxx: Ὁ θεός, ἤλθοσαν ἔθνη εἰς τὴν κληρονομίαν σου, ἐμίαναν τὸν ναὸν τὸν ἅγιόν σου, ἔθεντο Ἰερουσαλὴμ εἰς ὀπωροφυλάκιον·
vulg: psalmus Asaph Deus venerunt gentes in hereditatem tuam polluerunt templum sanctum tuum posuerunt Hierusalem in pomorum custodiam
clem: Psalmus Asaph. [Deus, venerunt gentes in hreditatem tuam; polluerunt templum sanctum tuum; posuerunt Jerusalem in pomorum custodiam.
kjv: Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.

wlc: אֶפְתְּחָה בְמָשָׁל פִּי אַבִּיעָה חִידוֹת מִנִּי־קֶדֶם ׃
lxx: ἔθεντο τὰ θνησιμαῖα τῶν δούλων σου βρώματα τοῖς πετεινοῖς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, τὰς σάρκας τῶν ὁσίων σου τοῖς θηρίοις τῆς γῆς·
vulg: posuerunt morticina servorum tuorum escas volatilibus caeli carnes sanctorum tuorum bestiis terrae
clem: Posuerunt morticina servorum tuorum escas volatilibus cli; carnes sanctorum tuorum bestiis terr.
kjv: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:

wlc: אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְנוּ וַנֵּדָעֵם וַאֲבוֹתֵינוּ סִפְּרוּ־לָנוּ ׃
lxx: ἐξέχεαν τὸ αἷμα αὐτῶν ὡς ὕδωρ κύκλῳ Ἰερουσαλήμ, καὶ οὐκ ἦν ὁ θάπτων.
vulg: effuderunt sanguinem ipsorum tamquam aquam in circuitu Hierusalem et non erat qui sepeliret
clem: Effuderunt sanguinem eorum tamquam aquam in circuitu Jerusalem, et non erat qui sepeliret.
kjv: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

wlc: לֹא נְכַחֵד מִבְּנֵיהֶם לְדוֹר אַחֲרוֹן מְסַפְּרִים תְּהִלּוֹת יְהוָה וֶעֱזוּזוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה ׃
lxx: ἐγενήθημεν εἰς ὄνειδος τοῖς γείτοσιν ἡμῶν. μυκτηρισμὸς καὶ χλευασμὸς τοῖς κύκλῳ ἡμῶν.
vulg: facti sumus obprobrium vicinis nostris subsannatio et inlusio his qui circum nos sunt
clem: Facti sumus opprobrium vicinis nostris; subsannatio et illusio his qui in circuitu nostro sunt.
kjv: We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of the Lord, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.

wlc: וַיָּקֶם עֵדוּת בְּיַעֲקֹב וְתוֹרָה שָׂם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶת־אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לְהוֹדִיעָם לִבְנֵיהֶם ׃
lxx: ἕως πότε, Κύριε, ὀργισθήσῃ εἰς τέλος; ἐκκαυθήσεται ὡς πῦρ ὁ ζῆλός σου;
vulg: usquequo Domine irasceris in finem accendetur velut ignis zelus tuus
clem: Usquequo, Domine, irasceris in finem? accendetur velut ignis zelus tuus?
kjv: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:

wlc: לְמַעַן יֵדְעוּ דּוֹר אַחֲרוֹן בָּנִים יִוָּלֵדוּ יָקֻמוּ וִיסַפְּרוּ לִבְנֵיהֶם ׃
lxx: ἔκχεον τὴν ὀργήν σου ἐπὶ ἔθνη τὰ μὴ ἐπεγνωκότα σε, καὶ ἐπὶ βασιλείας αἱ τὸ ὄνομά σου οὐκ ἐπεκαλέσαντο·
vulg: effunde iram tuam in gentes quae te non noverunt et in regna quae nomen tuum non invocaverunt
clem: Effunde iram tuam in gentes qu te non noverunt, et in regna qu nomen tuum non invocaverunt:
kjv: That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:

wlc: וְיָשִׂימוּ בֵאלֹהִים כִּסְלָם וְלֹא יִשְׁכְּחוּ מַעַלְלֵי־אֵל וּמִצְוֹתָיו יִנְצֹרוּ ׃
lxx: ὅτι κατέφαγον τὸν Ἰακώβ, καὶ τὸν τόπον αὐτοῦ ἠρήμωσαν.
vulg: quia comederunt Iacob et locum eius desolaverunt
clem: quia comederunt Jacob, et locum ejus desolaverunt.
kjv: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:

wlc: וְלֹא יִהְיוּ כַּאֲבוֹתָם דּוֹר סוֹרֵר וּמֹרֶה דּוֹר לֹא־הֵכִין לִבּוֹ וְלֹא־נֶאֶמְנָה אֶת־אֵל רוּחוֹ ׃
lxx: μὴ μνησθῇς ἡμῶν ἀνομιῶν ἀρχαίων· ταχὺ προκαταλαβέτωσαν ἡμᾶς οἱ οἰκτειρμοί σου, ὅτι ἐπτωχεύσαμεν σφόδρα.
vulg: ne memineris iniquitatum nostrarum antiquarum cito anticipent nos misericordiae tuae quia pauperes facti sumus nimis
clem: Ne memineris iniquitatum nostrarum antiquarum; cito anticipent nos misericordi tu, quia pauperes facti sumus nimis.
kjv: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.

wlc: בְּנֵי־אֶפְרַיִם נוֹשְׁקֵי רוֹמֵי־קָשֶׁת הָפְכוּ בְּיוֹם קְרָב ׃
lxx: βοήθησον ἡμῖν, ὁ θεὸς ὁ σωτὴρ ἡμῶν, ἕνεκα τῆς δόξης τοῦ ὀνόματός σου· Κύριε, ῥῦσαι ἡμᾶς, καὶ ἱλάσθητι ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ἡμῶν ἕνεκα τοῦ ὀνόματός σου·
vulg: adiuva nos Deus salutaris noster propter gloriam nominis tui Domine libera nos et propitius esto peccatis nostris propter nomen tuum
clem: Adjuva nos, Deus salutaris noster, et propter gloriam nominis tui, Domine, libera nos: et propitius esto peccatis nostris, propter nomen tuum.
kjv: The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.

wlc: לֹא שָׁמְרוּ בְּרִית אֱלֹהִים וּבְתוֹרָתוֹ מֵאֲנוּ לָלֶכֶת ׃
lxx: μή ποτε εἵπωσιν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν Ποῦ ἐστιν ὁ θεὸς αὐτῶν; καὶ γνωσθήτω ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἐνώπιον τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν ἡμῶν ἡ ἐκδίκησις τοῦ αἵματος τῶν δούλων σου τοῦ ἐκκεχυμένου.
vulg: ne forte dicant in gentibus ubi est Deus eorum et innotescat in nationibus coram oculis nostris ultio sanguinis servorum tuorum qui effusus est
clem: Ne forte dicant in gentibus: Ubi est Deus eorum? et innotescat in nationibus coram oculis nostris ultio sanguinis servorum tuorum qui effusus est.
kjv: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;

wlc: וַיִּשְׁכְּחוּ עֲלִילוֹתָיו וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו אֲשֶׁר הֶרְאָם ׃
lxx: εἰοηλθάτω ἐνώπιόν σου ὁ στεναγμὸς τῶν πεπεδημέναων, κατὰ τὴν μεγαλωσύνην τοῦ βραχίονός σου, περιποίησαι τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν τεθαναταομέναων.
vulg: introeat in conspectu tuo gemitus conpeditorum secundum magnitudinem brachii tui posside filios mortificatorum
clem: Introat in conspectu tuo gemitus compeditorum; secundum magnitudinem brachii tui posside filios mortificatorum:
kjv: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.

wlc: נֶגֶד אֲבוֹתָם עָשָׂה פֶלֶא בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם שְׂדֵה־צֹעַן ׃
lxx: ἀπόδος τοῖς γείτοσιν ἡμῶν ἑπταπλάσια εἰς τὸν κόλπον αὐτῶν, τὸν ὀνειδισμὸν αὐτῶν ὃν ὠνείδισάν σε, κύριε.
vulg: et redde vicinis nostris septuplum in sinu eorum inproperium ipsorum quod exprobraverunt tibi Domine
clem: et redde vicinis nostris septuplum in sinu eorum; improperium ipsorum quod exprobraverunt tibi, Domine.
kjv: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

wlc: בָּקַע יָם וַיַּעֲבִירֵם וַיַּצֶּב־מַיִם כְּמוֹ־נֵד ׃
lxx: ἡμεῖς γὰρ λαός σου καὶ πρόβατα τῆς νομῆς σου ἀνθομολογησόμεθά σοι εἰς τὸν αἰώνα, εἰς γενεὰν καὶ γενεὰν ἐξαγγελοῦμεν τὴν αἴνεσίν σου.
vulg: nos autem populus tuus et oves pascuae tuae confitebimur tibi in saeculum in generationem et generationem adnuntiabimus laudem tuam
clem: Nos autem populus tuus, et oves pascu tu, confitebimur tibi in sculum; in generationem et generationem annuntiabimus laudem tuam.]
kjv: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.

wlc: וַיַּנְחֵם בֶּעָנָן יוֹמָם וְכָל־הַלַּיְלָה בְּאוֹר אֵשׁ ׃
kjv: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.

wlc: יְבַקַּע צֻרִים בַּמִּדְבָּר וַיַּשְׁקְ כִּתְהֹמוֹת רַבָּה ׃
kjv: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink as out of the great depths.

wlc: וַיּוֹצִא נוֹזְלִים מִסָּלַע וַיּוֹרֶד כַּנְּהָרוֹת מָיִם ׃
kjv: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

wlc: וַיּוֹסִיפוּ עוֹד לַחֲטֹא־לוֹ לַמְרוֹת עֶלְיוֹן בַּצִּיָּה ׃
kjv: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.

wlc: וַיְנַסּוּ־אֵל בִּלְבָבָם לִשְׁאָל־אֹכֶל לְנַפְשָׁם ׃
kjv: And they tempted God in their heart by asking meat for their lust.

wlc: וַיְדַבְּרוּ בֵּאלֹהִים אָמְרוּ הֲיוּכַל אֵל לַעֲרֹךְ שֻׁלְחָן בַּמִּדְבָּר ׃
kjv: Yea, they spake against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?

wlc: הֵן הִכָּה־צוּר וַיָּזוּבוּ מַיִם וּנְחָלִים יִשְׁטֹפוּ הֲגַם־לֶחֶם יוּכַל תֵּת אִם־יָכִין שְׁאֵר לְעַמּוֹ ׃
kjv: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?

wlc: לָכֵן שָׁמַע יְהוָה וַיִּתְעַבָּר וְאֵשׁ נִשְּׂקָה בְיַעֲקֹב וְגַם־אַף עָלָה בְיִשְׂרָאֵל ׃
kjv: Therefore the Lord heard this, and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel;

wlc: כִּי לֹא הֶאֱמִינוּ בֵּאלֹהִים וְלֹא בָטְחוּ בִּישׁוּעָתוֹ ׃
kjv: Because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation:

wlc: וַיְצַו שְׁחָקִים מִמָּעַל וְדַלְתֵי שָׁמַיִם פָּתָח ׃
kjv: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,

wlc: וַיַּמְטֵר עֲלֵיהֶם מָן לֶאֱכֹל וּדְגַן־שָׁמַיִם נָתַן לָמוֹ ׃
kjv: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.

wlc: לֶחֶם אַבִּירִים אָכַל אִישׁ צֵידָה שָׁלַח לָהֶם לָשֹׂבַע ׃
kjv: Man did eat angels' food: he sent them meat to the full.

wlc: יַסַּע קָדִים בַּשָּׁמָיִם וַיְנַהֵג בְּעֻזּוֹ תֵימָן ׃
kjv: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind.

wlc: וַיַּמְטֵר עֲלֵיהֶם כֶּעָפָר שְׁאֵר וּכְחוֹל יַמִּים עוֹף כָּנָף ׃
kjv: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea:

wlc: וַיַּפֵּל בְּקֶרֶב מַחֲנֵהוּ סָבִיב לְמִשְׁכְּנֹתָיו ׃
kjv: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.

wlc: וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיִּשְׂבְּעוּ מְאֹד וְתַאֲוָתָם יָבִא לָהֶם ׃
kjv: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;

wlc: לֹא־זָרוּ מִתַּאֲוָתָם עוֹד אָכְלָם בְּפִיהֶם ׃
kjv: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat was yet in their mouths,

wlc: וְאַף אֱלֹהִים עָלָה בָהֶם וַיַּהֲרֹג בְּמִשְׁמַנֵּיהֶם וּבַחוּרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הִכְרִיעַ ׃
kjv: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Israel.

wlc: בְּכָל־זֹאת חָטְאוּ־עוֹד וְלֹא־הֶאֱמִינוּ בְּנִפְלְאוֹתָיו ׃
kjv: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.

wlc: וַיְכַל־בַּהֶבֶל יְמֵיהֶם וּשְׁנוֹתָם בַּבֶּהָלָה ׃
kjv: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.

wlc: אִם־הֲרָגָם וּדְרָשׁוּהוּ וְשָׁבוּ וְשִׁחֲרוּ־אֵל ׃
kjv: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after God.

wlc: וַיִּזְכְּרוּ כִּי־אֱלֹהִים צוּרָם וְאֵל עֶלְיוֹן גֹּאֲלָם ׃
kjv: And they remembered that God was their rock, and the high God their redeemer.

wlc: וַיְפַתּוּהוּ בְּפִיהֶם וּבִלְשׁוֹנָם יְכַזְּבוּ־לוֹ ׃
kjv: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.

wlc: וְלִבָּם לֹא־נָכוֹן עִמּוֹ וְלֹא נֶאֶמְנוּ בִּבְרִיתוֹ ׃
kjv: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.

wlc: וְהוּא רַחוּם יְכַפֵּר עָוֹן וְלֹא־יַשְׁחִית וְהִרְבָּה לְהָשִׁיב אַפּוֹ וְלֹא־יָעִיר כָּל־חֲמָתוֹ ׃
kjv: But he, being full of compassion, forgave their iniquity, and destroyed them not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.

wlc: וַיִּזְכֹּר כִּי־בָשָׂר הֵמָּה רוּחַ הוֹלֵךְ וְלֹא יָשׁוּב ׃
kjv: For he remembered that they were but flesh; a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.

wlc: כַּמָּה יַמְרוּהוּ בַמִּדְבָּר יַעֲצִיבוּהוּ בִּישִׁימוֹן ׃
kjv: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!

wlc: וַיָּשׁוּבוּ וַיְנַסּוּ אֵל וּקְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל הִתְווּ ׃
kjv: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and limited the Holy One of Israel.

wlc: לֹא־זָכְרוּ אֶת־יָדוֹ יוֹם אֲשֶׁר־פָּדָם מִנִּי־צָר ׃
kjv: They remembered not his hand, nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.

wlc: אֲשֶׁר־שָׂם בְּמִצְרַיִם אֹתוֹתָיו וּמוֹפְתָיו בִּשְׂדֵה־צֹעַן ׃
kjv: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan.

wlc: וַיַּהֲפֹךְ לְדָם יְאֹרֵיהֶם וְנֹזְלֵיהֶם בַּל־יִשְׁתָּיוּן ׃
kjv: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.

wlc: יְשַׁלַּח בָּהֶם עָרֹב וַיֹּאכְלֵם וּצְפַרְדֵּעַ וַתַּשְׁחִיתֵם ׃
kjv: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

wlc: וַיִּתֵּן לֶחָסִיל יְבוּלָם וִיגִיעָם לָאַרְבֶּה ׃
kjv: He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, and their labour unto the locust.

wlc: יַהֲרֹג בַּבָּרָד גַּפְנָם וְשִׁקְמוֹתָם בַּחֲנָמַל ׃
kjv: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost.

wlc: וַיַּסְגֵּר לַבָּרָד בְּעִירָם וּמִקְנֵיהֶם לָרְשָׁפִים ׃
kjv: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

wlc: יְשַׁלַּח־בָּם חֲרוֹן אַפּוֹ עֶבְרָה וָזַעַם וְצָרָה מִשְׁלַחַת מַלְאֲכֵי רָעִים ׃
kjv: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels among them.

wlc: יְפַלֵּס נָתִיב לְאַפּוֹ לֹא־חָשַׂךְ מִמָּוֶת נַפְשָׁם וְחַיָּתָם לַדֶּבֶר הִסְגִּיר ׃
kjv: He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;

wlc: וַיַּךְ כָּל־בְּכוֹר בְּמִצְרָיִם רֵאשִׁית אוֹנִים בְּאָהֳלֵי־חָם ׃
kjv: And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the chief of their strength in the tabernacles of Ham:

wlc: וַיַּסַּע כַּצֹּאן עַמּוֹ וַיְנַהֲגֵם כַּעֵדֶר בַּמִּדְבָּר ׃
kjv: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

wlc: וַיַּנְחֵם לָבֶטַח וְלֹא פָחָדוּ וְאֶת־אוֹיְבֵיהֶם כִּסָּה הַיָּם ׃
kjv: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

wlc: וַיְבִיאֵם אֶל־גְּבוּל קָדְשׁוֹ הַר־זֶה קָנְתָה יְמִינוֹ ׃
kjv: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, even to this mountain, which his right hand had purchased.

wlc: וַיְגָרֶשׁ מִפְּנֵיהֶם גּוֹיִם וַיַּפִּילֵם בְּחֶבֶל נַחֲלָה וַיַּשְׁכֵּן בְּאָהֳלֵיהֶם שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל ׃
kjv: He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

wlc: וַיְנַסּוּ וַיַּמְרוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהִים עֶלְיוֹן וְעֵדוֹתָיו לֹא שָׁמָרוּ ׃
kjv: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, and kept not his testimonies:

wlc: וַיִּסֹּגוּ וַיִּבְגְּדוּ כַּאֲבוֹתָם נֶהְפְּכוּ כְּקֶשֶׁת רְמִיָּה ׃
kjv: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.

wlc: וַיַּכְעִיסוּהוּ בְּבָמוֹתָם וּבִפְסִילֵיהֶם יַקְנִיאוּהוּ ׃
kjv: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.

wlc: שָׁמַע אֱלֹהִים וַיִּתְעַבָּר וַיִּמְאַס מְאֹד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל ׃
kjv: When God heard this, he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:

wlc: וַיִּטֹּשׁ מִשְׁכַּן שִׁלוֹ אֹהֶל שִׁכֵּן בָּאָדָם ׃
kjv: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;

wlc: וַיִּתֵּן לַשְּׁבִי עֻזּוֹ וְתִפְאַרְתּוֹ בְיַד־צָר ׃
kjv: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy's hand.

wlc: וַיַּסְגֵּר לַחֶרֶב עַמּוֹ וּבְנַחֲלָתוֹ הִתְעַבָּר ׃
kjv: He gave his people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.

wlc: בַּחוּרָיו אָכְלָה־אֵשׁ וּבְתוּלֹתָיו לֹא הוּלָּלוּ ׃
kjv: The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not given to marriage.

wlc: כֹּהֲנָיו בַּחֶרֶב נָפָלוּ וְאַלְמְנֹתָיו לֹא תִבְכֶּינָה ׃
kjv: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.

wlc: וַיִּקַץ כְּיָשֵׁן אֲדֹנָי כְּגִבּוֹר מִתְרוֹנֵן מִיָּיִן ׃
kjv: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, and like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.

wlc: וַיַּךְ־צָרָיו אָחוֹר חֶרְפַּת עוֹלָם נָתַן לָמוֹ ׃
kjv: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.

wlc: וַיִּמְאַס בְּאֹהֶל יוֹסֵף וּבְשֵׁבֶט אֶפְרַיִם לֹא בָחָר ׃
kjv: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:

wlc: וַיִּבְחַר אֶת־שֵׁבֶט יְהוּדָה אֶת־הַר צִיּוֹן אֲשֶׁר אָהֵב ׃
kjv: But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.

wlc: וַיִּבֶן כְּמוֹ־רָמִים מִקְדָּשׁוֹ כְּאֶרֶץ יְסָדָהּ לְעוֹלָם ׃
kjv: And he built his sanctuary like high palaces, like the earth which he hath established for ever.

wlc: וַיִּבְחַר בְּדָוִד עַבְדּוֹ וַיִּקָּחֵהוּ מִמִּכְלְאֹת צֹאן ׃
kjv: He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:

wlc: מֵאַחַר עָלוֹת הֱבִיאוֹ לִרְעוֹת בְּיַעֲקֹב עַמּוֹ וּבְיִשְׂרָאֵל נַחֲלָתוֹ ׃
kjv: From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.

wlc: וַיִּרְעֵם כְּתֹם לְבָבוֹ וּבִתְבוּנוֹת כַּפָּיו יַנְחֵם ׃
lxx: Ψαλμὸς τῷ Ἀσάφ.
kjv: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.

wlc: מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף אֱלֹהִים בָּאוּ גוֹיִם בְּנַחֲלָתֶךָ טִמְּאוּ אֶת־הֵיכַל קָדְשֶׁךָ שָׂמוּ אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַם לְעִיִּים ׃
lxx: Εἰς τὸ τέλος. ὐπερ τῶν Ἀλλοιωθητομένων· μαρτύ. ριον τῷ Ἀσάφ, ψαλμὸς ὐπερ τοῦ Ἀσσυρίου.
vulg: in finem pro his qui commutabuntur testimonium Asaph psalmus
clem: In finem, pro iis qui commutabuntur. Testimonium Asaph, psalmus.
kjv: O god, the heathen are come into thine inheritance; thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem on heaps.

wlc: נָתְנוּ אֶת־נִבְלַת עֲבָדֶיךָ מַאֲכָל לְעוֹף הַשָּׁמָיִם בְּשַׂר חֲסִידֶיךָ לְחַיְתוֹ־אָרֶץ ׃
lxx: Ὁ ποιμαίνων τὸν Ἰσραὴλ πρόσχες, ὁ ὁδηγῶν ὡσεὶ πρόβατα τὸν Ἰωσήφ· ὁ καθήμενος ἐπὶ τῶν χερουβεὶμ ἐμφάνηθι,
vulg: qui regis Israhel intende qui deducis tamquam oves Ioseph qui sedes super cherubin manifestare
clem: [Qui regis Isral, intende; qui deducis velut ovem Joseph. Qui sedes super cherubim, manifestare
kjv: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat unto the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.

wlc: שָׁפְכוּ דָמָם כַּמַּיִם סְבִיבוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָם וְאֵין קוֹבֵר ׃
lxx: ἐναντίον Ἐφράιμ καὶ Βενιαμεὶν καὶ Μανασσή, ἐξέγειρον τὴν δυναστείαν σου καὶ ἐλθὲ εἰς τὸ σῶσαι ἡμᾶς
vulg: coram Effraim et Beniamin et Manasse excita potentiam tuam et veni ut salvos facias nos
clem: coram Ephraim, Benjamin, et Manasse. Excita potentiam tuam, et veni, ut salvos facias nos.
kjv: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; and there was none to bury them.

wlc: הָיִינוּ חֶרְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנֵינוּ לַעַג וָקֶלֶס לִסְבִיבוֹתֵינוּ ׃
lxx: ὁ θεός, ἐπίστρεψον ἡμᾶς καὶ ἐπίφανον τὸ πρόσωπόν σου, καὶ σωθησόμεθα.
vulg: Deus converte nos et ostende faciem tuam et salvi erimus
clem: Deus, converte nos, et ostende faciem tuam, et salvi erimus.
kjv: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.

wlc: עַד־מָה יְהוָה תֶּאֱנַף לָנֶצַח תִּבְעַר כְּמוֹ־אֵשׁ קִנְאָתֶךָ ׃
lxx: Κύριε ὁ θεὸς τῶν δυνάμεων, ἕως πότε ὀργίζῃ ἐπὶ τὴν προσευχὴν τοῦ δούλου σου;
vulg: Domine Deus virtutum quousque irasceris super orationem servi tui
clem: Domine Deus virtutum, quousque irasceris super orationem servi tui?
kjv: How long, Lord? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?

wlc: שְׁפֹךְ חֲמָתְךָ אֶל־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יְדָעוּךָ וְעַל מַמְלָכוֹת אֲשֶׁר בְּשִׁמְךָ לֹא קָרָאוּ ׃
lxx: ψωμιεῖς ἡμᾶς ἄρτον δακρύων. καὶ ποτιεῖς ἡμᾶς ἐν δάκρυσιν ἐν μέτρῳ
vulg: cibabis nos pane lacrimarum et potum dabis nobis in lacrimis in mensura
clem: cibabis nos pane lacrimarum, et potum dabis nobis in lacrimis in mensura?
kjv: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.

wlc: כִּי אָכַל אֶת־יַעֲקֹב וְאֶת־נָוֵהוּ הֵשַׁמּוּ ׃
lxx: ἔθου ἡμᾶς εἰς ἀντιλογίαν τοῖς γείτοσιν ἡμῶν. καὶ οἱ ἐχθροὶ ἡμῶν ἐμυκτήρισαν ἡμᾶς.
vulg: posuisti nos in contradictionem vicinis nostris et inimici nostri subsannaverunt nos
clem: Posuisti nos in contradictionem vicinis nostris, et inimici nostri subsannaverunt nos.
kjv: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling place.

wlc: אַל־תִּזְכָּר־לָנוּ עֲוֹנֹת רִאשֹׁנִים מַהֵר יְקַדְּמוּנוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ כִּי דַלּוֹנוּ מְאֹד ׃
lxx: Κύριε ὁ θεὸς τῶν δυνάμεων, ἐπίστρεψον ἡμᾶς καὶ ἐπίφανον τὸ πρόσωπόν σου, καὶ σαωθησόμεθα.
vulg: Deus virtutum converte nos et ostende faciem tuam et salvi erimus
clem: Deus virtutum, converte nos, et ostende faciem tuam, et salvi erimus.
kjv: O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low.

wlc: עָזְרֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעֵנוּ עַל־דְּבַר כְּבוֹד־שְׁמֶךָ וְהַצִּילֵנוּ וְכַפֵּר עַל־חַטֹּאתֵינוּ לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ ׃
lxx: ἄμπελον ἐξ Αἰγύπτου μετῆρας. διάψαλμα. ἐξέβαλες ἔθνη καὶ κατεφύτευσας αὐτήν·
vulg: vineam de Aegypto transtulisti eiecisti gentes et plantasti eam
clem: Vineam de gypto transtulisti: ejecisti gentes, et plantasti eam.
kjv: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name: and deliver us, and purge away our sins, for thy name's sake.

wlc: לָמָּה יֹאמְרוּ הַגּוֹיִם אַיֵּה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם יִוָּדַע בַּגִּיִּים לְעֵינֵינוּ נִקְמַת דַּם־עֲבָדֶיךָ הַשָּׁפוּךְ ׃
lxx: ὠδοποίησας ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῆς. καὶ κατεφύτευσας τὰς ῥίζας αὐτῆς, καὶ ἐπλήσθη ἡ γῆ.
vulg: dux itineris fuisti in conspectu eius et plantasti radices eius et implevit terram
clem: Dux itineris fuisti in conspectu ejus; plantasti radices ejus, et implevit terram.
kjv: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their God? let him be known among the heathen in our sight by the revenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed.

wlc: תָּבוֹא לְפָנֶיךָ אֶנְקַת אָסִיר כְּגֹדֶל זְרוֹעֲךָ הוֹתֵר בְּנֵי תְמוּתָה ׃
lxx: ἐκάλυψεν ὄρη ἡ σκιὰ αὐτῆς, καὶ αἱ ἀναδενδράδες αὐτῆς τὰς κέδρους τοῦ θεοῦ·
vulg: operuit montes umbra eius et arbusta eius cedros Dei
clem: Operuit montes umbra ejus, et arbusta ejus cedros Dei.
kjv: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die;

wlc: וְהָשֵׁב לִשְׁכֵנֵינוּ שִׁבְעָתַיִם אֶל־חֵיקָם חֶרְפָּתָם אֲשֶׁר חֵרְפוּךָ אֲדֹנָי ׃
lxx: ἐξέτεινεν τὰ κλήματα αὐτῆς ἕως θαλάσσης. καὶ ἕως ποταμοῦ τὰς παραφυάδας αὐτῆς.
vulg: extendit palmites suos usque ad mare et usque ad Flumen propagines eius
clem: Extendit palmites suos usque ad mare, et usque ad flumen propagines ejus.
kjv: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.

wlc: וַאֲנַחְנוּ עַמְּךָ וְצֹאן מַרְעִיתֶךָ נוֹדֶה לְּךָ לְעוֹלָם לְדֹר וָדֹר נְסַפֵּר תְּהִלָּתֶךָ ׃
lxx: ἴνα τί καθεῖλες τὸν φραγμὸν αὐτῆς, καὶ τρυγῶσιν αὐτὴν πάντες οἱ παραπορευόμενοι τὴν ὁδόν;
vulg: ut quid destruxisti maceriam eius et vindemiant eam omnes qui praetergrediuntur viam
clem: Ut quid destruxisti maceriam ejus, et vindemiant eam omnes qui prtergrediuntur viam?
kjv: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations.

lxx: ἐλυμήνατο αὐτὴν σῦς ἐκ δρυμοῦ, καὶ ὄυος ἄγριος κατενεμήσατο αὐτήν.
vulg: exterminavit eam aper de silva et singularis ferus depastus est eam
clem: Exterminavit eam aper de silva, et singularis ferus depastus est eam.

lxx: ὁ θεὸς τῶν δυνάμεων, ἐπίστρεψον δή, ἐπίύκβλεψον ἐξ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ἴδε, καὶ ἐπίσκεψαι τὴν ἄμπελον ταύτην·
vulg: Deus virtutum convertere respice de caelo et vide et visita vineam istam
clem: Deus virtutum, convertere, respice de clo, et vide, et visita vineam istam:

lxx: καὶ κατάρτισαι αὐτὴν ἣν ἐφύτευσεν ἡ δεξιά σου, καὶ ἐπὶ υἱὸν ἀνθρώπου ὃν ἐκραταίωσας σεαυτῷ.
vulg: et perfice eam quam plantavit dextera tua et super filium quem confirmasti tibi
clem: et perfice eam quam plantavit dextera tua, et super filium hominis quem confirmasti tibi.

lxx: ἐμπεπυρισμένη πυρὶ καὶ ἀνεσκαμμένη· ἀπὸ ἐπιτιμήσεως τοῦ προσώπου σου ἀπολοῦνται.
vulg: incensa igni et suffossa ab increpatione vultus tui peribunt
clem: Incensa igni et suffossa, ab increpatione vultus tui peribunt.

lxx: γενηθήτω ἡ χείρ σου ἐπʼ ἄνδρα δεξιᾶς σου, καὶ ἐπὶ υἱὸν ἀνθρώπου ὁν ἐκραταίαοσας σεαυτῷ·
vulg: fiat manus tua super virum dexterae tuae et super filium hominis quem confirmasti tibi
clem: Fiat manus tua super virum dexter tu, et super filium hominis quem confirmasti tibi.

lxx: καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀποστῶμεν ἀπὸ σοῦ· ζωώσεις ἡμᾶς, καὶ τὸ ὄνομά σου ἐπικαλεσόμεθα.
vulg: et non discedimus a te vivificabis nos et nomen tuum invocabimus
clem: Et non discedimus a te: vivificabis nos, et nomen tuum invocabimus.

lxx: Κύριε ὁ θεὸς τῶν δυνάμεων, ἐπίστρεψον ἡμᾶς καὶ ἐπίφανον τὸ πρόσαοπόν σου, καὶ σωθησόμεθα.
vulg: Domine Deus virtutum converte nos et ostende faciem tuam et salvi erimus
clem: Domine Deus virtutum, converte nos, et ostende faciem tuam, et salvi erimus.]

wlc: לַמְנַצֵּחַ אֶל־שֹׁשַׁנִּים עֵדוּת לְאָסָף מִזְמוֹר ׃
lxx: Εἰς τὸ τελος, ὐπὲρ τῶν ληνῶν· τῷ Ἀσὰφ ψαλμός.
vulg: in finem pro torcularibus Asaph
clem: In finem, pro torcularibus. Psalmus ipsi Asaph.
kjv: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest between the cherubims, shine forth.

wlc: רֹעֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל הַאֲזִינָה נֹהֵג כַּצֹּאן יוֹסֵף יֹשֵׁב הַכְּרוּבִים הוֹפִיעָה ׃
lxx: Ἀγαλλιᾶσθε τῷ θεῷ τῷ βοηθῷ ἡμῶν, ἀλαλάξατε τῷ θεῷ Ἰακώβ·
vulg: exultate Deo adiutori nostro iubilate Deo Iacob
clem: [Exsultate Deo adjutori nostro; jubilate Deo Jacob.
kjv: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come and save us.

wlc: לִפְנֵי אֶפְרַיִם וּבִנְיָמִן וּמְנַשֶּׁה עוֹרְרָה אֶת־גְּבוּרָתֶךָ וּלְכָה לִישֻׁעָתָה לָּנוּ ׃
lxx: λάβετε ψαλμὸν καὶ δότε τύμπανον, ψαλτήριον τερπνὸν μετὰ κιθάρας·
vulg: sumite psalmum et date tympanum psalterium iucundum cum cithara
clem: Sumite psalmum, et date tympanum; psalterium jucundum cum cithara.
kjv: Turn us again, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

wlc: אֱלֹהִים הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ וְהָאֵר פָּנֶיךָ וְנִוָּשֵׁעָה ׃
lxx: σαλπίσατε ἐν νεομηνίᾳ σάλπιγγι, ἐν εὐσήμῳ ἡμέρᾳ ἑορτῆς ἡμῶν,
vulg: bucinate in neomenia tuba in insigni die sollemnitatis nostrae
clem: Buccinate in neomenia tuba, in insigni die solemnitatis vestr:
kjv: O Lord God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?

wlc: יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת עַד־מָתַי עָשַׁנְתָּ בִּתְפִלַּת עַמֶּךָ ׃
lxx: ὅτι πρόσταγμα τῷ Ἰσραήλ ἐστιν, καὶ κρίμα τῷ θεῷ Ἰακώβ·
vulg: quia praeceptum Israhel est et iudicium Dei Iacob
clem: quia prceptum in Isral est, et judicium Deo Jacob.
kjv: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.

wlc: הֶאֱכַלְתָּם לֶחֶם דִּמְעָה וַתַּשְׁקֵמוֹ בִּדְמָעוֹת שָׁלִישׁ ׃
lxx: μαρτύριον ἐν τῷ Ἰωσὴφ ἔθετο αὐτόν, ἐν τῷ ἐξελθεῖν αὐτὸν ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου. γλῶσσαν ἣν οὐκ ἔγνω ἤκουσεν,
vulg: testimonium in Ioseph posuit illud cum exiret de terra Aegypti linguam quam non noverat audivit
clem: Testimonium in Joseph posuit illud, cum exiret de terra gypti; linguam quam non noverat, audivit.
kjv: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.

wlc: תְּשִׂימֵנוּ מָדוֹן לִשְׁכֵנֵינוּ וְאֹיְבֵינוּ יִלְעֲגוּ־לָמוֹ ׃
lxx: ἀπέστησεν ἀπὸ ἄρσεων τὸν νῶτον αὐτοῦ, αἱ χεῖρες αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ κοφίνῳ ἐδούλευσαν.
vulg: devertit ab oneribus dorsum eius manus eius in cofino servierunt
clem: Divertit ab oneribus dorsum ejus; manus ejus in cophino servierunt.
kjv: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

wlc: אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ וְהָאֵר פָּנֶיךָ וְנִוָּשֵׁעָה ׃
lxx: ἐν θλίψει ἐπεκαλέσω με καὶ ἐρυσάμην σε· ἐπήκουσά σου ἐν ἀποκρύφῳ καταιγίδος, ἐδοκίμασά σε ἐπὶ ὕδατος Ἀντιλογίας. διάψαλμα.
vulg: in tribulatione invocasti me et liberavi te exaudivi te in abscondito tempestatis probavi te apud aquam Contradictionis diapsalma
clem: In tribulatione invocasti me, et liberavi te. Exaudivi te in abscondito tempestatis; probavi te apud aquam contradictionis.
kjv: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.

wlc: גֶּפֶן מִמִּצְרַיִם תַּסִּיעַ תְּגָרֵשׁ גּוֹיִם וַתִּטָּעֶהָ ׃
lxx: ἄκουσον, λαός μου, καὶ λαλήσω σοι· Ἰσραήλ, καὶ διαμαρτύρομαί σοι. ἐὰν ἀκούσῃς μου,
vulg: audi populus meus et contestabor te Israhel si audias me
clem: Audi, populus meus, et contestabor te. Isral, si audieris me,
kjv: Thou preparedst room before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.

wlc: פִּנִּיתָ לְפָנֶיהָ וַתַּשְׁרֵשׁ שָׁרָשֶׁיהָ וַתְּמַלֵּא־אָרֶץ ׃
lxx: οὐκ ἔσται ἐν σοὶ θεὸς πρόσφατος, οὐδὲ προσκυνήσεις θεῷ ἀλλοτρίῳ.
vulg: non erit in te deus recens nec adorabis deum alienum
clem: non erit in te deus recens, neque adorabis deum alienum.
kjv: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof were like the goodly cedars.

wlc: כָּסּוּ הָרִים צִלָּהּ וַעֲנָפֶיהָ אַרְזֵי־אֵל ׃
lxx: ἐγὼ γάρ εἰμι Κύριος ὁ θεός σου, ὁ ἀναγαγὼν σε ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου. πλάτυνον τὸ στόμα σου καὶ πληρώσω αὐτό.
vulg: ego enim sum Dominus Deus tuus qui eduxi te de terra Aegypti dilata os tuum et implebo illud
clem: Ego enim sum Dominus Deus tuus, qui eduxi te de terra gypti. Dilata os tuum, et implebo illud.
kjv: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.

wlc: תְּשַׁלַּח קְצִירֶהָ עַד־יָם וְאֶל־נָהָר יוֹנְקוֹתֶיהָ ׃
lxx: καὶ οὐκ ἤκουσεν ὁ λαός μου τῆς φωνῆς μου, καὶ Ἰσραὴλ οὐ προσέσχεν μοι·
vulg: et non audivit populus meus vocem meam et Israhel non intendit mihi
clem: Et non audivit populus meus vocem meam, et Isral non intendit mihi.
kjv: Why hast thou then broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?

wlc: לָמָּה פָּרַצְתָּ גְדֵרֶיהָ וְאָרוּהָ כָּל־עֹבְרֵי דָרֶךְ ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐξαπέστειλα αὐτοὺς κατὰ τὰ ἐπιτηδεύματα τῶν καρδιών αὐτῶν, πορεύσονται ἐν τοῖς ἐπιτηδεύμασιν αὐτῶν.
vulg: et dimisi illos secundum desideria cordis eorum ibunt in adinventionibus suis
clem: Et dimisi eos secundum desideria cordis eorum; ibunt in adinventionibus suis.
kjv: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.

wlc: יְכַרְסְמֶנָּה חֲזִיר מִיָּעַר וְזִיז שָׂדַי יִרְעֶנָּה ׃
lxx: εἰ ὁ λαὸς ἤκουσέν μου Ἰσραήλ, ταῖς ὁδοῖς μου εἰ ἐπορεύθη,
vulg: si populus meus audisset me Israhel si in viis meis ambulasset
clem: Si populus meus audisset me, Isral si in viis meis ambulasset,
kjv: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;

wlc: אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת שׁוּב־נָא הַבֵּט מִשָּׁמַיִם וּרְאֵה וּפְקֹד גֶּפֶן זֹאת ׃
lxx: ἐν τῷ μηδενὶ τοὺς ἐχθροὺς αὐτῶν ἐταπείνωσα, καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς θλίβοντας αὐτοὺς ἐπέβαλον τὴν χεῖρά μου.
vulg: pro nihilo forsitan inimicos eorum humiliassem et super tribulantes eos misissem manum meam
clem: pro nihilo forsitan inimicos eorum humiliassem, et super tribulantes eos misissem manum meam.
kjv: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.

wlc: וְכַנָּה אֲשֶׁר־נָטְעָה יְמִינֶךָ וְעַל־בֵּן אִמַּצְתָּה לָּךְ ׃
lxx: οἱ ἐχθροὶ Κυρίου ἐψεύσαντο αὐτῷ, καὶ ἔσται ὁ καιρὸς αὐτῶν εἰς τὸν αἰῶναι·
vulg: inimici Domini mentiti sunt ei et erit tempus eorum in saeculo
clem: Inimici Domini mentiti sunt ei, et erit tempus eorum in scula.
kjv: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.

wlc: שְׂרֻפָה בָאֵשׁ כְּסוּחָה מִגַּעֲרַת פָּנֶיךָ יֹאבֵדוּ ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐψώμισεν αὐτοὺς ἐκ στέατος πυροῦ, καὶ ἐκ πέτρας μέλι ἐχόρτασεν αὐτούς.
vulg: et cibavit illos ex adipe frumenti et de petra melle saturavit illos
clem: Et cibavit eos ex adipe frumenti, et de petra melle saturavit eos.]
kjv: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.

wlc: תְּהִי־יָדְךָ עַל־אִישׁ יְמִינֶךָ עַל־בֶּן־אָדָם אִמַּצְתָּ לָּךְ ׃
kjv: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.

wlc: וְלֹא־נָסוֹג מִמֶּךָּ תְּחַיֵּנוּ וּבְשִׁמְךָ נִקְרָא ׃
kjv: Turn us again, O Lord God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

wlc: יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ הָאֵר פָּנֶיךָ וְנִוָּשֵׁעָה ׃
לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־הַגִּתִּית לְאָסָף ׃
lxx: Ὁ θεὸς ἔστη ἐν συναγωγῇ θεῶν, ἐν μέσῳ δὲ θεοὺς διακρίνει.
vulg: psalmus Asaph Deus stetit in synagoga deorum in medio autem Deus deiudicat
clem: Psalmus Asaph. [Deus stetit in synagoga deorum; in medio autem deos dijudicat.
kjv: Sing aloud unto God our strength: make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.

wlc: הַרְנִינוּ לֵאלֹהִים עוּזֵּנוּ הָרִיעוּ לֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב ׃
lxx: ἕως πότε κρίνετε ἀδικίαν, καὶ πρόσωπα ἁμαρτωλῶν λαμβάνετε; διάψαλμα.
vulg: usquequo iudicatis iniquitatem et facies peccatorum sumitis diapsalma
clem: Usquequo judicatis iniquitatem, et facies peccatorum sumitis?
kjv: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.

wlc: שְׂאוּ־זִמְרָה וּתְנוּ־תֹף כִּנּוֹר נָעִים עִם־נָבֶל ׃
lxx: κρίνατε ὀρφανὸν καὶ πτωχόν, ταπεινὸν καὶ πέυητα δικαιώσατε·
vulg: iudicate egenum et pupillum humilem et pauperem iustificate
clem: Judicate egeno et pupillo; humilem et pauperem justificate.
kjv: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.

wlc: תִּקְעוּ בַחֹדֶשׁ שׁוֹפָר בַּכֵּסֶה לְיוֹם חַגֵּנוּ ׃
lxx: ἐξέλεσθε πένητα καὶ πτωχόν, ἐκ χειρὸς ἁμαρτωλοῦ ῥύσασθε.
vulg: eripite pauperem et egenum de manu peccatoris liberate
clem: Eripite pauperem, et egenum de manu peccatoris liberate.
kjv: For this was a statute for Israel, and a law of the God of Jacob.

wlc: כִּי חֹק לְיִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא מִשְׁפָּט לֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב ׃
lxx: οὐκ ἔγνωσαν οὐδὲ συνῆκαν. ἐν σκότει διαπορεύονται· σαλευθήσοναι πάντα τὰ θεμέλια τῆς γῆς.
vulg: nescierunt neque intellexerunt in tenebris ambulant movebuntur omnia fundamenta terrae
clem: Nescierunt, neque intellexerunt; in tenebris ambulant: movebuntur omnia fundamenta terr.
kjv: This he ordained in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out through the land of Egypt: where I heard a language that I understood not.

wlc: עֵדוּת בִּיהוֹסֵף שָׂמוֹ בְּצֵאתוֹ עַל־אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם שְׂפַת לֹא־יָדַעְתִּי אֶשְׁמָע ׃
lxx: ἐγὼ εἶπα Θεοί ἐστε καὶ υἱοὶ Υψἰστου πάντες·
vulg: ego dixi dii estis et filii Excelsi omnes
clem: Ego dixi: Dii estis, et filii Excelsi omnes.
kjv: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.

wlc: הֲסִירוֹתִי מִסֵּבֶל שִׁכְמוֹ כַּפָּיו מִדּוּד תַּעֲבֹרְנָה ׃
lxx: ὑμεῖς δὲ δὴ ὡς ἄνθρωποι ἀποθνήσκετε, καὶ ὡς εἴς τῶν ἀρχόντων πίπτετε.
vulg: vos autem sicut homines moriemini et sicut unus de principibus cadetis
clem: Vos autem sicut homines moriemini, et sicut unus de principibus cadetis.
kjv: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.

wlc: בַּצָּרָה קָרָאתָ וָאֲחַלְּצֶךָּ אֶעֶנְךָ בְּסֵתֶר רַעַם אֶבְחָנְךָ עַל־מֵי מְרִיבָה סֶלָה ׃
lxx: ἀνάστα, ὁ θεός, κρῖνον τὴν γῆν· ὅτι σὺ κατακληρονομήσεις ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν.
vulg: surge Deus iudica terram quoniam tu hereditabis in omnibus gentibus
clem: Surge, Deus, judica terram, quoniam tu hreditabis in omnibus gentibus.]
kjv: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;

wlc: שְׁמַע עַמִּי וְאָעִידָה בָּךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אִם־תִּשְׁמַע־לִי ׃
kjv: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.

wlc: לֹא־יִהְיֶה בְךָ אֵל זָר וְלֹא תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לְאֵל נֵכָר ׃
kjv: I am the Lord thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

wlc: אָנֹכִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הַמַּעַלְךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם הַרְחֶב־פִּיךָ וַאֲמַלְאֵהוּ ׃
kjv: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would none of me.

wlc: וְלֹא־שָׁמַע עַמִּי לְקוֹלִי וְיִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא־אָבָה לִי ׃
kjv: So I gave them up unto their own hearts' lust: and they walked in their own counsels.

wlc: וָאֲשַׁלְּחֵהוּ בִּשְׁרִירוּת לִבָּם יֵלְכוּ בְּמוֹעֲצוֹתֵיהֶם ׃
kjv: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, and Israel had walked in my ways!

wlc: לוּ עַמִּי שֹׁמֵעַ לִי יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּדְרָכַי יְהַלֵּכוּ ׃
kjv: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.

wlc: כִּמְעַט אוֹיְבֵיהֶם אַכְנִיעַ וְעַל צָרֵיהֶם אָשִׁיב יָדִי ׃
kjv: The haters of the Lord should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever.

wlc: מְשַׂנְאֵי יְהוָה יְכַחֲשׁוּ־לוֹ וִיהִי עִתָּם לְעוֹלָם ׃
kjv: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee.

wlc: וַיַּאֲכִילֵהוּ מֵחֵלֶב חִטָּה וּמִצּוּר דְּבַשׁ אַשְׂבִּיעֶךָ ׃
lxx: Ψαλμὸς τῷ Ἀσάφ.

wlc: מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף אֱלֹהִים נִצָּב בַּעֲדַת־אֵל בְּקֶרֶב אֱלֹהִים יִשְׁפֹּט ׃
lxx: Ὠδὴ ψαλμοῦ τῷ Ἀσάφ.
vulg: canticum psalmi Asaph
clem: Canticum Psalmi Asaph.
kjv: God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods.

wlc: עַד־מָתַי תִּשְׁפְּטוּ־עָוֶל וּפְנֵי רְשָׁעִים תִּשְׂאוּ־סֶלָה ׃
lxx: Ὁ θεός, τίς ὁμοιωθήσεταί σοι ; μὴ σιγήσῃς μηδὲ καταπραύνῃς, ὁ θεός·
vulg: Deus quis similis erit tibi ne taceas neque conpescaris Deus
clem: [Deus, quis similis erit tibi? ne taceas, neque compescaris, Deus:
kjv: How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.

wlc: שִׁפְטוּ־דַל וְיָתוֹם עָנִי וָרָשׁ הַצְדִּיקוּ ׃
lxx: ὅτι ἰδοὺ οἱ ἐχθροί σου ἤχησαν, καὶ οἱ μισοῦντές σε ἤραν κεφαλὴν·
vulg: quoniam ecce inimici tui sonaverunt et qui oderunt te extulerunt caput
clem: quoniam ecce inimici tui sonuerunt, et qui oderunt te extulerunt caput.
kjv: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.

wlc: פַּלְּטוּ־דַל וְאֶבְיוֹן מִיַּד רְשָׁעִים הַצִּילוּ ׃
lxx: ἐπὶ τὸν λαόν σου κατεπανουργεύσαντο γνώμην, καὶ ἐβουλεύσαντο κατὰ τῶν ἁγίων σου
vulg: super populum tuum malignaverunt consilium et cogitaverunt adversus sanctos tuos
clem: Super populum tuum malignaverunt consilium, et cogitaverunt adversus sanctos tuos.
kjv: Deliver the poor and needy: rid them out of the hand of the wicked.

wlc: לֹא יָדְעוּ וְלֹא יָבִינוּ בַּחֲשֵׁכָה יִתְהַלָּכוּ יִמּוֹטוּ כָּל־מוֹסְדֵי אָרֶץ ׃
lxx: εἶπαν Δεῦτε καὶ ἐξολεθρεύσωμεν αὐτοὺς ἐξ ἔθνους, καὶ οὐ μὴ μνησθῇ τὸ ὄνομα Ἰσραὴλ ἔτι
vulg: dixerunt venite et disperdamus eos de gente et non memoretur nomen Israhel ultra
clem: Dixerunt: Venite, et disperdamus eos de gente, et non memoretur nomen Isral ultra.
kjv: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.

wlc: אֲנִי־אָמַרְתִּי אֱלֹהִים אַתֶּם וּבְנֵי עֶלְיוֹן כֻּלְּכֶם ׃
lxx: ὅτι ἐβουλεύσαντο ἐν ὁμονοίᾳ ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό, κατὰ σοῦ διαθήκην διέθεντο,
vulg: quoniam cogitaverunt unianimiter simul adversum te testamentum disposuerunt
clem: Quoniam cogitaverunt unanimiter; simul adversum te testamentum disposuerunt:
kjv: I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.

wlc: אָכֵן כְּאָדָם תְּמוּתוּן וּכְאַחַד הַשָּׂרִים תִּפֹּלוּ ׃
lxx: τὰ σκηνώματα τῶν Ἰδουμαίων καὶ οἱ Ἰσμαηλεῖται, Μωὰβ καὶ οἱ Ἀγγαρηνοί,
vulg: tabernacula Idumeorum et Ismahelitae Moab et Aggareni
clem: tabernacula Idumorum et Ismahelit, Moab et Agareni,
kjv: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.

wlc: קוּמָה אֱלֹהִים שָׁפְטָה הָאָרֶץ כִּי־אַתָּה תִנְחַל בְּכָל־הַגּוֹיִם ׃
lxx: Ναιβὰλ καὶ Ἀμμὼν καὶ Ἀμαλήκ, καὶ ἀλλόφυλοι μετὰ τῶν κατοικούντων Τύρον·
vulg: Gebal et Ammon et Amalech alienigenae cum habitantibus Tyrum
clem: Gebal, et Ammon, et Amalec; alienigen cum habitantibus Tyrum.
kjv: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.

lxx: καὶ γὰρ καὶ Ἀσσοὺρ συνπαρεγένετο μετʼ αὐτῶν, ἐγενήθησαν εἰς ἀντίλημψιν τοῖς υἱοῖς Λώτ. διάψαλμα.
vulg: etenim Assur venit cum illis facti sunt in adiutorium filiis Loth diapsalma
clem: Etenim Assur venit cum illis: facti sunt in adjutorium filiis Lot.

lxx: ποίησον αὐτοῖς ὡς τῇ Μαδιάμ καὶ τῷ Σεισαρα, ὡς ὁ Ἰαβεὶν ἐν τῷ χειμάρρῳ Κεισών·
vulg: fac illis sicut Madiam et Sisarae sicut Iabin in torrente Cison
clem: Fac illis sicut Madian et Sisar, sicut Jabin in torrente Cisson.

lxx: ἐξολεθρεύθησαν ἐν Ἀενδώρ, ἐγενήθησαν ὡς κόπρος τῇ γῇ.
vulg: disperierunt in Endor facti sunt ut stercus terrae
clem: Disperierunt in Endor; facti sunt ut stercus terr.

lxx: θοῦ τοὺς ἄρχοντας αὐτῶν ὡς τὸν Ὠρὴβ καὶ Ζὴβ καὶ Σέβεε καὶ Σελμανά, πάντας τοὺς ἄρχοντας αὐτῶν,
vulg: pone principes eorum sicut Oreb et Zeb et Zebee et Salmana omnes principes eorum
clem: Pone principes eorum sicut Oreb, et Zeb, et Zebee, et Salmana: omnes principes eorum,

lxx: οἵτινες εἶπαν Κληρονομήσωμεν ἑαυτοῖς τὸ θυσιαστήριον τοῦ θεοῦ.
vulg: qui dixerunt hereditate possideamus sanctuarium Dei
clem: qui dixerunt: Hreditate possideamus sanctuarium Dei.

lxx: ὁ θεός μου, θοῦ αὐτοὺς ὡς τροχόν. ὡς καλάμην κατὰ πρόσωπου ἀνέμου.
vulg: Deus meus pone illos ut rotam sicut stipulam ante faciem venti
clem: Deus meus, pone illos ut rotam, et sicut stipulam ante faciem venti.

lxx: ὡσεὶ πῦρ ὃ διαφλέξει δρυμόν, ὡς εἰ φλὸξ κατακαύσαι ὄρη,
vulg: sicut ignis qui conburit silvam sicut flamma conburens montes
clem: Sicut ignis qui comburit silvam, et sicut flamma comburens montes,

lxx: οὕτως καταδιώξεις αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ καταιγίδι σου. καὶ ἐν τῇ ὀργῇ σου ταράξεις αὐτούς.
vulg: ita persequeris illos in tempestate tua et in ira tua turbabis eos
clem: ita persequeris illos in tempestate tua, et in ira tua turbabis eos.

lxx: πλήρωσον τὰ πρόσωπα αὐτῶν ἀτιμίας, καὶ ζητήσουσιν τὸ ὄνομά σου, Κύριε.
vulg: imple facies illorum ignominia et quaerent nomen tuum Domine
clem: Imple facies eorum ignominia, et qurent nomen tuum, Domine.

lxx: αἰσχυνθήτωσαν καὶ ταραχθήτωσαν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος, καὶ ἐντραπήτωσαν καὶ ἀπολέσθωσαν·
vulg: erubescant et conturbentur in saeculum saeculi et confundantur et pereant
clem: Erubescant, et conturbentur in sculum sculi, et confundantur, et pereant.

lxx: καὶ γνώτωσαν ὅτι ὄνομά σοι Κύριος, σὺ μόνος εἶ Ὕψιστος ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν.
vulg: et cognoscant quia nomen tibi Dominus tu solus Altissimus in omni terra
clem: Et cognoscant quia nomen tibi Dominus: tu solus Altissimus in omni terra.]

wlc: שִׁיר מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף ׃
lxx: Εἰς τὸ τέλος, ὐπὲρ τῶν ληνῶν· τοῖς υἱοῖς Κόρε ψαλμός.
vulg: in finem pro torcularibus filiis Core psalmus
clem: In finem, pro torcularibus filiis Core. Psalmus.
kjv: Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.

wlc: אֱלֹהִים אַל־דֳּמִי־לָךְ אַל־תֶּחֱרַשׁ וְאַל־תִּשְׁקֹט אֵל ׃
lxx: Ὡς ἀγαπητὰ τὰ σκηνώματά σου, Κύριε τῶν δυνάμεων.
vulg: quam dilecta tabernacula tua Domine virtutum
clem: [Quam dilecta tabernacula tua, Domine virtutum!
kjv: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.

wlc: כִּי־הִנֵּה אוֹיְבֶיךָ יֶהֱמָיוּן וּמְשַׂנְאֶיךָ נָשְׂאוּ רֹאשׁ ׃
lxx: ἐπιποθεῖ καὶ ἐκλείπει ἡ ψυχὴ μου εἰς τὰς αὐλὰς τοῦ κυρίου· ἡ καρδία μου καὶ ἡ σάρξ μου ἠγαλλιάσαντο ἐπὶ θεὸν ζῶντα.
vulg: concupiscit et defecit anima mea in atria Domini cor meum et caro mea exultavit in Deum vivum
clem: Concupiscit, et deficit anima mea in atria Domini; cor meum et caro mea exsultaverunt in Deum vivum.
kjv: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.

wlc: עַל־עַמְּךָ יַעֲרִימוּ סוֹד וְיִתְיָעֲצוּ עַל־צְפוּנֶיךָ ׃
lxx: καὶ γὰρ στρουθίον εὗρεν ἑαυτῷ οἰκίαν, καὶ τρυγὼν νοσσιὰν ἑαυτῇ οὗ θήσει τὰ νοσσία αὐτῆς· τὰ θυσιαστήριά σου, Κύριε τῶν δυνάμεων, ὁ βασιλεύς μου καὶ ὁ θεός μου.
vulg: etenim passer invenit %sibi; domum et turtur nidum sibi ubi ponat pullos suos altaria tua Domine virtutum rex meus et Deus meus
clem: Etenim passer invenit sibi domum, et turtur nidum sibi, ubi ponat pullos suos: altaria tua, Domine virtutum, rex meus, et Deus meus.
kjv: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.

wlc: אָמְרוּ לְכוּ וְנַכְחִידֵם מִגּוֹי וְלֹא־יִזָּכֵר שֵׁם־יִשְׂרָאֵל עוֹד ׃
lxx: μακάριοι πάντες οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ σου, εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων αἰνέσουσίν σε. διάψαλμα.
vulg: beati qui habitant in domo tua in saecula saeculorum laudabunt te diapsalma
clem: Beati qui habitant in domo tua, Domine; in scula sculorum laudabunt te.
kjv: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:

wlc: כִּי נוֹעֲצוּ לֵב יַחְדָּו עָלֶיךָ בְּרִית יִכְרֹתוּ ׃
lxx: μακάριος ἀνὴρ οὗ ἐστιν ἡ ἀντίλημψις αὐτοῦ παρὰ σοῦ, Κύριε· ἀναβάσεις ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ διέθετο,
vulg: beatus vir cui est auxilium abs te ascensiones in corde suo disposuit
clem: Beatus vir cujus est auxilium abs te: ascensiones in corde suo disposuit,
kjv: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;

wlc: אָהֳלֵי אֱדוֹם וְיִשְׁמְעֵאלִים מוֹאָב וְהַגְרִים ׃
lxx: ἐν τῇ κοίλαδι τοῦ κλαυθμῶνος, εἰς τόπον ὃν ἔθετο. καὶ γὰρ εὐλογίας δώσει ὁ νομοθετῶν·
vulg: in valle lacrimarum in loco quem posuit
clem: in valle lacrimarum, in loco quem posuit.
kjv: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;

wlc: גְּבָל וְעַמּוֹן וַעֲמָלֵק פְּלֶשֶׁת עִם־יֹשְׁבֵי צוֹר ׃
lxx: πορεύσονται ἐκ δυνάμεως εἰς δύναμιν, ὀφθήσεται ὁ θεὸς τῶν θεῶν ἐν Σιών.
vulg: etenim benedictiones dabit legis dator ibunt de virtute in virtutem videbitur Deus deorum in Sion
clem: Etenim benedictionem dabit legislator; ibunt de virtute in virtutem: videbitur Deus deorum in Sion.
kjv: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.

wlc: גַּם־אַשּׁוּר נִלְוָה עִמָּם הָיוּ זְרוֹעַ לִבְנֵי־לוֹט סֶלָה ׃
lxx: Κύριε ὁ θεὸς τῶν δυνάμεαον, εἰσάκουσον τῆς προσευχῆς μου, ἐνώτισαι, ὁ θεὸς Ἰακώβ. διάφαλμα.
vulg: Domine Deus virtutum exaudi orationem meam auribus percipe Deus Iacob diapsalma
clem: Domine Deus virtutum, exaudi orationem meam; auribus percipe, Deus Jacob.
kjv: Do unto them as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:

wlc: עֲשֵׂה־לָהֶם כְּמִדְיָן כְּסִיסְרָא כְיָבִין בְּנַחַל קִישׁוֹן ׃
lxx: ὑπερασπιστὰ ἡμῶν ἴδε ὁ θεός, καὶ ἐπίβλεψον ἐπὶ τὸ πρόσαωπον τοῦ χριστοῦ σου.
vulg: protector noster aspice Deus et respice in faciem christi tui
clem: Protector noster, aspice, Deus, et respice in faciem christi tui.
kjv: Which perished at Endor: they became as dung for the earth.

wlc: נִשְׁמְדוּ בְעֵין־דֹּאר הָיוּ דֹּמֶן לָאֲדָמָה ׃
lxx: ὅτι κρείσσων ἡμέρα μία ἐν ταῖς αὐλαῖς σου ὑπέρ χιλιάδας· ἐξελεξάμην παραριπτεῖσθαι ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ θεοῦ μᾶλλον ἡ οἰκεῖν ἐπὶ σκηνώμασιν ἁμαρτωλῶν.
vulg: quia melior est dies una in atriis tuis super milia elegi abiectus esse in domo Dei mei magis quam habitare in tabernaculis peccatorum
clem: Quia melior est dies una in atriis tuis super millia; elegi abjectus esse in domo Dei mei magis quam habitare in tabernaculis peccatorum.
kjv: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:

wlc: שִׁיתֵמוֹ נְדִיבֵמוֹ כְּעֹרֵב וְכִזְאֵב וּכְזֶבַח וּכְצַלְמֻנָּע כָּל־נְסִיכֵמוֹ ׃
lxx: ὄτι ἔλεον καὶ ἀλῆθειαν ἀγαπᾷ Κύριος ὁ θεός, χάριν καὶ δόξαν δώσει· Κύριος οὐχ ὑστερήσει τὰ ἀγαθὰ τοὺς πορευομένους ἐν ἀκακίᾳ.
vulg: quia misericordiam et veritatem %diligit; Deus gratiam et gloriam dabit Dominus
clem: Quia misericordiam et veritatem diligit Deus: gratiam et gloriam dabit Dominus.
kjv: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.

wlc: אֲשֶׁר אָמְרוּ נִירֲשָׁה לָּנוּ אֵת נְאוֹת אֱלֹהִים ׃
lxx: Κύριε τῶν δυνάμεων, μακάριος ἄνθρωπος ὁ ἐλπίζων ἐπὶ σέ.
vulg: non privabit bonis eos qui ambulant in innocentia Domine virtutum beatus vir qui sperat in te
clem: Non privabit bonis eos qui ambulant in innocentia: Domine virtutum, beatus homo qui sperat in te.]
kjv: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.

wlc: אֱלֹהַי שִׁיתֵמוֹ כַגַּלְגַּל כְּקַשׁ לִפְנֵי־רוּחַ ׃
kjv: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;

wlc: כְּאֵשׁ תִּבְעַר־יָעַר וּכְלֶהָבָה תְּלַהֵט הָרִים ׃
kjv: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.

wlc: כֵּן תִּרְדְּפֵם בְּסַעֲרֶךָ וּבְסוּפָתְךָ תְבַהֲלֵם ׃
kjv: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O Lord.

wlc: מַלֵּא פְנֵיהֶם קָלוֹן וִיבַקְשׁוּ שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה ׃
kjv: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:

wlc: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיִבָּהֲלוּ עֲדֵי־עַד וְיַחְפְּרוּ וְיֹאבֵדוּ ׃
kjv: That men may know that thou, whose name alone is Jehovah, art the most high over all the earth.

wlc: וְיֵדְעוּ כִּי־אַתָּה שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה לְבַדֶּךָ עֶלְיוֹן עַל־כָּל־הָאָרֶץ ׃
לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־הַגִּתִּית לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח מִזְמוֹר ׃
lxx: Εἰς τὸ τέλος· τοῖς υἱοῖς Κόρε ψαλμός.
vulg: in finem filiis Core psalmus
clem: In finem, filiis Core. Psalmus.
kjv: How amiable are thy tabernacles, O Lord of hosts!

wlc: מַה־יְּדִידוֹת מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֶיךָ יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת ׃
lxx: Εὐδόκησας, Κύριε, τὴν γῆν σου, ἀπέστρεψας τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν Ἰακώβ.
vulg: benedixisti Domine terram tuam avertisti captivitatem Iacob
clem: [Benedixisti, Domine, terram tuam; avertisti captivitatem Jacob.
kjv: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of the Lord: my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God.

wlc: נִכְסְפָה וְגַם־כָּלְתָה נַפְשִׁי לְחַצְרוֹת יְהוָה לִבִּי וּבְשָׂרִי יְרַנְּנוּ אֶל אֵל־חָי ׃
lxx: ἀφῆκας τὰς ἀνομίας τῷ λαῷ σου, ἐκάλυψας τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν. διάψαλμα.
vulg: remisisti iniquitates plebis tuae operuisti omnia peccata eorum diapsalma
clem: Remisisti iniquitatem plebis tu; operuisti omnia peccata eorum.
kjv: Yea, the sparrow hath found an house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, even thine altars, O Lord of hosts, my King, and my God.

wlc: גַּם־צִפּוֹר מָצְאָה בַיִת וּדְרוֹר קֵן לָהּ אֲשֶׁר־שָׁתָה אֶפְרֹחֶיהָ אֶת־מִזְבְּחוֹתֶיךָ יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת מַלְכִּי וֵאלֹהָי ׃
lxx: κατέπαυσας τὴν ὀργήν σου, ἀπέστρεψας ἀπὸ ὀργῆς θυμοῦ σου.
vulg: mitigasti omnem iram tuam avertisti ab ira indignationis tuae
clem: Mitigasti omnem iram tuam; avertisti ab ira indignationis tu.
kjv: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: they will be still praising thee. Selah.

wlc: אַשְׁרֵי יוֹשְׁבֵי בֵיתֶךָ עוֹד יְהַלְלוּךָ סֶּלָה ׃
lxx: ἐπίστρεψον ἡμᾶς, ὁ θεὸς τῶν σωτηρίων ἡμῶν, καὶ ἀπόστρεψον τὸν θυμόν σου ἀφʼ ἡμῶν.
vulg: converte nos Deus salutum nostrarum et averte iram tuam a nobis
clem: Converte nos, Deus salutaris noster, et averte iram tuam a nobis.
kjv: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; in whose heart are the ways of them.

wlc: אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם עוֹז־לוֹ בָךְ מְסִלּוֹת בִּלְבָבָם ׃
lxx: μὴ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ὀργισθήσῃ ἡμῖν ; ἤ διατενεῖς τὴν ὀργήν σου ἀπὸ γενεᾶς εἰς γενεάν
vulg: numquid in aeternum irasceris nobis aut extendes iram tuam a generatione in generationem
clem: Numquid in ternum irasceris nobis? aut extendes iram tuam a generatione in generationem?
kjv: Who passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools.

wlc: עֹבְרֵי בְּעֵמֶק הַבָּכָא מַעְיָן יְשִׁיתוּהוּ גַּם־בְּרָכוֹת יַעְטֶה מוֹרֶה ׃
lxx: ὁ θεός, σὺ ἐπιστρέψας ζωώσεις ἡμᾶς, καὶ ὁ λαός σου εὐφρανθήσεται ἐπὶ σοί.
vulg: Deus tu conversus vivificabis nos et plebs tua laetabitur in te
clem: Deus, tu conversus vivificabis nos, et plebs tua ltabitur in te.
kjv: They go from strength to strength, every one of them in Zion appeareth before God.

wlc: יֵלְכוּ מֵחַיִל אֶל־חָיִל יֵרָאֶה אֶל־אֱלֹהִים בְּצִיּוֹן ׃
lxx: δεῖξον ἡμῖν, Κύριε, τὸ ἔλεός σου, καὶ τὸ σωτήριόν σου, Κύριε, δῴης ἡμῖν.
vulg: ostende nobis Domine misericordiam tuam et salutare tuum da nobis
clem: Ostende nobis, Domine, misericordiam tuam, et salutare tuum da nobis.
kjv: O Lord God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.

wlc: יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת שִׁמְעָה תְפִלָּתִי הַאֲזִינָה אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב סֶלָה ׃
lxx: ἀκούσομαι τί λαλήσει ἐν ἐμοὶ Κύριος ὁ θεός, ὅτι λαλήσει εἰρήνην ἐπὶ τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς ὁσίους αὐτοῦ καὶ τοὺς ἐπιστρέφοντας πρὸς αὐτὸν καρδίαν.
vulg: audiam quid loquatur % in me; Dominus Deus quoniam loquetur pacem in plebem suam et super sanctos suos et in eos qui convertuntur ad cor
clem: Audiam quid loquatur in me Dominus Deus, quoniam loquetur pacem in plebem suam, et super sanctos suos, et in eos qui convertuntur ad cor.
kjv: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.

wlc: מָגִנֵּנוּ רְאֵה אֱלֹהִים וְהַבֵּט פְּנֵי מְשִׁיחֶךָ ׃
lxx: πλὴν ἐγγὺς τῶν φοβουμένων αὐτὸν τὸ σωτήριον αὐτοῦ. τοῦ κατασκηνῶσαι δόξαν ἐν τῇ γῇ ἡμῶν.
vulg: verumtamen prope timentes eum salutare ipsius ut inhabitet gloria in terra nostra
clem: Verumtamen prope timentes eum salutare ipsius, ut inhabitet gloria in terra nostra.
kjv: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

wlc: כִּי טוֹב־יוֹם בַּחֲצֵרֶיךָ מֵאָלֶף בָּחַרְתִּי הִסְתּוֹפֵף בְּבֵית אֱלֹהַי מִדּוּר בְּאָהֳלֵי־רֶשַׁע ׃
lxx: ἔλεος καὶ ἀλήθεια συνήντησαν, δικαιοσύνη καὶ εἰρήνη κατεφίλησαν·
vulg: misericordia et veritas obviaverunt % sibi; iustitia et pax osculatae sunt
clem: Misericordia et veritas obviaverunt sibi; justitia et pax osculat sunt.
kjv: For the Lord God is a sun and shield: the Lord will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.

wlc: כִּי שֶׁמֶשׁ וּמָגֵן יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים חֵן וְכָבוֹד יִתֵּן יְהוָה לֹא יִמְנַע־טוֹב לַהֹלְכִים בְּתָמִים ׃
lxx: ἀλήθεια ἐκ τῆς γῆς ἀνέτειλεν, καὶ δικαιοσύνη ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ διέκυψεν.
vulg: veritas de terra orta est et iustitia de caelo prospexit
clem: Veritas de terra orta est, et justitia de clo prospexit.
kjv: O Lord of hosts, blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.

wlc: יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם בֹּטֵחַ בָּךְ ׃
lxx: καὶ γὰρ ὁ κύριος δώσει χρηστότητα, καὶ ἡ γῆ ἡμῶν δώσει τὸν καρπὸν αὐτῆς.
vulg: etenim Dominus dabit benignitatem et terra nostra dabit fructum suum
clem: Etenim Dominus dabit benignitatem, et terra nostra dabit fructum suum.

lxx: δικαιοσύνη ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ προπορεύσεται, καὶ θήσει εἰς ὁδὸν τὰ διαβήματα αὐτοῦ.
vulg: iustitia ante eum ambulabit et ponet in via gressus suos
clem: Justitia ante eum ambulabit, et ponet in via gressus suos.]

wlc: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח מִזְמוֹר ׃
lxx: Κλῖνον, Κύριε, τὸ οὖς σου καὶ εἰσάκουσόν μου, ὅτι πτωχὸς καὶ πένης εἰμὶ ἐγὼ.
vulg: oratio ipsi David inclina Domine aurem tuam %et; exaudi me quoniam inops et pauper sum ego
clem: Oratio ipsi David. [Inclina, Domine, aurem tuam et exaudi me, quoniam inops et pauper sum ego.
kjv: Lord, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.

wlc: רָצִיתָ יְהוָה אַרְצֶךָ שַׁבְתָּ שְׁבוּת יַעֲקֹב ׃
lxx: φύλαξον τὴν ψυχήν μου, ὅτι ὅσιός εἰμι σῶσον τὸν δοῦλόν σου, ὁ θεός μου, τὸν ἐλπίζοντα ἐπὶ σέ.
vulg: custodi animam meam quoniam sanctus sum salvum fac servum tuum Deus meus sperantem in te
clem: Custodi animam meam, quoniam sanctus sum; salvum fac servum tuum, Deus meus, sperantem in te.
kjv: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.

wlc: נָשָׂאתָ עֲוֹן עַמֶּךָ כִּסִּיתָ כָל־חַטָּאתָם סֶלָה ׃
lxx: ἐλέησόν με, κύριε, ὅτι πρὸς σέ κεκράξομαι ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν.
vulg: miserere mei Domine quoniam ad te clamabo tota die
clem: Miserere mei, Domine, quoniam ad te clamavi tota die;
kjv: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger.

wlc: אָסַפְתָּ כָל־עֶבְרָתֶךָ הֱשִׁיבוֹתָ מֵחֲרוֹן אַפֶּךָ ׃
lxx: εὔφρανον τὴν ψυχὴν τοῦ δούλου σου, ὅτι πρὸς σέ, κύριε, ἤρα τὴν ψυχὴν μου.
vulg: laetifica animam servi tui quoniam ad te Domine animam meam levavi
clem: ltifica animam servi tui, quoniam ad te, Domine, animam meam levavi.
kjv: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.

wlc: שׁוּבֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעֵנוּ וְהָפֵר כַּעַסְךָ עִמָּנוּ ׃
lxx: ὅτι σύ, κύριε. χρηστὸς καὶ ἐπιεικὴς καὶ πολυέλεος πᾶσι τοῖς ἐπικαλουμένοις σε.
vulg: quoniam tu Domine suavis et mitis et multae misericordiae omnibus invocantibus te
clem: Quoniam tu, Domine, suavis et mitis, et mult misericordi omnibus invocantibus te.
kjv: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?

wlc: הַלְעוֹלָם תֶּאֱנַף־בָּנוּ תִּמְשֹׁךְ אַפְּךָ לְדֹר וָדֹר ׃
lxx: ἐνώτισαι, Κύριε, τὴν προσευχὴν μου. καὶ πρόσχες τῇ φωνῇ τῆς δεήσεώς μου.
vulg: auribus percipe Domine orationem meam et intende voci orationis meae
clem: Auribus percipe, Domine, orationem meam, et intende voci deprecationis me.
kjv: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?

wlc: הֲלֹא־אַתָּה תָּשׁוּב תְּחַיֵּנוּ וְעַמְּךָ יִשְׂמְחוּ־בָךְ ׃
lxx: ἐν ἡμέρᾳ θλίψεως μου ἐκέκραξα πρὸς σέ, ὅτι εἰσήκουσάς μου.
vulg: in die tribulationis meae clamavi ad te quia exaudisti me
clem: In die tribulationis me clamavi ad te, quia exaudisti me.
kjv: Shew us thy mercy, O Lord, and grant us thy salvation.

wlc: הַרְאֵנוּ יְהוָה חַסְדֶּךָ וְיֶשְׁעֲךָ תִּתֶּן־לָנוּ ׃
lxx: οὐκ ἔστιν ὅμοιός σοι ἐν θεοῖς, κύριε. καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν κατὰ τὰ ἔργα σου.
vulg: non est similis tui in diis Domine et non est secundum opera tua
clem: Non est similis tui in diis, Domine, et non est secundum opera tua.
kjv: I will hear what God the Lord will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.

wlc: אֶשְׁמְעָה מַה־יְדַבֵּר הָאֵל יְהוָה כִּי יְדַבֵּר שָׁלוֹם אֶל־עַמּוֹ וְאֶל־חֲסִידָיו וְאַל־יָשׁוּבוּ לְכִסְלָה ׃
lxx: πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ὅσα ἐποίησας ἥξουσιν καὶ προσκυνήσουσιν ἐνώπιόν σου, Κύριε, καὶ δοξάσουσιν τὸ ὄνομά σου·
vulg: omnes gentes quascumque fecisti venient et adorabunt coram te Domine et glorificabunt nomen tuum
clem: Omnes gentes quascumque fecisti venient, et adorabunt coram te, Domine, et glorificabunt nomen tuum.
kjv: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.

wlc: אַךְ קָרוֹב לִירֵאָיו יִשְׁעוֹ לִשְׁכֹּן כָּבוֹד בְּאַרְצֵנוּ ׃
lxx: ὅτι μέγας εἶ σὺ καὶ ποιὥν θαυμάσια, σὺ εἶ ὁ θεὸς μόνος ὁ μέγας.
vulg: quoniam magnus es tu et faciens mirabilia tu es Deus solus
clem: Quoniam magnus es tu, et faciens mirabilia; tu es Deus solus.
kjv: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

wlc: חֶסֶד־וֶאֱמֶת נִפְגָּשׁוּ צֶדֶק וְשָׁלוֹם נָשָׁקוּ ׃
lxx: δήγησόν με, Κύριε, τῇ ὁδῷ σου, καὶ πορεύσομαι τῇ ἀληθείᾳ σου· εὐφρανθήτω ἡ καρδία μου τοῦ φοβεῖσθαι τὸ ὄνομά σου.
vulg: deduc me Domine in via tua et ingrediar in veritate tua laetetur cor meum ut timeat nomen tuum
clem: Deduc me, Domine, in via tua, et ingrediar in veritate tua; ltetur cor meum, ut timeat nomen tuum.
kjv: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.

wlc: אֱמֶת מֵאֶרֶץ תִּצְמָח וְצֶדֶק מִשָּׁמַיִם נִשְׁקָף ׃
lxx: ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι, Κύριε ὁ θεός μου, ἐν ὅλῃ καρδίᾳ μου, καὶ δοξάσω τὸ ὄνομά σου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα·
vulg: confitebor tibi Domine Deus meus in toto corde meo et glorificabo nomen tuum in aeternum
clem: Confitebor tibi, Domine Deus meus, in toto corde meo, et glorificabo nomen tuum in ternum:
kjv: Yea, the Lord shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.

wlc: גַּם־יְהוָה יִתֵּן הַטּוֹב וְאַרְצֵנוּ תִּתֵּן יְבוּלָהּ ׃
lxx: ὅτι τὸ ἔλεός σου μέγα ἐπʼ ἐμέ, καὶ ἐρρύσω τὴν ψυχήν μου ἐξ ᾄδου κατωτάτου.
vulg: quia misericordia tua magna est super me et eruisti animam meam ex inferno inferiori
clem: quia misericordia tua magna est super me, et eruisti animam meam ex inferno inferiori.
kjv: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.

wlc: צֶדֶק לְפָנָיו יְהַלֵּךְ וְיָשֵׂם לְדֶרֶךְ פְּעָמָיו ׃
lxx: ΙΙροσευχὴ τῷ Δαυεἰδ. ὁ θεός, παράνομοι ἐπανέστησαν ἐπʼ ἐμέ, καὶ συναγωγὴ κραταιῶν ἐζήτησαν τὴν ψυχήν μου· οὐ προέθεντό σε ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν.
vulg: Deus iniqui insurrexerunt super me et synagoga potentium quaesierunt animam meam et non proposuerunt te in conspectu suo
clem: Deus, iniqui insurrexerunt super me, et synagoga potentium qusierunt animam meam: et non proposuerunt te in conspectu suo.

lxx: καὶ σύ, Κύριε ὁ θεός, οἰκτίρμων καὶ ἐλεήμων, μακρόθυμος καὶ πολυέλεος καὶ ἀληθινός.
vulg: et tu Domine Deus miserator et misericors patiens et multae misericordiae et verax
clem: Et tu, Domine Deus, miserator et misericors; patiens, et mult misericordi, et verax.

lxx: ἐπίβλεψον ἐπʼ ἐμὲ καὶ ἐλέησόν με, δὸς τὸ κράτος σου τῷ παιδί σου, καὶ σῶσον τὸν υἱὸν τῆς παιδίσκης σου.
vulg: respice in me et miserere mei da imperium tuum puero tuo et salvum fac filium ancillae tuae
clem: Respice in me, et miserere mei; da imperium tuum puero tuo, et salvum fac filium ancill tu.

lxx: ποίησον μετʼ ἐμοῦ σημεῖον εἰς ἀγαθόν, καὶ ἰδέτωσαν οἱ μισοῦντές με καὶ αἰσχυνθήτωσαν, ὅτι σύ, Κύριε, ἐβοήθησάς μοι καὶ παρεκάλεσάς με.
vulg: fac mecum signum in bono et videant qui oderunt me et confundantur quoniam tu Domine adiuvasti me et consolatus es me
clem: Fac mecum signum in bonum, ut videant qui oderunt me, et confundantur: quoniam tu, Domine, adjuvisti me, et consolatus es me.]

wlc: תְּפִלָּה לְדָוִד הַטֵּה־יְהוָה אָזְנְךָ עֲנֵנִי כִּי־עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן אָנִי ׃
lxx: Οἱ θεμέλιοι αὐτοῦ ἐν τοῖς ὄρεσιν τοῖς ἁγίοις·
vulg: filiis Core psalmus cantici fundamenta eius in montibus sanctis
clem: Filiis Core. Psalmus cantici. [Fundamenta ejus in montibus sanctis;
kjv: Bow down thine ear, O Lord, hear me: for I am poor and needy.

wlc: שָׁמְרָה נַפְשִׁי כִּי־חָסִיד אָנִי הוֹשַׁע עַבְדְּךָ אַתָּה אֱלֹהַי הַבּוֹטֵחַ אֵלֶיךָ ׃
lxx: ἀγαπᾄ Κύριος τὰς πύλας Σειὼν ὑπὲρ πάντα τὰ σκηνώματα Ἰακώβ.
vulg: diligit Dominus portas Sion super omnia tabernacula Iacob
clem: diligit Dominus portas Sion super omnia tabernacula Jacob.
kjv: Preserve my soul; for I am holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.

wlc: חָנֵּנִי אֲדֹנָי כִּי אֵלֶיךָ אֶקְרָא כָּל־הַיּוֹם ׃
lxx: δεδοξασμένα ἐλαλήθη περὶ σοῦ, ἡ πόλις τοῦ θεοῦ. διάψαλμα.
vulg: gloriosa dicta sunt de te civitas Dei diapsalma
clem: Gloriosa dicta sunt de te, civitas Dei!
kjv: Be merciful unto me, O Lord: for I cry unto thee daily.

wlc: שַׂמֵּחַ נֶפֶשׁ עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי אֵלֶיךָ אֲדֹנָי נַפְשִׁי אֶשָּׂא ׃
lxx: μνησθήσομαι Ῥαὰβ καὶ Βαβυλῶνος τοῖς γινώσκουσίν με· καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀλλόφυλοι καὶ Tύρος καὶ λαὸς Αἰθιόπων, οὗτοι ἐγενήθησαν ἐκεῖ
vulg: memor ero Raab et Babylonis scientibus me ecce alienigenae et Tyrus et populus Aethiopum hii fuerunt illic
clem: Memor ero Rahab et Babylonis, scientium me; ecce alienigen, et Tyrus, et populus thiopum, hi fuerunt illic.
kjv: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.

wlc: כִּי־אַתָּה אֲדֹנָי טוֹב וְסַלָּח וְרַב־חֶסֶד לְכָל־קֹרְאֶיךָ ׃
lxx: Μήτηρ Σειών. ἐρεῖ ἄνθρωπος. καί Ἀνθρωπος ἐγενήθη ἐν αὐτῇ, καί Αὐτὸς ἐθεμελίωσεν αὐτὴν ὁ ὕψιστος.
vulg: numquid Sion dicet homo et homo natus est in ea et ipse fundavit eam Altissimus
clem: Numquid Sion dicet: Homo et homo natus est in ea, et ipse fundavit eam Altissimus?
kjv: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.

wlc: הַאֲזִינָה יְהוָה תְּפִלָּתִי וְהַקְשִׁיבָה בְּקוֹל תַּחֲנוּנוֹתָי ׃
lxx: Κύριος διηγήσεται ἐν γραφῇ λαῶν καὶ ἀρχόντων τούτων τῶν γεγενημέναων ἐν αὐτῇ. διάψαλμα.
vulg: Dominus narrabit in scriptura populorum et principum horum qui fuerunt in ea diapsalma
clem: Dominus narrabit in scripturis populorum et principum, horum qui fuerunt in ea.
kjv: Give ear, O Lord, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.

wlc: בְּיוֹם צָרָתִי אֶקְרָאֶךָּ כִּי תַעֲנֵנִי ׃
lxx: ὡς εὐφραινομένων πάντων ἡ κατοικία ἐν σοί.
vulg: sicut laetantium omnium habitatio in te
clem: Sicut ltantium omnium habitatio est in te.]
kjv: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.

wlc: אֵין־כָּמוֹךָ בָאֱלֹהִים אֲדֹנָי וְאֵין כְּמַעֲשֶׂיךָ ׃
kjv: Among the gods there is none like unto thee, O Lord; neither are there any works like unto thy works.

wlc: כָּל־גּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ יָבוֹאוּ וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְפָנֶיךָ אֲדֹנָי וִיכַבְּדוּ לִשְׁמֶךָ ׃
kjv: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.

wlc: כִּי־גָדוֹל אַתָּה וְעֹשֵׂה נִפְלָאוֹת אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים לְבַדֶּךָ ׃
kjv: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: thou art God alone.

wlc: הוֹרֵנִי יְהוָה דַּרְכֶּךָ אֲהַלֵּךְ בַּאֲמִתֶּךָ יַחֵד לְבָבִי לְיִרְאָה שְׁמֶךָ ׃
kjv: Teach me thy way, O Lord; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.

wlc: אוֹדְךָ אֲדֹנָי אֱלֹהַי בְּכָל־לְבָבִי וַאֲכַבְּדָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם ׃
kjv: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.

wlc: כִּי־חַסְדְּךָ גָּדוֹל עָלָי וְהִצַּלְתָּ נַפְשִׁי מִשְּׁאוֹל תַּחְתִּיָּה ׃
kjv: For great is thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.

wlc: אֱלֹהִים זֵדִים קָמוּ־עָלַי וַעֲדַת עָרִיצִים בִּקְשׁוּ נַפְשִׁי וְלֹא שָׂמוּךָ לְנֶגְדָּם ׃
kjv: O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent men have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them.

wlc: וְאַתָּה אֲדֹנָי אֵל־רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב־חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת ׃
kjv: But thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious, long suffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.

wlc: פְּנֵה אֵלַי וְחָנֵּנִי תְּנָה־עֻזְּךָ לְעַבְדֶּךָ וְהוֹשִׁיעָה לְבֶן־אֲמָתֶךָ ׃
kjv: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.

wlc: עֲשֵׂה־עִמִּי אוֹת לְטוֹבָה וְיִרְאוּ שֹׂנְאַי וְיֵבֹשׁוּ כִּי־אַתָּה יְהוָה עֲזַרְתַּנִי וְנִחַמְתָּנִי ׃
lxx: Τοῖς υἱοῖς Κόρε ψαλμὸς ᾠδῆς.
kjv: Shew me a token for good; that they which hate me may see it, and be ashamed: because thou, Lord, hast holpen me, and comforted me.

wlc: לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח מִזְמוֹר שִׁיר יְסוּדָתוֹ בְּהַרְרֵי־קֹדֶשׁ ׃
lxx: Ὠδὴ ψαλμοῦ τοῖς υἱοῖς Κόρε· εἰς τὸ τέλος, ὐπὲρ μαελέθ τοῦ ἀποκριθῆναι· συνέσεως Αἱμὰν τῷ Ἰσραηλείτη.
vulg: canticum psalmi filiis Core in finem pro Maeleth ad respondendum intellectus Eman Ezraitae
clem: Canticum Psalmi, filiis Core, in finem, pro Maheleth ad respondendum. Intellectus Eman Ezrahit.
kjv: His foundation is in the holy mountains.

wlc: אֹהֵב יְהוָה שַׁעֲרֵי צִיּוֹן מִכֹּל מִשְׁכְּנוֹת יַעֲקֹב ׃
lxx: Κύριε ὁ θεὸς τῆς σωτηρίας μου. ἡμέρας ἐκέκραξα καὶ ἐν νυκτὶ ἐναντίον σου·
vulg: Domine Deus salutis meae die clamavi et nocte coram te
clem: [Domine, Deus salutis me, in die clamavi et nocte coram te.
kjv: The Lord loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

wlc: נִכְבָּדוֹת מְדֻבָּר בָּךְ עִיר הָאֱלֹהִים סֶלָה ׃
lxx: εἰσελθέτω ἐνώπιόν σου ἡ προσευχή μου. κλῖνον τὸ οὖς σου εἰς τὴν δέησίν μου, Κύριε.
vulg: intret in conspectu tuo oratio mea inclina aurem tuam ad precem meam
clem: Intret in conspectu tuo oratio mea, inclina aurem tuam ad precem meam.
kjv: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.

wlc: אַזְכִּיר רַהַב וּבָבֶל לְיֹדְעָי הִנֵּה פְלֶשֶׁת וְצוֹר עִם־כּוּשׁ זֶה יֻלַּד־שָׁם ׃
lxx: ὅτι ἐπλήσθη κακῶν ἡ ψυχή μου. καὶ ἡ ζωή μου τῷ ᾄδῃ ἤγγισεν.
vulg: quia repleta est malis anima mea et vita mea in inferno adpropinquavit
clem: Quia repleta est malis anima mea, et vita mea inferno appropinquavit.
kjv: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man was born there.

wlc: וּלֲצִיּוֹן יֵאָמַר אִישׁ וְאִישׁ יֻלַּד־בָּהּ וְהוּא יְכוֹנְנֶהָ עֶלְיוֹן ׃
lxx: προσελογίσθην μετὰ τῶν καταβαινόντων εἰς λάκκον, ἐγενήθην ὡς ἄνθρωπος ἀβοήθητος,
vulg: aestimatus sum cum descendentibus in lacum factus sum sicut homo sine adiutorio
clem: stimatus sum cum descendentibus in lacum, factus sum sicut homo sine adjutorio,
kjv: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.

wlc: יְהוָה יִסְפֹּר בִּכְתוֹב עַמִּים זֶה יֻלַּד־שָׁם סֶלָה ׃
lxx: ἐν νεκροῖς ἐλεύθερος· ὡσεὶ τραυματίαι ἐρριμμένοι καθεύδοντες ἐν τάφῳ, ὧν οὐκ ἐμνήσθης ἔτι, καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐκ τῆς χειρός σου ἀπώσθησαν·
vulg: inter mortuos liber sicut vulnerati dormientes in sepulchris quorum non es memor amplius et ipsi de manu tua repulsi sunt
clem: inter mortuos liber; sicut vulnerati dormientes in sepulchris, quorum non es memor amplius, et ipsi de manu tua repulsi sunt.
kjv: The Lord shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.

wlc: וְשָׁרִים כְּחֹלְלִים כָּל־מַעְיָנַי בָּךְ ׃
lxx: ἔθεντό με ἐν λάκκῳ κατωτάτῳ, ἐν σκοτεινοῖς καὶ ἐν σκιᾷ θανάτου.
vulg: posuerunt me in lacu inferiori in tenebrosis et in umbra mortis
clem: Posuerunt me in lacu inferiori, in tenebrosis, et in umbra mortis.
kjv: As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in thee.

lxx: ἐπʼ ἐμὲ ἐπεστηρίχθη ὁ θυμός σου, καὶ πάντας τοὺς μετεαορισμοὺς σου ἐπʼ ἐμὲ ἐπήγαγες. διάψαλμα.
vulg: super me confirmatus est furor tuus et omnes fluctus tuos induxisti super me diapsalma
clem: Super me confirmatus est furor tuus, et omnes fluctus tuos induxisti super me.

lxx: ἐμάκρυνας τοὺς γνωστούς μου ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ, ἔθεντό με βδέλυγμα ἑαυτοῖς· παρεδόθην καὶ οὐκ ἐξεπορευόμην.
vulg: longe fecisti notos meos a me posuerunt me abominationem sibi traditus sum et non egrediebar
clem: Longe fecisti notos meos a me; posuerunt me abominationem sibi. Traditus sum, et non egrediebar;

lxx: οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου ἠσθένησαν ἀπὸ πτωχείας· καὶ ἐκέκραξα πρὸς σέ, Κύριε, ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν. διεπέτασα τὰς χεῖράς μου·
vulg: oculi mei languerunt prae inopia clamavi ad te Domine tota die expandi ad te manus meas
clem: oculi mei languerunt pr inopia. Clamavi ad te, Domine, tota die; expandi ad te manus meas.

lxx: μὴ τοῖς νεκροῖς ποιήσεις θαυμάσια; ἢ ἰατροὶ ἀναστήσουσιν καὶ ἐξομολογήσονταί σοι;
vulg: numquid mortuis facies mirabilia aut medici suscitabunt et confitebuntur tibi diapsalma
clem: Numquid mortuis facies mirabilia? aut medici suscitabunt, et confitebuntur tibi?

lxx: μὴ διηγήσεταί τις ἐν τάφῳ τὸ ἔλεός σου, καὶ τὴν ἀλήθειάν σου ἐν τῇ ἀπωλίᾳ ;
vulg: numquid narrabit aliquis in sepulchro misericordiam tuam et veritatem tuam in perditione
clem: Numquid narrabit aliquis in sepulchro misericordiam tuam, et veritatem tuam in perditione?

lxx: μὴ γνωσθήσεται ἐν τῷ σκότει τὰ θαυμάσιά σου, καὶ ἡ δικαιοσύνη σου ἐν γῇ ἐπιλελησμένῃ;
vulg: numquid cognoscentur in tenebris mirabilia tua et iustitia tua in terra oblivionis
clem: Numquid cognoscentur in tenebris mirabilia tua? et justitia tua in terra oblivionis?

lxx: κἀγώ, Κύριε, πρὸς σέ ἐκέκραξα, καὶ τὸ πρωὶ ἡ προσευχὴ μου προφθάσει σε.
vulg: et ego ad te Domine clamavi et mane oratio mea praeveniet te
clem: Et ego ad te, Domine, clamavi, et mane oratio mea prveniet te.

lxx: ἵνα τί, Κύριε, ἀπωθεῖς τὴν προσευχὴν μου. ἀποστρέφεις τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ;
vulg: ut quid Domine repellis orationem meam avertis faciem tuam a me
clem: Ut quid, Domine, repellis orationem meam; avertis faciem tuam a me?

lxx: πτωχός εἰμι ἐγὼ καὶ ἐν κόποις ἐκ νεότητός μου, ὑψωθεὶς δὲ ἐταπεινώθην καὶ ἐξηπορήθην.
vulg: pauper sum ego et in laboribus a iuventute mea exaltatus autem humiliatus sum et conturbatus
clem: Pauper sum ego, et in laboribus a juventute mea; exaltatus autem, humiliatus sum et conturbatus.

lxx: ἐπ᾿ ἐμὲ διῆλθον αἱ ὀργαί σου, καὶ οἱ φοβερισμοί σου ἐτάραξάν με.
vulg: in me transierunt irae tuae et terrores tui conturbaverunt me
clem: In me transierunt ir tu, et terrores tui conturbaverunt me:

lxx: ἐκύκλωσάν με ὡς ὕδωρ ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν. περιέσχον με ἄμα.
vulg: circuierunt me sicut aqua tota die circumdederunt me simul
clem: circumdederunt me sicut aqua tota die; circumdederunt me simul.

lxx: ἐμάκρυνας ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ φίλον καὶ τοὺς γνωστοὺς μου ἀπὸ ταλαιπαωρίας.
vulg: elongasti a me amicum et proximum et notos meos a miseria
clem: Elongasti a me amicum et proximum, et notos meos a miseria.]

wlc: שִׁיר מִזְמוֹר לִבְנֵי קֹרַח לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־מָחֲלַת לְעַנּוֹת מַשְׂכִּיל לְהֵימָן הָאֶזְרָחִי ׃
lxx: Συνέσεως Αἰθὰν τῷ Ἰσραηλείτῃ.
vulg: intellectus Aethan Ezraitae
clem: Intellectus Ethan Ezrahit.
kjv: O lord God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee:

wlc: יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יְשׁוּעָתִי יוֹם־צָעַקְתִּי בַלַּיְלָה נֶגְדֶּךָ ׃
lxx: Τὰ ἐλέη σου, Κύριε, εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ᾄσομαι, εἰς γενεὰν καὶ γενεὰν ἀπαγγελῶ τὴν ἀλήθειάν σου ἐν τῷ στόματί μου.
vulg: misericordias Domini in aeternum cantabo in generationem et generationem adnuntiabo veritatem tuam in ore meo
clem: [Misericordias Domini in ternum cantabo; in generationem et generationem annuntiabo veritatem tuam in ore meo.
kjv: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;

wlc: תָּבוֹא לְפָנֶיךָ תְּפִלָּתִי הַטֵּה־אָזְנְךָ לְרִנָּתִי ׃
lxx: ὅτι εἶπας Εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἔλεος οἰκοδομηθήσεται, ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς ἑτοιμασθήσεται ἡ ἀλήθειά σου·
vulg: quoniam dixisti in aeternum misericordia aedificabitur in caelis praeparabitur veritas tua in eis;
clem: Quoniam dixisti: In ternum misericordia dificabitur in clis; prparabitur veritas tua in eis.
kjv: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.

wlc: כִּי־שָׂבְעָה בְרָעוֹת נַפְשִׁי וְחַיַּי לִשְׁאוֹל הִגִּיעוּ ׃
lxx: διεθέμην διαθήκην τοῖς ἐκλεκτοῖς μου. ὤμοσα Δαυεὶδ τῷ δούλῳ μου
vulg: disposui testamentum electis meis iuravi David servo meo
clem: Disposui testamentum electis meis; juravi David servo meo:
kjv: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man that hath no strength:

wlc: נֶחְשַׁבְתִּי עִם־יוֹרְדֵי בוֹר הָיִיתִי כְּגֶבֶר אֵין־אֱיָל ׃
lxx: Ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος ἑτοιμάσω τὸ σπέρμα σου. καὶ οἰκοδομήσω εἰς γενεὰν καὶ γενεὰν τὸν θρόνον σου. διάφαλμα.
vulg: usque in aeternum praeparabo semen tuum et aedificabo in generationem et generationem sedem tuam diapsalma
clem: Usque in ternum prparabo semen tuum, et dificabo in generationem et generationem sedem tuam.
kjv: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.

wlc: בַּמֵּתִים חָפְשִׁי כְּמוֹ חֲלָלִים שֹׁכְבֵי קֶבֶר אֲשֶׁר לֹא זְכַרְתָּם עוֹד וְהֵמָּה מִיָּדְךָ נִגְזָרוּ ׃
lxx: ἐξομολογήσονται οἱ οὐρανοὶ τὰ θαυμάσιά σου, Κύριε, καὶ τὴν ἀλήθειάν σου ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ ἁγίων.
vulg: confitebuntur caeli mirabilia tua Domine etenim veritatem tuam in ecclesia sanctorum
clem: Confitebuntur cli mirabilia tua, Domine; etenim veritatem tuam in ecclesia sanctorum.
kjv: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.

wlc: שַׁתַּנִי בְּבוֹר תַּחְתִּיּוֹת בְּמַחֲשַׁכִּים בִּמְצֹלוֹת ׃
lxx: ὅτι τίς ἐν νεφέλαις ἰσωθήσεται τῷ κυρίῳ ; καὶ τίς ὁμοιωθήσεται τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν υἱοῖς θεοὺ ;
vulg: quoniam quis in nubibus aequabitur Domino similis erit Domino in filiis Dei
clem: Quoniam quis in nubibus quabitur Domino; similis erit Deo in filiis Dei?
kjv: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. Selah.

wlc: עָלַי סָמְכָה חֲמָתֶךָ וְכָל־מִשְׁבָּרֶיךָ עִנִּיתָ סֶּלָה ׃
lxx: ὁ θεὸς ἐνδοξαζόμενος ἐν βουλῇ ἁγίων. μέγας καὶ φοβερὸς ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς περικυκλῶ αὐτοῦ.
vulg: Deus qui glorificatur in consilio sanctorum magnus et horrendus super omnes qui in circuitu eius sunt
clem: Deus, qui glorificatur in consilio sanctorum, magnus et terribilis super omnes qui in circuitu ejus sunt.
kjv: Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.

wlc: הִרְחַקְתָּ מְיֻדָּעַי מִמֶּנִּי שַׁתַּנִי תוֹעֵבוֹת לָמוֹ כָּלֻא וְלֹא אֵצֵא ׃
lxx: Κύριε ὁ θεὸς τῶν δυνάμεων, τίς ὅμοιός σος ; δυνατὸς εἶ, Κύριε, καὶ ἡ ἀλήθειά σου κύκλῳ σου.
vulg: Domine Deus virtutum quis similis tibi potens es Domine et veritas tua in circuitu tuo
clem: Domine Deus virtutum, quis similis tibi? potens es, Domine, et veritas tua in circuitu tuo.
kjv: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: Lord, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.

wlc: עֵינִי דָאֲבָה מִנִּי עֹנִי קְרָאתִיךָ יְהוָה בְּכָל־יוֹם שִׁטַּחְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ כַפָּי ׃
lxx: σὺ δεσπόζεις τοῦ κράτους τῆς θαλάσσης, καὶ τὸν σάλον τῶν κυμάτων αὐτῆς σὺ καταπραύνεις.
vulg: tu dominaris potestatis maris motum autem fluctuum eius tu mitigas
clem: Tu dominaris potestati maris; motum autem fluctuum ejus tu mitigas.
kjv: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise and praise thee? Selah.

wlc: הֲלַמֵּתִים תַּעֲשֶׂה־פֶּלֶא אִם־רְפָאִים יָקוּמוּ יוֹדוּךָ סֶּלָה ׃
lxx: σὺ ἐταπείνωσας ὡς τραυματίαν ὑπερήφανον, καὶ ἐν τῷ βραχίονι τῆς δυνάμεως σου διεσκόρπισας τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου.
vulg: tu humiliasti sicut vulneratum superbum in brachio virtutis tuae dispersisti inimicos tuos
clem: Tu humiliasti, sicut vulneratum, superbum; in brachio virtutis tu dispersisti inimicos tuos.
kjv: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? or thy faithfulness in destruction?

wlc: הַיְסֻפַּר בַּקֶּבֶר חַסְדֶּךָ אֱמוּנָתְךָ בָּאֲבַדּוֹן ׃
lxx: σοί εἰσιν οἱ οὐρανοί, καὶ σή ἐστιν ἡ γῆ· τὴν οἰκουμένην καὶ τὸ πλήραωμα αὐτῆς σὺ ἐθεμελίωσας.
vulg: tui sunt caeli et tua est terra orbem terrae et plenitudinem eius tu fundasti
clem: Tui sunt cli, et tua est terra: orbem terr, et plenitudinem ejus tu fundasti;
kjv: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

wlc: הֲיִוָּדַע בַּחֹשֶׁךְ פִּלְאֶךָ וְצִדְקָתְךָ בְּאֶרֶץ נְשִׁיָּה ׃
lxx: τὸν βορρᾶν καὶ θαλάσσας σὺ ἔκτισας, Θαβὼρ καὶ Ἑρμωνιεὶμ τῷ ὀνόματί σου ἀγαλλιάσονται.
vulg: aquilonem et mare tu creasti Thabor et Hermon in nomine tuo exultabunt
clem: aquilonem et mare tu creasti. Thabor et Hermon in nomine tuo exsultabunt:
kjv: But unto thee have I cried, O Lord; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.

wlc: וַאֲנִי אֵלֶיךָ יְהוָה שִׁוַּעְתִּי וּבַבֹּקֶר תְּפִלָּתִי תְקַדְּמֶךָּ ׃
lxx: σὸς ὁ βραχίων μετὰ δυναστείας· κραταιωθήτω ἡ χείρ σου, ὑψωθήτω ἡ δεξιά σου.
vulg: tuum brachium cum potentia firmetur manus tua et exaltetur dextera tua
clem: tuum brachium cum potentia. Firmetur manus tua, et exaltetur dextera tua:
kjv: Lord, why castest thou off my soul? why hidest thou thy face from me?

wlc: לָמָה יְהוָה תִּזְנַח נַפְשִׁי תַּסְתִּיר פָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי ׃
lxx: δικαιοσύνη καὶ κρίμα ἑτοιμασία τοῦ θρόνου σου· ἔλεος καὶ ἀλήθεια προπορεύσεται πρὸ προσώπου σου.
vulg: iustitia et iudicium praeparatio sedis tuae misericordia et veritas praecedent faciem tuam
clem: justitia et judicium prparatio sedis tu: misericordia et veritas prcedent faciem tuam.
kjv: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: while I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.

wlc: עָנִי אֲנִי וְגוֵֹעַ מִנֹּעַר נָשָׂאתִי אֵמֶיךָ אָפוּנָה ׃
lxx: μακάριος ὁ λαὸς ὁ γινώσκων ἀλαλαγμόν· Κύριε, ἐν τῷ φωτὶ τοῦ προσώπου σου πορεύσονται,
vulg: beatus populus qui scit iubilationem Domine in lumine vultus tui ambulabunt
clem: Beatus populus qui scit jubilationem: Domine, in lumine vultus tui ambulabunt,
kjv: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.

wlc: עָלַי עָבְרוּ חֲרוֹנֶיךָ בִּעוּתֶיךָ צִמְּתוּתֻנִי ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ἀγαλλιάσονται ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν, καὶ ἐν τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ σου ὑψωθήσονται.
vulg: et in nomine tuo exultabunt tota die et in iustitia tua exaltabuntur
clem: et in nomine tuo exsultabunt tota die, et in justitia tua exaltabuntur.
kjv: They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together.

wlc: סַבּוּנִי כַמַּיִם כָּל־הַיּוֹם הִקִּיפוּ עָלַי יָחַד ׃
lxx: ὅτι τὸ καύχημα τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτῶν εἶ σύ, καὶ ἐν τῇ εὐδοκίᾳ σου ὑψωθήσεται τὸ κέρας ἡμῶν.
