vulg: quoniam gloria virtutis eorum tu es et in beneplacito tuo exaltabitur cornu nostrum
clem: Quoniam gloria virtutis eorum tu es, et in beneplacito tuo exaltabitur cornu nostrum.
kjv: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, and mine acquaintance into darkness.

wlc: הִרְחַקְתָּ מִמֶּנִּי אֹהֵב וָרֵעַ מְיֻדָּעַי מַחְשָׁךְ ׃
lxx: ὅτι τοῦ κυρίου ἡ ἀντίλημψις, καὶ τοῦ ἁγίου Ἰσραὴλ βασιλέως ἡμῶν.
vulg: quia Domini est adsumptio nostra; et Sancti Israhel regis nostri
clem: Quia Domini est assumptio nostra, et sancti Isral regis nostri.

lxx: τότε ἐλάλησας ἐν ὁράσει τοῖς υἱοῖς σου, καὶ εἶπας Ἐθέμην βοήθειαν ἐπὶ δυνατόν, ὕψωσα ἐκλεκτὸν ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ μου·
vulg: tunc locutus es in visione sanctis tuis et dixisti posui adiutorium in potentem exaltavi electum de plebe mea
clem: Tunc locutus es in visione sanctis tuis, et dixisti: Posui adjutorium in potente, et exaltavi electum de plebe mea.

lxx: εὗρον Δαυεὶδ τὸν δοῦλόν μου, ἐν ἐλέει ἁγίῳ ἔχρισα αὐτόν.
vulg: inveni David servum meum in oleo sancto meo linui eum
clem: Inveni David, servum meum; oleo sancto meo unxi eum.

lxx: ἡ γὰρ χείρ μου συναντιλήμψεται αὐτῷ, καὶ ὁ βραχίων μου κατισχύσει αὐτόν·
vulg: manus enim mea auxiliabitur ei et brachium meum confirmabit eum
clem: Manus enim mea auxiliabitur ei, et brachium meum confortabit eum.

lxx: οὐκ ὠφελήσει ἐχθρὸς ἐν αὐτῷ, καὶ υἱὸς ἀνομίας οὐ προσθήσει τοῦ κακῶσαι αὐτόν·
vulg: nihil proficiet inimicus in eo et filius iniquitatis non adponet nocere eum
clem: Nihil proficiet inimicus in eo, et filius iniquitatis non apponet nocere ei.

lxx: καὶ συγκόψω τοὺς ἐχθροὺς αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ, καὶ τοὺς μισοῦντας αὐτὸν τροπώσομαι.
vulg: et concidam a facie ipsius inimicos eius et odientes eum in fugam convertam
clem: Et concidam a facie ipsius inimicos ejus, et odientes eum in fugam convertam.

lxx: καὶ ἡ ἀλήθειά μου καὶ τὸ ἔλεός μου μετʼ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου ὑψωθήσεται τὸ κέρας αὐτοῦ·
vulg: et veritas mea et misericordia mea cum ipso et in nomine meo exaltabitur cornu eius
clem: Et veritas mea et misericordia mea cum ipso, et in nomine meo exaltabitur cornu ejus.

lxx: καὶ θήσομαι ἐν θαλάσσῃ χεῖρα αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐν ποταμοῖς δεξιὰν αὐτοῦ.
vulg: et ponam in mari manum eius et in fluminibus dexteram eius
clem: Et ponam in mari manum ejus, et in fluminibus dexteram ejus.

lxx: αὐτὸς ἐπικαλέσεταί με ΙΙατὴρ μου εἶ σύ, θεός μου καὶ ἀντιλήμπτωρ τῆς σωτηρίας μου·
vulg: ipse invocabit me pater meus es tu Deus meus et susceptor salutis meae
clem: Ipse invocabit me: Pater meus es tu, Deus meus, et susceptor salutis me.

lxx: κἀγὼ πρωτότοκον θήσομαι αὐτόν, ὑψηλὸν παρὰ τοῖς βασιλεῦσιν τῆς γῆς.
vulg: et ego primogenitum ponam illum excelsum prae regibus terrae
clem: Et ego primogenitum ponam illum, excelsum pr regibus terr.

lxx: εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα φυλάξω αὐτῷ τὸ ἔλεός μου, καὶ ἡ διαθήκη μου πιστὴ αὐτῷ·
vulg: in aeternum servabo illi misericordiam meam et testamentum meum fidele ipsi
clem: In ternum servabo illi misericordiam meam, et testamentum meum fidele ipsi.

lxx: καὶ θήσομαι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος τὸ σπέρμα αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὸν θρόνον αὐτοῦ ὡς τὰς ἡμέρας τοῦ οὐρανοῦ.
vulg: et ponam in saeculum saeculi semen eius et thronum eius sicut dies caeli
clem: Et ponam in sculum sculi semen ejus, et thronum ejus sicut dies cli.

lxx: ἐὰν ἐγκαταλίπωσιν οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ τὸν νόμον μου, καὶ τοῖς κρίμασίν μου μὴ πορευθῶσιν·
vulg: si dereliquerint filii eius legem meam et in iudiciis meis non ambulaverint
clem: Si autem dereliquerint filii ejus legem meam, et in judiciis meis non ambulaverint;

lxx: ἐὰν τὰ δικαιώματά μου βεβηλώσουσιν, καὶ τὰς ἐντολάς μου μὴ φυλάξωσιν·
vulg: si iustitias meas profanaverint et mandata mea non custodierint
clem: si justitias meas profanaverint, et mandata mea non custodierint:

lxx: ἐπισκέψομαι ἐν ῥάβδῳ ἀνομίας αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐν μάστιξιν τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν.
vulg: visitabo in virga iniquitates eorum et in verberibus peccata eorum
clem: visitabo in virga iniquitates eorum, et in verberibus peccata eorum;

lxx: τὸ δὲ ἔλεός μου οὐ μὴ διασκεδάσω ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ, οὐδὲ μὴ ἀδικήσω ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ μου,
vulg: misericordiam autem meam non dispergam ab eo neque nocebo in veritate mea
clem: misericordiam autem meam non dispergam ab eo, neque nocebo in veritate mea,

lxx: οὑδὲ μὴ βεβηλώσω τὴν διαθήκην μου, καὶ τὰ ἐκπορευόμενα διὰ τῶν χειλέων μου οὐ μὴ ἀθετήσω.
vulg: neque profanabo testamentum meum et quae procedunt de labiis meis non faciam irrita
clem: neque profanabo testamentum meum: et qu procedunt de labiis meis non faciam irrita.

lxx: ἅπαξ ὤμοσα ἐν τῷ ἁγίῳ μου, εἰ τῷ Δαυεὶδ ψεύσομαι·
vulg: semel iuravi in sancto meo si David mentiar
clem: Semel juravi in sancto meo, si David mentiar:

lxx: τὸ σπέρμα αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα μενεῖ, καὶ ὁ θρόνος αὐτοῦ ὡς ὁ ἤλιος ἐναντίον μου,
vulg: semen eius in aeternum manebit
clem: semen ejus in ternum manebit. Et thronus ejus sicut sol in conspectu meo,

lxx: καὶ ὡς ἡ σελήνη κατηρτισμένη εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα· καὶ ὁ μάρτυς ἐν οὐρανῷ πιστός. διάψαλμα.
vulg: et thronus eius sicut sol in conspectu meo et sicut luna perfecta in aeternum et testis in caelo fidelis diapsalma
clem: et sicut luna perfecta in ternum, et testis in clo fidelis.

lxx: σὺ δὲ ἀπώσω καὶ ἐξουδένωσας, ἀνεβάλου τὸν χριστόν σου·
vulg: tu vero reppulisti et despexisti distulisti christum tuum
clem: Tu vero repulisti et despexisti; distulisti christum tuum.

lxx: κατέστρεψας τὴν διαθήκην τοῦ δούλου σου, ἐβεβήλωσας εἰς τὴν γῆν τὸ ἁγίασμα αὐτοῦ.
vulg: evertisti testamentum servi tui profanasti in terram sanctuarium eius
clem: Evertisti testamentum servi tui; profanasti in terra sanctuarium ejus.

lxx: καθεῖλες πάντας τοὺς φραγμοὺς αὐτοῦ, ἔθου τὰ ὀχυρώματα αὐτοῦ δειλίαν·
vulg: destruxisti omnes sepes eius posuisti firmamenta eius formidinem
clem: Destruxisti omnes sepes ejus; posuisti firmamentum ejus formidinem.

lxx: διήρπασαν αὐτὸν πάντες οἱ διοδεύοντες ὁδόν, ἐγενήθη ὄνειδος τοῖς γείτοσιν αὐτοῦ.
vulg: diripuerunt eum omnes transeuntes viam factus est obprobrium vicinis suis
clem: Diripuerunt eum omnes transeuntes viam; factus est opprobrium vicinis suis.

lxx: ὕψωσας τὴν δεξιὰν τῶν ἐχθρῶν αὐτοῦ, εὔφρανας πάντας τοὺς ἐχθροὺς αὐτοῦ·
vulg: exaltasti dexteram deprimentium eum laetificasti omnes inimicos eius
clem: Exaltasti dexteram deprimentium eum; ltificasti omnes inimicos ejus.

lxx: ἀπέστρεψας τὴν βοήθειαν τῆς ῥομφαίας αὐτοῦ, καὶ οὐκ ἀντελάβου αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ πολέμῳ.
vulg: avertisti adiutorium gladii eius et non es auxiliatus ei in bello
clem: Avertisti adjutorium gladii ejus, et non es auxiliatus ei in bello.

lxx: κατέλυσας ἀπὸ καθαρισμοῦ αὐτόν, τὸν θρόνον αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν γῆν κατέρραξας·
vulg: destruxisti eum a mundatione sedem eius in terram conlisisti
clem: Destruxisti eum ab emundatione, et sedem ejus in terram collisisti.

lxx: ἐσμίκρυνας τὰς ἡμέρας τοῦ θρόνου αὐτοῦ, κατέχεας αὐτοῦ αἰσχύνην.
vulg: minorasti dies temporis eius perfudisti eum confusione diapsalma
clem: Minorasti dies temporis ejus; perfudisti eum confusione.

lxx: ἕως πότε, Κύριε, ἀποστρέψεις εἰς τέλος; ἐκκαυθήσεται ὡς πῦρ ἡ ὀργή σου ;
vulg: usquequo Domine avertis in finem exardescet sicut ignis ira tua
clem: Usquequo, Domine, avertis in finem? exardescet sicut ignis ira tua?

vulg: memorare quae mea substantia numquid enim vane constituisti omnes filios hominum
clem: Memorare qu mea substantia: numquid enim vane constituisti omnes filios hominum?

lxx: τίς ἐστιν ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὃς ζήσεται καὶ οὐκ ὄψεται θάνατον; ῥύσεται τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἐκ χειρὸς ἅδαυ ; διάφαλμα.
vulg: quis est homo qui vivet et non videbit mortem eruet animam suam de manu inferi diapsalma
clem: Quis est homo qui vivet et non videbit mortem? eruet animam suam de manu inferi?

lxx: ποῦ ἐστιν τὰ ἐλέη σου τὰ ἀρχαῖα, Κύριε, ἃ ὤμοσας τῷ Δαυεὶδ ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ σου;
vulg: ubi sunt misericordiae tuae antiquae Domine sicut iurasti David in veritate tua
clem: Ubi sunt misericordi tu antiqu, Domine, sicut jurasti David in veritate tua?

lxx: μνήσθητι, Κύριε, τοῦ ὀνειδισμοῦ τῶν δούλων σου, οὖ ὑπέσχου ἐν τῷ κόλπῳ μου πολλῶν ἐθνῶν·
vulg: memor esto Domine obprobrii servorum tuorum quod continui in sinu meo multarum gentium
clem: Memor esto, Domine, opprobrii servorum tuorum, quod continui in sinu meo, multarum gentium:

lxx: οὖ ὠνείδισαν οἱ ἐχθροί σου, Κύριε, οὗ ὠνείδισαν τὸ ἀντάλλαγμα τοῦ χριστοῦ σου.
vulg: quod exprobraverunt inimici tui Domine quod exprobraverunt commutationem christi tui
clem: quod exprobraverunt inimici tui, Domine; quod exprobraverunt commutationem christi tui.

lxx: εὐλογητὸς Κύριος εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα. γένοιτο, γένοιτο.
vulg: benedictus Dominus in aeternum fiat fiat
clem: Benedictus Dominus in ternum. Fiat, fiat.]

lxx: μνήσθητι τίς μου ἡ ὑπόστασις· διάψαλμα. μὴ γὰρ ματαίως ἔκτισας πάντας τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν ἀυθρώπων

wlc: מַשְׂכִּיל לְאֵיתָן הָאֶזְרָחִי ׃
lxx: Κύριε, καταφυγὴ ἡμῖν ἐγενήθης ἐν γενεᾷ καὶ γενεᾷ·
vulg: oratio Mosi hominis Dei Domine refugium tu factus es nobis in generatione et generatione
clem: Oratio Moysi, hominis Dei. [Domine, refugium factus es nobis a generatione in generationem.
kjv: I will sing of the mercies of the Lord for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.

wlc: חַסְדֵי יְהוָה עוֹלָם אָשִׁירָה לְדֹר וָדֹר אוֹדִיעַ אֱמוּנָתְךָ בְּפִי ׃
lxx: πρὸ τοῦ ὄρη γενηθῆναι καὶ πλασθῆναι τὴν γῆν καὶ τὴν οἰκουμένην, καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος σὺ εἶ
vulg: priusquam montes fierent et formaretur terra et orbis a saeculo usque in saeculum tu es Deus
clem: Priusquam montes fierent, aut formaretur terra et orbis, a sculo et usque in sculum tu es, Deus.
kjv: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.

wlc: כִּי־אָמַרְתִּי עוֹלָם חֶסֶד יִבָּנֶה שָׁמַיִם תָּכִן אֱמוּנָתְךָ בָהֶם ׃
lxx: μὴ ἀποστρέψῃς ἄνθρωπον εἰς ταπείνωσιν, καὶ εἶπας Ἐπιστρέψατε υἱοὶ ἀνθρώπων;
vulg: ne avertas hominem in humilitatem et dixisti convertimini filii hominum
clem: Ne avertas hominem in humilitatem: et dixisti: Convertimini, filii hominum.
kjv: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,

wlc: כָּרַתִּי בְרִית לִבְחִירִי נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לְדָוִד עַבְדִּי ׃
lxx: ὅτι χίλια ἔτη ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς σου ὡς ἡ ἡμέρα ἡ ἐχθὲς ἥτις διῆλθεν, καὶ φυλακὴ ἐν νυκτί.
vulg: quoniam mille anni ante oculos tuos tamquam dies hesterna quae praeteriit et custodia in nocte
clem: Quoniam mille anni ante oculos tuos tamquam dies hesterna qu prteriit: et custodia in nocte
kjv: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.

wlc: עַד־עוֹלָם אָכִין זַרְעֶךָ וּבָנִיתִי לְדֹר־וָדוֹר כִּסְאֲךָ סֶלָה ׃
lxx: τὰ ἐξουδενώματα αὐτῶν ἔτη ἔσονται, τὸ πρωὶ ὡσεὶ χλόη παρέλθοι·
vulg: quae pro nihilo habentur eorum anni erunt
clem: qu pro nihilo habentur, eorum anni erunt.
kjv: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O Lord: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.

wlc: וְיוֹדוּ שָׁמַיִם פִּלְאֲךָ יְהוָה אַף־אֱמוּנָתְךָ בִּקְהַל קְדֹשִׁים ׃
lxx: τὸ πρωὶ ἀνθήσαι καὶ παρέλθοι, τὸ ἑσπέρας ἀποπέσοι, σκληρυνθείη καὶ ξηρανθείη.
vulg: mane sicut herba transeat mane floreat et transeat vespere decidat induret et arescat
clem: Mane sicut herba transeat; mane floreat, et transeat; vespere decidat, induret, et arescat.
kjv: For who in the heaven can be compared unto the Lord? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the Lord?

wlc: כִּי מִי בַשַּׁחַק יַעֲרֹךְ לַיהוָה יִדְמֶה לַיהוָה בִּבְנֵי אֵלִים ׃
lxx: ὅτι ἐξελίπομεν ἐν τῆ ὀργῇ σου. καὶ ἐν τῷ θυμῷ σου ἐταράχθημεν·
vulg: quia defecimus in ira tua et in furore tuo turbati sumus
clem: Quia defecimus in ira tua, et in furore tuo turbati sumus.
kjv: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.

wlc: אֵל נַעֲרָץ בְּסוֹד־קְדֹשִׁים רַבָּה וְנוֹרָא עַל־כָּל־סְבִיבָיו ׃
lxx: ἔθοῦ τὰς ἀνομίας ἡμῶν ἐνώπιόν σου, ὁ αἰὼν ἡμῶν εἰς φωτισμὸν τοῦ προσώπου σου.
vulg: posuisti iniquitates nostras in conspectu tuo saeculum nostrum in inluminatione vultus tui
clem: Posuisti iniquitates nostras in conspectu tuo; sculum nostrum in illuminatione vultus tui.
kjv: O Lord God of hosts, who is a strong Lord like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?

wlc: יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי צְבָאוֹת מִי־כָמוֹךָ חֲסִין יָהּ וֶאֱמוּנָתְךָ סְבִיבוֹתֶיךָ ׃
lxx: ὅτι πᾶσαι αἱ ἡμέραι ἡμῶν ἐξέλιπον, καὶ ἐν τῇ ὀργῇ σου ἐξελίπομεν· τὰ ἔτη ἡμῶν ὡς ἀράχνην ἐμελέτων.
vulg: quoniam omnes dies nostri defecerunt in ira tua defecimus anni nostri sicut aranea meditabantur
clem: Quoniam omnes dies nostri defecerunt, et in ira tua defecimus. Anni nostri sicut aranea meditabuntur;
kjv: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.

wlc: אַתָּה מוֹשֵׁל בְּגֵאוּת הַיָּם בְּשׂוֹא גַלָּיו אַתָּה תְשַׁבְּחֵם ׃
lxx: αἱ ἡμέραι τῶν ἐτῶν ἡμῶν ἐν ἐνιαυτοῖς ἑβδομήκοντα ἔτη, ἐὸν δὲ ἐν δυναστείαις, ὀγδοήκοντα ἔτη, καὶ τὸ πλεῖον αὐτῶν κόπος καὶ πόνος· ὅτι ἐπῆλθεν πραύτης ἐφʼ ἡμᾶς, καὶ παιδευθησόμεθα.
vulg: dies annorum nostrorum in ipsis septuaginta anni si autem in potentatibus octoginta anni et amplius eorum labor et dolor quoniam supervenit mansuetudo et corripiemur
clem: dies annorum nostrorum in ipsis septuaginta anni. Si autem in potentatibus octoginta anni, et amplius eorum labor et dolor; quoniam supervenit mansuetudo, et corripiemur.
kjv: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.

wlc: אַתָּה דִכִּאתָ כֶחָלָל רָהַב בִּזְרוֹעַ עֻזְּךָ פִּזַּרְתָּ אוֹיְבֶיךָ ׃
lxx: τίς γινώσκει τὸ κράτος τῆς ἀργῆς σου, καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ φόβου τοῦ θυμοῦ σου ἐξαριθμήσασθαι;
vulg: quis novit potestatem irae tuae et prae timore tuo iram tuam
clem: Quis novit potestatem ir tu, et pr timore tuo iram tuam
kjv: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: as for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.

wlc: לְךָ שָׁמַיִם אַף־לְךָ אָרֶץ תֵּבֵל וּמְלֹאָהּ אַתָּה יְסַדְתָּם ׃
lxx: τὴν δεξιάν σου γνώρισον, καὶ τοὺς πεπαιδευμένους τῇ καρδίᾳ ἐν σοφίᾳ.
vulg: dinumerare dexteram tuam sic notam fac et conpeditos corde in sapientia
clem: dinumerare? Dexteram tuam sic notam fac, et eruditos corde in sapientia.
kjv: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.

wlc: צָפוֹן וְיָמִין אַתָּה בְרָאתָם תָּבוֹר וְחֶרְמוֹן בְּשִׁמְךָ יְרַנֵּנוּ ׃
lxx: ἐπίστρεψον, Κύριε· ἕως πότε; καὶ παρακλήθητι ἐπὶ τοῖς δούλοις σου.
vulg: convertere Domine usquequo et deprecabilis esto super servos tuos
clem: Convertere, Domine; usquequo? et deprecabilis esto super servos tuos.
kjv: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.

wlc: לְךָ זְרוֹעַ עִם־גְּבוּרָה תָּעֹז יָדְךָ תָּרוּם יְמִינֶךָ ׃
lxx: ἐνεπλήσθημεν τὸ πρωὶ τοῦ ἐλέους σου, καὶ ἠγαλλιασάμεθα καὶ εὐφράνθημεν ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ἡμέραις ἡμῶν,
vulg: repleti sumus mane misericordia tua et exultavimus et delectati sumus in omnibus diebus nostris
clem: Repleti sumus mane misericordia tua; et exsultavimus, et delectati sumus omnibus diebus nostris.
kjv: Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.

wlc: צֶדֶק וּמִשְׁפָּט מְכוֹן כִּסְאֶךָ חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת יְקַדְּמוּ פָנֶיךָ ׃
lxx: ἀνθʼ ὧν ἡμερῶν ἐταπείνωσας ἡμᾶς, ἐτῶν ὧν εἴδομεν κακά.
vulg: laetati sumus pro diebus quibus nos humiliasti annis quibus vidimus mala
clem: Ltati sumus pro diebus quibus nos humiliasti; annis quibus vidimus mala.
kjv: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O Lord, in the light of thy countenance.

wlc: אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם יוֹדְעֵי תְרוּעָה יְהוָה בְּאוֹר־פָּנֶיךָ יְהַלֵּכוּן ׃
lxx: καὶ ἴδε ἐπὶ τοὺς δούλους σου καὶ τὰ ἔργα σου, καὶ ὁδήγησον τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτῶν.
vulg: et respice in servos tuos et in opera tua et dirige filios eorum
clem: Respice in servos tuos et in opera tua, et dirige filios eorum.
kjv: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.

wlc: בְּשִׁמְךָ יְגִילוּן כָּל־הַיּוֹם וּבְצִדְקָתְךָ יָרוּמוּ ׃
lxx: καὶ ἔστω ἡ λαμπρότης Κυρίου θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἐφʼ ἡμᾶς. καὶ τὰ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν ἡμῶν κατεύθυνον ἐφʼ ἡμᾶς.
vulg: et sit splendor Domini Dei nostri super nos et opera manuum nostrarum dirige super nos et opus manuum nostrarum dirige;
clem: Et sit splendor Domini Dei nostri super nos, et opera manuum nostrarum dirige super nos, et opus manuum nostrarum dirige.]
kjv: For thou art the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.

wlc: כִּי־תִפְאֶרֶת עֻזָּמוֹ אָתָּה וּבִרְצֹנְךָ תָּרִים קַרְנֵנוּ ׃
kjv: For the Lord is our defence; and the Holy One of Israel is our king.

wlc: כִּי לַיהוָה מָגִנֵּנוּ וְלִקְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל מַלְכֵּנוּ ׃
kjv: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.

wlc: אָז דִּבַּרְתָּ־בְחָזוֹן לַחֲסִידֶיךָ וַתֹּאמֶר שִׁוִּיתִי עֵזֶר עַל־גִּבּוֹר הֲרִימוֹתִי בָחוּר מֵעָם ׃
kjv: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:

wlc: מָצָאתִי דָּוִד עַבְדִּי בְּשֶׁמֶן קָדְשִׁי מְשַׁחְתִּיו ׃
kjv: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.

wlc: אֲשֶׁר יָדִי תִּכּוֹן עִמּוֹ אַף־זְרוֹעִי תְאַמְּצֶנּוּ ׃
kjv: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.

wlc: לֹא־יַשִּׁא אוֹיֵב בּוֹ וּבֶן־עַוְלָה לֹא יְעַנֶּנּוּ ׃
kjv: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.

wlc: וְכַתּוֹתִי מִפָּנָיו צָרָיו וּמְשַׂנְאָיו אֶגּוֹף ׃
kjv: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.

wlc: וֶאֶמוּנָתִי וְחַסְדִּי עִמּוֹ וּבִשְׁמִי תָּרוּם קַרְנוֹ ׃
kjv: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.

wlc: וְשַׂמְתִּי בַיָּם יָדוֹ וּבַנְּהָרוֹת יְמִינוֹ ׃
kjv: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.

wlc: הוּא יִקְרָאֵנִי אָבִי אָתָּה אֵלִי וְצוּר יְשׁוּעָתִי ׃
kjv: Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.

wlc: אַף־אָנִי בְּכוֹר אֶתְּנֵהוּ עֶלְיוֹן לְמַלְכֵי־אָרֶץ ׃
kjv: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.

wlc: לְעוֹלָם אֶשְׁמור־לוֹ חַסְדִּי וּבְרִיתִי נֶאֱמֶנֶת לוֹ ׃
kjv: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

wlc: וְשַׂמְתִּי לָעַד זַרְעוֹ וְכִסְאוֹ כִּימֵי שָׁמָיִם ׃
kjv: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;

wlc: אִם־יַעַזְבוּ בָנָיו תּוֹרָתִי וּבְמִשְׁפָּטַי לֹא יֵלֵכוּן ׃
kjv: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;

wlc: אִם־חֻקֹּתַי יְחַלֵּלוּ וּמִצְוֹתַי לֹא יִשְׁמֹרוּ ׃
kjv: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

wlc: וּפָקַדְתִּי בְשֵׁבֶט פִּשְׁעָם וּבִנְגָעִים עֲוֹנָם ׃
kjv: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.

wlc: וְחַסְדִּי לֹא־אָפִיר מֵעִמּוֹ וְלֹא־אֲשַׁקֵּר בֶּאֱמוּנָתִי ׃
kjv: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.

wlc: לֹא־אֲחַלֵּל בְּרִיתִי וּמוֹצָא שְׂפָתַי לֹא אֲשַׁנֶּה ׃
kjv: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.

wlc: אַחַת נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי בְקָדְשִׁי אִם־לְדָוִד אֲכַזֵּב ׃
kjv: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.

wlc: זַרְעוֹ לְעוֹלָם יִהְיֶה וְכִסְאוֹ כַשֶּׁמֶשׁ נֶגְדִּי ׃
kjv: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.

wlc: כְּיָרֵחַ יִכּוֹן עוֹלָם וְעֵד בַּשַּׁחַק נֶאֱמָן סֶלָה ׃
kjv: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.

wlc: וְאַתָּה זָנַחְתָּ וַתִּמְאָס הִתְעַבַּרְתָּ עִם־מְשִׁיחֶךָ ׃
kjv: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.

wlc: נֵאַרְתָּה בְּרִית עַבְדֶּךָ חִלַּלְתָּ לָאָרֶץ נִזְרוֹ ׃
kjv: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.

wlc: פָּרַצְתָּ כָל־גְּדֵרֹתָיו שַׂמְתָּ מִבְצָרָיו מְחִתָּה ׃
kjv: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.

wlc: שַׁסֻּהוּ כָּל־עֹבְרֵי דָרֶךְ הָיָה חֶרְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנָיו ׃
kjv: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.

wlc: הֲרִימוֹתָ יְמִין צָרָיו הִשְׂמַחְתָּ כָּל־אוֹיְבָיו ׃
kjv: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.

wlc: אַף־תָּשִׁיב צוּר חַרְבּוֹ וְלֹא הֲקֵימֹתוֹ בַּמִּלְחָמָה ׃
kjv: Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.

wlc: הִשְׁבַּתָּ מִטְּהָרוֹ וְכִסְאוֹ לָאָרֶץ מִגַּרְתָּה ׃
kjv: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.

wlc: הִקְצַרְתָּ יְמֵי עֲלוּמָיו הֶעֱטִיתָ עָלָיו בּוּשָׁה סֶלָה ׃
kjv: How long, Lord? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?

wlc: עַד־מָה יְהוָה תִּסָּתֵר לָנֶצַח תִּבְעַר כְּמוֹ־אֵשׁ חֲמָתֶךָ ׃
kjv: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?

wlc: זְכָר־אֲנִי מֶה־חָלֶד עַל־מַה־שָּׁוְא בָּרָאתָ כָל־בְּנֵי־אָדָם ׃
kjv: What man is he that liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.

wlc: מִי גֶבֶר יִחְיֶה וְלֹא יִרְאֶה־מָּוֶת יְמַלֵּט נַפְשׁוֹ מִיַּד־שְׁאוֹל סֶלָה ׃
kjv: Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, which thou swarest unto David in thy truth?

wlc: אַיֵּה חֲסָדֶיךָ הָרִאשֹׁנִים אֲדֹנָי נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ לְדָוִד בֶּאֱמוּנָתֶךָ ׃
kjv: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; how I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people;

wlc: זְכֹר אֲדֹנָי חֶרְפַּת עֲבָדֶיךָ שְׂאֵתִי בְחֵיקִי כָּל־רַבִּים עַמִּים ׃
kjv: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O Lord; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.

wlc: אֲשֶׁר חֵרְפוּ אוֹיְבֶיךָ יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר חֵרְפוּ עִקְּבוֹת מְשִׁיחֶךָ ׃
kjv: Blessed be the Lord for evermore. Amen, and Amen.

wlc: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם אָמֵן וְאָמֵן ׃
lxx: ΙΙροσευχὴ τοῦ Μωυσῆ ἀνθρώπου τοῦ θεοῦ.

wlc: תְּפִלָּה לְמֹשֶׁה אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים אֲדֹנָי מָעוֹן אַתָּה הָיִיתָ לָּנוּ בְּדֹר וָדֹר ׃
lxx: Ὁ κατοικῶν ἐν βοηθείᾳ τοῦ ὑψίστου ἐν σκέπῃ τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ αὐλισθήσεται.
vulg: laus cantici David qui habitat in adiutorio Altissimi in protectione Dei caeli commorabitur
clem: Laus cantici David. [Qui habitat in adjutorio Altissimi, in protectione Dei cli commorabitur.
kjv: Lord, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.

wlc: בְּטֶרֶם הָרִים יֻלָּדוּ וַתְּחוֹלֵל אֶרֶץ וְתֵבֵל וּמֵעוֹלָם עַד־עוֹלָם אַתָּה אֵל ׃
lxx: ἐρεῖ τῷ θεῷ Ἀντιλήμπτωρ μου εἶ· καὶ καταφυγὴ μου ὁ θεός μου, ἐλπιῶ ἐπʼ αὐτόν.
vulg: dicet Domino susceptor meus es tu et refugium meum Deus meus sperabo in eum
clem: Dicet Domino: Susceptor meus es tu, et refugium meum; Deus meus, sperabo in eum.
kjv: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.

wlc: תָּשֵׁב אֱנוֹשׁ עַד־דַּכָּא וַתֹּאמֶר שׁוּבוּ בְנֵי־אָדָם ׃
lxx: ὅτι αὐτὸς ῥύσεται ἐκ παγίδος θηρευτῶν, καὶ ἀπὸ λόγου ταραχώδους·
vulg: quoniam ipse liberabit me de laqueo venantium et a verbo aspero
clem: Quoniam ipse liberavit me de laqueo venantium, et a verbo aspero.
kjv: Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men.

wlc: כִּי אֶלֶף שָׁנִים בְּעֵינֶיךָ כְּיוֹם אֶתְמוֹל כִּי יַעֲבֹר וְאַשְׁמוּרָה בַלָּיְלָה ׃
lxx: ἐυ τοῖς μεταφρένοις αὐτοῦ ἐπισκιάσει σοι, καὶ ὑπὸ τὰς πτέρυγας αὐτοῦ ἐλπιεῖς· ὅπλῳ κυκλώσει σε ἡ ἀλήθεια αὐτοῦ.
vulg: in scapulis suis obumbrabit te et sub pinnis eius sperabis
clem: Scapulis suis obumbrabit tibi, et sub pennis ejus sperabis.
kjv: For a thousand years in thy sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night.

wlc: זְרַמְתָּם שֵׁנָה יִהְיוּ בַּבֹּקֶר כֶּחָצִיר יַחֲלֹף ׃
lxx: οὐ φοβηθήσῃ ἀπὸ φόβου νυκτερινοῦ, ἀπὸ βέλους πετομένου ἡμέρας,
vulg: scuto circumdabit te veritas eius non timebis a timore nocturno
clem: Scuto circumdabit te veritas ejus: non timebis a timore nocturno;
kjv: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: in the morning they are like grass which groweth up.

wlc: בַּבֹּקֶר יָצִיץ וְחָלָף לָעֶרֶב יְמוֹלֵל וְיָבֵשׁ ׃
lxx: ἀπὸ πράγματος διαπορευομένου ἐν σκότει, ἀπὸ συμπτώματος καὶ δαιμονίου μεσημβρινοῦ.
vulg: a sagitta volante in die a negotio perambulante in tenebris ab incursu et daemonio meridiano
clem: a sagitta volante in die, a negotio perambulante in tenebris, ab incursu, et dmonio meridiano.
kjv: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.

wlc: כִּי־כָלִינוּ בְאַפֶּךָ וּבַחֲמָתְךָ נִבְהָלְנוּ ׃
lxx: πεσεῖται ἐκ τοῦ κλίτους σου χιλιάς, καὶ μυριὰς ἐκ δεξιῶν σου, πρὸς σὲ δὲ οὐκ ἐγγιεῖ
vulg: cadent a latere tuo mille et decem milia a dextris tuis ad te autem non adpropinquabit
clem: Cadent a latere tuo mille, et decem millia a dextris tuis; ad te autem non appropinquabit.
kjv: For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy wrath are we troubled.

wlc: שַׁתָּ עֲוֹנֹתֵינוּ לְנֶגְדֶּךָ עֲלֻמֵנוּ לִמְאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ ׃
lxx: πλὴν τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς σου κατανοήσεις, καὶ ἀνταπόδοσιν ἁμαρτωλῶν ὄψῃ.
vulg: verumtamen oculis tuis considerabis et retributionem peccatorum videbis
clem: Verumtamen oculis tuis considerabis, et retributionem peccatorum videbis.
kjv: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.

wlc: כִּי כָל־יָמֵינוּ פָּנוּ בְעֶבְרָתֶךָ כִּלִּינוּ שָׁנֵינוּ כְמוֹ־הֶגֶה ׃
lxx: ὅτι σύ, Κύριε. ἡ ἐλπίς μου· τὸν ὕψιστον ἔθου καταφυγὴν σου.
vulg: quoniam tu Domine spes mea Altissimum posuisti refugium tuum
clem: Quoniam tu es, Domine, spes mea; Altissimum posuisti refugium tuum.
kjv: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a tale that is told.

wlc: יְמֵי־שְׁנוֹתֵינוּ בָהֶם שִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה וְאִם בִּגְבוּרֹת שְׁמוֹנִים שָׁנָה וְרָהְבָּם עָמָל וָאָוֶן כִּי־גָז חִישׁ וַנָּעֻפָה ׃
lxx: οὐ προσελεύσεται πρὸς σὲ κακά, καὶ μάστιξ οὐκ ἐγγιεῖ τῷ σκηνώματί σου·
vulg: non accedent ad te mala et flagellum non adpropinquabit tabernaculo tuo
clem: Non accedet ad te malum, et flagellum non appropinquabit tabernaculo tuo.
kjv: The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, yet is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.

wlc: מִי־יוֹדֵעַ עֹז אַפֶּךָ וּכְיִרְאָתְךָ עֶבְרָתֶךָ ׃
lxx: ὅτι τοῖς ἀγγέλοις αὐτοῦ ἐντελεῖται περὶ σοῦ τοῦ διαφυλάξαι σε ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς σου·
vulg: quoniam angelis suis mandabit de te ut custodiant te in omnibus viis tuis
clem: Quoniam angelis suis mandavit de te, ut custodiant te in omnibus viis tuis.
kjv: Who knoweth the power of thine anger? even according to thy fear, so is thy wrath.

wlc: לִמְנוֹת יָמֵינוּ כֵּן הוֹדַע וְנָבִא לְבַב חָכְמָה ׃
lxx: ἐπὶ χειρῶν ἀροῦσίν σε. μή ποτε προσκόψῃς πρὸς λίθον τὸν πόδα σου.
vulg: in manibus portabunt te ne forte offendas ad lapidem pedem tuum
clem: In manibus portabunt te, ne forte offendas ad lapidem pedem tuum.
kjv: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.

wlc: שׁוּבָה יְהוָה עַד־מָתָי וְהִנָּחֵם עַל־עֲבָדֶיךָ ׃
lxx: ἐπ᾿ ἀσπίδα καὶ βασιλίσκον ἐπιβήσῃ, καὶ καταπατήσεις λέοντα καὶ δράκοντα.
vulg: super aspidem et basiliscum ambulabis %et; conculcabis leonem et draconem
clem: Super aspidem et basiliscum ambulabis, et conculcabis leonem et draconem.
kjv: Return, O Lord, how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants.

wlc: שַׂבְּעֵנוּ בַבֹּקֶר חַסְדֶּךָ וּנְרַנְּנָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בְּכָל־יָמֵינוּ ׃
lxx: ὅτι ἐπʼ ἐμὲ ἤλπισεν, καὶ ῥύσομαι αὐτόν· σκεπάσω αὐτόν, ὅτι ἔγνω τὸ ὄνομά μου.
vulg: quoniam in me speravit et liberabo eum protegam eum quia cognovit nomen meum
clem: Quoniam in me speravit, liberabo eum; protegam eum, quoniam cognovit nomen meum.
kjv: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

wlc: שַׂמְּחֵנוּ כִּימוֹת עִנִּיתָנוּ שְׁנוֹת רָאִינוּ רָעָה ׃
lxx: ἐπικαλέσεται με, καὶ εἰσακούσομαι αὐτοῦ. μετʼ αὐτοῦ εἰμι ἐν θλίψει, καὶ ἐξελοῦμαι καὶ δοξάσω αὐτόν.
vulg: clamabit ad me et exaudiam eum cum ipso sum in tribulatione eripiam eum et clarificabo eum
clem: Clamabit ad me, et ego exaudiam eum; cum ipso sum in tribulatione: eripiam eum, et glorificabo eum.
kjv: Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, and the years wherein we have seen evil.

wlc: יֵרָאֶה אֶל־עֲבָדֶיךָ פָעֳלֶךָ וַהֲדָרְךָ עַל־בְּנֵיהֶם ׃
lxx: μακρότητι ἡμερῶν ἐμπλήσω αὐτόν, καὶ δείξω αὐτῷ τὸ σωτήριόν μου. Ψαλμὸς ᾠδῆς, εἰς τὴν ἡμέραν τοῦ σαββάτου.
vulg: longitudine dierum replebo eum et ostendam illi salutare meum
clem: Longitudine dierum replebo eum, et ostendam illi salutare meum.]
kjv: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, and thy glory unto their children.

wlc: וִיהִי נֹעַם אֲדֹנָי אֱלֹהֵינוּ עָלֵינוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֵינוּ כּוֹנְנָה עָלֵינוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֵינוּ כּוֹנְנֵהוּ ׃
lxx: Αἶνος ᾠδῆς τῷ Δαυείδ.
kjv: And let the beauty of the Lord our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.

wlc: יֹשֵׁב בְּסֵתֶר עֶלְיוֹן בְּצֵל שַׁדַּי יִתְלוֹנָן ׃
lxx: ψαλμὸς ᾠδῆς, εὶς τὴς ἠμέραν τοῦ ασββάτον.
vulg: psalmus cantici in die sabbati
clem: Psalmus cantici, in die sabbati.
kjv: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

wlc: אֹמַר לַיהוָה מַחְסִי וּמְצוּדָתִי אֱלֹהַי אֶבְטַח־בּוֹ ׃
lxx: Ἀγαθὸν τὸ ἐξομολογεῖσθαι τῷ κυρίῳ, καὶ ψάλλειν τῷ ὀνόματί σου, Ὕψιστε·
vulg: bonum est confiteri Domino et psallere nomini tuo Altissime
clem: [Bonum est confiteri Domino, et psallere nomini tuo, Altissime:
kjv: I will say of the Lord, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.

wlc: כִּי הוּא יַצִּילְךָ מִפַּח יָקוּשׁ מִדֶּבֶר הַוּוֹת ׃
lxx: τοῦ ἀναγγέλλειν τὸ πρωὶ τὸ ἔλεός σου, καὶ τὴν ἀλήθειάν σου κατὰ νύκτα,
vulg: ad adnuntiandum mane misericordiam tuam et veritatem tuam per noctem
clem: ad annuntiandum mane misericordiam tuam, et veritatem tuam per noctem,
kjv: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.

wlc: בְּאֶבְרָתוֹ יָסֶךְ לָךְ וְתַחַת־כְּנָפָיו תֶּחְסֶה צִנָּה וְסֹחֵרָה אֲמִתּוֹ ׃
lxx: ἐν δεκαχόρδῳ ψαλτηρίῳ μετʼ ᾠδῆς ἐν κιθάρᾳ·
vulg: in decacordo psalterio cum cantico in cithara
clem: in decachordo, psalterio; cum cantico, in cithara.
kjv: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.

wlc: לֹא־תִירָא מִפַּחַד לָיְלָה מֵחֵץ יָעוּף יוֹמָם ׃
lxx: ὅτι εὔφρανάς με, Κύριε, ἐν τῷ ποιήματί σου, καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἔργοις τῶν χειρῶν σου ἀγαλλιάσομαι.
vulg: quia delectasti me Domine in factura tua et in operibus manuum tuarum exultabo
clem: Quia delectasti me, Domine, in factura tua; et in operibus manuum tuarum exsultabo.
kjv: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;

wlc: מִדֶּבֶר בָּאֹפֶל יַהֲלֹךְ מִקֶּטֶב יָשׁוּד צָהֳרָיִם ׃
lxx: ὡς ἐμεγαλύνθη τὰ ἔργα σου, Κύριε, σφόδρα ἐβαρύνθησαν οἱ διαλογισμοί σου.
vulg: quam magnificata sunt opera tua Domine nimis profundae factae sunt cogitationes tuae
clem: Quam magnificata sunt opera tua, Domine! nimis profund fact sunt cogitationes tu.
kjv: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.

wlc: יִפֹּל מִצִּדְּךָ אֶלֶף וּרְבָבָה מִימִינֶךָ אֵלֶיךָ לֹא יִגָּשׁ ׃
lxx: ἀνὴρ ἄφρων οὐ γνώσεται, καὶ ἀσύνετος οὐ συνήσει ταῦτα.
vulg: vir insipiens non cognoscet et stultus non intelleget haec
clem: Vir insipiens non cognoscet, et stultus non intelliget hc.
kjv: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.

wlc: רַק בְּעֵינֶיךָ תַבִּיט וְשִׁלֻּמַת רְשָׁעִים תִּרְאֶה ׃
lxx: ἐν τῷ ἀνατεῖλαι τοὺς ἁμαρτωλοὺς ὡς χόρτον, καὶ διέκυψαν πάντες οἱ ἐργαζόμενοι τὴν ἀνομίαν, ὅπως ἂν ἐξολεθρευθῶσιν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος.
vulg: cum exorti fuerint peccatores sicut faenum et apparuerint omnes qui operantur iniquitatem ut intereant in saeculum %saeculi;
clem: Cum exorti fuerint peccatores sicut fnum, et apparuerint omnes qui operantur iniquitatem, ut intereant in sculum sculi:
kjv: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.

wlc: כִּי־אַתָּה יְהוָה מַחְסִי עֶלְיוֹן שַׂמְתָּ מְעוֹנֶךָ ׃
lxx: σὺ δὲ Ὕψιστος εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, Κύριε.
vulg: tu autem Altissimus in aeternum Domine
clem: tu autem Altissimus in ternum, Domine.
kjv: Because thou hast made the Lord, which is my refuge, even the most High, thy habitation;

wlc: לֹא־תְאֻנֶּה אֵלֶיךָ רָעָה וְנֶגַע לֹא־יִקְרַב בְּאָהֳלֶךָ ׃
lxx: ὅτὶ ἰδοὺ οἱ ἐχθροί σου ἀπολοῦνται, καὶ διασκορπισθήσονται πάντες οἱ ἐργαζόμενοι τὴν ἀνομίαν.
vulg: quoniam ecce inimici tui Domine; quoniam ecce inimici tui peribunt et dispergentur omnes qui operantur iniquitatem
clem: Quoniam ecce inimici tui, Domine, quoniam ecce inimici tui peribunt; et dispergentur omnes qui operantur iniquitatem.
kjv: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.

wlc: כִּי מַלְאָכָיו יְצַוֶּה־לָּךְ לִשְׁמָרְךָ בְּכָל־דְּרָכֶיךָ ׃
lxx: καὶ ὑψωθήσεται ὡς μονοκέρωτος τὸ κέρας μου. καὶ τὸ γῆράς μου ἐν ἐλαίῳ πίονι·
vulg: et exaltabitur sicut unicornis cornu meum et senectus mea in misericordia uberi
clem: Et exaltabitur sicut unicornis cornu meum, et senectus mea in misericordia uberi.
kjv: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.

wlc: עַל־כַּפַּיִם יִשָּׂאוּנְךָ פֶּן־תִּגֹּף בָּאֶבֶן רַגְלֶךָ ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐπεῖδεν ὁ ὀφθαλμός μου ἐν τοῖς ἐχθροῖς μου. καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἐπανισταμένοις ἐπʼ ἐμέ πονηρευομένοις εἰσακούσεται τὸ οὖς μου.
vulg: et despexit oculus meus inimicis meis et insurgentibus in me malignantibus audiet auris mea
clem: Et despexit oculus meus inimicos meos, et in insurgentibus in me malignantibus audiet auris mea.
kjv: They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

wlc: עַל־שַׁחַל וָפֶתֶן תִּדְרֹךְ תִּרְמֹס כְּפִיר וְתַנִּין ׃
lxx: δίκαιος ὡς φοίνιξ ἀνθήσει, ὡς ἡ κέδρος ἡ ἐν τῷ Λιβάνῳ πληθυνθήσεται.
vulg: iustus ut palma florebit ut cedrus Libani multiplicabitur
clem: Justus ut palma florebit; sicut cedrus Libani multiplicabitur.
kjv: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.

wlc: כִּי בִי חָשַׁק וַאֲפַלְּטֵהוּ אֲשַׂגְּבֵהוּ כִּי־יָדַע שְׁמִי ׃
lxx: πεφυτευμένοι ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ Κυρίου ἐν ταῖς αὐλαῖς τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἐξανθήσουσιν·
vulg: plantati in domo Domini in atriis Dei nostri florebunt
clem: Plantati in domo Domini, in atriis domus Dei nostri florebunt.
kjv: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.

wlc: יִקְרָאֵנִי וְאֶעֱנֵהוּ עִמּוֹ־אָנֹכִי בְצָרָה אֲחַלְּצֵהוּ וַאֲכַבְּדֵהוּ ׃
lxx: γότε πληθυνθήσονται ἐν γήρει πίονι, καὶ εὐπαθοῦντες ἔσονται· τοῦ ἀναγγεῖλαι ὅτι εὐθὴς Κύριος ὁ θεός μου. καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἀδικία ἐν αὐτῷ.
vulg: adhuc multiplicabuntur in senecta uberi et bene patientes erunt
clem: Adhuc multiplicabuntur in senecta uberi, et bene patientes erunt:
kjv: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.

wlc: אֹרֶךְ יָמִים אַשְׂבִּיעֵהוּ וְאַרְאֵהוּ בִּישׁוּעָתִי ׃
vulg: ut adnuntient quoniam rectus Dominus Deus noster et non est iniquitas in eo
clem: ut annuntient quoniam rectus Dominus Deus noster, et non est iniquitas in eo.]
kjv: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.

wlc: מִזְמוֹר שִׁיר לְיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת ׃
lxx: Κύριος ἐβασίλευσεν, εὐπρέπειαν ἐνεδύσατο· ἐυεδύσατο Κύριος δύναμιν καὶ περιεζώσατο, καὶ γὰρ ἐστερέωσεν τὴν οἰκουμένην, ἥτις οὐ σαλευθήσεται
vulg: laus cantici David in die ante sabbatum quando inhabitata est terra Dominus regnavit decore indutus est indutus est Dominus fortitudine et praecinxit se etenim firmavit orbem terrae qui non commovebitur
clem: Laus cantici ipsi David, in die ante sabbatum, quando fundata est terra. [Dominus regnavit, decorem indutus est: indutus est Dominus fortitudinem, et prcinxit se. Etenim firmavit orbem terr, qui non commovebitur.
kjv: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the Lord, and to sing praises unto thy name, O Most High:

wlc: טוֹב לְהֹדוֹת לַיהוָה וּלְזַמֵּר לְשִׁמְךָ עֶלְיוֹן ׃
lxx: ἕτοιμος ὁ θρόνος σου ἀπὸ τότε· ἀπὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος σὺ εἶ
vulg: parata sedis tua ex tunc a saeculo tu es
clem: Parata sedes tua ex tunc; a sculo tu es.
kjv: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night,

wlc: לְהַגִּיד בַּבֹּקֶר חַסְדֶּךָ וֶאֱמוּנָתְךָ בַּלֵּילוֹת ׃
lxx: ἐπῆραν οἱ ποταμοί, Κύριε, ἐπῆραν οἱ ποταμοὶ φωνὰς αὐτῶν.
vulg: elevaverunt flumina Domine elevaverunt flumina vocem suam elevabunt flumina fluctus suos;
clem: Elevaverunt flumina, Domine, elevaverunt flumina vocem suam; elevaverunt flumina fluctus suos,
kjv: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound.

wlc: עֲלֵי־עָשׂוֹר וַעֲלֵי־נָבֶל עֲלֵי הִגָּיוֹן בְּכִנּוֹר ׃
lxx: ἀπὸ φωνῶν ὑδάτων πολλῶυ θαυμαστοὶ οἱ μετεωρισμοὶ τῆς θαλάσσης· θαυμαστὸς ἐν ὑψηλοῖς ὁ κύριος.
vulg: a vocibus aquarum multarum mirabiles elationes maris mirabilis in altis Dominus
clem: a vocibus aquarum multarum. Mirabiles elationes maris; mirabilis in altis Dominus.
kjv: For thou, Lord, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.

wlc: כִּי שִׂמַּחְתַּנִי יְהוָה בְּפָעֳלֶךָ בְּמַעֲשֵׂי יָדֶיךָ אֲרַנֵּן ׃
lxx: τὰ μαρτύριά σου ἐπιστώθησαν σφόδρα· τῷ οἴκῳ σου πρέπει ἁγίασμα, Κύριε, εἰς μακρότητα ἡμερῶν.
vulg: testimonia tua credibilia facta sunt nimis domum tuam decet sanctitudo Domine in longitudine dierum
clem: Testimonia tua credibilia facta sunt nimis; domum tuam decet sanctitudo, Domine, in longitudinem dierum.]
kjv: O Lord, how great are thy works! and thy thoughts are very deep.

wlc: מַה־גָּדְלוּ מַעֲשֶׂיךָ יְהוָה מְאֹד עָמְקוּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶיךָ ׃
kjv: A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.

wlc: אִישׁ־בַּעַר לֹא יֵדָע וּכְסִיל לֹא־יָבִין אֶת־זֹאת ׃
kjv: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; it is that they shall be destroyed for ever:

wlc: בִּפְרֹחַ רְשָׁעִים כְּמוֹ עֵשֶׂב וַיָּצִיצוּ כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן לְהִשָּׁמְדָם עֲדֵי־עַד ׃
kjv: But thou, Lord, art most high for evermore.

wlc: וְאַתָּה מָרוֹם לְעֹלָם יְהוָה ׃
kjv: For, lo, thine enemies, O Lord, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

wlc: כִּי הִנֵּה אֹיְבֶיךָ יְהוָה כִּי־הִנֵּה אֹיְבֶיךָ יֹאבֵדוּ יִתְפָּרְדוּ כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן ׃
kjv: But my horn shalt thou exalt like the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.

wlc: וַתָּרֶם כִּרְאֵים קַרְנִי בַּלֹּתִי בְּשֶׁמֶן רַעֲנָן ׃
kjv: Mine eye also shall see my desire on mine enemies, and mine ears shall hear my desire of the wicked that rise up against me.

wlc: וַתַּבֵּט עֵינִי בְּשׁוּרָי בַּקָּמִים עָלַי מְרֵעִים תִּשְׁמַעְנָה אָזְנָי ׃
kjv: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

wlc: צַדִּיק כַּתָּמָר יִפְרָח כְּאֶרֶז בַּלְּבָנוֹן יִשְׂגֶּה ׃
kjv: Those that be planted in the house of the Lord shall flourish in the courts of our God.

wlc: שְׁתוּלִים בְּבֵית יְהוָה בְּחַצְרוֹת אֱלֹהֵינוּ יַפְרִיחוּ ׃
kjv: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;

wlc: עוֹד יְנוּבוּן בְּשֵׂיבָה דְּשֵׁנִים וְרַעֲנַנִּים יִהְיוּ ׃
lxx: Εἰς τὴν ἡμέραν τοῦ προσαββάτου, ὅτε κατῴκισται ἡ γῆ· αἴνος ᾠδης τῷ Δαυείδ.
kjv: To shew that the Lord is upright: he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

wlc: לְהַגִּיד כִּי־יָשָׁר יְהוָה צוּרִי וְלֹא־עֹלָתָה בּוֹ ׃
יְהוָה מָלָךְ גֵּאוּת לָבֵשׁ לָבֵשׁ יְהוָה עֹז הִתְאַזָּר אַף־תִּכּוֹן תֵּבֵל בַּל־תִּמּוֹט ׃
lxx: Ὁ θεὸς ἐκδικήσεων Κύριος, ὁ θεὸς ἐκδικήσεων ἐπαρρησιάσατο.
vulg: psalmus David quarta sabbati Deus ultionum Dominus Deus ultionum libere egit
clem: Psalmus ipsi David, quarta sabbati. [Deus ultionum Dominus; Deus ultionum libere egit.
kjv: The Lord reigneth, he is clothed with majesty; the Lord is clothed with strength, wherewith he hath girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.

wlc: נָכוֹן כִּסְאֲךָ מֵאָז מֵעוֹלָם אָתָּה ׃
lxx: ὑψώθητι ὁ κρίνων τὴν γῆν, ἀπόδος ἀνταπόδοσιν τοῖς ὑπερηφάνοις.
vulg: exaltare qui iudicas terram redde retributionem superbis
clem: Exaltare, qui judicas terram; redde retributionem superbis.
kjv: Thy throne is established of old: thou art from everlasting.

wlc: נָשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת יְהוָה נָשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת קוֹלָם יִשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת דָּכְיָם ׃
lxx: ἕως πότε ἁμαρτωλοί, Κύριε, ἕως πότε ἁμαρτωλοὶ καυχήσοσται;
vulg: usquequo peccatores Domine usquequo peccatores gloriabuntur
clem: Usquequo peccatores, Domine, usquequo peccatores gloriabuntur;
kjv: The floods have lifted up, O Lord, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.

wlc: מִקֹּלוֹת מַיִם רַבִּים אַדִּירִים מִשְׁבְּרֵי־יָם אַדִּיר בַּמָּרוֹם יְהוָה ׃
lxx: φθέγξονται καὶ λαλήσουσιν ἀδικίαν, λαλήσουσιν πάντες οἱ ἐργαζόμενοι τὴν ἀνομίαν ;
vulg: effabuntur et loquentur iniquitatem loquentur omnes qui operantur iniustitiam
clem: effabuntur et loquentur iniquitatem; loquentur omnes qui operantur injustitiam?
kjv: The Lord on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.

wlc: עֵדֹתֶיךָ נֶאֶמְנוּ מְאֹד לְבֵיתְךָ נַאֲוָה־קֹדֶשׁ יְהוָה לְאֹרֶךְ יָמִים ׃
lxx: Ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυείδ, τετράδι σαββάτων. τὸν λαόν σου, Κύριε, ἐταπείνωσαν, καὶ τὴν κληροσομίαν σου ἐκάκωσαν·
vulg: populum tuum Domine humiliaverunt et hereditatem tuam vexaverunt
clem: Populum tuum, Domine, humiliaverunt, et hreditatem tuam vexaverunt.
kjv: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O Lord, for ever.

lxx: χήραν καὶ ὀρφανὸν ἀπέκτειναν, καὶ προσήλυτον ἐφόοευσαν·
vulg: viduam et advenam interfecerunt et pupillos occiderunt
clem: Viduam et advenam interfecerunt, et pupillos occiderunt.

lxx: καὶ εἶπαν Οὐκ ὄψεται Κύριος, οὐδὲ συνήσει ὁ θεὸς τοῦ Ἰακώβ.
vulg: et dixerunt non videbit Dominus nec intelleget Deus Iacob
clem: Et dixerunt: Non videbit Dominus, nec intelliget Deus Jacob.

lxx: σύνετε δή, ἄφρονες ἐν τῷ λαῷ· καὶ μωροί, ποτὲ φρονήσατε.
vulg: intellegite qui insipientes estis in populo et stulti aliquando sapite
clem: Intelligite, insipientes in populo; et stulti, aliquando sapite.

lxx: ὁ φυτεύσας τὸ οὖς, οὐχὶ ἀκούει; ἢ ὁ πλάσας ὀφθαλμούς, οὐ κατανοεῖ
vulg: qui plantavit aurem non audiet aut qui finxit oculum non considerat
clem: Qui plantavit aurem non audiet? aut qui finxit oculum non considerat?

lxx: ὁ παιδεύων ἔθνη, οὐχὶ ἐλέγξει, ὁ διδάσκων ἄνθρωπον γνῶσιν;
vulg: qui corripit gentes non arguet qui docet hominem scientiam
clem: Qui corripit gentes non arguet, qui docet hominem scientiam?

lxx: Κύριος γινώσκει τοὺς διαλογισμοὺς τῶν ἀνθρώπων, ὅτι εἰσὶν μάταιοι.
vulg: Dominus scit cogitationes hominum quoniam vanae sunt
clem: Dominus scit cogitationes hominum, quoniam van sunt.

lxx: μακάριος ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὃν ἂν σὺ παιδεύσῃς, Κύριε. καὶ ἐκ τοῦ νόμου σου διδάξῃς αὐτόν,
vulg: beatus homo quem tu erudieris Domine et de lege tua docueris eum
clem: Beatus homo quem tu erudieris, Domine, et de lege tua docueris eum:

lxx: τοῦ πραῦναι αὐτῷ ἀφʼ ἡμερῶν πονηρῶν. ἕως οὗ ὀρυγῇ τῷ ἁμαρτωλῷ βόθρος.
vulg: ut mitiges ei a diebus malis donec fodiatur peccatori fovea
clem: ut mitiges ei a diebus malis, donec fodiatur peccatori fovea.

lxx: τι οὐκ ἀπώσεται Κύριος τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὴν κληρονομίαν αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐγκαταλείψει,
vulg: quia non repellet Dominus plebem suam et hereditatem suam non derelinquet
clem: Quia non repellet Dominus plebem suam, et hreditatem suam non derelinquet,

lxx: ἕως οὗ δικαιοσύνη ἐπιστρέψῃ εἰς κρίσιν, καὶ ἐχόμενοι αὐτῆς πάντες οἱ εὐθεῖς τῇ καρδίᾳ. διάψαλμα.
vulg: quoadusque iustitia convertatur in iudicium et qui iuxta illam omnes qui recto sunt corde diapsalma
clem: quoadusque justitia convertatur in judicium: et qui juxta illam, omnes qui recto sunt corde.

lxx: τίς ἀναστήσεταί μοι ἐπὶ πονηρευομένους, ἢ τίς συνπαραστήσεταί μοι ἐπὶ ἐργαζομένους τὴν ἀνομίαν
vulg: quis consurget mihi adversus malignantes aut quis stabit mecum adversus operantes iniquitatem
clem: Quis consurget mihi adversus malignantes? aut quis stabit mecum adversus operantes iniquitatem?

lxx: εἰ μὴ ὅτι Κύριος ἐβοήθησέν μοι, παρὰ βραχὺ παρῴκησεν τῷ ᾄδῃ ἡ ψυχὴ μου.
vulg: nisi quia Dominus adiuvit me paulo minus habitavit in inferno anima mea
clem: Nisi quia Dominus adjuvit me, paulominus habitasset in inferno anima mea.

lxx: τ ἔλεγον Σεσάλευται ὁ πούς μου, τὸ ἔλεός σου, Κύριε, βοηθεῖ μοι.
vulg: si dicebam motus est pes meus misericordia tua Domine adiuvabat me
clem: Si dicebam: Motus est pes meus: misericordia tua, Domine, adjuvabat me.

lxx: Κύριε, κατὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῶν ὀδυνῶν μου ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ μου, αἱ παρακλήσεις σου ἠγάπησαν τὴν ψυχὴν μου.
vulg: secundum multitudinem dolorum meorum in corde meo consolationes tuae laetificaverunt animam meam
clem: Secundum multitudinem dolorum meorum in corde meo, consolationes tu ltificaverunt animam meam.

lxx: μὴ συνπροσέσται σοι θρόνος ἀνομίας, ὁ πλάσσων κόπον ἐπὶ προστάγματι;
vulg: numquid aderit tibi sedis iniquitatis qui fingis dolorem in praecepto
clem: Numquid adhret tibi sedes iniquitatis, qui fingis laborem in prcepto?

lxx: θηρεύσουσιν ἐπὶ ψυχὴν δικαίου, καὶ αἷμα ἀθῷον καταδικάσονται.
vulg: captabunt in animam iusti et sanguinem innocentem condemnabunt
clem: Captabunt in animam justi, et sanguinem innocentem condemnabunt.

lxx: καὶ ἐγένετό μοι Κύριος εἰς καταφυγήν, καὶ ὁ θεός μου εἰς βοηθὸν ἐλπίδος μου·
vulg: et factus est Dominus mihi in refugium et Deus meus in adiutorem spei meae
clem: Et factus est mihi Dominus in refugium, et Deus meus in adjutorium spei me.

lxx: καὶ ἀποδώσει αὐτοῖς τὴν ἀνομίαν αὐτῶν καὶ τὴν πονηρίαν αὐτῶν· ἀφανιεῖ αὐτοὺς Κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν.
vulg: et reddet illis iniquitatem ipsorum et in malitia eorum disperdet eos disperdet illos Dominus Deus noster
clem: Et reddet illis iniquitatem ipsorum, et in malitia eorum disperdet eos: disperdet illos Dominus Deus noster.]

wlc: אֵל־נְקָמוֹת יְהוָה אֵל נְקָמוֹת הוֹפִיַע ׃
lxx: Δεῦτε ἀγαλλιασώμεθα τῷ κυρίῳ, ἀλαλάξωμεν τῷ θεῷ τῷ σωτῆρι ἡμῶν·
vulg: laus cantici David venite exultemus Domino iubilemus Deo salutari nostro
clem: Laus cantici ipsi David. [Venite, exsultemus Domino; jubilemus Deo salutari nostro;
kjv: O Lord God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.

wlc: הִנָּשֵׂא שֹׁפֵט הָאָרֶץ הָשֵׁב גְּמוּל עַל־גֵּאִים ׃
lxx: προφθάσωμεν τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἐν ἐξομολογήσει, καὶ ἐν ψαλμοῖς ἀλαλάξωμεν αὐτῷ.
vulg: praeoccupemus faciem eius in confessione et in psalmis iubilemus ei
clem: proccupemus faciem ejus in confessione, et in psalmis jubilemus ei:
kjv: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.

wlc: עַד־מָתַי רְשָׁעִים יְהוָה עַד־מָתַי רְשָׁעִים יַעֲלֹזוּ ׃
lxx: ὅτι θεὸς μέγας Κύριος καὶ βασιλεὺς μέγας ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς θεούς.
vulg: quoniam Deus magnus Dominus et rex magnus super omnes deos
clem: quoniam Deus magnus Dominus, et rex magnus super omnes deos.
kjv: Lord, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?

wlc: יַבִּיעוּ יְדַבְּרוּ עָתָק יִתְאַמְּרוּ כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן ׃
lxx: ὅτι οὐκ ἀπώσεται Κύριος τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ, ὅτι ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ τὰ πέρατα τῆς γῆς καὶ τὰ ὕψη τῶν ὀρέων αὐτοῦ ἐστιν·
vulg: quia in manu eius fines terrae et altitudines montium ipsius sunt
clem: Quia in manu ejus sunt omnes fines terr, et altitudines montium ipsius sunt;
kjv: How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?

wlc: עַמְּךָ יְהוָה יְדַכְּאוּ וְנַחֲלָתְךָ יְעַנּוּ ׃
lxx: ὅτι αὐτοῦ ἐστιν ἡ θάλασσα καὶ αὐτὸς ἐποίησεν αὐτήν, καὶ τὴν ξηρὰν αἱ χεῖρες αὐτοῦ ἔπλασαν.
vulg: quoniam ipsius est mare et ipse fecit illud et siccam manus eius formaverunt
clem: quoniam ipsius est mare, et ipse fecit illud, et siccam manus ejus formaverunt.
kjv: They break in pieces thy people, O Lord, and afflict thine heritage.

wlc: אַלְמָנָה וְגֵר יַהֲרֹגוּ וִיתוֹמִים יְרַצֵּחוּ ׃
lxx: δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν καὶ προσπέσωμεν αὐτῷ, καὶ κλαύσωμεν ἐναντίον Κυρίου τοῦ ποιήσαντος ἡμᾶς·
vulg: venite adoremus et procidamus et ploremus ante Dominum qui fecit nos
clem: Venite, adoremus, et procidamus, et ploremus ante Dominum qui fecit nos:
kjv: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.

wlc: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹא יִרְאֶה־יָּהּ וְלֹא־יָבִין אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב ׃
lxx: ὅτι αὐτός ἐστιν ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν, καὶ ἡμεῖς λαὸς νομῆς αὐτοῦ καὶ πρόβατα χειρὸς αὐτοῦ.
vulg: quia ipse est Deus noster et nos populus pascuae eius et oves manus eius
clem: quia ipse est Dominus Deus noster, et nos populus pascu ejus, et oves manus ejus.
kjv: Yet they say, The Lord shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob regard it.

wlc: בִּינוּ בֹּעֲרִים בָּעָם וּכְסִילִים מָתַי תַּשְׂכִּילוּ ׃
lxx: σήμερον ἐὰν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ ἀκούσητε, μὴ σκληρύνητε τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν, ὡς ἐν τῷ παραπικρασμῷ. κατὰ τὴν ἡμέραν τοῦ πειρασμοῦ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ·
vulg: hodie si vocem eius audieritis nolite obdurare corda vestra
clem: Hodie si vocem ejus audieritis, nolite obdurare corda vestra
kjv: Understand, ye brutish among the people: and ye fools, when will ye be wise?

wlc: הֲנֹטַע אֹזֶן הֲלֹא יִשְׁמָע אִם־יֹצֵר עַיִן הֲלֹא יַבִּיט ׃
lxx: οὗ ἐπείρασαν οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν, ἐδοκίμασαν καὶ ἴδοσαν τὰ ἔργα μου.
vulg: sicut in inritatione secundum diem temptationis in deserto ubi temptaverunt me patres vestri probaverunt me; et viderunt opera mea
clem: sicut in irritatione, secundum diem tentationis in deserto, ubi tentaverunt me patres vestri: probaverunt me, et viderunt opera mea.
kjv: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?

wlc: הֲיֹסֵר גּוֹיִם הֲלֹא יוֹכִיחַ הַמְלַמֵּד אָדָם דָּעַת ׃
lxx: τεσσεράκοντα ἔτη προσώχθισα τῇ γενεᾷ ἐκείνῃ, καὶ εἶπα Ἀεὶ πλανῶνται τῇ καρδία, καὶ αὐτοὶ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τὰς ὁδούς μου.
vulg: quadraginta annis offensus fui generationi illi et dixi semper errant corde
clem: Quadraginta annis offensus fui generationi illi, et dixi: Semper hi errant corde.
kjv: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge, shall not he know?

wlc: יְהוָה יֹדֵעַ מַחְשְׁבוֹת אָדָם כִּי־הֵמָּה הָבֶל ׃
lxx: ὡς ὤμοσα ἐν τῆ ὀργῇ μου Εἰ εἰσελεύσονται εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσίν μου.
vulg: et isti non cognoverunt vias meas ut iuravi in ira mea si intrabunt in requiem meam
clem: Et isti non cognoverunt vias meas: ut juravi in ira mea: Si introibunt in requiem meam.]
kjv: The Lord knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.

wlc: אַשְׁרֵי הַגֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר־תְּיַסְּרֶנּוּ יָּהּ וּמִתּוֹרָתְךָ תְלַמְּדֶנּוּ ׃
kjv: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O Lord, and teachest him out of thy law;

wlc: לְהַשְׁקִיט לוֹ מִימֵי רָע עַד יִכָּרֶה לָרָשָׁע שָׁחַת ׃
kjv: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.

wlc: כִּי לֹא־יִטֹּשׁ יְהוָה עַמּוֹ וְנַחֲלָתוֹ לֹא יַעֲזֹב ׃
kjv: For the Lord will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

wlc: כִּי־עַד־צֶדֶק יָשׁוּב מִשְׁפָּט וְאַחֲרָיו כָּל־יִשְׁרֵי־לֵב ׃
kjv: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.

wlc: מִי־יָקוּם לִי עִם־מְרֵעִים מִי־יִתְיַצֵּב לִי עִם־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן ׃
kjv: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

wlc: לוּלֵי יְהוָה עֶזְרָתָה לִּי כִּמְעַט שָׁכְנָה דוּמָה נַפְשִׁי ׃
kjv: Unless the Lord had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.

wlc: אִם־אָמַרְתִּי מָטָה רַגְלִי חַסְדְּךָ יְהוָה יִסְעָדֵנִי ׃
kjv: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O Lord, held me up.

wlc: בְּרֹב שַׂרְעַפַּי בְּקִרְבִּי תַּנְחוּמֶיךָ יְשַׁעַשְׁעוּ נַפְשִׁי ׃
kjv: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.

wlc: הַיְחָבְרְךָ כִּסֵּא הַוּוֹת יֹצֵר עָמָל עֲלֵי־חֹק ׃
kjv: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?

wlc: יָגוֹדּוּ עַל־נֶפֶשׁ צַדִּיק וְדָם נָקִי יַרְשִׁיעוּ ׃
kjv: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

wlc: וַיְהִי יְהוָה לִי לְמִשְׂגָּב וֵאלֹהַי לְצוּר מַחְסִי ׃
kjv: But the Lord is my defence; and my God is the rock of my refuge.

wlc: וַיָּשֶׁב עֲלֵיהֶם אֶת־אוֹנָם וּבְרָעָתָם יַצְמִיתֵם יַצְמִיתֵם יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ ׃
lxx: Αἶγος ᾠδῆς τῷ Δαυείδ.
kjv: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; yea, the Lord our God shall cut them off.

wlc: לְכוּ נְרַנְּנָה לַיהוָה נָרִיעָה לְצוּר יִשְׁעֵנוּ ׃
lxx: Ἄσατε τῷ κυρίῳ ἆσμα καινόν, ἄσατε τῷ κυρίῳ, πᾶσα ἡ γῆ·
vulg: quando domus aedificabatur post captivitatem canticum huic David cantate Domino canticum novum cantate Domino omnis terra
clem: Canticum ipsi David, quando domus dificabatur post captivitatem. [Cantate Domino canticum novum; cantate Domino omnis terra.
kjv: O come, let us sing unto the Lord: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.

wlc: נְקַדְּמָה פָנָיו בְּתוֹדָה בִּזְמִרוֹת נָרִיעַ לוֹ ׃
lxx: ἄσατε τῷ κυρίῳ, εὐλογήσατε τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ, εὐαγγελίζεσθε ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας τὸ σωτήριον αὐτοῦ.
vulg: cantate Domino benedicite nomini eius adnuntiate diem de die salutare eius
clem: Cantate Domino, et benedicite nomini ejus; annuntiate de die in diem salutare ejus.
kjv: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.

wlc: כִּי אֵל גָּדוֹל יְהוָה וּמֶלֶךְ גָּדוֹל עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִים ׃
lxx: ἀναγγείλατε ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ. ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς λαοῖς τὰ θαυμάσια αὐτοῦ.
vulg: adnuntiate inter gentes gloriam eius in omnibus populis mirabilia eius
clem: Annuntiate inter gentes gloriam ejus; in omnibus populis mirabilia ejus.
kjv: For the Lord is a great God, and a great King above all gods.

wlc: אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדוֹ מֶחְקְרֵי־אָרֶץ וְתוֹעֲפוֹת הָרִים לוֹ ׃
lxx: ὅτι μέγας Κύριος καὶ αἰνετὸς σφόδρα, φοβερός ἐστιν ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς θεοὺς·
vulg: quoniam magnus Dominus et laudabilis valde terribilis est super omnes deos
clem: Quoniam magnus Dominus, et laudabilis nimis: terribilis est super omnes deos.
kjv: In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills is his also.

wlc: אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ הַיָּם וְהוּא עָשָׂהוּ וְיַבֶּשֶׁת יָדָיו יָצָרוּ ׃
lxx: ὅτι πάντες οἱ θεοὶ τῶν ἐθνῶν δαιμόνια, ὁ δὲ κύριος τοὺς οὐρανοὺς ἐποίησεν.
vulg: quoniam omnes dii gentium daemonia at vero Dominus caelos fecit
clem: Quoniam omnes dii gentium dmonia; Dominus autem clos fecit.
kjv: The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.

wlc: בֹּאוּ נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה וְנִכְרָעָה נִבְרְכָה לִפְנֵי־יְהוָה עֹשֵׂנוּ ׃
lxx: ἐξομολόγησις καὶ ὡραιότης ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ, ἁγιωσύνη καὶ μεγαλοπρέπεια ἐν τῷ ἁγιάσματι αὐτοῦ.
vulg: confessio et pulchritudo in conspectu eius sanctimonia et magnificentia in sanctificatione eius
clem: Confessio et pulchritudo in conspectu ejus; sanctimonia et magnificentia in sanctificatione ejus.
kjv: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the Lord our maker.

wlc: כִּי הוּא אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַאֲנַחְנוּ עַם מַרְעִיתוֹ וְצֹאן יָדוֹ הַיּוֹם אִם־בְּקֹלוֹ תִשְׁמָעוּ ׃
lxx: ἐνέγκατε τῷ κυρίῳ, αἱ πατριαὶ τῶν ἐθνῶν, ἐνέγκατε τῷ κυρίῳ δόξαν καὶ τιμήν·
vulg: adferte Domino patriae gentium adferte Domino gloriam et honorem
clem: Afferte Domino, patri gentium, afferte Domino gloriam et honorem;
kjv: For he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,

wlc: אַל־תַּקְשׁוּ לְבַבְכֶם כִּמְרִיבָה כְּיוֹם מַסָּה בַּמִּדְבָּר ׃
lxx: ἐνέγκατε τῷ κυρίῳ δόξαν ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ, ἄρατε θυσίας καὶ εἰσπορεύεσθε εἰς τὰς αὐλὰς αὐτοῦ.
vulg: adferte Domino gloriam nomini eius tollite hostias et introite in atria eius
clem: afferte Domino gloriam nomini ejus. Tollite hostias, et introite in atria ejus;
kjv: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:

wlc: אֲשֶׁר נִסּוּנִי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם בְּחָנוּנִי גַּם־רָאוּ פָעֳלִי ׃
lxx: προσκυνήσατε τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν αὐλῇ ἁγίᾳ αὐτοῦ· σαλευθήτω ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ πᾶσα ἡ γῆ.
vulg: adorate Dominum in atrio sancto eius commoveatur a facie eius universa terra
clem: adorate Dominum in atrio sancto ejus. Commoveatur a facie ejus universa terra;
kjv: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.

wlc: אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה אָקוּט בְּדוֹר וָאֹמַר עַם תֹּעֵי לֵבָב הֵם וְהֵם לֹא־יָדְעוּ דְרָכָי ׃
lxx: εἴπατε ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν Ὁ κύριος ἐβασίλευσεν, καὶ γὰρ κατώρθωσεν τὴν οἰκουμένην, ἥτις οὐ σαλευθήσεται· κρινεῖ λαοὺς ἐν εὐθύτητι.
vulg: dicite in gentibus quia Dominus regnavit etenim correxit orbem qui non movebitur iudicabit populos in aequitate
clem: dicite in gentibus, quia Dominus regnavit. Etenim correxit orbem terr, qui non commovebitur; judicabit populos in quitate.
kjv: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation, and said, It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:

wlc: אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי בְאַפִּי אִם־יְבֹאוּן אֶל־מְנוּחָתִי ׃
lxx: Ὄτε ὁ οἶκὸς οἰκοδομεῖται μετὰ τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν· ᾠδὴ τῷ Δαυείδ. εὐφραινέσθωσαν οἱ οὐρανοὶ καὶ ἀγαλλιάσθω ἡ γῆ, σαλευθήτω ἡ θάλασσα καὶ τὸ πλήραωμα αὐτῆς·
vulg: laetentur caeli et exultet terra commoveatur mare et plenitudo eius
clem: Ltentur cli, et exsultet terra; commoveatur mare et plenitudo ejus;
kjv: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest.

lxx: χαρήσεται τὰ πεδία καὶ πάντα τὰ ἐν αὐτοῖς, τότε ἀγαλλιάσονται πάντα τὰ ξύλα τοῦ δρυμοῦ
vulg: gaudebunt campi et omnia quae in eis sunt tunc exultabunt omnia ligna silvarum
clem: gaudebunt campi, et omnia qu in eis sunt. Tunc exsultabunt omnia ligna silvarum

lxx: πρὸ προσώπου Κυρίου, ὅτι ἔρχεται, ὅτι ἔρχεται κρῖναι τὴν γῆν· κρινεῖ τὴν οἰκουμένην ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ λαοὺς ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ αὐτοῦ.
vulg: a facie Domini quia venit quoniam venit iudicare terram iudicabit orbem terrae in aequitate et populos in veritate sua
clem: a facie Domini, quia venit, quoniam venit judicare terram. Judicabit orbem terr in quitate, et populos in veritate sua.]

wlc: שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה שִׁיר חָדָשׁ שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה כָּל־הָאָרֶץ ׃
lxx: Ὁ κύριος ἐβασίλευσεν, ἀγαλλιάσεται ἡ γῆ. εὐφρανθήτωσαν νῆσοι πολλαί.
vulg: huic David quando terra eius restituta est Dominus regnavit exultet terra laetentur insulae multae
clem: Huic David, quando terra ejus restituta est. [Dominus regnavit: exsultet terra; ltentur insul mult.
kjv: O sing unto the Lord a new song: sing unto the Lord, all the earth.

wlc: שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה בָּרֲכוּ שְׁמוֹ בַּשְּׂרוּ מִיּוֹם־לְיוֹם יְשׁוּעָתוֹ ׃
lxx: νεφέλη καὶ γνόφος κύκλῳ αὐτοῦ, δικαιοσύνη καὶ κρίμα κατόρθωσις τοῦ θρόνυυ αὐτοῦ.
vulg: nubes et caligo in circuitu eius iustitia et iudicium correctio sedis eius
clem: Nubes et caligo in circuitu ejus; justitia et judicium correctio sedis ejus.
kjv: Sing unto the Lord, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.

wlc: סַפְּרוּ בַגּוֹיִם כְּבוֹדוֹ בְּכָל־הָעַמִּים נִפְלְאוֹתָיו ׃
lxx: πῦρ ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ προπορεύσεται, καὶ φλογιεῖ κύκλῳ τοὺς ἐχθροὺς αὐτοῦ·
vulg: ignis ante ipsum praecedet et inflammabit in circuitu inimicos eius
clem: Ignis ante ipsum prcedet, et inflammabit in circuitu inimicos ejus.
kjv: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.

wlc: כִּי גָדוֹל יְהוָה וּמְהֻלָּל מְאֹד נוֹרָא הוּא עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִים ׃
lxx: ἔφαναν αἱ ἀστραπαὶ αὐτοῦ τῇ οἰκουμένῃ, εἶδεν καὶ ἐσαλεύθη ἡ γῆ.
vulg: adluxerunt fulgora eius orbi terrae vidit et commota est terra
clem: Illuxerunt fulgura ejus orbi terr; vidit, et commota est terra.
kjv: For the Lord is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.

wlc: כִּי כָּל־אֱלֹהֵי הָעַמִּים אֱלִילִים וַיהוָה שָׁמַיִם עָשָׂה ׃
lxx: τὰ ὄρη ἐτάκησαν ὡσεὶ κηρὸς ἀπὸ προσώπου Κυρίου. ἀπὸ προσώπου Κυρίου πάσης τῆς γῆς.
vulg: montes sicut cera fluxerunt a facie Domini; a facie Domini omnis terrae
clem: Montes sicut cera fluxerunt a facie Domini; a facie Domini omnis terra.
kjv: For all the gods of the nations are idols: but the Lord made the heavens.

wlc: הוֹד־וְהָדָר לְפָנָיו עֹז וְתִפְאֶרֶת בְּמִקְדָּשׁוֹ ׃
lxx: ἀνήγγειλαν οἱ οὐρανοὶ τὴν δικαιοσύνην αὐτοῦ, καὶ εἴδοσαν πάντες οἱ λαοὶ τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ.
vulg: adnuntiaverunt caeli iustitiam eius et viderunt omnes populi gloriam eius
clem: Annuntiaverunt cli justitiam ejus, et viderunt omnes populi gloriam ejus.
kjv: Honour and majesty are before him: strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

wlc: הָבוּ לַיהוָה מִשְׁפְּחוֹת עַמִּים הָבוּ לַיהוָה כָּבוֹד וָעֹז ׃
lxx: αἰσχυνθήτωσαν πάντες οἱ προσκυνοῦντες τοῖς γλυπτοῖς, οἱ ἐγκαυχώμενοι ἐν τοῖς εἰδώλοις αὐτῶν· προσκυνήσατε αὐτῷ πάντες οἱ ἄγγελοι αὐτοῦ.
vulg: confundantur omnes qui adorant sculptilia qui gloriantur in simulacris suis adorate eum omnes angeli eius
clem: Confundantur omnes qui adorant sculptilia, et qui gloriantur in simulacris suis. Adorate eum omnes angeli ejus.
kjv: Give unto the Lord, O ye kindreds of the people, give unto the Lord glory and strength.

wlc: הָבוּ לַיהוָה כְּבוֹד שְׁמוֹ שְׂאוּ־מִנְחָה וּבֹאוּ לְחַצְרוֹתָיו ׃
lxx: ἤκουσεν καὶ εὐφράνθη Σειών, καὶ ἠγαλλιάσαντο αἱ θυγατέρες τῆς Ἰουδαίας, ἕνεκεν τῶν κριμάτων σου, Κύριε·
vulg: audivit et laetata est Sion et exultaverunt filiae Iudaeae propter iudicia tua Domine
clem: Audivit, et ltata est Sion, et exsultaverunt fili Jud propter judicia tua, Domine.
kjv: Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.

wlc: הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַיהוָה בְּהַדְרַת־קֹדֶשׁ חִילוּ מִפָּנָיו כָּל־הָאָרֶץ ׃
lxx: ὅτι σὺ εἶ Κύριος ὁ ὕψιστος ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν. σφόδρα ὑπερυψώθης ὑπέρ πάντας τοὺς θεούς.
vulg: quoniam tu Dominus Altissimus super omnem terram nimis superexaltatus es super omnes deos
clem: Quoniam tu Dominus altissimus super omnem terram; nimis exaltatus es super omnes deos.
kjv: O worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.

wlc: אִמְרוּ בַגּוֹיִם יְהוָה מָלָךְ אַף־תִּכּוֹן תֵּבֵל בַּל־תִּמּוֹט יָדִין עַמִּים בְּמֵישָׁרִים ׃
lxx: οἱ ἀγαπῶντες τὸν κύριον, μισεῖτε πονηρόν· φυλάσσει Κύριος τὰς ψυχὰς τῶν ὁσίων αὐτοῦ, ἐκ χειρὸς ἁμαρτωλῶν ῥύσεται αὐτούς.
vulg: qui diligitis Dominum odite malum custodit animas sanctorum suorum de manu peccatoris liberabit eos
clem: Qui diligitis Dominum, odite malum: custodit Dominus animas sanctorum suorum; de manu peccatoris liberabit eos.
kjv: Say among the heathen that the Lord reigneth: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.

wlc: יִשְׂמְחוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם וְתָגֵל הָאָרֶץ יִרְעַם הַיָּם וּמְלֹאוֹ ׃
lxx: φῶς ἀνέτειλεν τῷ δικαίῳ, καὶ τοῖς εὐθέσι τῇ καρδίᾳ εὐφροσύνη.
vulg: lux orta est iusto et rectis corde laetitia
clem: Lux orta est justo, et rectis corde ltitia.
kjv: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.

wlc: יַעֲלֹז שָׂדַי וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־בּוֹ אָז יְרַנְּנוּ כָּל־עֲצֵי־יָעַר ׃
lxx: εὐφράνθητε, δίκαιοι, ἐπὶ τῷ κυρίῳ, καὶ ἐξομολογεῖσθε τῇ μνήμῃ τῆς ἁγιωσύνης αὐτοῦ.
vulg: laetamini iusti in Domino et confitemini memoriae sanctificationis eius
clem: Ltamini, justi, in Domino, et confitemini memori sanctificationis ejus.]
kjv: Let the field be joyful, and all that is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice

wlc: לִפְנֵי יְהוָה כִּי בָא כִּי בָא לִשְׁפֹּט הָאָרֶץ יִשְׁפֹּט־תֵּבֵל בְּצֶדֶק וְעַמִּים בֶּאֱמוּנָתוֹ ׃
lxx: Τῷ Δαυείδ, ὅτε ἡ γῆ αὐτοῦ καθίσταται.
kjv: Before the Lord: for he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.

wlc: יְהוָה מָלָךְ תָּגֵל הָאָרֶץ יִשְׂמְחוּ אִיִּים רַבִּים ׃
lxx: Ἄσατε τῷ κυρίῳ ᾆσμα καινόν, ὅτι θαυμαστὰ ἐποίησεν Κύριος· ἔσωσεν αὐτῷ ἡ δεξιὰ αὐτοῦ καὶ ὁ βραχίων ὁ ἅγιος αὐτοῦ.
vulg: psalmus David cantate Domino canticum novum quoniam mirabilia fecit salvavit sibi dextera eius et brachium sanctum eius
clem: Psalmus ipsi David. [Cantate Domino canticum novum, quia mirabilia fecit. Salvavit sibi dextera ejus, et brachium sanctum ejus.
kjv: The Lord reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof.

wlc: עָנָן וַעֲרָפֶל סְבִיבָיו צֶדֶק וּמִשְׁפָּט מְכוֹן כִּסְאוֹ ׃
lxx: ἐγνώρισεν Κύριος τὸ σωτήριον αὐτοῦ ἐναντίον τῶν ἐθνῶν· ἀπεκάλυψεν τὴν δικαιοσύνην αὐτοῦ.
vulg: notum fecit Dominus salutare suum in conspectu gentium revelavit iustitiam suam
clem: Notum fecit Dominus salutare suum; in conspectu gentium revelavit justitiam suam.
kjv: Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.

wlc: אֵשׁ לְפָנָיו תֵּלֵךְ וּתְלַהֵט סָבִיב צָרָיו ׃
lxx: ἐμνήσθη τοῦ ἐλέους αὐτοῦ τῷ Ἰακώβ, καὶ τῆς ἀληθείας αὐτοῦ τῷ οἴκῳ Ἰσραήλ· εἴδοσαν πάντα τὰ πέρατα τῆς γῆς τὸ σωτήριον τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν.
vulg: recordatus est misericordiae suae et veritatem suam domui Israhel viderunt omnes termini terrae salutare Dei nostri
clem: Recordatus est misericordi su, et veritatis su domui Isral. Viderunt omnes termini terr salutare Dei nostri.
kjv: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.

wlc: הֵאִירוּ בְרָקָיו תֵּבֵל רָאֲתָה וַתָּחֵל הָאָרֶץ ׃
lxx: ἀλαλάξατε τῷ θεῷ πᾶσα ἡ γῆ, ἄσατε καὶ ἀγαλλιᾶσθε καὶ ψάλατε.
vulg: iubilate Domino omnis terra cantate et exultate et psallite
clem: Jubilate Deo, omnis terra; cantate, et exsultate, et psallite.
kjv: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.

wlc: הָרִים כַּדּוֹנַג נָמַסּוּ מִלִּפְנֵי יְהוָה מִלִּפְנֵי אֲדוֹן כָּל־הָאָרֶץ ׃
lxx: ψάλατε τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν κιθάρᾳ, ἐν κιθάρᾳ καὶ φωνῇ ψαλμοῦ,
vulg: psallite Domino in cithara in cithara et voce psalmi
clem: Psallite Domino in cithara; in cithara et voce psalmi;
kjv: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

wlc: הִגִּידוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם צִדְקוֹ וְרָאוּ כָל־הָעַמִּים כְּבוֹדוֹ ׃
lxx: ἐν σάλπιγξιν ἐλαταῖς καὶ φωνῇ σάλπιγγος κερατίνης· ἀλαλάξατε ἐνώπιον τοῦ βασιλέως Κυρίῳ.
vulg: in tubis ductilibus et voce tubae corneae iubilate in conspectu regis Domini
clem: in tubis ductilibus, et voce tub corne. Jubilate in conspectu regis Domini:
kjv: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.

wlc: יֵבֹשׁוּ כָּל־עֹבְדֵי פֶסֶל הַמִּתְהַלְלִים בָּאֱלִילִים הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ־לוֹ כָּל־אֱלֹהִים ׃
lxx: σαλευθήτω ἡ θάλασσα καὶ τὸ πλήρωμα αὐτῆς, ἡ οἰκουμένη καὶ οἱ κατοικοῦντες αὐτὴν·
vulg: moveatur mare et plenitudo eius orbis terrarum et qui habitant in eo
clem: moveatur mare, et plenitudo ejus; orbis terrarum, et qui habitant in eo.
kjv: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all ye gods.

wlc: שָׁמְעָה וַתִּשְׂמַח צִיּוֹן וַתָּגֵלְנָה בְּנוֹת יְהוּדָה לְמַעַן מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ יְהוָה ׃
lxx: ποταμοὶ κροτήσουσιν χειρὶ ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό, τὰ ὄρη ἀγαλλιάσονται,
vulg: flumina plaudent manu simul montes exultabunt
clem: Flumina plaudent manu; simul montes exsultabunt
kjv: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O Lord.

wlc: כִּי־אַתָּה יְהוָה עֶלְיוֹן עַל־כָּל־הָאָרֶץ מְאֹד נַעֲלֵיתָ עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִים ׃
lxx: ὅτι ἥκει κρῖναι τὴν γῆν· κρινεῖ τὴν οἰκουμένην ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ λαοὺς ἐν εὐθύτητι.
vulg: a conspectu Domini quoniam venit iudicare terram iudicabit orbem terrarum in iustitia et populos in aequitate
clem: a conspectu Domini: quoniam venit judicare terram. Judicabit orbem terrarum in justitia, et populos in quitate.]
kjv: For thou, Lord, art high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.

wlc: אֹהֲבֵי יְהוָה שִׂנְאוּ רָע שֹׁמֵר נַפְשׁוֹת חֲסִידָיו מִיַּד רְשָׁעִים יַצִּילֵם ׃
kjv: Ye that love the Lord, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.

wlc: אוֹר זָרֻעַ לַצַּדִּיק וּלְיִשְׁרֵי־לֵב שִׂמְחָה ׃
kjv: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

wlc: שִׂמְחוּ צַדִּיקִים בַּיהוָה וְהוֹדוּ לְזֵכֶר קָדְשׁוֹ ׃
lxx: Ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυείδ.
kjv: Rejoice in the Lord, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

wlc: מִזְמוֹר שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה שִׁיר חָדָשׁ כִּי־נִפְלָאוֹת עָשָׂה הוֹשִׁיעָה־לּוֹ יְמִינוֹ וּזְרוֹעַ קָדְשׁוֹ ׃
lxx: Κύριος ἐβασίλευσεν, ὀργιζέσθωσαν λαοί· ὁ καθήμενος ἐπὶ τῶν χερουβείμ, σαλευθήτω ἡ γῆ.
vulg: psalmus David Dominus regnavit irascantur populi qui sedet super cherubin moveatur terra
clem: Psalmus ipsi David. [Dominus regnavit: irascantur populi; qui sedet super cherubim: moveatur terra.
kjv: O sing unto the Lord a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.

wlc: הוֹדִיעַ יְהוָה יְשׁוּעָתוֹ לְעֵינֵי הַגּוֹיִם גִּלָּה צִדְקָתוֹ ׃
lxx: Κύριος ἐν Σειὼν μέγας, καὶ ὑψηλός ἐστιν ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς λαούς.
vulg: Dominus in Sion magnus et excelsus est super omnes populos
clem: Dominus in Sion magnus, et excelsus super omnes populos.
kjv: The Lord hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.

wlc: זָכַר חַסְדּוֹ וֶאֱמוּנָתוֹ לְבֵית יִשְׂרָאֵל רָאוּ כָל־אַפְסֵי־אָרֶץ אֵת יְשׁוּעַת אֱלֹהֵינוּ ׃
lxx: ἐξομολογησάσθωσαν πάντες τῷ ὀνόματί σου τῷ μεγάλῳ, ὅτι φοβερὸν καὶ ἄγιόν ἐστιν.
vulg: confiteantur nomini tuo magno quoniam terribile et sanctum est
clem: Confiteantur nomini tuo magno, quoniam terribile et sanctum est,
kjv: He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

wlc: הָרִיעוּ לַיהוָה כָּל־הָאָרֶץ פִּצְחוּ וְרַנְּנוּ וְזַמֵּרוּ ׃
lxx: καὶ τιμὴ βασλέως κρίσιν ἀγαπᾷ· σὺ ἡτοίμασας εὐθύτητας, κρίσιν καὶ δικαιοσύνην ἐν Ἰακὼβ σὺ ἐποίησας.
vulg: et honor regis iudicium diligit tu parasti directiones iudicium et iustitiam in Iacob tu fecisti
clem: et honor regis judicium diligit. Tu parasti directiones; judicium et justitiam in Jacob tu fecisti.
kjv: Make a joyful noise unto the Lord, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.

wlc: זַמְּרוּ לַיהוָה בְּכִנּוֹר בְּכִנּוֹר וְקוֹל זִמְרָה ׃
lxx: ὑψοῦτε Κύριον τὸν θεὸν ἡμῶν, καὶ προσκυνεῖτε τῷ ὑποποδίῳ τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ.
vulg: exaltate Dominum Deum nostrum et adorate scabillum pedum eius quoniam sanctum est
clem: Exaltate Dominum Deum nostrum, et adorate scabellum pedum ejus, quoniam sanctum est.
kjv: Sing unto the Lord with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.

wlc: בַּחֲצֹצְרוֹת וְקוֹל שׁוֹפָר הָרִיעוּ לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ יְהוָה ׃
lxx: ἄγιός ἐστιν (6)Μωυσῆς καὶ Ἀαρὼν ἐν τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν αὐτοῦ καὶ Σαμουὴλ ἐν τοῖς ἐπικαλουμένοις τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ· ἐπεκαλοῦντο τὸν κύριον, καὶ αὐτὸς ἐπήκουσεν αὐτοῖς,
vulg: Moses et Aaron in sacerdotibus eius et Samuhel inter eos qui invocant nomen eius invocabant Dominum et ipse exaudiebat illos
clem: Moyses et Aaron in sacerdotibus ejus, et Samuel inter eos qui invocant nomen ejus: invocabant Dominum, et ipse exaudiebat eos;
kjv: With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the Lord, the King.

wlc: יִרְעַם הַיָּם וּמְלֹאוֹ תֵּבֵל וְיֹשְׁבֵי בָהּ ׃
lxx: ἐν στύλῳ νεφέλης ἐλάλει πρὸς αὐτούς· ἐφύλασσον τὰ μαρτύρια αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὰ προστάγματα ἃ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς.
vulg: in columna nubis loquebatur ad eos custodiebant testimonia eius et praeceptum quod dedit illis
clem: in columna nubis loquebatur ad eos. Custodiebant testimonia ejus, et prceptum quod dedit illis.
kjv: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.

wlc: נְהָרוֹת יִמְחֲאוּ־כָף יַחַד הָרִים יְרַנֵּנוּ ׃
lxx: Κύριε ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν, σὺ ἐπήκουες αὐτῶν· ὁ θεός, εὐίλατος ἐγίνου αὐτοῖς, καὶ ἐκδικῶν ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ ἐπιτηδεύματα αὐτῶν.
vulg: Domine Deus noster tu exaudiebas illos Deus tu propitius fuisti eis et ulciscens in omnes adinventiones eorum
clem: Domine Deus noster, tu exaudiebas eos; Deus, tu propitius fuisti eis, et ulciscens in omnes adinventiones eorum.
kjv: Let the floods clap their hands: let the hills be joyful together

wlc: לִפְנֵי־יְהוָה כִּי בָא לִשְׁפֹּט הָאָרֶץ יִשְׁפֹּט־תֵּבֵל בְּצֶדֶק וְעַמִּים בְּמֵישָׁרִים ׃
lxx: Ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυείδ. ὑψοῦτε Κύριον τὸν θεὸν ἡμῶν, καὶ προσκυνεῖτε εἰς ὄρος ἅγιον αὐτοῦ, ὅτι ἅγιος Κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν.
vulg: exaltate Dominum Deum nostrum et adorate in monte sancto eius quoniam sanctus Dominus Deus noster
clem: Exaltate Dominum Deum nostrum, et adorate in monte sancto ejus, quoniam sanctus Dominus Deus noster.]
kjv: Before the Lord; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.

wlc: יְהוָה מָלָךְ יִרְגְּזוּ עַמִּים יֹשֵׁב כְּרוּבִים תָּנוּט הָאָרֶץ ׃
lxx: Ἀλαλάξατε τῷ κυρίῳ, πᾶσα ἡ γῆ,
vulg: psalmus in confessione
clem: Psalmus in confessione.
kjv: The Lord reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.

wlc: יְהוָה בְּצִיּוֹן גָּדוֹל וְרָם הוּא עַל־כָּל־הָעַמִּים ׃
lxx: δουλεύσατε τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν εὐφροσύνῃ, εἰσέλθατε ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ ἐν ἀγαλλιάσει.
vulg: iubilate Domino omnis terra servite Domino in laetitia introite in conspectu eius in exultatione
clem: [Jubilate Deo, omnis terra; servite Domino in ltitia. Introite in conspectu ejus in exsultatione.
kjv: The Lord is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.

wlc: יוֹדוּ שִׁמְךָ גָּדוֹל וְנוֹרָא קָדוֹשׁ הוּא ׃
lxx: γνῶτε ὅτι Κύριος, αὐτός ἐστιν ὁ θεός· αὐτὸς ἐποίησεν ἡμᾶς καὶ οὐχ ἡμεῖς, λαὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ πρόβατα τῆς νομῆς αὐτοῦ.
vulg: scitote quoniam Dominus ipse est Deus ipse fecit nos et non ipsi nos populus eius et oves pascuae eius
clem: Scitote quoniam Dominus ipse est Deus; ipse fecit nos, et non ipsi nos: populus ejus, et oves pascu ejus.
kjv: Let them praise thy great and terrible name; for it is holy.

wlc: וְעֹז מֶלֶךְ מִשְׁפָּט אָהֵב אַתָּה כּוֹנַנְתָּ מֵישָׁרִים מִשְׁפָּט וּצְדָקָה בְּיַעֲקֹב אַתָּה עָשִׂיתָ ׃
lxx: εἰσέλθατε εἰς τὰς πύλας αὐτοῦ ἐν ἐξομολογήσει, τὰς αὐλὰς αὐτοῦ ἐν ὕμνοις· ἐξομολογεῖσθε αὐτῷ, αἰνεῖτε τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ,
vulg: introite portas eius in confessione atria eius in hymnis confitemini illi laudate nomen eius
clem: Introite portas ejus in confessione; atria ejus in hymnis: confitemini illi. Laudate nomen ejus,
kjv: The king's strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.

wlc: רוֹמְמוּ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַהֲדֹם רַגְלָיו קָדוֹשׁ הוּא ׃
lxx: ὅτι χρηστὸς Κύριος, εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἕως γενεᾶς καὶ γενεᾶς ἡ ἀλήθεια αὐτοῦ.
vulg: quoniam suavis Dominus in aeternum misericordia eius et usque in generationem et generationem veritas eius
clem: quoniam suavis est Dominus, in ternum misericordia ejus, et usque in generationem et generationem veritas ejus.]
kjv: Exalt ye the Lord our God, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.

wlc: מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן בְּכֹהֲנָיו וּשְׁמוּאֵל בְּקֹרְאֵי שְׁמוֹ קֹרִאים אֶל־יְהוָה וְהוּא יַעֲנֵם ׃
kjv: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon the Lord, and he answered them.

wlc: בְּעַמּוּד עָנָן יְדַבֵּר אֲלֵיהֶם שָׁמְרוּ עֵדֹתָיו וְחֹק נָתַן־לָמוֹ ׃
kjv: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.

wlc: יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ אַתָּה עֲנִיתָם אֵל נֹשֵׂא הָיִיתָ לָהֶם וְנֹקֵם עַל־עֲלִילוֹתָם ׃
kjv: Thou answeredst them, O Lord our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.

wlc: רוֹמְמוּ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְהַר קָדְשׁוֹ כִּי־קָדוֹשׁ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ ׃
lxx: Ψαλμὸς εἰς ἐξομολόγησιν.
kjv: Exalt the Lord our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the Lord our God is holy.

wlc: מִזְמוֹר לְתוֹדָה הָרִיעוּ לַיהוָה כָּל־הָאָרֶץ ׃
lxx: Ἔλεος καὶ κρίσιν ἄσομαί σοι, Κύριε·
vulg: David psalmus misericordiam et iudicium cantabo tibi Domine psallam
clem: Psalmus ipsi David. [Misericordiam et judicium cantabo tibi, Domine; psallam,
kjv: Make a joyful noise unto the Lord, all ye lands.

wlc: עִבְדוּ אֶת־יְהוָה בְּשִׂמְחָה בֹּאוּ לְפָנָיו בִּרְנָנָה ׃
lxx: ψαλῶ καὶ συνήσω ἐν ᾠδῇ ἀμώμῳ· πότε ἥξεις πρὸς μέ; διεπορευόμην ἐν ἀκακίᾳ καρδίας μου, ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ οἴκου μου.
vulg: et intellegam in via inmaculata quando venies ad me perambulabam in innocentia cordis mei in medio domus meae
clem: et intelligam in via immaculata: quando venies ad me? Perambulabam in innocentia cordis mei, in medio domus me.
kjv: Serve the Lord with gladness: come before his presence with singing.

wlc: דְּעוּ כִּי־יְהוָה הוּא אֱלֹהִים הוּא־עָשָׂנוּ וְלֹא אֲנַחְנוּ עַמּוֹ וְצֹאן מַרְעִיתוֹ ׃
lxx: οὐ προεθέμην πρὸ ὀφθαλμῶν μου πρᾶγμα παράνομον, ποιοῦντας παραβάσεις ἐμίσησα· οὐκ ἐκολλήθη μοι καρδία σκαμβή,
vulg: non proponebam ante oculos meos rem iniustam facientes praevaricationes odivi non adhesit mihi
clem: Non proponebam ante oculos meos rem injustam; facientes prvaricationes odivi; non adhsit mihi
kjv: Know ye that the Lord he is God: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

wlc: בֹּאוּ שְׁעָרָיו בְּתוֹדָה חֲצֵרֹתָיו בִּתְהִלָּה הוֹדוּ־לוֹ בָּרֲכוּ שְׁמוֹ ׃
lxx: ἐκκλίνοντος ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ τοῦ πονηροῦ οὐκ ἐγίνωσκον.
vulg: cor pravum declinante a me maligno non cognoscebam
clem: cor pravum; declinantem a me malignum non cognoscebam.
kjv: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.

wlc: כִּי־טוֹב יְהֹוָה לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ וְעַד־דֹּר וָדֹר אֱמוּנָתוֹ ׃
lxx: Τῷ Δαυεὶδ ψαλμός. τὸν καταλαλοῦντα λάθρα τοῦ πλησίον αὐτοῦ, τοῦτον ἐξεδίωκον· ὑπερηφάνῳ ὀφθαλμῷ καὶ ἀπλήστῳ καρδίᾳ, τούτῳ οὐ συνήσθιον.
vulg: detrahentem secreto proximo suo hunc persequebar superbo oculo et insatiabili corde cum hoc non edebam
clem: Detrahentem secreto proximo suo, hunc persequebar: superbo oculo, et insatiabili corde, cum hoc non edebam.
kjv: For the Lord is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.

lxx: οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου ἐπὶ τοὺς πιστοὺς τῆς γῆς. τοῦ συνκαθῆσθαι αὐτοὺς μετʼ ἐμοῦ· πορευόμενος ἐν ὁδῷ ἀμώμῳ, οὗτός μοι ἐλειτούργει.
vulg: oculi mei ad fideles terrae ut sederent mecum ambulans in via inmaculata hic mihi ministrabat
clem: Oculi mei ad fideles terr, ut sedeant mecum; ambulans in via immaculata, hic mihi ministrabat.

lxx: οὐ κατῴκει ἐν μέσῳ τῆς οἰκίας μου ποιῶν ὑπερηφανίαν· λαλῶν ἄδικα οὐ κατεύθυνεν ἐναντίον τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν μου.
vulg: non habitabat in medio domus meae qui facit superbiam qui loquitur iniqua non direxit in conspectu oculorum meorum
clem: Non habitabit in medio domus me qui facit superbiam; qui loquitur iniqua non direxit in conspectu oculorum meorum.

lxx: εἰς τὰς πρωίας ἀπέκτεννον πάντας τοὺς ἁμαρτωλοὺς τῆς γῆς, τοῦ ἐξολεθρεῦσαι ἐκ πόλεως Κυρίου πάντας τοὺς ἐργαζομένους τὴν ἀδικίαν.
vulg: in matutino interficiebam omnes peccatores terrae ut disperderem de civitate Domini omnes operantes iniquitatem
clem: In matutino interficiebam omnes peccatores terr, ut disperderem de civitate Domini omnes operantes iniquitatem.]

wlc: לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר חֶסֶד־וּמִשְׁפָּט אָשִׁירָה לְךָ יְהוָה אֲזַמֵּרָה ׃
lxx: Προσευχὴ τῷ πτωχῷ, ὅταν ἀκηδιάσῃ καὶ ἑναντίον Κυρίου ἐκχέῃ τὴν δέησιν αὐτοῦ.
vulg: oratio pauperis cum anxius fuerit et coram Domino effuderit precem suam
clem: Oratio pauperis, cum anxius fuerit, et in conspectu Domini effuderit precem suam.
kjv: I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O Lord, will I sing.

wlc: אַשְׂכִּילָה בְּדֶרֶךְ תָּמִים מָתַי תָּבוֹא אֵלָי אֶתְהַלֵּךְ בְּתָם־לְבָבִי בְּקֶרֶב בֵּיתִי ׃
lxx: Εἰσάκουσον, Κύριε. τῆς προσευχῆς μου. καὶ ἡ κραυγὴ μου πρὸς σέ ἐλθάτω.
vulg: Domine exaudi orationem meam et clamor meus ad te veniat
clem: [Domine, exaudi orationem meam, et clamor meus ad te veniat.
kjv: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.

wlc: לֹא־אָשִׁית לְנֶגֶד עֵינַי דְּבַר־בְּלִיָּעַל עֲשֹׂה־סֵטִים שָׂנֵאתִי לֹא יִדְבַּק בִּי ׃
lxx: μὴ ἀποστρέψῃς τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ· ἐν ἦ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ θλίβωμαι, κλῖνον τὸ οὗς σου πρὸς μέ ἐν ἦ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ ἐπικαλέσωμαί σε, ταχὺ εἰσάκουσόν μου.
vulg: non avertas faciem tuam a me in quacumque die tribulor inclina ad me aurem tuam in quacumque die invocavero te velociter exaudi me
clem: Non avertas faciem tuam a me: in quacumque die tribulor, inclina ad me aurem tuam; in quacumque die invocavero te, velociter exaudi me.
kjv: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.

wlc: לֵבָב עִקֵּשׁ יָסוּר מִמֶּנִּי רָע לֹא אֵדָע ׃
