vulg: cantabiles mihi erant iustificationes tuae in loco peregrinationis meae
clem: Cantabiles mihi erant justificationes tu in loco peregrinationis me.

lxx: ἐμνήσθην ἐν νυκτὶ τὸ ὄνομά σου, Κύριε. καὶ ἐφύλαξα τὸν νόμον σου.
vulg: memor fui in nocte nominis tui Domine et custodivi legem tuam
clem: Memor fui nocte nominis tui, Domine, et custodivi legem tuam.

lxx: αὕτη ἐγενήθη μοι. τὰ δικαιώματά σου ἐξεζήτησα.
vulg: haec facta est mihi quia iustificationes tuas exquisivi
clem: Hc facta est mihi, quia justificationes tuas exquisivi.

lxx: Μερίς μου, Κύριε· εἶπα φυλάξασθαι τὰς ἐντολάς σου.
vulg: heth portio mea Dominus dixi custodire legem tuam
clem: Heth Portio mea, Domine, dixi custodire legem tuam.

lxx: ἐδεήθην τοῦ προσώπου σου ἐν ὅλῃ καρδίᾳ μου. ἐλέησόν με κατὰ τὸ λόγιόν σου.
vulg: deprecatus sum faciem tuam in toto corde meo miserere mei secundum eloquium tuum
clem: Deprecatus sum faciem tuam in toto corde meo; miserere mei secundum eloquium tuum.

lxx: ὅτι διελογισάμην κατὰ τὰς ὁδούς σου. καὶ ἀπέστρεψα τοὺς πόδας μου εἰς τὰ μαρτύριά σου.
vulg: cogitavi vias meas et avertisti pedes meos in testimonia tua
clem: Cogitavi vias meas, et converti pedes meos in testimonia tua.

lxx: ἡτοιμάσθην καὶ οὐκ ἐταράχθην φυλάξασθαι τὰς ἐντολάς σου.
vulg: paratus sum et non sum turbatus ut custodiam mandata tua
clem: Paratus sum, et non sum turbatus, ut custodiam mandata tua.

lxx: σχοινία ἁμαρτωλῶν περιεπλάκησάν μοι. καὶ τοῦ νόμου σου οὐκ ἐπελαθόμην.
vulg: funes peccatorum circumplexi sunt me et legem tuam non sum oblitus
clem: Funes peccatorum circumplexi sunt me, et legem tuam non sum oblitus.

lxx: μεσονύκτιον ἐξηγειρόμην τοῦ ἐξομολογεῖσθαί σοι ἐπὶ τὰ κρίματα τῆς δικαιοσύνης σου.
vulg: media nocte surgebam ad confitendum tibi super iudicia iustificationis tuae
clem: Media nocte surgebam ad confitendum tibi, super judicia justificationis tu.

lxx: μέτοχος ἐγὼ εἰμι πάντων τῶν φοβουμένων σε καὶ φυλασσόντων τὰς ἐντολάς σου.
vulg: particeps ego sum omnium timentium te et custodientium mandata tua
clem: Particeps ego sum omnium timentium te, et custodientium mandata tua.

lxx: τοῦ ἐλέους σου, Κύριε, πλήρης πᾶσα ἡ γῆ· τὰ δικαιώματά σου, Κύριε, δίδαξόν με.
vulg: misericordia Domini plena est terra iustificationes tuas doce me
clem: Misericordia tua, Domine, plena est terra; justificationes tuas doce me.

lxx: Χρηστότητα ἐποίησας μετὰ τοῦ δούλου σου, Κύριε, κατὰ τὸ λόγιόν σου.
vulg: teth bonitatem fecisti cum servo tuo Domine secundum verbum tuum
clem: Teth Bonitatem fecisti cum servo tuo, Domine, secundum verbum tuum.

lxx: χρηστότητα καὶ παιδίαν καὶ γνῶσιν δίδαξόν με, ὅτι ταῖς ἐντολαῖς σου ἐπίστευσα.
vulg: bonitatem et disciplinam et scientiam doce me quia mandatis tuis credidi
clem: Bonitatem, et disciplinam, et scientiam doce me, quia mandatis tuis credidi.

lxx: πρὸ τοῦ με ταπεινωθῆναι ἐγὼ ἐπλημμέλησα, διὰ τοῦτο τὸ λόγιόν σου ἐγὼ ἐφύλαξα.
vulg: priusquam humiliarer ego deliqui propterea eloquium tuum custodivi
clem: Priusquam humiliarer ego deliqui: propterea eloquium tuum custodivi.

lxx: χρηστὸς εἶ σύ, Κύριε, καὶ ἐν τῇ χρηστότητί σου δίδαξόν με τὰ δικαιώματά σου.
vulg: bonus es tu et in bonitate tua doce me iustificationes tuas
clem: Bonus es tu, et in bonitate tua doce me justificationes tuas.

lxx: ἐπληθύνθη ἐπʼ ἐμὲ ἀδικία ὑπερηφάνων, ἐγὼ δὲ ἐν ὅλη καρδίᾳ μου ἐξεραυνήσω τὰς ἐντολάς σου.
vulg: multiplicata est super me iniquitas superborum ego autem in toto corde scrutabor mandata tua
clem: Multiplicata est super me iniquitas superborum; ego autem in toto corde meo scrutabor mandata tua.

lxx: ἐτυρώθη ὡς γάλα ἡ καρδία αὐτῶν, ἐγὼ δὲ τὸν νόμον σου ἐμελέτησα.
vulg: coagulatum est sicut lac cor eorum ego vero legem tuam meditatus sum
clem: Coagulatum est sicut lac cor eorum; ego vero legem tuam meditatus sum.

lxx: ἀγαθόν μοι ὅτι ἐταπείνωσάς με, ὅπως ἂν μάθω τὰ δικαιώματά σου.
vulg: bonum mihi quia humiliasti me ut discam iustificationes tuas
clem: Bonum mihi quia humiliasti me, ut discam justificationes tuas.

lxx: ἀγαθόν μοι ὁ νόμος τοῦ στόματός σου ὑπέρ χιλιάδας χρυσίου καὶ ἀργυρίου.
vulg: bonum mihi lex oris tui super milia auri et argenti
clem: Bonum mihi lex oris tui, super millia auri et argenti.

lxx: Aἱ χεῖρές σου ἔπλασάν με καὶ ἡτοίμασάν με· συνέτισόν με καὶ μαθήσομαι τὰς ἐντολάς σου.
vulg: ioth manus tuae fecerunt me et plasmaverunt me da mihi intellectum et discam mandata tua
clem: Jod Manus tu fecerunt me, et plasmaverunt me: da mihi intellectum, et discam mandata tua.

lxx: οἱ φοβούμενοί σε ὄψονταί με καὶ εὐφρανθήσονται, ὅτι εἰς τοὺς λόγους σου ἐπήλπισα.
vulg: qui timent te videbunt me et laetabuntur quia in verba tua supersperavi
clem: Qui timent te videbunt me et ltabuntur, quia in verba tua supersperavi.

lxx: ἔγνων, Κύριε, ὅτι δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ ἀληθεία τὰ κρίματά σου ἐταπείνωσάν με.
vulg: cognovi Domine quia aequitas iudicia tua et veritate humiliasti me
clem: Cognovi, Domine, quia quitas judicia tua, et in veritate tua humiliasti me.

lxx: γενηθήτω δὴ τὸ ἔλεός σου τοῦ παρακαλέσαι με καὶ τὸ λόγιόν σου τῷ δούλῳ σου·
vulg: fiat misericordia tua ut consoletur me secundum eloquium tuum servo tuo
clem: Fiat misericordia tua ut consoletur me, secundum eloquium tuum servo tuo.

lxx: ἐλθέτωσάν μοι οἱ οἰκτιρμοί σου καὶ ζήσομαι, ὅτι ὁ νόμος σου μελέτη μοί ἐστιν.
vulg: veniant mihi miserationes tuae et vivam quia lex tua meditatio mea est
clem: Veniant mihi miserationes tu, et vivam, quia lex tua meditatio mea est.

lxx: αἰσχυνθήτωσαν ὑπερήφανοι, ὅτι ἀδίκως ἠνόμησαν εἰς ἐμέ· ἐγὼ δὲ ἀδολεσχήσω ἐν ταῖς ἐντολαῖς σου.
vulg: confundantur superbi quia iniuste iniquitatem fecerunt in me ego autem exercebor in mandatis tuis
clem: Confundantur superbi, quia injuste iniquitatem fecerunt in me; ego autem exercebor in mandatis tuis.

lxx: ἐπιστρεψάτωσαν οἱ φοβούμενοί σε καὶ οἱ γινώσκοντες τὰ μαρτύριά σου.
vulg: convertantur mihi timentes te et qui noverunt testimonia tua
clem: Convertantur mihi timentes te, et qui noverunt testimonia tua.

lxx: γενηθήτω ἡ καρδία μου ἄμωμος ἐν τοῖς δικαιώμασίν σου, ὅπως ἂν μὴ αἰσχυνθῶ.
vulg: fiat cor meum inmaculatum in iustificationibus tuis ut non confundar
clem: Fiat cor meum immaculatum in justificationibus tuis, ut non confundar.

lxx: Ἐκλείπει εἰς τὸ σωτήριόν σου ἡ ψυχὴ μου, καὶ εἰς τὸν λόγον σου ἐπήλπισα.
vulg: caf defecit in salutare tuum anima mea in verbum tuum supersperavi
clem: Caph Defecit in salutare tuum anima mea, et in verbum tuum supersperavi.

lxx: ἐξέλιπον οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου εἰς τὸ λόγιόν σου, λέγοντες ΙΙαρεκάλεσάν με.
vulg: defecerunt oculi mei in eloquium tuum dicentes quando consolaberis me
clem: Defecerunt oculi mei in eloquium tuum, dicentes: Quando consolaberis me?

lxx: τι ἐγενήθην ὡς ἀσκὸς ἐν πάχνῃ· τὰ δικαιώματά σου οὐκ ἐπελαθόμην.
vulg: quia factus sum sicut uter in pruina iustificationes tuas non sum oblitus
clem: Quia factus sum sicut uter in pruina; justificationes tuas non sum oblitus.

lxx: πόσαι όσαι εἰσὶν αἱ ἡμέραι τοῦ δούλου σου; πότε ποιήσεις μοι ἐκ τῶν καταδιωκόντων με κρίσιν;
vulg: quot sunt dies servo tuo quando facies de persequentibus me iudicium
clem: Quot sunt dies servi tui? quando facies de persequentibus me judicium?

lxx: διηγήσαντό μοι παράνομοι ἀδολεσχίας, ἀλλʼ οὐχ ὡς ὁ νόμος σου, Κύριε.
vulg: narraverunt mihi iniqui fabulationes sed non ut lex tua
clem: Narraverunt mihi iniqui fabulationes, sed non ut lex tua.

lxx: ,πᾶσαι αἱ ἐντολαί σου ἀλήθεια· ἀδίκως κατεδίωξάν με. βοήθησόν μοι.
vulg: omnia mandata tua veritas inique persecuti sunt me adiuva me
clem: Omnia mandata tua veritas: inique persecuti sunt me, adjuva me.

lxx: παρὰ βοαχὺ συνετλεσάν με ἐν τῇ γῇ. ἐγὼ δὲ οὐκ ἐνκατέλειπον τὰς ἐντολάς σου.
vulg: paulo minus consummaverunt me in terra ego autem non dereliqui mandata tua
clem: Paulominus consummaverunt me in terra; ego autem non dereliqui mandata tua.

lxx: κατὰ τὸ ἔλεός σου ζήσομαι, καὶ φυλάξω τὰ μαρτύρια τοῦ στόματός σου.
vulg: secundum misericordiam tuam vivifica me et custodiam testimonia oris tui
clem: Secundum misericordiam tuam vivifica me, et custodiam testimonia oris tui.

lxx: Εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, Κύριε, ὁ λόγος σου διαμένει ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ.
vulg: lamed in aeternum Domine verbum tuum permanet in caelo
clem: Lamed In ternum, Domine, verbum tuum permanet in clo.

lxx: εἰς γενεὰν καὶ γενεὰν ἡ ἀλήθειά σου· ἐθεμελίωσας τὴν γῆν καὶ διαμένει.
vulg: in generationem et generationem veritas tua fundasti terram et permanet
clem: In generationem et generationem veritas tua; fundasti terram, et permanet.

lxx: τῇ διατάξει σου διαμένει ἡ ἡμέρα, ὅτι τὰ σύμπαντα δοῦλά σου.
vulg: ordinatione tua perseverat dies quoniam omnia serviunt tibi
clem: Ordinatione tua perseverat dies, quoniam omnia serviunt tibi.

lxx: εἰ μὴ ὅτι ὁ νόμος σου μελέτη μού ἐστιν, τότε ἂν ἀπωλόμην ἐν τῇ ταπεινώσει μου·
vulg: nisi quod lex tua meditatio mea est tunc forte perissem in humilitate mea
clem: Nisi quod lex tua meditatio mea est, tunc forte periissem in humilitate mea.

lxx: εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα οὐ μὴ ἐπιλάθωμαι τῶν δικαιωμάτων σου, ὅτι ἐν αὐτοῖς ἔζησάς με, Κύριε.
vulg: in aeternum non obliviscar iustificationes tuas quia in ipsis vivificasti me
clem: In ternum non obliviscar justificationes tuas, quia in ipsis vivificasti me.

lxx: σός εἰμι, Κύριε, σῶσόν με, ὅτι τὰ δικαιώματά σου ἐξεζήτησα·
vulg: tuus sum ego salvum me fac quoniam iustificationes tuas exquisivi
clem: Tuus sum ego; salvum me fac: quoniam justificationes tuas exquisivi.

lxx: τὰ δέ μαρτύριά σου συνῆκα.
vulg: me expectaverunt peccatores ut perderent me testimonia tua intellexi
clem: Me exspectaverunt peccatores ut perderent me; testimonia tua intellexi.

lxx: πάσης συντελείας εἶδον πέρας, πλατεῖα ἡ ἐντολή σου σφόδρα.
vulg: omni consummationi vidi finem latum mandatum tuum nimis
clem: Omnis consummationis vidi finem, latum mandatum tuum nimis.

lxx: Ὡς ἠγάπησα τὸν νόμον σου, Κύριε· ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν μελέτη μού ἐστιν.
vulg: mem quomodo dilexi legem tuam tota die meditatio mea est
clem: Mem Quomodo dilexi legem tuam, Domine! tota die meditatio mea est.

lxx: ὑπέρ τοὺς ἐχθρούς μου ἐσόφισάς με τὰς ἐντολάς σου, ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνά μοί ἐστιν.
vulg: super inimicos meos prudentem me fecisti mandato tuo quia in aeternum mihi est
clem: Super inimicos meos prudentem me fecisti mandato tuo, quia in ternum mihi est.

lxx: ὑπὲρ πάντας τοὺς διδάσκοντας με συνῆκα, ὅτι τὰ μαρτύριά σου μελέτη μού ἐστιν.
vulg: super omnes docentes me intellexi quia testimonia tua meditatio mea est
clem: Super omnes docentes me intellexi, quia testimonia tua meditatio mea est.

lxx: ὑπὲρ πρεσβυτέρους συνῆκα, ὅτι τὰς ἐντολάς σου ἐζήτησα.
vulg: super senes intellexi quia mandata tua quaesivi
clem: Super senes intellexi, quia mandata tua qusivi.

lxx: ἐκ πάσης ὁδοῦ πονηρᾶς ἐκώλυσα τοὺς πόδας μου, ὅπως ἂν φυλάξω τοὺς λόγους σου·
vulg: ab omni via mala prohibui pedes meos ut custodiam verba tua
clem: Ab omni via mala prohibui pedes meos, ut custodiam verba tua.

lxx: ἀπὸ τῶν κλιμάτων σου οὐκ ἐξέκλινα, ὅτι σὺ ἐνομοθέτησάς μοι.
vulg: a iudiciis tuis non declinavi quia tu legem posuisti mihi
clem: A judiciis tuis non declinavi, quia tu legem posuisti mihi.

lxx: ὡς γλυκέα τῷ λάρυγγί μου τὰ λόγιά σου, ὑπέρ μέλι καὶ κηρίον τῷ στόματί μου.
vulg: quam dulcia faucibus meis eloquia tua super mel ori meo
clem: Quam dulcia faucibus meis eloquia tua! super mel ori meo.

lxx: ἀπὸ τῶν ἐντολῶν σου συνῆκα· διὰ τοῦτο ἐμίσησα πᾶσαν ὁδὸν ἀδικίας, ὅτι σὺ ἐνομοθέτησάς
vulg: a mandatis tuis intellexi propterea odivi omnem viam iniquitatis
clem: A mandatis tuis intellexi; propterea odivi omnem viam iniquitatis.

lxx: Λύχνος τοῖς ποσίν μου ὁ νόμος σου, καὶ φῶς ταῖς τρίβοις μου.
vulg: nun lucerna pedibus meis verbum tuum et lumen semitis meis
clem: Nun Lucerna pedibus meis verbum tuum, et lumen semitis meis.

lxx: ὀμώμοκα καὶ ἔστησα τοῦ φυλάξασθαι τὰ κρίματα τῆς δικαιοσύνης σου.
vulg: iuravi et statui custodire iudicia iustitiae tuae
clem: Juravi et statui custodire judicia justiti tu.

lxx: ἐταπεινώθην ἕως σφόδρα· Κύριε, ζῆσόν με κατὰ τὸ λόγιόν σου.
vulg: humiliatus sum usquequaque Domine vivifica me secundum verbum tuum
clem: Humiliatus sum usquequaque, Domine; vivifica me secundum verbum tuum.

lxx: τὰ ἑκούσια τοῦ στόματός μου εὐλόγησον, Κύριε, καὶ τὰ κρίματά σου δίδαξόν με.
vulg: voluntaria oris mei beneplacita fac Domine et iudicia tua doce me
clem: Voluntaria oris mei beneplacita fac, Domine, et judicia tua doce me.

lxx: ἡ ψυχὴ μου ἐν ταῖς χερσὶ διὰ παντός, καὶ τὸν νόμον σου οὐκ ἐπελαθόμην.
vulg: anima mea in manibus meis semper et legem tuam non sum oblitus
clem: Anima mea in manibus meis semper, et legem tuam non sum oblitus.

lxx: ἔθεντο ἁμαρτωλοὶ παγίδα μοι, καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἐντολῶν σου οὐκ ἐπλανήθην.
vulg: posuerunt peccatores laqueum mihi et de mandatis tuis non erravi
clem: Posuerunt peccatores laqueum mihi, et de mandatis tuis non erravi.

lxx: ἐκληρονόμησα τὰ μαρτύριά σου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, ὅτι ἀγαλλίαμα τῆς καρδίας μού εἰσιν·
vulg: hereditate adquisivi testimonia tua in aeternum quia exultatio cordis mei sunt
clem: Hreditate acquisivi testimonia tua in ternum, quia exsultatio cordis mei sunt.

lxx: ἔκλινα τὴν καρδίαν μου τοῦ ποιῆσαι τὰ δικαιώματά σου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα διὰ παντὸς ἄμειψιν.
vulg: inclinavi cor meum ad faciendas iustificationes tuas in aeternum propter retributionem
clem: Inclinavi cor meum ad faciendas justificationes tuas in ternum, propter retributionem.

lxx: Παρανόμους ἐμίσησα, καὶ τὸν νόμον σου ἠγάπησα.
vulg: samech iniquos odio habui et legem tuam dilexi
clem: Samech Iniquos odio habui, et legem tuam dilexi.

lxx: βοηθός μου καὶ ἀντιλήμπτωρ μου εἶ σύ, καὶ εἰς τὸν λαόν σου ἤλπισα.
vulg: adiutor meus et susceptor meus es tu in verbum tuum supersperavi
clem: Adjutor et susceptor meus es tu, et in verbum tuum supersperavi.

lxx: ἐκκλίνατε ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ, οἱ πονηρευόμενοι, καὶ ἐξεραυνήσω τὰς ἐντολὰς τοῦ θεοῦ μου.
vulg: declinate a me maligni et scrutabor mandata Dei mei
clem: Declinate a me, maligni, et scrutabor mandata Dei mei.

lxx: ἀντιλαβοῦ κατὰ τὸ λόγιόν σου καὶ ζῆσόν με. καὶ μὴ καταισχύνῃς με ἀπὸ τῆς προσδοκίας μου.
vulg: suscipe me secundum eloquium tuum et vivam et non confundas me ab expectatione mea
clem: Suscipe me secundum eloquium tuum, et vivam, et non confundas me ab exspectatione mea.

lxx: βοήθησόν μοι καὶ σωθήσομαι, καὶ μελετήσω ἐν τοῖς δικαιώμασίν σου διὰ παντός.
vulg: adiuva me et salvus ero et meditabor in iustificationibus tuis semper
clem: Adjuva me, et salvus ero, et meditabor in justificationibus tuis semper.

lxx: ἐξουδένωσας πάντας τοὺς ἀποστατοῦντας ἀπὸ τῶν δικαιωμάπαου σοῦ, ὅτι ἄδικον τὸ ἐνθύμημα αὐτῶν.
vulg: sprevisti omnes discedentes a iustitiis tuis quia iniusta cogitatio eorum
clem: Sprevisti omnes discedentes a judiciis tuis, quia injusta cogitatio eorum.

lxx: παραβαίνοντας ἐλογισάμην πάντας τοὺς ἁμαρτωλοὺς τῆς γῆς, διὰ τοῦτο ἠγάπησα τὰ μαρτύριά σου διὰ παντός.
vulg: praevaricantes reputavi omnes peccatores terrae ideo dilexi testimonia tua
clem: Prvaricantes reputavi omnes peccatores terr; ideo dilexi testimonia tua.

lxx: καθήλωσον ἐκ τοῦ φόβου σου τὰς σάρκας μου, ἀπὸ γὰρ τῶν κριμάτων σου ἐφοβήθην.
vulg: confige timore tuo carnes meas a iudiciis %enim; tuis timui
clem: Confige timore tuo carnes meas; a judiciis enim tuis timui.

lxx: Ἐποίησα κρίμα καὶ δικαιοσύνην, μὴ παραδῷς με τοῖς ἀδικοῦσίν με.
vulg: ain feci iudicium et iustitiam non tradas me calumniantibus me
clem: Ain Feci judicium et justitiam: non tradas me calumniantibus me.

lxx: ἔκδεξαι τὸν δοῦλόν σου εἰς ἀγαθά, μὴ συκοφαντησάτωσάν με ὑπερήφανοι.
vulg: suscipe servum tuum in bonum non calumnientur me superbi
clem: Suscipe servum tuum in bonum: non calumnientur me superbi.

lxx: οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου ἐξέλιπον εἰς τὸ σωτήριόν σου καὶ εἰς τὸ λόγιον τῆς δικαιοσύνης σου.
vulg: oculi mei defecerunt in salutare tuum et in eloquium iustitiae tuae
clem: Oculi mei defecerunt in salutare tuum, et in eloquium justiti tu.

lxx: ποίησον μετὰ τοῦ δούλου σου κατὰ τὸ λόγιόν σου, καὶ κατὰ τὰ δικαιώματά σου δίδαξόν με.
vulg: fac cum servo tuo secundum misericordiam tuam et iustificationes tuas doce me
clem: Fac cum servo tuo secundum misericordiam tuam, et justificationes tuas doce me.

lxx: δοῦλός σού εἰμι ἐγώ· συνέτισόν με, καὶ γνώσομαι τὰ μαρτύριά σου.
vulg: servus tuus sum ego da mihi intellectum et sciam testimonia tua
clem: Servus tuus sum ego: da mihi intellectum, ut sciam testimonia tua.

lxx: καιρὸς τοῦ ποιῆσαι τῷ κυρίῳ· διεσκέδασαν τὸν νόμον σου.
vulg: tempus faciendi Domino dissipaverunt legem tuam
clem: Tempus faciendi, Domine: dissipaverunt legem tuam.

lxx: διὰ τοῦτο ἠγάπησα τὰς ἐντολάς σου ὑπέρ τὸ χρυσίον καὶ τοπάζιον·
vulg: ideo dilexi mandata tua super aurum et topazion
clem: Ideo dilexi mandata tua super aurum et topazion.

lxx: δὴ τοῦτο πρὸς πάσας τὰς ἐντολάς σου κατωρθούμην, πᾶσαν ὁδὸν ἄδικον ἐμίσησα.
vulg: propterea ad omnia mandata tua dirigebar omnem viam iniquam odio habui
clem: Propterea ad omnia mandata tua dirigebar; omnem viam iniquam odio habui.

lxx: Θαυμαστὰ τὰ μαρτύριά σου, διὰ τοῦτο ἐξηρεύνησεν αὐτὰ ἡ ψυχὴ μου.
vulg: fe mirabilia testimonia tua ideo scrutata est ea anima mea
clem: Phe Mirabilia testimonia tua: ideo scrutata est ea anima mea.

lxx: ἡ δήλωσις τῶν λόγων σου φωτιεῖ, καὶ συνετιεῖ νηπίους.
vulg: declaratio sermonum tuorum inluminat et intellectum dat parvulis
clem: Declaratio sermonum tuorum illuminat, et intellectum dat parvulis.

vulg: os meum aperui et adtraxi spiritum quia mandata tua desiderabam
clem: Os meum aperui, et attraxi spiritum: quia mandata tua desiderabam.

lxx: ἐπίβλεψον ἐπʼ ἐμὲ καὶ ἐλέησόν με κατὰ τὸ κρίμα τῶν ἀγαπώντων τὸ ὄνομά σου.
vulg: aspice in me et miserere mei secundum iudicium diligentium nomen tuum
clem: Aspice in me, et miserere mei, secundum judicium diligentium nomen tuum.

vulg: gressus meos dirige secundum eloquium tuum et non dominetur mei omnis iniustitia
clem: Gressus meos dirige secundum eloquium tuum, et non dominetur mei omnis injustitia.

lxx: λύτρωσαί με ἀπὸ συκοφαντίας ἀνθρώπων, καὶ φυλάξω τὰς ἐντολάς σου.
vulg: redime me a calumniis hominum et custodiam mandata tua
clem: Redime me a calumniis hominum ut custodiam mandata tua.

lxx: τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἐπίφανον ἐπὶ τὸν δοῦλόν σου, καὶ δίδαξόν με τὰ δικαιώματά σου.
vulg: faciem tuam inlumina super servum tuum et doce me iustificationes tuas
clem: Faciem tuam illumina super servum tuum, et doce me justificationes tuas.

lxx: διεξόδους ὑδάτων κατέβησαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου. ἐπεὶ οὐκ ἐφύλαξαν τὸν νόμον σου.
vulg: exitus aquarum deduxerunt oculi mei quia non custodierunt legem tuam
clem: Exitus aquarum deduxerunt oculi mei, quia non custodierunt legem tuam.

lxx: Δίκαιος εἶ, Κύριε, καὶ εὐθὴς ἡ κρίσις σου·
vulg: sade iustus es Domine et rectum iudicium tuum
clem: Sade Justus es, Domine, et rectum judicium tuum.

lxx: ἐυετείλω δικαιοσύνην τὰ μαρτύριά σου καὶ ἀλήθειαν σφόδρα.
vulg: mandasti iustitiam testimonia tua et veritatem tuam nimis
clem: Mandasti justitiam testimonia tua, et veritatem tuam nimis.

lxx: ἐξέτηξέν με ὁ ζῆλος τοῦ οἴκου σου, ὅτι ἐπελάθοντο τῶν ἐντολῶν σου οἱ ἐχθροί μου.
vulg: tabescere me fecit zelus meus quia obliti sunt verba tua inimici mei
clem: Tabescere me fecit zelus meus, quia obliti sunt verba tua inimici mei.

lxx: πεπυρωμένον τὸ λόγιόν σου σφόδρα, καὶ ὁ δοῦλός σου ἠγάπησεν αὐτό.
vulg: ignitum eloquium tuum vehementer et servus tuus dilexit illud
clem: Ignitum eloquium tuum vehementer, et servus tuus dilexit illud.

lxx: νεώτερός εἰμι ἐγὼ καὶ ἐξουδενωμένος· τὰ δικαιώματά σου οὐκ ἐπελαθόμην.
vulg: adulescentulus sum ego et contemptus iustificationes tuas non sum oblitus
clem: Adolescentulus sum ego et contemptus; justificationes tuas non sum oblitus.

lxx: ἡ δικαιοσύνη σου δικαιοσύνη εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, καὶ ὁ λόγος σου ἀλήθεια.
vulg: iustitia tua iustitia in aeternum et lex tua veritas
clem: Justitia tua, justitia in ternum, et lex tua veritas.

lxx: θλίψεις καὶ ἀνάγκη εὕροσάν με· αἱ ἐντολαί σου μελέτη μου.
vulg: tribulatio et angustia invenerunt me mandata tua meditatio mea
clem: Tribulatio et angustia invenerunt me; mandata tua meditatio mea est.

lxx: δικαιοσύνη τὰ μαρτύριά σου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα· συνέτισόν με καὶ ζῆσόν με.
vulg: aequitas testimonia tua in aeternum intellectum da mihi et vivam
clem: quitas testimonia tua in ternum: intellectum da mihi, et vivam.

lxx: Ἐκέκραξα ἐν ὅλῃ καρδίᾳ, ἐπάκουσόν μου, Κύριε. τὰ δικαιάματά σου ἐκζητήσω.
vulg: cof clamavi in toto corde exaudi me Domine iustificationes tuas requiram
clem: Coph Clamavi in toto corde meo: exaudi me, Domine; justificationes tuas requiram.

lxx: ἐκέκραξά σε, σῶσόν με. καὶ φυλάξω τὰ μαρτύριά σου.
vulg: clamavi te salvum me fac et custodiam mandata tua
clem: Clamavi ad te; salvum me fac: ut custodiam mandata tua.

lxx: προέφθασάν με ἐν ἀωρίᾳ καὶ ἐκέκραξα, εἰς τοὺς λόγους σου ἐπήλπισα.
vulg: praeveni in maturitate et clamavi in verba tua supersperavi
clem: Prveni in maturitate, et clamavi: quia in verba tua supersperavi.

lxx: προέφθασαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου πρὸς σὲ ὀρθροῦν, τοῦ μελετᾷν τὰ λόγιά σου.
vulg: praevenerunt oculi mei ad diluculum ut meditarer eloquia tua
clem: Prvenerunt oculi mei ad te diluculo, ut meditarer eloquia tua.

lxx: τῆς φωνῆς μου ἄκουσον, Κύριε, κατὰ τὸ λόγιόν σου, κατὰ τὸ κρίμα σου ζῆσόν με.
vulg: vocem meam audi secundum misericordiam tuam Domine secundum iudicium tuum vivifica me
clem: Vocem meam audi secundum misericordiam tuam, Domine, et secundum judicium tuum vivifica me.

lxx: προσήγγισαν οἱ καταδιώκοντές με ἀνομίᾳ. ἀπὸ δὲ τοῦ νόμου σου ἐμακρύνθησαν.
vulg: adpropinquaverunt persequentes me iniquitate a lege autem tua longe facti sunt
clem: Appropinquaverunt persequentes me iniquitati: a lege autem tua longe facti sunt.

lxx: ἐγγὺς εἶ, Κύριε. καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ ὁδοί σου ἀλήθεια.
vulg: prope es tu Domine et omnes viae tuae veritas
clem: Prope es tu, Domine, et omnes vi tu veritas.

lxx: κατʼ ἀρχὰς ἔγνων ἐκ τῶν μαρτυρίων σου. ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἐθεμελίωσας αὐτά.
vulg: initio cognovi de testimoniis tuis quia in aeternum fundasti ea
clem: Initio cognovi de testimoniis tuis, quia in ternum fundasti ea.

lxx: Ἴδε τὴν ταπείνωσίν μου καὶ ἐξελοῦ με, ὅτι τὸν νόμον σου οὐκ ἐπελαθόμην.
vulg: res vide humilitatem meam et eripe me quia legem tuam non sum oblitus
clem: Res Vide humilitatem meam, et eripe me, quia legem tuam non sum oblitus.

lxx: κρῖὴν κρίσιν μου καὶ λύτρωσαί με· διὰ τὸν λόγον σου ζῆσόν με.
vulg: iudica iudicium meum et redime me propter eloquium tuum vivifica me
clem: Judica judicium meum, et redime me: propter eloquium tuum vivifica me.

lxx: μακρὰν ἀπὸ ἁμαρτωλῶν ἡ σωτηρία, ὅτι τὰ δικαιώματά σου οὐκ ἐξεζήτησαν.
vulg: longe a peccatoribus salus quia iustificationes tuas non exquisierunt
clem: Longe a peccatoribus salus, quia justificationes tuas non exquisierunt.

lxx: οἱ οἰκτιρμοί σου πολλοί, Κύριε, σφόδρα· κατὰ τὰ κρίματά σου ζῆσόν με.
vulg: misericordiae tuae multae Domine secundum iudicia tua vivifica me
clem: Misericordi tu mult, Domine; secundum judicium tuum vivifica me.

lxx: πολλοὶ οἱ ἐκδιώκοντές με καὶ ἐκθλίβοντές με· ἐκ τῶν μαρτυρίων σου οὐκ ἐξέκλινα.
vulg: multi qui persequuntur me et tribulant me a testimoniis tuis non declinavi
clem: Multi qui persequuntur me, et tribulant me; a testimoniis tuis non declinavi.

lxx: εἶυνθετοῦντας καὶ ἐξετηκόμην, ὅτι τὰ λόγιά σου οὐκ ἐφυλάξαντο.
vulg: vidi praevaricantes et tabescebam quia eloquia tua non custodierunt
clem: Vidi prvaricantes et tabescebam, quia eloquia tua non custodierunt.

lxx: ἴδε ὅτι τὰς ἐντολάς σου ἠγάπησα, Κύριε· ἐν τῷ ἐλέει σου ζῆσόν με.
vulg: vide quoniam mandata tua dilexi Domine in misericordia tua vivifica me
clem: Vide quoniam mandata tua dilexi, Domine: in misericordia tua vivifica me.

lxx: ἀρχὴ τῶν λόγων σου ἀλήθεια, καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα πάντα τὰ κρίματα τῆς δικαιοσύνης σου.
vulg: principium verborum tuorum veritas et in aeternum omnia iudicia iustitiae tuae
clem: Principium verborum tuorum veritas; in ternum omnia judicia justiti tu.

lxx: Ἄρχοντες κατεδίωξάν με δωρεάν, καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν λόγων σου ἐδειλίασεν ἡ καρδία μου.
vulg: sen principes persecuti sunt me gratis et a verbis tuis formidavit cor meum
clem: Sin Principes persecuti sunt me gratis, et a verbis tuis formidavit cor meum.

lxx: ἀγαλλιάσομαι ἐγὼ ἐπὶ τὰ λόγιά σου, ὡς ὁ εὑρίσκων σκῦλα πολλά.
vulg: laetabor ego super eloquia tua sicut qui invenit spolia multa
clem: Ltabor ego super eloquia tua, sicut qui invenit spolia multa.

lxx: ἀδικίαν ἐμίσησα καὶ ἐβδελυξάμην, τὸν δὲ νόμον σου ἠγάπησα.
vulg: iniquitatem odio habui et abominatus sum legem autem tuam dilexi
clem: Iniquitatem odio habui, et abominatus sum, legem autem tuam dilexi.

lxx: ἑπτάκις τῆς ἡμέρας ᾔνεσά σοι ἐπὶ τά κρίματα τῆς δικαιοσύνης σου.
vulg: septies in die laudem dixi tibi super iudicia iustitiae tuae
clem: Septies in die laudem dixi tibi, super judicia justiti tu.

lxx: εἰρήνη πολλὴ τοῖς ἀγαπῶσιν τὸν νόμον σου, καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν αὐτοῖς σκάνδαλον.
vulg: pax multa diligentibus legem tuam et non est illis scandalum
clem: Pax multa diligentibus legem tuam, et non est illis scandalum.

lxx: προσεδόκων τὸ σωτήριόν σου, Κύριε, καὶ τὰς ἐντολάς σου ἠγάπησα·
vulg: expectabam salutare tuum Domine et mandata tua dilexi
clem: Exspectabam salutare tuum, Domine, et mandata tua dilexi.

lxx: καὶ ἐφύλαξεν ἡ ψυχή μου τὰ μαρτύριά σου, καὶ ἠγάπησεν αὐτὰ σφόδρα·
vulg: custodivit anima mea testimonia tua et dilexi ea vehementer
clem: Custodivit anima mea testimonia tua, et dilexit ea vehementer.

lxx: ἐφύλαξα τὰς ἐντολάς σου καὶ τὰ μαρτύριά σου, ὅτι πᾶσαι αἱ ὁδοί μου ἐυαντίον σου.
vulg: servavi mandata tua et testimonia tua quia omnes viae meae in conspectu tuo
clem: Servavi mandata tua et testimonia tua, quia omnes vi me in conspectu tuo.

lxx: Ἐγγισάτω δὴ ἡ δέησίς μου ἐνώπιόν σου, Κύριε, Κύριε· κατὰ τὸ λόγιόν σου συνέτισόν με.
vulg: thau adpropinquet deprecatio mea in conspectu tuo Domine iuxta eloquium tuum da mihi intellectum
clem: Tau Appropinquet deprecatio mea in conspectu tuo, Domine; juxta eloquium tuum da mihi intellectum.

lxx: εἰσέλθοι τὸ ἀξίωμά μου ἐνώπιόν σου· κατὰ τὸ λόγιόν σου ῥῦσαί με.
vulg: intret postulatio mea in conspectu tuo secundum eloquium tuum eripe me
clem: Intret postulatio mea in conspectu tuo; secundum eloquium tuum eripe me.

lxx: ἐξηρεύξαντο τὰ χείλη μου ὕμνον. ὅταν διδάξῃς με τὰ δικαιώματαά σου·
vulg: eructabunt labia mea hymnum cum docueris me iustificationes tuas
clem: Eructabunt labia mea hymnum, cum docueris me justificationes tuas.

lxx: φθέγξαιτο ἡ γλῶσσά μου τὸ λόγιόν σου, ὅτι πᾶσαι αἱ ἐντολαί σου δικαιοσύνη ἐστίν.
vulg: pronuntiabit lingua mea eloquium tuum quia omnia mandata tua aequitas
clem: Pronuntiabit lingua mea eloquium tuum, quia omnia mandata tua quitas.

lxx: γενέσθω ἡ χείρ σου τοῦ σῶσαι, ὅτι τὰς ἐντολάς σου ᾑρετισάμην.
vulg: fiat manus tua ut salvet me quoniam mandata tua elegi
clem: Fiat manus tua ut salvet me, quoniam mandata tua elegi.

lxx: ἐπεπόθησα τὸ σωτήριόν σου, Κύριε, καὶ ὁ νόμος σου μελέτη μού ἐστιν.
vulg: concupivi salutare tuum Domine et lex tua meditatio mea
clem: Concupivi salutare tuum, Domine, et lex tua meditatio mea est.

lxx: ζήσεται ἡ ψυχή μου καὶ αἰνέσει σε, καὶ τὰ κρίματά σου βοηθήσει μοι.
vulg: vivet anima mea et laudabit te et iudicia tua adiuvabunt me
clem: Vivet anima mea, et laudabit te, et judicia tua adjuvabunt me.

lxx: ἐπλανήθην ὡσεὶ πρόβατον ἀπολωλός· ζῆσον τὸν δοῦλόν σου, ὅτι τὰς ἐντολάς σου οὐκ ἐπελαθόμην.
vulg: erravi sicut ovis quae periit quaere servum tuum quia mandata tua non sum oblitus
clem: Erravi sicut ovis qu periit: qure servum tuum, quia mandata tua non sum oblitus.]

wlc: אַשְׁרֵי תְמִימֵי־דָרֶךְ הַהֹלְכִים בְּתוֹרַת יְהוָה ׃
lxx: Πρὸς Κύριον ἐν τῷ θλίβεσθαί με ἐκέκραξα, καὶ εἰσήκουσέν
vulg: canticum graduum ad Dominum cum tribularer clamavi et exaudivit me
clem: Canticum graduum. [Ad Dominum cum tribularer clamavi, et exaudivit me.
kjv: Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the Lord.

wlc: אַשְׁרֵי נֹצְרֵי עֵדֹתָיו בְּכָל־לֵב יִדְרְשׁוּהוּ ׃
lxx: Κύριε. ῥῦσαι τὴν ψυχὴν μου ἀπὸ χειλέων ἀδίκων καὶ ἀπὸ γλώσσης δολίας.
vulg: Domine libera animam meam a labiis iniquis a lingua dolosa
clem: Domine, libera animam meam a labiis iniquis et a lingua dolosa.
kjv: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.

wlc: אַף לֹא־פָעֲלוּ עַוְלָה בִּדְרָכָיו הָלָכוּ ׃
lxx: τί δοθείη σοι καὶ τί προστεθείη σοι πρὸς γλῶσσαν δολίαν; τὸ βέλη τοῦ δυνατοῦ ἠκονημένα σὺν τοῖς ἄνθραξιν τοῖς ἐρημικοῖς.
vulg: quid detur tibi et quid adponatur tibi ad linguam dolosam
clem: Quid detur tibi, aut quid apponatur tibi ad linguam dolosam?
kjv: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.

wlc: אַתָּה צִוִּיתָה פִקֻּדֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹר מְאֹד ׃
vulg: sagittae potentis acutae cum carbonibus desolatoriis
clem: Sagitt potentis acut, cum carbonibus desolatoriis.
kjv: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently.

wlc: אַחֲלַי יִכֹּנוּ דְרָכָי לִשְׁמֹר חֻקֶּיךָ ׃
lxx: οἴμοι ὅτι ἡ παροικία μου ἐμακρύνθη, κατεσκήωνσα μετὰ τῶν σκηωνμάτων Κηδάρ.
vulg: heu mihi quia incolatus meus prolongatus est habitavi cum habitationibus Cedar
clem: Heu mihi, quia incolatus meus prolongatus est! habitavi cum habitantibus Cedar;
kjv: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!

wlc: אָז לֹא־אֵבוֹשׁ בְּהַבִּיטִי אֶל־כָּל־מִצְוֹתֶיךָ ׃
lxx: πολλὰ παρῴκησεν ἡ ψυχή μου μετὰ τῶν μισούντων τὴν εἰρήνην.
vulg: multum incola fuit anima mea
clem: multum incola fuit anima mea.
kjv: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.

wlc: אוֹדְךָ בְּיֹשֶׁר לֵבָב בְּלָמְדִי מִשְׁפְּטֵי צִדְקֶךָ ׃
lxx: ἤμην εἰρηνικός· ὅταν ἐλάλουν αὐτοῖς, ἐπολέμουν με δωρεάν.
vulg: cum his qui oderant pacem eram pacificus cum loquebar illis inpugnabant me gratis
clem: Cum his qui oderunt pacem eram pacificus; cum loquebar illis, impugnabant me gratis.]
kjv: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.

wlc: אֶת־חֻקֶּיךָ אֶשְׁמֹר אַל־תַּעַזְבֵנִי עַד־מְאֹד ׃
kjv: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.

wlc: בַּמֶּה יְזַכֶּה־נַּעַר אֶת־אָרְחוֹ לִשְׁמֹר כִּדְבָרֶךָ ׃
kjv: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.

wlc: בְּכָל־לִבִּי דְרַשְׁתִּיךָ אַל־תַּשְׁגֵּנִי מִמִּצְוֹתֶיךָ ׃
kjv: With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.

wlc: בְּלִבִּי צָפַנְתִּי אִמְרָתֶךָ לְמַעַן לֹא אֶחֱטָא־לָךְ ׃
kjv: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.

wlc: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהוָה לַמְּדֵנִי חֻקֶּיךָ ׃
kjv: Blessed art thou, O Lord: teach me thy statutes.

wlc: בִּשְׂפָתַי סִפַּרְתִּי כֹּל מִשְׁפְּטֵי־פִיךָ ׃
kjv: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.

wlc: בְּדֶרֶךְ עֵדְוֹתֶיךָ שַׂשְׂתִּי כְּעַל כָּל־הוֹן ׃
kjv: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.

wlc: בְּפִקֻּדֶיךָ אָשִׂיחָה וְאַבִּיטָה אֹרְחֹתֶיךָ ׃
kjv: I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.

wlc: בְּחֻקֹּתֶיךָ אֶשְׁתַּעֲשָׁע לֹא אֶשְׁכַּח דְּבָרֶךָ ׃
kjv: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.

wlc: גְּמֹל עַל־עַבְדְּךָ אֶחְיֶה וְאֶשְׁמְרָה דְבָרֶךָ ׃
kjv: Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live, and keep thy word.

wlc: גַּל־עֵינַי וְאַבִּיטָה נִפְלָאוֹת מִתּוֹרָתֶךָ ׃
kjv: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.

wlc: גֵּר אָנֹכִי בָאָרֶץ אַל־תַּסְתֵּר מִמֶּנִּי מִצְוֹתֶיךָ ׃
kjv: I am a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.

wlc: גָּרְסָה נַפְשִׁי לְתַאֲבָה אֶל־מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ בְכָל־עֵת ׃
kjv: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto thy judgments at all times.

wlc: גָּעַרְתָּ זֵדִים אֲרוּרִים הַשֹּׁגִים מִמִּצְוֹתֶיךָ ׃
kjv: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from thy commandments.

wlc: גַּל מֵעָלַי חֶרְפָּה וָבוּז כִּי עֵדֹתֶיךָ נָצָרְתִּי ׃
kjv: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.

wlc: גַּם יָשְׁבוּ שָׂרִים בִּי נִדְבָּרוּ עַבְדְּךָ יָשִׂיחַ בְּחֻקֶּיךָ ׃
kjv: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.

wlc: גַּם־עֵדֹתֶיךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָי אַנְשֵׁי עֲצָתִי ׃
kjv: Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counselors.

wlc: דָּבְקָה לֶעָפָר נַפְשִׁי חַיֵּנִי כִּדְבָרֶךָ ׃
kjv: My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.

wlc: דְּרָכַי סִפַּרְתִּי וַתַּעֲנֵנִי לַמְּדֵנִי חֻקֶּיךָ ׃
kjv: I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.

wlc: דֶּרֶךְ־פִּקּוּדֶיךָ הֲבִינֵנִי וְאָשִׂיחָה בְּנִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ ׃
kjv: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.

wlc: דָּלְפָה נַפְשִׁי מִתּוּגָה קַיְּמֵנִי כִּדְבָרֶךָ ׃
kjv: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.

wlc: דֶּרֶךְ־שֶׁקֶר הָסֵר מִמֶּנִּי וְתוֹרָתְךָ חָנֵּנִי ׃
kjv: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.

wlc: דֶּרֶךְ־אֱמוּנָה בָחָרְתִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ שִׁוִּיתִי ׃
kjv: I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid before me.

wlc: דָּבַקְתִּי בְעֵדְוֹתֶיךָ יְהוָה אַל־תְּבִישֵׁנִי ׃
kjv: I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O Lord, put me not to shame.

wlc: דֶּרֶךְ־מִצְוֹתֶיךָ אָרוּץ כִּי תַרְחִיב לִבִּי ׃
kjv: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.

wlc: הוֹרֵנִי יְהוָה דֶּרֶךְ חֻקֶּיךָ וְאֶצְּרֶנָּה עֵקֶב ׃
kjv: Teach me, O Lord, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.

wlc: הֲבִינֵנִי וְאֶצְּרָה תוֹרָתֶךָ וְאֶשְׁמְרֶנָּה בְכָל־לֵב ׃
kjv: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.

wlc: הַדְרִיכֵנִי בִּנְתִיב מִצְוֹתֶיךָ כִּי־בוֹ חָפָצְתִּי ׃
kjv: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.

wlc: הַט־לִבִּי אֶל־עֵדְוֹתֶיךָ וְאַל אֶל־בָּצַע ׃
kjv: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.

wlc: הַעֲבֵר עֵינַי מֵרְאוֹת שָׁוְא בִּדְרָכֶךָ חַיֵּנִי ׃
kjv: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken thou me in thy way.

wlc: הָקֵם לְעַבְדְּךָ אִמְרָתֶךָ אֲשֶׁר לְיִרְאָתֶךָ ׃
kjv: Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who is devoted to thy fear.

wlc: הַעֲבֵר חֶרְפָּתִי אֲשֶׁר יָגֹרְתִּי כִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ טוֹבִים ׃
kjv: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments are good.

wlc: הִנֵּה תָּאַבְתִּי לְפִקֻּדֶיךָ בְּצִדְקָתְךָ חַיֵּנִי ׃
kjv: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.

wlc: וִיבֹאֻנִי חֲסָדֶךָ יְהוָה תְּשׁוּעָתְךָ כְּאִמְרָתֶךָ ׃
kjv: Let thy mercies come also unto me, O Lord, even thy salvation, according to thy word.

wlc: וְאֶעֱנֶה חֹרְפִי דָבָר כִּי־בָטַחְתִּי בִּדְבָרֶךָ ׃
kjv: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word.

wlc: וְאַל־תַּצֵּל מִפִּי דְבַר־אֱמֶת עַד־מְאֹד כִּי לְמִשְׁפָּטֶךָ יִחָלְתִּי ׃
kjv: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.

wlc: וְאֶשְׁמְרָה תוֹרָתְךָ תָמִיד לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד ׃
kjv: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.

wlc: וְאֶתְהַלְּכָה בָרְחָבָה כִּי פִקֻּדֶיךָ דָרָשְׁתִּי ׃
kjv: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.

wlc: וַאֲדַבְּרָה בְעֵדֹתֶיךָ נֶגֶד מְלָכִים וְלֹא אֵבוֹשׁ ׃
kjv: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.

wlc: וְאֶשְׁתַּעֲשַׁע בְּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר אָהָבְתִּי ׃
kjv: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.

wlc: וְאֶשָּׂא־כַפַּי אֶל־מִצְוֹתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר אָהָבְתִּי וְאָשִׂיחָה בְחֻקֶּיךָ ׃
kjv: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.

wlc: זְכֹר־דָּבָר לְעַבְדֶּךָ עַל אֲשֶׁר יִחַלְתָּנִי ׃
kjv: Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.

wlc: זֹאת נֶחָמָתִי בְעָנְיִי כִּי אִמְרָתְךָ חִיָּתְנִי ׃
kjv: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.

wlc: זֵדִים הֱלִיצֻנִי עַד־מְאֹד מִתּוֹרָתְךָ לֹא נָטִיתִי ׃
kjv: The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from thy law.

wlc: זָכַרְתִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ מֵעוֹלָם יְהוָה וָאֶתְנֶחָם ׃
kjv: I remembered thy judgments of old, O Lord; and have comforted myself.

wlc: זַלְעָפָה אֲחָזַתְנִי מֵרְשָׁעִים עֹזְבֵי תּוֹרָתֶךָ ׃
kjv: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.

wlc: זְמִרוֹת הָיוּ־לִי חֻקֶּיךָ בְּבֵית מְגוּרָי ׃
kjv: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.

wlc: זָכַרְתִּי בַלַּיְלָה שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה וָאֶשְׁמְרָה תּוֹרָתֶךָ ׃
kjv: I have remembered thy name, O Lord, in the night, and have kept thy law.

wlc: זֹאת הָיְתָה־לִּי כִּי פִקֻּדֶיךָ נָצָרְתִּי ׃
kjv: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.

wlc: חֶלְקִי יְהוָה אָמַרְתִּי לִשְׁמֹר דְּבָרֶיךָ ׃
kjv: Thou art my portion, O Lord: I have said that I would keep thy words.

wlc: חִלִּיתִי פָנֶיךָ בְכָל־לֵב חָנֵּנִי כְּאִמְרָתֶךָ ׃
kjv: I intreated thy favour with my whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word.

wlc: חִשַּׁבְתִּי דְרָכָי וָאָשִׁיבָה רַגְלַי אֶל־עֵדֹתֶיךָ ׃
kjv: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.

wlc: חַשְׁתִּי וְלֹא הִתְמַהְמָהְתִּי לִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֹתֶיךָ ׃
kjv: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.

wlc: חֶבְלֵי רְשָׁעִים עִוְּדֻנִי תּוֹרָתְךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי ׃
kjv: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law.

wlc: חֲצוֹת־לַיְלָה אָקוּם לְהוֹדוֹת לָךְ עַל מִשְׁפְּטֵי צִדְקֶךָ ׃
kjv: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.

wlc: חָבֵר אָנִי לְכָל־אֲשֶׁר יְרֵאוּךָ וּלְשֹׁמְרֵי פִּקּוּדֶיךָ ׃
kjv: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.

wlc: חַסְדְּךָ יְהוָה מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ חֻקֶּיךָ לַמְּדֵנִי ׃
kjv: The earth, O Lord, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.

wlc: טוֹב עָשִׂיתָ עִם־עַבְדְּךָ יְהוָה כִּדְבָרֶךָ ׃
kjv: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O Lord, according unto thy word.

wlc: טוּב טַעַם וָדַעַת לַמְּדֵנִי כִּי בְמִצְוֹתֶיךָ הֶאֱמָנְתִּי ׃
kjv: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.

wlc: טֶרֶם אֶעֱנֶה אֲנִי שֹׁגֵג וְעַתָּה אִמְרָתְךָ שָׁמָרְתִּי ׃
kjv: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.

wlc: טוֹב־אַתָּה וּמֵטִיב לַמְּדֵנִי חֻקֶּיךָ ׃
kjv: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.

wlc: טָפְלוּ עָלַי שֶׁקֶר זֵדִים אֲנִי בְּכָל־לֵב אֱצֹּר פִּקּוּדֶיךָ ׃
kjv: The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart.

wlc: טָפַשׁ כַּחֵלֶב לִבָּם אֲנִי תּוֹרָתְךָ שִׁעֲשָׁעְתִּי ׃
kjv: Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in thy law.

wlc: טוֹב־לִי כִי־עֻנֵּיתִי לְמַעַן אֶלְמַד חֻקֶּיךָ ׃
kjv: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.

wlc: טוֹב־לִי תוֹרַת־פִּיךָ מֵאַלְפֵי זָהָב וָכָסֶף ׃
kjv: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.

wlc: יָדֶיךָ עָשׂוּנִי וַיְכוֹנְנוּנִי הֲבִינֵנִי וְאֶלְמְדָה מִצְוֹתֶיךָ ׃
kjv: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.

wlc: יְרֵאֶיךָ יִרְאוּנִי וְיִשְׂמָחוּ כִּי לִדְבָרְךָ יִחָלְתִּי ׃
kjv: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.

wlc: יָדַעְתִּי יְהוָה כִּי־צֶדֶק מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ וֶאֱמוּנָה עִנִּיתָנִי ׃
kjv: I know, O Lord, that thy judgments are right, and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.

wlc: יְהִי־נָא חַסְדְּךָ לְנַחֲמֵנִי כְּאִמְרָתְךָ לְעַבְדֶּךָ ׃
kjv: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.

wlc: יְבֹאוּנִי רַחֲמֶיךָ וְאֶחְיֶה כִּי־תוֹרָתְךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָי ׃
kjv: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law is my delight.

wlc: יֵבֹשׁוּ זֵדִים כִּי־שֶׁקֶר עִוְּתוּנִי אֲנִי אָשִׂיחַ בְּפִקּוּדֶיךָ ׃
kjv: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.

wlc: יָשׁוּבוּ לִי יְרֵאֶיךָ וְיָדְעוּ עֵדֹתֶיךָ ׃
kjv: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.

wlc: יְהִי־לִבִּי תָמִים בְּחֻקֶּיךָ לְמַעַן לֹא אֵבוֹשׁ ׃
kjv: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.

wlc: כָּלְתָה לִתְשׁוּעָתְךָ נַפְשִׁי לִדְבָרְךָ יִחָלְתִּי ׃
kjv: My soul fainteth for thy salvation: but I hope in thy word.

wlc: כָּלוּ עֵינַי לְאִמְרָתֶךָ לֵאמֹר מָתַי תְּנַחֲמֵנִי ׃
kjv: Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?

wlc: כִּי־הָיִיתִי כְּנֹאד בְּקִיטוֹר חֻקֶּיךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי ׃
kjv: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget thy statutes.

wlc: כַּמָּה יְמֵי־עַבְדֶּךָ מָתַי תַּעֲשֶׂה בְרֹדְפַי מִשְׁפָּט ׃
kjv: How many are the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?

wlc: כָּרוּ־לִי זֵדִים שִׁיחוֹת אֲשֶׁר לֹא כְתוֹרָתֶךָ ׃
kjv: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law.

wlc: כָּל־מִצְוֹתֶיךָ אֱמוּנָה שֶׁקֶר רְדָפוּנִי עָזְרֵנִי ׃
kjv: All thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.

wlc: כִּמְעַט כִּלּוּנִי בָאָרֶץ וַאֲנִי לֹא־עָזַבְתִּי פִקֻּודֶיךָ ׃
kjv: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.

wlc: כְּחַסְדְּךָ חַיֵּנִי וְאֶשְׁמְרָה עֵדוּת פִּיךָ ׃
kjv: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.

wlc: לְעוֹלָם יְהוָה דְּבָרְךָ נִצָּב בַּשָּׁמָיִם ׃
kjv: For ever, O Lord, thy word is settled in heaven.

wlc: לְדֹר וָדֹר אֱמוּנָתֶךָ כּוֹנַנְתָּ אֶרֶץ וַתַּעֲמֹד ׃
kjv: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.

wlc: לְמִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ עָמְדוּ הַיּוֹם כִּי הַכֹּל עֲבָדֶיךָ ׃
kjv: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.

wlc: לוּלֵי תוֹרָתְךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָי אָז אָבַדְתִּי בְעָנְיִי ׃
kjv: Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.

wlc: לְעוֹלָם לֹא־אֶשְׁכַּח פִּקּוּדֶיךָ כִּי בָם חִיִּיתָנִי ׃
kjv: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.

wlc: לְךָ־אֲנִי הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי כִּי פִקּוּדֶיךָ דָרָשְׁתִּי ׃
kjv: I am thine, save me: for I have sought thy precepts.

wlc: לִי קִוּוּ רְשָׁעִים לְאַבְּדֵנִי עֵדֹתֶיךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָן ׃
kjv: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies.

wlc: לְכָל תִּכְלָה רָאִיתִי קֵץ רְחָבָה מִצְוָתְךָ מְאֹד ׃
kjv: I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.

wlc: מָה־אָהַבְתִּי תוֹרָתֶךָ כָּל־הַיּוֹם הִיא שִׂיחָתִי ׃
kjv: O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.

wlc: מֵאֹיְבַי תְּחַכְּמֵנִי מִצְוֹתֶךָ כִּי לְעוֹלָם הִיא־לִי ׃
kjv: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me.

wlc: מִכָּל־מְלַמְּדַי הִשְׂכַּלְתִּי כִּי עֵדְוֹתֶיךָ שִׂיחָה לִי ׃
kjv: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation.

wlc: מִזְּקֵנִים אֶתְבּוֹנָן כִּי פִקּוּדֶיךָ נָצָרְתִּי ׃
kjv: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.

wlc: מִכָּל־אֹרַח רָע כָּלִאתִי רַגְלָי לְמַעַן אֶשְׁמֹר דְּבָרֶךָ ׃
kjv: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.

wlc: מִמִּשְׁפָּטֶיךָ לֹא־סָרְתִּי כִּי־אַתָּה הוֹרֵתָנִי ׃
kjv: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.

wlc: מַה־נִּמְלְצוּ לְחִכִּי אִמְרָתֶךָ מִדְּבַשׁ לְפִי ׃
kjv: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!

wlc: מִפִּקּוּדֶיךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָן עַל־כֵּן שָׂנֵאתִי כָּל־אֹרַח שָׁקֶר ׃
kjv: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.

wlc: נֵר־לְרַגְלִי דְבָרֶךָ וְאוֹר לִנְתִיבָתִי ׃
kjv: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

wlc: נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי וָאֲקַיֵּמָה לִשְׁמֹר מִשְׁפְּטֵי צִדְקֶךָ ׃
kjv: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.

wlc: נַעֲנֵיתִי עַד־מְאֹד יְהוָה חַיֵּנִי כִדְבָרֶךָ ׃
kjv: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O Lord, according unto thy word.

wlc: נִדְבוֹת פִּי רְצֵה־נָא יְהוָה וּמִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ לַמְּדֵנִי ׃
kjv: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O Lord, and teach me thy judgments.

wlc: נַפְשִׁי בְכַפִּי תָמִיד וְתוֹרָתְךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי ׃
kjv: My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.

wlc: נָתְנוּ רְשָׁעִים פַּח לִי וּמִפִּקּוּדֶיךָ לֹא תָעִיתִי ׃
kjv: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.

wlc: נָחַלְתִּי עֵדְוֹתֶיךָ לְעוֹלָם כִּי־שְׂשׂוֹן לִבִּי הֵמָּה ׃
kjv: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.

wlc: נָטִיתִי לִבִּי לַעֲשׂוֹת חֻקֶּיךָ לְעוֹלָם עֵקֶב ׃
kjv: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, even unto the end.

wlc: סֵעֲפִים שָׂנֵאתִי וְתוֹרָתְךָ אָהָבְתִּי ׃
kjv: I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.

wlc: סִתְרִי וּמָגִנִּי אָתָּה לִדְבָרְךָ יִחָלְתִּי ׃
kjv: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.

wlc: סוּרוּ־מִמֶּנִּי מְרֵעִים וְאֶצְּרָה מִצְוֹת אֱלֹהָי ׃
kjv: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.

wlc: סָמְכֵנִי כְאִמְרָתְךָ וְאֶחְיֶה וְאַל־תְּבִישֵׁנִי מִשִּׂבְרִי ׃
kjv: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.

wlc: סְעָדֵנִי וְאִוָּשֵׁעָה וְאֶשְׁעָה בְחֻקֶּיךָ תָמִיד ׃
kjv: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.

wlc: סָלִיתָ כָּל־שׁוֹגִים מֵחֻקֶּיךָ כִּי־שֶׁקֶר תַּרְמִיתָם ׃
kjv: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.

wlc: סִגִים הִשְׁבַּתָּ כָל־רִשְׁעֵי־אָרֶץ לָכֵן אָהַבְתִּי עֵדֹתֶיךָ ׃
kjv: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.

wlc: סָמַר מִפַּחְדְּךָ בְשָׂרִי וּמִמִּשְׁפָּטֶיךָ יָרֵאתִי ׃
kjv: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.

wlc: עָשִׂיתִי מִשְׁפָּט וָצֶדֶק בַּל־תַּנִּיחֵנִי לְעֹשְׁקָי ׃
kjv: I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.

wlc: עֲרֹב עַבְדְּךָ לְטוֹב אַל־יַעַשְׁקֻנִי זֵדִים ׃
kjv: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.

wlc: עֵינַי כָּלוּ לִישׁוּעָתֶךָ וּלְאִמְרַת צִדְקֶךָ ׃
kjv: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.

wlc: עֲשֵׂה עִם־עַבְדְּךָ כְחַסְדֶּךָ וְחֻקֶּיךָ לַמְּדֵנִי ׃
kjv: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.

wlc: עַבְדְּךָ־אָנִי הֲבִינֵנִי וְאֵדְעָה עֵדֹתֶיךָ ׃
kjv: I am thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.

wlc: עֵת לַעֲשׂוֹת לַיהוָה הֵפֵרוּ תּוֹרָתֶךָ ׃
kjv: It is time for thee, Lord, to work: for they have made void thy law.

wlc: עַל־כֵּן אָהַבְתִּי מִצְוֹתֶיךָ מִזָּהָב וּמִפָּז ׃
kjv: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.

wlc: עַל־כֵּן כָּל־פִּקּוּדֵי כֹל יִשָּׁרְתִּי כָּל־אֹרַח שֶׁקֶר שָׂנֵאתִי ׃
kjv: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.

wlc: פְּלָאוֹת עֵדְוֹתֶיךָ עַל־כֵּן נְצָרָתַם נַפְשִׁי ׃
kjv: Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.

wlc: פֵּתַח דְּבָרֶיךָ יָאִיר מֵבִין פְּתָיִים ׃
kjv: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.

wlc: פִּי־פָעַרְתִּי וָאֶשְׁאָפָה כִּי לְמִצְוֹתֶיךָ יָאָבְתִּי ׃
kjv: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.

wlc: פְּנֵה־אֵלַי וְחָנֵּנִי כְּמִשְׁפָּט לְאֹהֲבֵי שְׁמֶךָ ׃
kjv: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.

wlc: פְּעָמַי הָכֵן בְּאִמְרָתֶךָ וְאַל־תַּשְׁלֶט־בִּי כָל־אָוֶן ׃
kjv: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.

wlc: פְּדֵנִי מֵעֹשֶׁק אָדָם וְאֶשְׁמְרָה פִּקּוּדֶיךָ ׃
kjv: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.

wlc: פָּנֶיךָ הָאֵר בְּעַבְדֶּךָ וְלַמְּדֵנִי אֶת־חֻקֶּיךָ ׃
kjv: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.

wlc: פַּלְגֵי־מַיִם יָרְדוּ עֵינָי עַל לֹא־שָׁמְרוּ תוֹרָתֶךָ ׃
kjv: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.

wlc: צַדִּיק אַתָּה יְהוָה וְיָשָׁר מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ ׃
kjv: Righteous art thou, O Lord, and upright are thy judgments.

wlc: צִוִּיתָ צֶדֶק עֵדֹתֶיךָ וֶאֱמוּנָה מְאֹד ׃
kjv: Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful.

wlc: צִמְּתַתְנִי קִנְאָתִי כִּי־שָׁכְחוּ דְבָרֶיךָ צָרָי ׃
kjv: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.

wlc: צְרוּפָה אִמְרָתְךָ מְאֹד וְעַבְדְּךָ אֲהֵבָהּ ׃
kjv: Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.

wlc: צָעִיר אָנֹכִי וְנִבְזֶה פִּקֻּדֶיךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי ׃
kjv: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.

wlc: צִדְקָתְךָ צֶדֶק לְעוֹלָם וְתוֹרָתְךָ אֱמֶת ׃
kjv: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.

wlc: צַר־וּמָצוֹק מְצָאוּנִי מִצְוֹתֶיךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָי ׃
kjv: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights.

wlc: צֶדֶק עֵדְוֹתֶיךָ לְעוֹלָם הֲבִינֵנִי וְאֶחְיֶה ׃
kjv: The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.

wlc: קָרָאתִי בְכָל־לֵב עֲנֵנִי יְהוָה חֻקֶּיךָ אֶצֹּרָה ׃
kjv: I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O Lord: I will keep thy statutes.

wlc: קְרָאתִיךָ הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי וְאֶשְׁמְרָה עֵדֹתֶיךָ ׃
kjv: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.

wlc: קִדַּמְתִּי בַנֶּשֶׁף וָאֲשַׁוֵּעָה לִדְבָרֶיךָ יִחָלְתִּי ׃
kjv: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.

wlc: קִדְּמוּ עֵינַי אַשְׁמֻרוֹת לָשִׂיחַ בְּאִמְרָתֶךָ ׃
kjv: Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.

wlc: קוֹלִי שִׁמְעָה כְחַסְדֶּךָ יְהוָה כְּמִשְׁפָּטֶךָ חַיֵּנִי ׃
kjv: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O Lord, quicken me according to thy judgment.

wlc: קָרְבוּ רֹדְפֵי זִמָּה מִתּוֹרָתְךָ רָחָקוּ ׃
kjv: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.

wlc: קָרוֹב אַתָּה יְהוָה וְכָל־מִצְוֹתֶיךָ אֱמֶת ׃
kjv: Thou art near, O Lord; and all thy commandments are truth.

wlc: קֶדֶם יָדַעְתִּי מֵעֵדֹתֶיךָ כִּי לְעוֹלָם יְסַדְתָּם ׃
kjv: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.

wlc: רְאֵה־עָנְיִי וְחַלְּצֵנִי כִּי־תוֹרָתְךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי ׃
kjv: Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.

wlc: רִיבָה רִיבִי וּגְאָלֵנִי לְאִמְרָתְךָ חַיֵּנִי ׃
kjv: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.

wlc: רָחוֹק מֵרְשָׁעִים יְשׁוּעָה כִּי־חֻקֶּיךָ לֹא דָרָשׁוּ ׃
kjv: Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.

wlc: רַחֲמֶיךָ רַבִּים יְהוָה כְּמִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ חַיֵּנִי ׃
kjv: Great are thy tender mercies, O Lord: quicken me according to thy judgments.

wlc: רַבִּים רֹדְפַי וְצָרָי מֵעֵדְוֹתֶיךָ לֹא נָטִיתִי ׃
kjv: Many are my persecutors and mine enemies; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies.

wlc: רָאִיתִי בֹגְדִים וָאֶתְקוֹטָטָה אֲשֶׁר אִמְרָתְךָ לֹא שָׁמָרוּ ׃
kjv: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.

wlc: רְאֵה כִּי־פִקּוּדֶיךָ אָהָבְתִּי יְהוָה כְּחַסְדְּךָ חַיֵּנִי ׃
kjv: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O Lord, according to thy lovingkindness.

wlc: רֹאשׁ־דְּבָרְךָ אֱמֶת וּלְעוֹלָם כָּל־מִשְׁפַּט צִדְקֶךָ ׃
kjv: Thy word is true from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever.

wlc: שָׂרִים רְדָפוּנִי חִנָּם וּמִדְּבָרֶיךָ פָּחַד לִבִּי ׃
kjv: Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.

wlc: שָׂשׂ אָנֹכִי עַל־אִמְרָתֶךָ כְּמוֹצֵא שָׁלָל רָב ׃
kjv: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.

wlc: שֶׁקֶר שָׂנֵאתִי וַאֲתַעֵבָה תּוֹרָתְךָ אָהָבְתִּי ׃
kjv: I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.

wlc: שֶׁבַע בַּיּוֹם הִלַּלְתִּיךָ עַל מִשְׁפְּטֵי צִדְקֶךָ ׃
kjv: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.

wlc: שָׁלוֹם רָב לְאֹהֲבֵי תוֹרָתֶךָ וְאֵין־לָמוֹ מִכְשׁוֹל ׃
kjv: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.

wlc: שִׂבַּרְתִּי לִישׁוּעָתְךָ יְהוָה וּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ עָשִׂיתִי ׃
kjv: Lord, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.

wlc: שָׁמְרָה נַפְשִׁי עֵדֹתֶיךָ וָאֹהֲבֵם מְאֹד ׃
kjv: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.

wlc: שָׁמַרְתִּי פִקּוּדֶיךָ וְעֵדֹתֶיךָ כִּי כָל־דְּרָכַי נֶגְדֶּךָ ׃
kjv: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways are before thee.

wlc: תִּקְרַב רִנָּתִי לְפָנֶיךָ יְהוָה כִּדְבָרְךָ הֲבִינֵנִי ׃
kjv: Let my cry come near before thee, O Lord: give me understanding according to thy word.

wlc: תָּבוֹא תְּחִנָּתִי לְפָנֶיךָ כְּאִמְרָתְךָ הַצִּילֵנִי ׃
kjv: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.

wlc: תַּבַּעְנָה שְׂפָתַי תְּהִלָּה כִּי תְלַמְּדֵנִי חֻקֶּיךָ ׃
kjv: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.

wlc: תַּעַן לְשׁוֹנִי אִמְרָתֶךָ כִּי כָל־מִצְוֹתֶיךָ צֶּדֶק ׃
kjv: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments are righteousness.

wlc: תְּהִי־יָדְךָ לְעָזְרֵנִי כִּי פִקּוּדֶיךָ בָחָרְתִּי ׃
kjv: Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.

wlc: תָּאַבְתִּי לִישׁוּעָתְךָ יְהוָה וְתוֹרָתְךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָי ׃
kjv: I have longed for thy salvation, O Lord; and thy law is my delight.

wlc: תְּחִי־נַפְשִׁי וּתְהַלְלֶךָּ וּמִשְׁפָּטֶךָ יַעֲזְרֻנִי ׃
kjv: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.

wlc: תָּעִיתִי כְּשֶׂה אֹבֵד בַּקֵּשׁ עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי מִצְוֹתֶיךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי ׃
lxx: ᾨδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν.
kjv: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.

wlc: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת אֶל־יְהוָה בַּצָּרָתָה לִּי קָרָאתִי וַיַּעֲנֵנִי ׃
lxx: Ἦρα τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου εἰς τὰ ὄρη· πόθεν ἥξει ἡ βοήθειά
vulg: canticum graduum levavi oculos meos in montes unde veniet auxilium mihi
clem: Canticum graduum. [Levavi oculos meos in montes, unde veniet auxilium mihi.
kjv: In my distress I cried unto the Lord, and he heard me.

wlc: יְהוָה הַצִּילָה נַפְשִׁי מִשְּׂפַת־שֶׁקֶר מִלָּשׁוֹן רְמִיָּה ׃
lxx: ἡ βοήθειά μου παρὰ Κυρίου τοῦ ποιήσαντος τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν.
vulg: auxilium meum a Domino qui fecit caelum et terram
clem: Auxilium meum a Domino, qui fecit clum et terram.
kjv: Deliver my soul, O Lord, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.

wlc: מַה־יִּתֵּן לְךָ וּמַה־יֹּסִיף לָךְ לָשׁוֹן רְמִיָּה ׃
lxx: μὴ δῷς εἰς σάλον τὸν πόδα σου, μηδέ νυστάξει ὁ φυλάσσων σε.
vulg: non det in commotionem pedem tuum neque dormitet qui custodit te
clem: Non det in commotionem pedem tuum, neque dormitet qui custodit te.
kjv: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?

wlc: חִצֵּי גִבּוֹר שְׁנוּנִים עִם גַּחֲלֵי רְתָמִים ׃
lxx: ἰδοὺ οὐ νυστάξει οὐδὲ ἐξυπνώσει ὁ φυλάσσων τὸν Ἰσραήλ.
vulg: ecce non dormitabit neque dormiet qui custodit Israhel
clem: Ecce non dormitabit neque dormiet qui custodit Isral.
kjv: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

wlc: אוֹיָה־לִי כִּי־גַרְתִּי מֶשֶׁךְ שָׁכַנְתִּי עִם־אָהֳלֵי קֵדָר ׃
lxx: Κύριος φυλάξει σε, Κύριος σκέπη σου ἐπὶ χεῖρα δεξιάν σου·
vulg: Dominus custodit te Dominus protectio tua super manum dexteram tuam
clem: Dominus custodit te; Dominus protectio tua super manum dexteram tuam.
kjv: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!

wlc: רַבַּת שָׁכְנָה־לָּהּ נַפְשִׁי עִם שׂוֹנֵא שָׁלוֹם ׃
lxx: ἡμέρας ὁ ἥλιος οὐκ ἐκκαύσει σε, καὶ ἡ σελήνη τὴν νύκτα.
vulg: per diem sol non uret te neque luna per noctem
clem: Per diem sol non uret te, neque luna per noctem.
kjv: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.

wlc: אֲנִי־שָׁלוֹם וְכִי אֲדַבֵּר הֵמָּה לַמִּלְחָמָה ׃
lxx: Ὠδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν. Κύριος φυλάξει σε ἀπὸ παντὸς κακοῦ, φυλάξαι τὴν ψυχήν σου.
vulg: Dominus custodit te ab omni malo custodiat animam tuam Dominus
clem: Dominus custodit te ab omni malo; custodiat animam tuam Dominus.
kjv: I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.

lxx: Κύριος φυλάξει τὴν εἴσοδόν σου καὶ τὴν ἔξοδόν σου ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν καὶ ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος.
vulg: Dominus custodiat introitum tuum et exitum tuum ex hoc nunc et usque in saeculum
clem: Dominus custodiat introitum tuum et exitum tuum, ex hoc nunc et usque in sculum.]

wlc: שִׁיר לַמַּעֲלוֹת אֶשָּׂא עֵינַי אֶל־הֶהָרִים מֵאַיִן יָבֹא עֶזְרִי ׃
lxx: ὐφράνθην ἐπὶ τοῖς εἰρηκόσιν μοι Εἰς οἶκον Κυρίου πορευσόμεθα·
vulg: canticum graduum huic David laetatus sum in his quae dicta sunt mihi in domum Domini ibimus
clem: Canticum graduum. [Ltatus sum in his qu dicta sunt mihi: In domum Domini ibimus.
kjv: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.

wlc: עֶזְרִי מֵעִם יְהוָה עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ ׃
lxx: ἑστῶτες ἦσαν οἱ πόδες ἡμῶν ἐν ταῖς αὐλαῖς Ἰερουσαλήμ.
vulg: stantes erant pedes nostri in atriis tuis Hierusalem
clem: Stantes erant pedes nostri in atriis tuis, Jerusalem.
kjv: My help cometh from the Lord, which made heaven and earth.

wlc: אַל־יִתֵּן לַמּוֹט רַגְלֶךָ אַל־יָנוּם שֹׁמְרֶךָ ׃
lxx: Ἰερουσαλὴμ οἰκοδομουμένη ὡς πόλις ἧς ἡ μετοχὴ αὐτῆς ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό.
vulg: Hierusalem quae aedificatur ut civitas cuius participatio eius in id ipsum
clem: Jerusalem, qu dificatur ut civitas, cujus participatio ejus in idipsum.
kjv: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.

wlc: הִנֵּה לֹא־יָנוּם וְלֹא יִישָׁן שׁוֹמֵר יִשְׂרָאֵל ׃
lxx: ἐκεῖ γὰρ ἀνέβησαν αἱ φυλαὶ Κυρίου, μαρτύριον τοῦ Ἰσραήλ, τοῦ ἐξομολογήσασθαι τῷ ὀνόματι Κυρίου·
vulg: illic enim ascenderunt tribus tribus Domini testimonium Israhel ad confitendum nomini Domini
clem: Illuc enim ascenderunt tribus, tribus Domini: testimonium Isral, ad confitendum nomini Domini.
kjv: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.

wlc: יְהוָה שֹׁמְרֶךָ יְהוָה צִלְּךָ עַל־יַד יְמִינֶךָ ׃
lxx: ὅτι ἐκεῖ ἐκάθισαν θρόνοι εἰς κρίσιν, θρόνοι ἐπὶ οἶκον Δαυείδ,
vulg: quia illic sederunt sedes in iudicium sedes super domum David
clem: Quia illic sederunt sedes in judicio, sedes super domum David.
kjv: The Lord is thy keeper: the Lord is thy shade upon thy right hand.

wlc: יוֹמָם הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ לֹא־יַכֶּכָּה וְיָרֵחַ בַּלָּיְלָה ׃
lxx: καὶ εὐθηνία τοῖς ἀγαπῶσίν σε· ἐρωτήσατε δὴ τὰ εἰς εἰρήνην τῇ Ἰερουσαλήμ.
vulg: rogate quae ad pacem sunt Hierusalem et abundantia diligentibus te
clem: Rogate qu ad pacem sunt Jerusalem, et abundantia diligentibus te.
kjv: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.

wlc: יְהוָה יִשְׁמָרְךָ מִכָּל־רָע יִשְׁמֹר אֶת־נַפְשֶׁךָ ׃
lxx: γενέσθω δὴ εἰρήνη σου ἐν τῇ δυνάμει σου, καὶ εὐθηνία ἐν τοῖς πυργοβάρεσίν σου,
vulg: fiat pax in virtute tua et abundantia in turribus tuis
clem: Fiat pax in virtute tua, et abundantia in turribus tuis.
kjv: The Lord shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.

wlc: יְהוָה יִשְׁמָר־צֵאתְךָ וּבוֹאֶךָ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם ׃
lxx: Ὠδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν· τῷ Δαυείδ. ἔνεκα τῶν ἀδελφῶν μου καὶ τῶν πλησίον μου. ἐλάλουν δὲ εἰρήνην περὶ σοῦ·
vulg: propter fratres meos et proximos meos loquebar pacem de te
clem: Propter fratres meos et proximos meos, loquebar pacem de te.
kjv: The Lord shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.

lxx: ἕνεκα τοῦ οἴκου Κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἐξεζήτησά σοι.
vulg: propter domum Domini Dei nostri quaesivi bona tibi
clem: Propter domum Domini Dei nostri, qusivi bona tibi.]

wlc: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת לְדָוִד שָׂמַחְתִּי בְּאֹמְרִים לִי בֵּית יְהוָה נֵלֵךְ ׃
lxx: Πρὸς σὲ ἦρα τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου, τὸν κατοικοῦντα ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ.
vulg: canticum graduum ad te levavi oculos meos qui habitas in caelo
clem: Canticum graduum. [Ad te levavi oculos meos, qui habitas in clis.
kjv: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the Lord.

wlc: עֹמְדוֹת הָיוּ רַגְלֵינוּ בִּשְׁעָרַיִךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָם ׃
lxx: ἰδοὺ ὡς ὀφθαλμοὶ δούλων εἰς χεῖρας τῶν κυρίων αὐτῶν, ὣς ὀφθαλμοὶ παιδίσκης εἰς χεῖρας τῆς κυρίας αὐτῆς, οὕτως οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ἡμῶν πρὸς Κύριον τὸν θεὸν ἡμῶν, ἕως οὗ οἰκτειρῆσαι ἡμᾶς.
vulg: ecce sicut oculi servorum in manibus dominorum suorum sicut oculi ancillae in manibus dominae eius ita oculi nostri ad Dominum Deum nostrum donec misereatur nostri
clem: Ecce sicut oculi servorum in manibus dominorum suorum; sicut oculi ancill in manibus domin su: ita oculi nostri ad Dominum Deum nostrum, donec misereatur nostri.
kjv: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.

wlc: יְרוּשָׁלַםִ הַבְּנוּיָה כְּעִיר שֶׁחֻבְּרָה־לָּהּ יַחְדָּו ׃
lxx: ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς, Κύριε, ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς. ὅτι ἐπὶ πολὺ ἐπληθύνθημεν ἐξουδενώσεως·
vulg: miserere nostri Domine miserere nostri quia multum repleti sumus despectione
clem: Miserere nostri, Domine, miserere nostri, quia multum repleti sumus despectione;
kjv: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:

wlc: שֶׁשָּׁם עָלוּ שְׁבָטִים שִׁבְטֵי־יָהּ עֵדוּת לְיִשְׂרָאֵל לְהֹדוֹת לְשֵׁם יְהוָה ׃
lxx: ἐπὶ πλεῖον ἐπληθύνθη ἡ ψυχὴ ἡμῶν· τὸ ὄνειδος τοῖς εὐθηνοῦσιν καὶ ἡ ἐξουδένωσις τοῖς ὑπερηφάνοις.
vulg: quia multum repleta est anima nostra obprobrium abundantibus et despectio superbis
clem: quia multum repleta est anima nostra opprobrium abundantibus, et despectio superbis.]
kjv: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the Lord, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the Lord.

wlc: כִּי שָׁמָּה יָשְׁבוּ כִסְאוֹת לְמִשְׁפָּט כִּסְאוֹת לְבֵית דָּוִיד ׃
kjv: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.

wlc: שַׁאֲלוּ שְׁלוֹם יְרוּשָׁלִָם יִשְׁלָיוּ אֹהֲבָיִךְ ׃
kjv: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.

wlc: יְהִי־שָׁלוֹם בְּחֵילֵךְ שַׁלְוָה בְּאַרְמְנוֹתָיִךְ ׃
kjv: Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.

wlc: לְמַעַן אַחַי וְרֵעָי אֲדַבְּרָה־נָּא שָׁלוֹם בָּךְ ׃
kjv: For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.

wlc: לְמַעַן בֵּית־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֲבַקְשָׁה טוֹב לָךְ ׃
lxx: ᾨδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν.
kjv: Because of the house of the Lord our God I will seek thy good.

wlc: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת אֵלֶיךָ נָשָׂאתִי אֶת־עֵינַי הַיֹּשְׁבִי בַּשָּׁמָיִם ׃
lxx: Εί μὴ ὅτι Κύριος ἦν ἐν ἡμῖν, εἰπάτω δὴ Ἰσραήλ,
vulg: canticum graduum huic David nisi quia Dominus erat in nobis dicat nunc Israhel
clem: Canticum graduum. [Nisi quia Dominus erat in nobis, dicat nunc Isral,
kjv: Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.

wlc: הִנֵּה כְעֵינֵי עֲבָדִים אֶל־יַד אֲדוֹנֵיהֶם כְּעֵינֵי שִׁפְחָה אֶל־יַד גְּבִרְתָּהּ כֵּן עֵינֵינוּ אֶל־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ עַד שֶׁיְּחָנֵּנוּ ׃
lxx: εἰ μὴ ὅτι Κύριος ἦν ἐν ἡμῖν, ἐν τῷ ἐπαναστῆναι ἀνθρώπους ἐφʼ ἡμᾶς,
vulg: nisi quia Dominus erat in nobis cum exsurgerent in nos homines
clem: nisi quia Dominus erat in nobis: cum exsurgerent homines in nos,
kjv: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon the Lord our God, until that he have mercy upon us.

wlc: חָנֵּנוּ יְהוָה חָנֵּנוּ כִּי־רַב שָׂבַעְנוּ בוּז ׃
lxx: ἄρα ζῶντας ἂν κατέπιον ἡμᾶς, ἐν τῷ ὀργισθῆναι τὸν θυμὸν αὐτῶν ἐφʼ ἡμᾶς.
vulg: forte vivos degluttissent nos cum irasceretur furor eorum in nos
clem: forte vivos deglutissent nos; cum irasceretur furor eorum in nos,
kjv: Have mercy upon us, O Lord, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.

wlc: רַבַּת שָׂבְעָה־לָּהּ נַפְשֵׁנוּ הַלַּעַג הַשַּׁאֲנַנִּים הַבּוּז לִגְאֵיוֹנִים ׃
lxx: ᾨδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν· τῷ Δαυείδ. ἄρα τὸ ὕδωρ κατεπόντισεν ἡμᾶς, χείμαρρον διῆλθεν ἡ ψυχὴ ἡμῶν·
vulg: forsitan aqua absorbuisset nos
clem: forsitan aqua absorbuisset nos;
kjv: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.

lxx: ἄρα διῆλθεν ἡ ψυχὴ ἡμῶν τὸ ὕδωρ τὸ ἀνυπόστατον.
vulg: torrentem pertransivit anima nostra forsitan pertransisset anima nostra aquam intolerabilem
clem: torrentem pertransivit anima nostra; forsitan pertransisset anima nostra aquam intolerabilem.

lxx: εὐλογητὸς Κύριος ὃς οὐκ ἔδωκεν ἡμᾶς εἰς θήραν τοῖς ὀδοῦσιν αὐτῶν.
vulg: benedictus Dominus qui non dedit nos in captionem dentibus eorum
clem: Benedictus Dominus, qui non dedit nos in captionem dentibus eorum.

lxx: ἡ ψυχὴ ἡμῶν ὡς στρουθίον ἐρρύσθη ἐκ τῆς παγίδος τῶν θηρευόντων· ἡ παγὶς συνετερἴβη, καὶ ἡμεῖς ἐρύσθημεν.
vulg: anima nostra sicut passer erepta est de laqueo venantium laqueus contritus est et nos liberati sumus
clem: Anima nostra sicut passer erepta est de laqueo venantium; laqueus contritus est, et nos liberati sumus.

lxx: βοήθεια ἡμῶν ἐν ὀνόματι Κυρίου τοῦ ποιήσαντος τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν.
vulg: adiutorium nostrum in nomine Domini qui fecit caelum et terram
clem: Adjutorium nostrum in nomine Domini, qui fecit clum et terram.]

wlc: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת לְדָוִד לוּלֵי יְהוָה שֶׁהָיָה לָנוּ יֹאמַר־נָא יִשְׂרָאֵל ׃
lxx: Οἱ πεποιθότες ἐπὶ Κύριον ὡς ὄρος Σιῶν· οὐ σαλευθήσεται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ὁ κατοικῶν Ἰερουσαλήμ.
vulg: canticum graduum qui confidunt in Domino sicut mons Sion non commovebitur in aeternum qui habitat
clem: Canticum graduum. [Qui confidunt in Domino, sicut mons Sion: non commovebitur in ternum, qui habitat
kjv: If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, now may Israel say;

wlc: לוּלֵי יְהוָה שֶׁהָיָה לָנוּ בְּקוּם עָלֵינוּ אָדָם ׃
lxx: ὄρη κύκλῳ αὐτῆς, καὶ Κύριος κύκλῳ τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν καὶ ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος.
vulg: in Hierusalem montes in circuitu eius et Dominus in circuitu populi sui ex hoc nunc et usque in saeculum
clem: in Jerusalem. Montes in circuitu ejus; et Dominus in circuitu populi sui, ex hoc nunc et usque in sculum.
kjv: If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, when men rose up against us:

wlc: אֲזַי חַיִּים בְּלָעוּנוּ בַּחֲרוֹת אַפָּם בָּנוּ ׃
lxx: ὅτι οὐκ ἀφήσει τὴν ῥάβδον τῶν ἁμαρτωλῶν ἐπὶ τὸν κλῆρον τῶν δικαίων. ὅπως ἂν μὴ ἐκτείνωσιν οἱ δίκαιοι ἐν ἀνομίᾳ χεῖρας αὐτῶν.
vulg: quia non relinquet virgam peccatorum super sortem iustorum ut non extendant iusti ad iniquitatem manus suas
clem: Quia non relinquet Dominus virgam peccatorum super sortem justorum: ut non extendant justi ad iniquitatem manus suas,
kjv: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:

wlc: אֲזַי הַמַּיִם שְׁטָפוּנוּ נַחְלָה עָבַר עַל־נַפְשֵׁנוּ ׃
lxx: ἀγάθυνον, Κύριε, τοῖς ἀγαθοῖς καὶ τοῖς εὐθέσι τῇ καρδίᾳ·
vulg: benefac Domine bonis et rectis corde
clem: benefac, Domine, bonis, et rectis corde.
kjv: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:

wlc: אֲזַי עָבַר עַל־נַפְשֵׁנוּ הַמַּיִם הַזֵּידוֹנִים ׃
lxx: τοὺς δὲ ἐκκλίνοντας εἰς τὰς στραγγαλιὰς ἀπάξει Κύριος μετὰ τῶν ἐργαζομένων τὴν ἀνομίαν. εἰρήνη ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰσραήλ.
vulg: declinantes autem in obligationes adducet Dominus cum operantibus iniquitatem pax super Israhel
clem: Declinantes autem in obligationes, adducet Dominus cum operantibus iniquitatem. Pax super Isral!]
kjv: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.

wlc: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה שֶׁלֹּא נְתָנָנוּ טֶרֶף לְשִׁנֵּיהֶם ׃
kjv: Blessed be the Lord, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.

wlc: נַפְשֵׁנוּ כְּצִפּוֹר נִמְלְטָה מִפַּח יוֹקְשִׁים הַפַּח נִשְׁבָּר וַאֲנַחְנוּ נִמְלָטְנוּ ׃
kjv: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.

wlc: עֶזְרֵנוּ בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ ׃
lxx: ᾨδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν.
kjv: Our help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth.

wlc: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת הַבֹּטְחִים בַּיהוָה כְּהַר־צִיּוֹן לֹא־יִמּוֹט לְעוֹלָם יֵשֵׁב ׃
lxx: ᾨδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν. Ἐν τῷ ἐπιστρέψαι Κύριον τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν Σιὼν ἐγενήθημεν ὡς παρακεκλημένοι.
vulg: canticum graduum in convertendo Dominum captivitatem Sion facti sumus sicut consolati
clem: Canticum graduum. [In convertendo Dominus captivitatem Sion, facti sumus sicut consolati.
kjv: They that trust in the Lord shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.

wlc: יְרוּשָׁלַםִ הָרִים סָבִיב לָהּ וַיהוָה סָבִיב לְעַמּוֹ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם ׃
lxx: τότε ἐπλήσθη χαρᾶς τὸ στόμα ἡμῶν καὶ ἡ γλῶσσα ἡμῶν ἀγαλλιάσεως· τότε ἐροῦσιν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν Ἐμεγάλυνεν Κύριος τοῦ ποιῆσαι μετʼ αὐτῶν.
vulg: tunc repletum est gaudio os nostrum et lingua nostra exultatione tunc dicent inter gentes magnificavit Dominus facere cum eis
clem: Tunc repletum est gaudio os nostrum, et lingua nostra exsultatione. Tunc dicent inter gentes: Magnificavit Dominus facere cum eis.
kjv: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the Lord is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.

wlc: כִּי לֹא יָנוּחַ שֵׁבֶט הָרֶשַׁע עַל גּוֹרַל הַצַּדִּיקִים לְמַעַן לֹא־יִשְׁלְחוּ הַצַּדִּיקִים בְּעַוְלָתָה יְדֵיהֶם ׃
lxx: ἐμεγάλυνεν Κύριος τοῦ ποιῆσαι μεθʼ ἡμῶν, ἐγενήθημεν εὐφραινόμενοι.
vulg: magnificavit Dominus facere nobiscum facti sumus laetantes
clem: Magnificavit Dominus facere nobiscum; facti sumus ltantes.
kjv: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.

wlc: הֵיטִיבָה יְהוָה לַטּוֹבִים וְלִישָׁרִים בְּלִבּוֹתָם ׃
lxx: ἐπίστρεψον, Κύριε. τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν ἡμῶν ὡς ὁ χειμάρρους ἐν τῷ νότῳ.
vulg: converte Domine captivitatem nostram sicut torrens in austro
clem: Converte, Domine, captivitatem nostram, sicut torrens in austro.
kjv: Do good, O Lord, unto those that be good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.

wlc: וְהַמַּטִּים עַקַלְקַלּוֹתָם יוֹלִיכֵם יְהוָה אֶת־פֹּעֲלֵי הָאָוֶן שָׁלוֹם עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל ׃
lxx: οἱ σπείροντες ἐν δάκρυσιν ἐν ἀγαλλιάσει θεριοῦσιν.
vulg: qui seminant in lacrimis in exultatione metent
clem: Qui seminant in lacrimis, in exsultatione metent.
kjv: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the Lord shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Israel.

lxx: πορευόμενοι ἐπορεύοντο, καὶ ἔκλαιον αἴροντες τὰ σπέρματα αὐτῶν· ἐρχόμενοι δὲ ἥξουσιν ἐυ ἀγαλλιάσει αἴροντες τὰ δράγματα αὐτῶν.
vulg: euntes ibant et flebant portantes semina sua venientes autem venient in exultatione portantes manipulos suos
clem: Euntes ibant et flebant, mittentes semina sua. Venientes autem venient cum exsultatione, portantes manipulos suos.]

wlc: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת בְּשׁוּב יְהוָה אֶת־שִׁיבַת צִיּוֹן הָיִינוּ כְּחֹלְמִים ׃
lxx: Ἐὰν μὴ Κύριος οἰκοδομήσῃ οἶκον, εἰς μάτην ἐκοπίασαν οἱ οἰκοδομοῦντες αὐτόν· ἐὰν μὴ Κύριος φυλάξῃ πόλιν, εἰς μάτην ἠγρύπνησεν ὁ φυλάσσαων.
vulg: canticum graduum Salomonis nisi Dominus aedificaverit domum in vanum laboraverunt qui aedificant eam nisi Dominus custodierit civitatem frustra vigilavit qui custodit
clem: Canticum graduum Salomonis. [Nisi Dominus dificaverit domum, in vanum laboraverunt qui dificant eam. Nisi Dominus custodierit civitatem, frustra vigilat qui custodit eam.
kjv: When the Lord turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.

wlc: אָז יִמָּלֵא שְׂחוֹק פִּינוּ וּלְשׁוֹנֵנוּ רִנָּה אָז יֹאמְרוּ בַגּוֹיִם הִגְדִּיל יְהוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת עִם־אֵלֶּה ׃
lxx: εἰς μάτην ἐστὶν ὑμῖν τοῦ ὀρθρίζειν, ἐγείρεσθαι μετὰ τὸ καθῆσθαι, οἱ ἔσθοντες ἄρτον ὀδύνης, ὅταν δῷ τοῖς ἀγαπητοῖς αὐτοῦ ὕπνον.
vulg: vanum est vobis ante lucem surgere surgere postquam sederitis qui manducatis panem doloris cum dederit dilectis suis somnum
clem: Vanum est vobis ante lucem surgere: surgite postquam sederitis, qui manducatis panem doloris. Cum dederit dilectis suis somnum,
kjv: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The Lord hath done great things for them.

wlc: הִגְדִּיל יְהוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת עִמָּנוּ הָיִינוּ שְׂמֵחִים ׃
lxx: δοῦ ἡ κληρονομία Κυρίου υἱοί, ὁ μισθὸς τοῦ καρποῦ τῆς γαστρὸς αὐτῆς.
vulg: ecce hereditas Domini filii mercis fructus ventris
clem: ecce hreditas Domini, filii; merces, fructus ventris.
kjv: The Lord hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.

wlc: שׁוּבָה יְהוָה אֶת־שְׁבוּתֵנוּ כַּאֲפִיקִים בַּנֶּגֶב ׃
lxx: ὡσεὶ βέλη ἐν χειρὶ δυνατοῦ, οὕτως οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν ἐκτετιναγμένων.
vulg: sicut sagittae in manu potentis ita filii excussorum
clem: Sicut sagitt in manu potentis, ita filii excussorum.
kjv: Turn again our captivity, O Lord, as the streams in the south.

wlc: הַזֹּרְעִים בְּדִמְעָה בְּרִנָּה יִקְצֹרוּ ׃
lxx: μακάριος ὃς πληρώσει τὴν ἐπιθυρίαν αὐτοῦ ἐξ αὐτῶν· οὐ καταισχυνθήσεται, ὅταν λαλῶσι τοῖς ἐχθροῖς αὐτῶν ἐν πύλῃ.
vulg: beatus vir qui implebit desiderium suum ex ipsis non confundentur cum loquentur inimicis suis in porta
clem: Beatus vir qui implevit desiderium suum ex ipsis: non confundetur cum loquetur inimicis suis in porta.]
kjv: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.

wlc: הָלוֹךְ יֵלֵךְ וּבָכֹה נֹשֵׂא מֶשֶׁךְ־הַזָּרַע בֹּא־יָבוֹא בְרִנָּה נֹשֵׂא אֲלֻמֹּתָיו ׃
lxx: ᾨδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν.
kjv: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.

wlc: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת לִשְׁלֹמֹה אִם־יְהוָה לֹא־יִבְנֶה בַיִת שָׁוְא עָמְלוּ בוֹנָיו בּוֹ אִם־יְהוָה לֹא־יִשְׁמָר־עִיר שָׁוְא שָׁקַד שׁוֹמֵר ׃
lxx: Μακάριοι πάντες οἱ φοβούμενοι τὸν κύριον, οἱ πορευόμενοι ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτοῦ.
vulg: canticum graduum beati omnes qui timent Dominum qui ambulant in viis eius
clem: Canticum graduum. [Beati omnes qui timent Dominum, qui ambulant in viis ejus.
kjv: Except the Lord build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the Lord keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.

wlc: שָׁוְא לָכֶם מַשְׁכִּימֵי קוּם מְאַחֲרֵי־שֶׁבֶת אֹכְלֵי לֶחֶם הָעֲצָבִים כֵּן יִתֵּן לִידִידוֹ שֵׁנָא ׃
lxx: τοὺς καρποὺς τῶν πόνων. σου φάγεσαι, μακάριος εἶ καὶ καλῶς σοι ἔσται.
vulg: labores manuum tuarum quia; manducabis beatus es et bene tibi erit
clem: Labores manuum tuarum quia manducabis: beatus es, et bene tibi erit.
kjv: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.

wlc: הִנֵּה נַחֲלַת יְהוָה בָּנִים שָׂכָר פְּרִי הַבָּטֶן ׃
lxx: ἡ γυνή σου ὡς ἄμπελος εὐθηνοῦσα ἐν τοῖς κλίτεσι τῆς οἰκίας οἱ υἱοί σου ὡς νεόφυτα ἐλαιῶν κύκλῳ τῆς τραπέζης σου. σου·
vulg: uxor tua sicut vitis abundans in lateribus domus tuae filii tui sicut novella olivarum in circuitu mensae tuae
clem: Uxor tua sicut vitis abundans in lateribus domus tu; filii tui sicut novell olivarum in circuitu mens tu.
kjv: Lo, children are an heritage of the Lord: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.

wlc: כְּחִצִּים בְּיַד־גִּבּוֹר כֵּן בְּנֵי הַנְּעוּרִים ׃
lxx: ἰδοὺ οὕτως εὐλογηθήσεται ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὁ φοβούμενος τὸν κύριον.
vulg: ecce sic benedicetur homo qui timet Dominum
clem: Ecce sic benedicetur homo qui timet Dominum.
kjv: As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man; so are children of the youth.

wlc: אַשְׁרֵי הַגֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר מִלֵּא אֶת־אַשְׁפָּתוֹ מֵהֶם לֹא־יֵבֹשׁוּ כִּי־יְדַבְּרוּ אֶת־אוֹיְבִים בַּשָּׁעַר ׃
lxx: ᾨδἡ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν. εὐλογήσαι σε Κύριος ἐκ Σιών, καὶ ἴδοις τὰ ἀγαθὰ Ἰερουσαλὴμ πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς ζωῆς σου,
vulg: benedicat te Dominus ex Sion et videas bona Hierusalem omnibus diebus vitae tuae
clem: Benedicat tibi Dominus ex Sion, et videas bona Jerusalem omnibus diebus vit tu.
kjv: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.

lxx: καὶ ἴδοις υἱοὺς τῶν υἱῶν σου. εἰρήνη ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰσραήλ.
vulg: et videas filios filiorum tuorum pax super Israhel
clem: Et videas filios filiorum tuorum: pacem super Isral.]

wlc: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת אַשְׁרֵי כָּל־יְרֵא יְהוָה הַהֹלֵךְ בִּדְרָכָיו ׃
lxx: Πλεονάκις ἐπολέμησάν με ἐκ νεότητός μου, εἰπάτω δὴ Ἰσραήλ·
vulg: canticum graduum saepe expugnaverunt me a iuventute mea dicat nunc Israhel
clem: Canticum graduum. [Spe expugnaverunt me a juventute mea, dicat nunc Isral;
kjv: Blessed is every one that feareth the Lord; that walketh in his ways.

wlc: יְגִיעַ כַּפֶּיךָ כִּי תֹאכֵל אַשְׁרֶיךָ וְטוֹב לָךְ ׃
lxx: πλεονάκις ἐπολέμησάν με ἐκ νεότητός μου, καὶ γὰρ οὐκ ἠδυνήθησαν μοι.
vulg: saepe expugnaverunt me a iuventute mea etenim non potuerunt mihi
clem: spe expugnaverunt me a juventute mea: etenim non potuerunt mihi.
kjv: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.

wlc: אֶשְׁתְּךָ כְּגֶפֶן פֹּרִיָּה בְּיַרְכְּתֵי בֵיתֶךָ בָּנֶיךָ כִּשְׁתִלֵי זֵיתִים סָבִיב לְשֻׁלְחָנֶךָ ׃
lxx: ἐπὶ τοῦ νώτου μου ἐτέκταινον οἱ ἁμαρτωλοί, ἀμάκρυναν τὴν ἀνομίαν αὐτῶν·
vulg: supra dorsum meum fabricabantur peccatores prolongaverunt iniquitatem suam
clem: Supra dorsum meum fabricaverunt peccatores; prolongaverunt iniquitatem suam.
kjv: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.

wlc: הִנֵּה כִי־כֵן יְבֹרַךְ גָּבֶר יְרֵא יְהוָה ׃
lxx: Κύριος δίκαιος συνέκοψεν αὐχένα ἁμαρτωλῶν·
vulg: Dominus iustus concidet cervices peccatorum
clem: Dominus justus concidit cervices peccatorum.
kjv: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the Lord.

wlc: יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהוָה מִצִּיּוֹן וּרְאֵה בְּטוּב יְרוּשָׁלִָם כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ ׃
lxx: αἰσχυνθήτωσαν καὶ ἀποστραφήτωσαν εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω πάντες οἱ μισοῦντες Σιών·
vulg: confundantur et convertantur retrorsum omnes qui oderunt Sion
clem: Confundantur, et convertantur retrorsum omnes qui oderunt Sion.
kjv: The Lord shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.

wlc: וּרְאֵה־בָנִים לְבָנֶיךָ שָׁלוֹם עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל ׃
lxx: ᾨδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν. γενηθήτωσαν ὡς χόρτος δωμάτων, ὃς πρὸ τοῦ ἐκσπασθῆναι ἐξηράνθη·
vulg: fiant sicut faenum tectorum quod priusquam evellatur exaruit
clem: Fiant sicut fnum tectorum, quod priusquam evellatur exaruit:
kjv: Yea, thou shalt see thy children's children, and peace upon Israel.

lxx: οὗ οὐκ ἐπλήρωσεν τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ὁ θερίζων, καὶ τὸν κόλπον αὐτοῦ ὁ τὰ δράγματα συλλέγων·
vulg: de quo non implevit manum suam qui metit et sinum suum qui manipulos colligit
clem: de quo non implevit manum suam qui metit, et sinum suum qui manipulos colligit.

lxx: καὶ οὐκ εἶπαν οἱ παράγοντες Εὐλογία Κυρίου ἐφʼ ἡμᾶς, εὐλογήσομεν ὑμᾶς ἐν ὀνόματι Κυρίου.
vulg: et non dixerunt qui praeteribant benedictio Domini super vos benediximus vobis in nomine Domini
clem: Et non dixerunt qui prteribant: Benedictio Domini super vos. Benediximus vobis in nomine Domini.]

wlc: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת רַבַּת צְרָרוּנִי מִנְּעוּרַי יֹאמַר־נָא יִשְׂרָאֵל ׃
lxx: Ἐκ βαθέων ἐκέκραξά σε. Κύριε·
vulg: canticum graduum de profundis clamavi ad te Domine
clem: Canticum graduum. [De profundis clamavi ad te, Domine;
kjv: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:

wlc: רַבַּת צְרָרוּנִי מִנְּעוּרָי גַּם לֹא־יָכְלוּ לִי ׃
lxx: Κύριε, εἰσάκουσον τῆς φωνῆς μου· γενηθήτω τὰ ὦτά σου προσέχοντα εἰς τὴν φωνὴν τῆς δεήσεώς μου.
vulg: Domine exaudi vocem meam fiant aures tuae intendentes in vocem deprecationis meae
clem: Domine, exaudi vocem meam. Fiant aures tu intendentes in vocem deprecationis me.
kjv: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.

wlc: עַל־גַּבִּי חָרְשׁוּ חֹרְשִׁים הֶאֱרִיכוּ לְמַעֲנוֹתָם ׃
lxx: ἐὰν ἀνομίαςς παρατηρήσῃ. Κύριε. Κύριε, τίς ὑποστήσηται;
vulg: si iniquitates observabis Domine Domine quis sustinebit
clem: Si iniquitates observaveris, Domine, Domine, quis sustinebit?
kjv: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.

wlc: יְהוָה צַדִּיק קִצֵּץ עֲבוֹת רְשָׁעִים ׃
lxx: ὅτι παρὰ σοὶ ὁ ἱλασμός ἐστιν. ἕνεκεν τοῦ ὀνόματός σου
vulg: quia apud te propitiatio est propter legem tuam sustinui te Domine sustinuit anima mea in verbum eius
clem: Quia apud te propitiatio est; et propter legem tuam sustinui te, Domine. Sustinuit anima mea in verbo ejus:
kjv: The Lord is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.

wlc: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיִסֹּגוּ אָחוֹר כֹּל שֹׂנְאֵי צִיּוֹן ׃
lxx: ὑπέμεινα, Κύριε· ὑπέμεινεν ἡ ψυχή μου εἰς τὸν νόμον αὐτοῦ.
vulg: speravit anima mea in Domino
clem: speravit anima mea in Domino.
kjv: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.

wlc: יִהְיוּ כַּחֲצִיר גַּגּוֹת שֶׁקַּדְמַת שָׁלַף יָבֵשׁ ׃
lxx: ἤλπισεν ἡ ψυχή μου ἐπὶ τὸν κύριον
vulg: a custodia matutina usque ad noctem speret Israhel in Domino
clem: A custodia matutina usque ad noctem, speret Isral in Domino.
kjv: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:

wlc: שֶׁלֹּא מִלֵּא כַפּוֹ קוֹצֵר וְחִצְנוֹ מְעַמֵּר ׃
lxx: ὅτι παρὰ τῷ κυρίῳ τὸ ἔλεος. καὶ πολλὴ παρ᾿ αὐτῷ λύτρωσις, ἀπὸ φυλακῆς πρωίας μέχρι νυκτός·
